projects.title: AGESDER Volunteers - 2026.06.L.1
projects.description:
The starting point of our project is to add a European element to our local activities and to provide information and opportunities for young people.As an association we carry out many activities in our province.In this context our aims are: -Adding a European element to our volunteering work.- Increasing the quality of our youth information activities.-Providing opportunities. -Fighting discrimination against women, youth and disabled people and removing obstacles for equal opportunities and participation in social and economic life.
Volunteers will do different activities:1° Organizing an English Speaking Club and, if they want, in their own language; 2° Creating social media content for AGESDER’s English learning Instagram account; 3° Preparing their own activities in any area that they are interested in (arts and culture, sustainable development, work life,book or movie club)
4.Social responsibility activities,...
Project Duration: 152 days
Travel Time: 2 days
Total: 154 days

projects.title: Heads High - ESC Project
projects.description:
📩 Send your CV and motivation letter to: tbexbix.evs@gmail.comCENTRU TBEXBIX is a vibrant socio-educational initiative empowering individuals through informal education and creative learning. Activities in English include theatre, music, visual arts, sports, yoga, and workshops promoting healthy lifestyles and nutrition. Participants discover their potential, build confidence, and develop new skills.

Through the European Solidarity Corps program, volunteers engage with children and the elderly, lead artistic workshops, organize excursions, and support community events—offering personal growth, cultural exchange, and social impact.🎥 Discover our activities:

projects.title: Healthy Body Camp II Part 2
projects.description: Since very young, people in the villages develop unhealthy eating disorders, lack of sports practice and have quite passive lifestyles, therefore, we want to provide a good perspective of what is "a healthy body", starting with understanding the state of physical health of the inhabitants. We plan to offer fun sport alternatives, in nature, teach and experiment healthy but delicious meals and teach about the consequences of unhealthy lifestyle. One subject of great importance is that of personal hygiene, especially in the Rroma communities we work with. The team will be consist in 6 volunteers, 1 in-country and 5 foreigners, that during the period of 3 weeks, will be part of the community and its development.

projects.title: MOMENTUM
projects.description:
Young people learn best through experience, participation, and real human connections. Momentum was created to offer volunteers a safe and inspiring environment where learning happens through action.
Many small communities face challenges such as limited youth opportunities, social isolation among elderly people, and reduced access to non-formal education. Through volunteering, participants become active contributors to positive change while discovering their own potential.
Momentum is not only about helping others — it is about building confidence, skills, and direction for the future.
By joining the project, volunteers will:
step outside their comfort zone
gain international experience
develop independence and responsibility
discover new cultures and perspectives
create meaningful social impact

projects.title: 4.0 The Power of Good Will
MAD MAX: Make Art from Discards – Maximize Arts
projects.description:
Reimagining Waste through Creativity, Dialogue, and Community Action
In Thessaloniki, a city shaped by centuries of cultural exchange and vibrant public life, MAD MAXS – Make Art from Discards emerges as a creative campaign under the framework of the European Solidarity Corps activity “Maximize Arts and Creativity Skills.” This initiative brings together young volunteers, artists, journalists, and community members to confront one of the most pressing challenges of modern urban life—waste and overconsumption—by transforming discarded materials into symbols of renewal and social reflection. Through recycled art installations in parks and public spaces, open debates on circular economy and sustainable living, a symposium connecting environmental thinkers and cultural practitioners, and youth-led journalism that documents and amplifies these conversations, the campaign turns creativity into a catalyst for change. 

4 PLACEMENTS left for males (pursuing gender balance)

projects.title: Short Term Volunteering In Bolu(Heart of Nature)
projects.description:
What We Offer:
Gain unique experience in sports management by working with our 850-person professional team. We provide free training in one of 30 sports branches (boxing, soccer, gymnastics, etc.). You will stay in a modern, 24/7 secured dormitory hosting national and Olympic athletes, with free access to a gym and sauna.
What We Expect:
We seek motivated volunteers to lead English and Spanish speaking clubs. Responsibilities include English-Spanish translations, supporting the Provincial Director in field operations, and organizing weekly social activities. You will also coordinate one major monthly event to promote the ESC program. Professionalism and adaptability to an official institution are essential

INFOPACK: https://www.canva.com/design/DAG9ZgaaGR4/GjPpE6Xosq9NfKljskcIhw/view?utm_content=DAG9ZgaaGR4&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=uniquelinks&utlId=hb456b1168c

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Laulasmaa School in Estonia
projects.description: Laulasmaa is a village in Northern Estonia on the shore of Lahepere Bay and is 29 km away from the capital. Laulasmaa School is an organisation which is made up of three schools and three kindergartens at Laulasmaa, Klooga and Lehola.  The school and the kindergarten at Laulasmaa are the biggest. It has 280 pupils and 85 employees, and provides primary education. The kindergarten has 126 children from the age of 1-6. Laulasmaa School maintains and develops Estonian culture by paying attention to Estonian language and the study of culture. In addition to the traditional subjects, the students learn folklore, crafts, art, folk dances, choir songs, music. Also, the children take part in hobby classes, contests and other projects. Laulasmaa School knows that non-formal learning is important. During breaks, the school offers the children a variety of activities. More information and how to apply: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/laulasmaa-school/

projects.title: Building Solidarity Vol 4
projects.description:
Stagones Social Cooperative is looking for two volunteers, 18-30 years old, to spend 4 months with us from May to October 2026 in the frame of the ESC programme.

Main activities during this period will be gardening/permaculture, natural building, woodwork but also collecting herbs and plants. Furthermore organization and support of workshops on self-directed education, arts and well being. Our daily rhythm will be mostly calm, with 4-5 hours of work in the morning hours so afternoons are free. The exact flow will be determined in collaboration with the volunteers, according to the project's needs.

projects.title: Volunteering For a Better World
projects.description: Volunteering within our project involves engaging in daily non-formal educational, child-centered activities for children and young people from day centers, schools for kids with special needs, nurseries, primary schools, after-school programs, and kindergartens in disadvantaged areas of Reșița (Calnic), Bocșa, Dognecea, and Ocna de Fier. Volunteers will help facilitate learning experiences that foster tolerance, inclusion, and social skills. Additionally, we organize cultural and volunteering activities that promote values such as solidarity and voluntary work, and encourage positive interaction within the community. During the summer, volunteers will take part as team members in short-term projects, wearing personalized t-shirts, where they will have the opportunity to lead teams and help facilitate team-building activities, allowing them to improve their leadership and collaboration skills.

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Võru Kindergarten Punamütsike in Estonia
projects.description: This European Solidarity Corps volunteering project takes place at Kindergarten Punamütsike in Võru, a municipality kindergarten with over 40 years of history. The volunteer supports teachers in daily activities with children aged 1.6–7, helping with play, creative learning, outdoor activities, and special events such as theme weeks, festivals, and excursions. The kindergarten has strong traditions of family and community involvement and long experience working with children with special needs. Volunteers can also experience local culture, community events, and the beautiful nature of Võru County while developing new skills and intercultural understanding. The project offers a great opportunity to gain experience in youth work while contributing to a friendly and supportive kindergarten environment. MORE INFORMATION & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/voru-punamutsike-kindergarten/

projects.title: Green management & sport monitoring in Belgium
projects.description: The Outsider is a center for young people to spend their holiday. We have one center to host 72 people and another for 24 people. In addition we also orginize a number of leisure,outdoor activities such as canoeing,laser battle, survival workshops, teambulding activities and many more. All our activities are focused on increasing the feeling of personal and social responsibility, sustainable enviromental education and helping the development of life leading skills. We focus on organizing international exchanges intiated and developed by our target group itself under our mentoring and overall support. Our organization gives the possibility to discover and develop hidden resources through real adventures and challenges. Next to monitoring groups is the green management on the domain a main task. Creating new natural places and maintaining the wild grown.

projects.title: A discovery of nature and adventure by guiding outdoor sports
projects.description: VZW Het Moerashuis is a center for young people to spend their holiday and free time. We have one center to host 72 people and another for 24 people. In addition we also orginize a number of leisure,outdoor activities such as canoeing,laserbattle, survival workshops, teambulding activities and many more. All our activities are focused on increasing the feeling of personal and social responsibility, sustainable enviromental education and helping the development of life leading skills. We focus on organizing international exchanges intiated and developed by our target group itself under our mentoring and overall support. Our organization gives the possibility to discover and develop hidden resources through real adventures and challenges. The target group of our organizations are schools, youngsters of sports clubs, youth movements and families. The activities take place during weekdays, weekends and holidays relating the volunteers.

projects.title: Live, Work, and Thrive in an Alpine Ecovillage & Seminar Center Sulzbrunn - 2026
projects.description: This internship offers a unique chance to live and work in an ecological community. We run a seminar center and an organic farm with vegetables, orchards, sheep and cattle. We manage our own forest and are renovating our buildings ecologically. Your role will be diverse and hands-on. You will help cook organic meals for seminar guests, assist with cleaning guest rooms, help organise our annual family festival, work on renovation projects, cultivate vegetables, and develop your own projects.  After a comprehensive introduction and practical experience in all areas, you will be able to choose a focus based on your interests and strengths, and bring your own ideas to life. While responsibilities at the seminar center form the core of the internship, additional tasks can be tailored to match your personal interests. If you enjoy working in a team, enjoy meaningful interaction with people, and find fulfilment in creative and practical work, then Sulzbrunn is the ideal place for you.

projects.title: Through the Seasons - ESC Volunteering at Re‑Green 2026
projects.description: Join a 2-12 month immersive ESC experience in the mountains of Seliana, Peloponnese, Greece. Open to young people aged 18-30 who are resident in Belgium, this program invites you into a landscape of extraordinary natural beauty - nestled between the wildlife reserves of Mount Chelmos and Mount Kyllini, home to rich biodiversity and thriving ecosystems. The valley hosts an international eco‑village community, organically grown over the years, offering daily intercultural exchange and shared learning. You’ll explore permaculture, regenerative gardening, zero‑waste living, climate adaptation, nature restoration, and community life. The program follows the rhythm of the land - from the quiet introspection of winter to the abundance of summer - offering real skills, personal growth, and space for your own projects. All costs are covered by ESC, and no experience is required - just curiosity, openness, and a willingness to live and learn in community.

projects.title: Národní dobrovolnictví - Krátkodobé
projects.description:
Dobrovolnický projekt je realizován v rámci programu European Solidarity Corps a je otevřen národním dobrovolníkům, kteří chtějí získat zkušenosti, rozvíjet své dovednosti a zapojit se do aktivit organizace.

Role dobrovolníků není pevně daná – jejich zapojení se přizpůsobuje jejich zájmům, schopnostem a potřebám organizace. Dobrovolníci se mohou podílet například na asistenci při vzdělávacích aktivitách, pomoci při práci s dětmi a mládeží, podpoře volnočasových programů, základní IT podpoře, organizačních úkolech nebo pomoci se správou a chodem budovy.

Cílem projektu je vytvořit prostředí, ve kterém si dobrovolníci mohou vyzkoušet různé činnosti, získat nové zkušenosti a aktivně přispět k fungování organizace i místní komunity. Dobrovolníci jsou také vítáni, aby přinášeli vlastní nápady a iniciativy.

Dobrovolník vždy pracuje pod dohledem kvalifikovaného pracovníka organizace nebo mentora, který mu poskytuje podporu, vedení a zpětnou vazbu během celého projektu.

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Keila Youth Center in Estonia
projects.description: This European Solidarity Corps project takes place at Keila Youth Centre in Keila. The volunteer supports youth workers in the daily activities of the youth centre and helps create a safe, welcoming, and inclusive environment for young people aged 7–16. The centre offers a variety of activities where young people can spend their free time in a meaningful way, including creative workshops, sports activities, movie evenings, and different events. The volunteer engages with young people in the open youth space, supports their ideas and initiatives, and assists in organising activities, workshops, and special events such as youth nights and cultural evenings. The project provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in youth work, develop communication and organisational skills, and take part in intercultural exchange while contributing to the local community. FOR MORE INFO & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/keila-youth-center/

projects.title: Youth Empowerment Project 1 April 2026 - 16 June 2026(2 & a half months)
projects.description:
🌍 ESC Volunteering Opportunity with ABS!

📌 About the Project:
Join Active Bulgarian Society (ABS) in empowering youth and promoting sustainability, eco-friendly initiatives, and European values! As an ESC volunteer, you’ll help spread awareness of Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps opportunities through interactive events, workshops, and outreach activities.

📩 Apply now and start your ESC adventure with ABS! 🚀

projects.title: Bring happiness to social centre in Slovakia
projects.description: The volunteers will organize free time activities for young people with disabilities and seniors from the NGO Barlicka. The young people from Barlicka are 18+ years old. The activities will be organized during daily summer camp – trips, competitions, and games. Most of young people and seniors are on wheelchairs. Volunteers with camp leaders will plan activities and program in advance. On first work day volunteers will have short training how to manage the wheelchair and they will get information about young people and seniors from Barlicka. There are no special skills required. Important is motivation, empathy and proactive creation and organization of activities. The staff of social centre will be guiding the volunteers during the work. The working hours are from Monday to Friday divided as follows: 9:00 – 12:00 and 13:00 – 15:30. In case of any questions, contact Monika on inex@inex.sk. Please, don't write to Barlicka Association.

projects.title: ESCalade Volunteering Mountain 5: DISABLED PEOPLE
projects.description: Coop. soc. Kara Bobowski is looking for 2 volunteers to be hosted in Modigliana (Italy), to work in a residential center for PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES. Our main aim is INCLUSION, and we host also young people with fewer opportunities. The volunteer will be part of a team of 4 long-term volunteers from different nationalities. In the residential center for people with disabilities there will be a team of 2 volunteers, working on the morning or afternoon shift, 5 days a week. The volunteers will support the staff with the daily activities like creativity, games, gardening, music, reading, walking, eating, cooking workshop, and so on. It will be giving the possibility to create new activities connected with the volunteer's interests or hobby.

projects.title: Leisure activities in a Disabled Adult House
projects.description:
The Maison d'Accueil Spécialisée Marc Toussaint is a lodging and day care center for adults with heavy physical disabilities. The center is in the suburbs of Reims, in Cormontreuil, located 45 min from Paris by train. The volunteer will take part in leisure activities (animations) such as manual workshops, well-being activities, outings, boardgames, and adapted sport activities, cooking workshops, make-up activities, etc. He/She might work with another European volunteer, French volunteers and two activity leaders. Having a basic knowledge of the French language is necessary. Discover testimonies of former volunteers at the Maison d'Accueil Spécialisée Marc Toussaint by following this link : 

https://www.canva.com/design/DAGiuhANIe4/_KJ9JmPzpcyhWbjUTdnhOQ/view?utm_content=DAGiuhANIe4&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=uniquelinks&utlId=hb9c717c772

projects.title: Long-term Volunteering to Support Youth and Children
projects.description: We will work about youth work ,children and refugees.Volunteers will help the staff and work on the associations activities.Our local partners will be included to our local various activities.During our activities;Non-Formal Education,Outdoor Activities,Visual Presentations will be implemented.They will develop new projects and experience the project development or the young people with fewer opportunities and they will have opportunity to discuss about the problems which we can face during the implementation of projects and they will gain competences about quality management. The duration of the project activities is 6 months for long-term volunteers.

projects.title: Join for a better future ! In Grand Est
projects.description:
TWO MONTHS PROJECT : Join the team of the local antenna of Solidarités Jeunesses in Alsace ! You will live in the hosting center where the international workcamps take place, in the heart of the action ! As a volunteer, you will be actively involved in the collective and daily life of the house: logistical support for group arrivals and departures, accompanying groups in discovering and understanding the rules of the house, collective life, and organization, logistical support for organizing meals and food stocks, etc. You will also participate in various activities organized as part of the workcamps: international meals, excursions, barbecue evenings, etc. 
It is preferable to have a driving license.
If you enjoy living and organizing yourself in a collective, intercultural encounters, and want to spend a summer working on international projects, this project is for you!

projects.title: Volunteering in the Youth Center II
projects.description:
Face Club is a youth centre in the heart of Spišská Belá — an open space where local kids and young people come to learn, create, move and connect. As a volunteer, you become a real part of the team: co-creating workshops, running English days, sports days, film nights and creative sessions, helping plan holiday programmes or occasionally joining events with our partner organisations.

Imagine spending your afternoon helping a 10-year-old discover they love painting, your evening planning untraditional sports festival with teenagers, and your night time playing som table tennis with your colleagues. That's a Tuesday at Face Club.

No two weeks look the same. You'll help prepare the space, bring your own ideas, and grow into better version of yourself.
Whether you can commit for 5 months or a full year — we we adapt to your life situation.

Check our infopack here: https://acesse.one/infopack-faceclub-slovakia

projects.title: Art & nature development at Slovak countryside
projects.description: Pôtoň is an independent theatre and art centre located in the village of Bátovce in rural Slovakia. After the recent renovation of our cultural house, we are entering a new phase of development and are looking for two volunteers for an 8–12 month stay to become part of our team. Volunteers will join the daily life of the centre and help us take care of the space while supporting our cultural activities. The work includes maintenance of the centre, cleaning of shared spaces, gardening in the Park of Arts (watering plants, mowing grass and seasonal care), and technical or production assistance during cultural events such as performances, workshops and residencies. Depending on your interests and skills, you may also develop small activities for local residents or your own creative project, and contribute with photography, graphics or documentation. We are looking for motivated and flexible people who are curious about working in an independent cultural centre in a rural environment.

projects.title: Volunteering at the House of Generations in Kaunas: Connecting Through Care
projects.description:
Looking for a volunteering experience that is REAL, meaningful, and full of human connection? Welcome to the House of Generations in Kaunas 💛
Here, every day is different. You’ll become part of a unique community where around 40 seniors and young mothers with their children share the same space -creating a powerful mix of stories, energy, challenges, and growth.
As a volunteer, you won’t sit on the sidelines. You’ll help organise fun activities, bring new ideas, support daily routines, teach simple language or digital skills, and most importantly - build genuine relationships. One moment you might be dancing or playing games at the Day Centre, the next you could be helping a young mum feel more confident about everyday life.
This is not just about helping others - it’s about discovering yourself too. You’ll grow your patience, empathy, creativity, and confidence while experiencing what true intergenerational solidarity feels like 🌍🤝

projects.title: Art in Action - Volunteering at Kaunas Artists’ House
projects.description:
🎨✨ Want to experience Kaunas through creativity and real cultural action? Volunteer at Kaunas Artists’ House — a vibrant space where new ideas, artistic experiments, and diverse communities come together. Here you won’t just attend events — you’ll help shape them, connect with inspiring people, and explore what contemporary culture really means 🌍⚡
As a volunteer, you’ll get hands-on experience from day one. You might help design and lead creative workshops with teenagers, prepare venues and shape the atmosphere before events, welcome guests from all over the world, or spread the word about cultural activities to foreigners living in Kaunas. You’ll also collaborate with local volunteers to organise parts of bigger festivals and happenings — and even develop your own mini-project based on your passions and the organisation’s values 🚀
Join Kaunas Artists’ House to build skills, meet artists, unleash your creativity, and be part of a vibrant cultural community 💥

projects.title: Supporting Children with Disabilities – ESC Volunteering at SA Perekodu in Viljandi, Estonia
projects.description: Foundation Perekodu in Viljandi County provides a supportive and caring environment for children and youth with mental or physical disabilities. Through its diverse services, the organization aims to enhance their quality of life, foster independence, and create opportunities for growth. Perekodu offers childcare, support for daily activities, rehabilitation, and aftercare. It houses a nursery and school for children aged 1.5 to 19, where volunteers can engage in creative activities, play, and social support. Rehabilitation services benefit over 100 children annually, with experts providing tailored therapy programs. Volunteers can make a meaningful difference by supporting children in their daily routines and organizing activities. This is a rewarding opportunity to build connections, gain valuable experience, and contribute to a positive change in their lives. FOR MORE INFORMATION & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/viljandi-perekodu-center/

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Pühalepa Community Centre – Hiiumaa Island, Estonia
projects.description: The volunteering project takes place at Pühalepa Vaba Aja Keskus, a multifunctional community and youth centre located on the island of Hiiumaa. The centre plays an important role in local community life by organising cultural, educational, and recreational activities for people of all ages, with a special focus on young people. Through various events, workshops, and community initiatives, the centre encourages creativity, active participation, and social interaction. The project offers volunteers the opportunity to become actively involved in the daily life of the centre while gaining valuable experience in youth work and community engagement. Volunteers support different activities and events, interact with young people and community members, and contribute their own ideas and skills to the centre’s programmes. MORE INFO & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/puhalepa-community-centre/

projects.title: Circus pedagogy & artistic development at CirKusKus IV.
projects.description: CirKusKus will focus on the artistic & pedagogical development of the volunteer. The activity will begin with an initiation circus pedagogy. Next, the volunteer shall be involved in both pedagogical & artistic activities, being the assistant teacher at different circus courses, and sharing the love and knowledge for new circus at different events. The volunteer has the opportunity to develop their own act, as well as join the existing shows that are currently touring. Additionally, the volunteer will perform administrative tasks that are related to the circus school. The volunteer will carry out tasks such as: Leading games and assisting and ensuring the safety with kids during weekly multi-circus lessons and the summer camps, explaining the basics of circus during workshops and events to the general public, attending one-off events, giving a workshop or a show, performing in the CirKusKus variety show. Volunteer prepares workshops, own project, and related tasks.

projects.title: Circus pedagogy & community building at CirKusKus IV.
projects.description: CirKusKus will focus on organising skills & graphic design & pedagogical development. The activity will begin with an initiation into circus pedagogy. Afterwards, the volunteer will be involved in both pedagogical and organisational activities. The volunteer will have the opportunity to organise their own activities for the circus community. The volunteer will carry out tasks: taking photos/videos and editing them, writing texts, preparing designs for social media, making posters; leading opening games, assisting and ensuring the safety of kids during weekly multi-circus lessons and the summer camps, explaining basics of circus during workshops and events to the general public, attending one-off events, posting content on social media/setting up and boosting campaigns, organising the festival’s workshops, volunteers or waste management, organising artistic workshops during the Slovak Artist Community meetings. The tasks can be adjusted to the volunteer's interests.

projects.title: Beja Factum
projects.description: This project focuses on community intervention between Beja and Montijo, with the volunteer being based in Beja for the majority of the duration. Working closely with a local youth association, the main tasks involve the physical improvement of the space through mural painting and gardening, as well as direct engagement with the local population. The volunteer will also be responsible for preparing and leading outreach sessions in schools to promote the ESC among local students. Most of the project will take place in the city of Beja. As planned from the beginning, the experience includes traveling to Montijo to collaborate with Omnis Factum. In this phase, the volunteer integrates into our ongoing activities with the community and local schools. This dual approach allows for a transition from practical, hands-on maintenance to the organization of social initiatives. The goal is to develop skills in teamwork, public speaking, and event planning across two different regions.

projects.title: Supporting Rural Youth
projects.description: La Voix de l’Enfant Rural (The Voice of the Rural Child) is a non-profit association based in Médenine, Tunisia. Founded in 2011, the association is dedicated to the protection, education, and empowerment of children and youth, especially in rural areas. PROJECT OBJECTIVES: - Foster the personal and civic engagement of youth in rural areas. - Promote creative media and radio as tools for youth expression. - Encourage intercultural exchange and dialogue. - Raise awareness on children's rights, citizenship, and volunteering. MAIN ACTIVITIES: - Support the production of radio shows and podcasts with local youth. - Participate in awareness campaigns on children’s rights and civic responsibility. - Organize and lead workshops on creative arts, media, or mobility’s topics. - Assist with the communication and promotion of association activities (social media, photography, reporting). - Support youth initiatives and intercultural events

projects.title: Volunteering For a Better World
projects.description: Volunteering within our project involves engaging in daily non-formal educational, child-centered activities for children and young people from day centers, schools for kids with special needs, nurseries, primary schools, after-school programs, and kindergartens in disadvantaged areas of Reșița (Calnic), Bocșa, Dognecea, and Ocna de Fier. Volunteers will help facilitate learning experiences that foster tolerance, inclusion, and social skills. Additionally, we organize cultural and volunteering activities that promote values such as solidarity and voluntary work, and encourage positive interaction within the community. During the summer, volunteers will take part as team members in short-term projects, wearing personalized t-shirts, where they will have the opportunity to lead teams and help facilitate team-building activities, allowing them to improve their leadership and collaboration skills.

projects.title: Creative leisure and cultural diversity
projects.description: Our project aims to, with the help of volunteers from other cultures, offer creative leisure engagements to the participants in our youth activities in the municipality of Sundsvall, that originates from their needs and interests. The basis for these activities is that everybody is welcome, regardless of ethnical and socioeconomically background, physical or psychological disability, religious outlook, gender and sexual orientation. A solidarity approach will saturate all activities that the volunteers will participate in or operate themselves. In short terms the project aims to increase all youth’s participation and engagement in their own leisure time on a local social level. In the long term we expect the volunteers to influence the activities with their own experiences and knowledge from their respective countries, in order to strengthen the young people's views on democracy and European citizenship. We think this will improve their ability to meet social challenges.

projects.title: Conservation opportunity in Western Uganda
projects.description:
The volunteer sent by Viatores Christi -Ireland  will work on the AVCA (Amplifying Voice for Climate Action) project. This  is an ESC Humanitarian Aid initiative in Uganda, hosted by VC Uganda with the Justice and Peace Commission Hoima and the Bulindi Chimpanzee and Community Project. Hoima faces environmental pressures from population growth, oil development, deforestation, and habitat loss, affecting local livelihoods and biodiversity. Volunteers support environmental education, tree planting, habitat restoration, conservation awareness, and sustainable agriculture in schools, communities, and conservation areas. Typical work is Monday to Friday, 35 hours per week, combining fieldwork, engagement, and reflection. The project aims to strengthen environmental awareness, foster practical climate action, support locally led sustainable development, and promote intercultural learning between volunteers and host communities.
VC -INFO-PACK-UGANDA-2026-2027 at https://shorturl.at/HKWSv

projects.title: Fair Play for All
projects.description:
The use of theater art to foster acceptance of diversity and strengthening social inclusion process. Volunteers will work on presenting fair play rules through theater tools to the kids of the “UMOJA-ENOSI” fc. By learning to follow the rules, cooperate with others, and accept victory or defeat with dignity, children and volunteers (volunteers as well) could develop social and emotional skills such as empathy, acceptance of diversity and mutual respect. 
The 1st week will be introductory, preparatory and educational. The volunteers will get to know each other through theater games and get in touch with the kids introducing the topic of fair play.
The volunteers will explore and share the rules of fair play and stories of racism in football in order to be more familiar with the topic.
The 2nd week volunteers will prepare the interactive performance, (based on Forum Theater methods) which will be presented at the football field. Find more info in:  https://canva.link/5c7m9h9ir2jnhp5

projects.title: Join for a better future ! In Vaunières
projects.description: The Hameau de Vaunières is an old village whose oldest buildings datefrom the 17th century. Converted into collective lodgings, workshops orparty rooms, they now host a large part of the activity of the Youth Villages. The organisation was born in 1964, from the dual desire to promote social, cultural and generational decompartmentalization between people from diverse backgrounds and to revive abandoned sites in rural areas. . Its particularity is to be established on two sites located in the Hautes-Alpes: the Hameau de Vaunières. The missions of the volunteers are diverse and vary according to the season. Throughout the duration of their volunteering, volunteers will be involved in welcoming groups, in ongoing projects. They can choose the place they want to hold. This can be dicussed and decided together with the permanent team. Missions specific during the summer can be  : gardening, animation of the technical workshops with the groups, logistic support to host the groups

projects.title: Wildlife rehabilitation assistant: advanced project
projects.description: You take your share in the daily work at the Wildlife Rehab centre. Step by step, we will introduce you to our way of working and the strict protocols that we follow. Being keen to learn is essential. In the beginning, you will mainly perform basic task and assist a more experienced volunteer or staff member. Do take in mind that at our centre everyone should undertake all sorts of work: feeding and weighing the animals, preparing food, but also cleaning cages, dishes, laundry and mopping floors. You have to pursue administrative discipline and follow certain hygienic procedures. Being flexible is essential since wildlife does not have a clock to follow. During your project, you will learn how to rehabilitate all types of birds and mammals, how to tube animals and how to help oiled wildlife. You will work together with a big group of motivated volunteers (locals, interns, older people), where a good team spirit is important.

projects.title: Técnico/a de apoyo en Gestión de Proyectos de Justicia Climática y Territorio- Aguachica
projects.description:
En el marco del proyecto “EVER: European Volunteering for Environment and Resilience” colaborarás con MPDL Colombia apoyando sus proyectos desde una perspectiva de género y de derechos humanos, contribuyendo también a iniciativas de justicia climática con enfoque de apropiación del territorio y fortalecimiento de capacidades comunitarias. Las personas voluntarias apoyarán actividades de visibilidad, comunicación y acompañamiento en las zonas de actuación, así como la consolidación del modelo integral de construcción de paz y el fortalecimiento de procesos locales y organizativos. Formarás parte de Movimiento por la Paz, una organización pacifista, feminista y antirracista con más de 40 años de trayectoria y compromiso social. 
La jornada será de 30 a 38 horas semanales, con acompañamiento, formación continua y seguimiento. Las actividades tendrán lugar en Aguachica, con posibles desplazamientos a comunidades cercanas en la región del Sur de Bolívar donde se implementan los proyectos.

projects.title: Técnico/a de apoyo MEAL (Monitoreo, Evaluación, Aprendizaje y Rendición de Cuentas) en Tumaco
projects.description: ¿Te gustaría ser parte de un proyecto que promueve la igualdad de género y defiende los derechos de las mujeres? En el marco del proyecto “IdeM: Igualdad y Derechos de las Mujeres en América Latina”, colaborarás con MPDL Colombia apoyando los diferentes proyectos en el país, con un enfoque en monitoreo, evaluación, aprendizaje y rendición de cuentas (MEAL), desde una perspectiva de género y de protección de los derechos humanos. Además, formarás parte de Movimiento por la Paz, una organización pacifista, feminista y antirracista con más de 40 años luchando por un mundo más justo. La persona voluntaria tendrá una jornada de 30 a 38 horas semanales, ajustada a las necesidades de la organización, y contará con acompañamiento y formación continua. Las actividades principales tendrán lugar en Tumaco con posibles desplazamientos a comunidades cercanas donde se implementan proyectos.

projects.title: The education - a key to a better future
projects.description: Don Bosko Bulgaria foundation hosts volunteers since 2010. Till 2025 we hosted over 50 volunteers - long term and short term under the programmes EVS and ESC. We work in town of Stara Zagora mainly with Romany children and young people and their families. True the project "The education - a key to a better future" we want to support the children and young people who will work with in their formal, non-formal and in-formal education. We have a Center for children and young people - Center Don Bosko. In the center we do study rooms, art workshops, skaut meetings, meetings for girls, music and sports. We also do winter and summer camps, excursions and educational trips. We are looking for 2 long term volunteers who will help with the activities in the Center - depending on their own interests and skills. The volunteers will study Bulgarian language. The activities start on the 15. of September 2025 and end on the 15. of August 2026.

projects.title: Volontariat Calvisano, Italie
projects.description: « Binario Solidale » promeut l'inclusion sociale, le développement durable et l'engagement communautaire actif en milieu rural, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur les activités éducatives et créatives destinées aux enfants et aux jeunes. Les volontaires apporteront leur soutien aux activités périscolaires, aux jeux en plein air, aux ateliers créatifs et à l'apprentissage informel, tant au sein de l'organisation que dans les écoles locales. Ils contribueront également à l'organisation d'initiatives interculturelles (telles que des ateliers, des soirées jeux, des soirées cinéma et des rassemblements communautaires) et apporteront leur soutien aux activités de communication, notamment sur les réseaux sociaux, le montage vidéo et la création de supports promotionnels.

projects.title: Creative Youth Worker & Outreach Volunteer
projects.description:
We are a Romanian organisation working with young people, running a Youth Hub in Bucharest for teenagers aged 15–19. It’s an open, dynamic space where young people come daily to connect, explore ideas and take part in non-formal learning activities.

We are looking for a volunteer to support us in promoting the Youth Hub and making its activities visible through social media and direct outreach.

Your role will combine content creation and direct work with young people: capturing photos and videos, creating content for social media, and showing what youth work looks like in practice. At the same time, you will be involved in outreach activities – joining school visits, outdoor activities and working directly with teenagers.

You will be part of a small, supportive team and an active youth community where your ideas and initiative are encouraged.

projects.title: Discovering diversity and improving human rights of vulnerable people. Involvement and engagement in communities with people with fewer opportunities and/or with mild disabilities.
projects.description:
- Increase the social well-being in special communities by helping people in need, especially young people, mild disabilities disadvantaged persons, through daily support activities and promoting participation and social welfare and inclusion.
- together with dedicated professional staff, assist in providing educational support, create an inclusive and stimulating environment, promote personal development of people in need, solidarity and human’s rights defence
- plan, implement and participate in recreational activities (games, music course /plays, sports activities, theatre, Pet Therapy, and so on); 
- accompany special need people in their daily routine and recreational activities/laboratories;  Spend time with them in different environmental setting, outdoor activities, short trips....
- Accompany and support youth with learning difficulties or psychological support in fragile family situations ; afternoon school support for kids

projects.title: Seeds of Solidarity 5.
projects.description:
Looking for a long-term volunteering experience where you can grow, take initiative, and make a real impact?
Seeds of Solidarity is an ESC project running for over a decade in rural Hungary. As part of an international team, you will work with children and young people in schools and youth centers, especially those with fewer opportunities. You will design and deliver interactive activities, support community programmes, and teach English through non-formal methods. Your work will have a visible impact — while you gain hands-on experience in youth work and develop your ideas with professional support. You will be involved in both outreach youth work in villages and activities at the Egyesek Youth Center, combining fieldwork with a stable community place
👉 Apply here: https://bit.ly/3PYMgrO
👉 Learn more: https://bit.ly/4rR6eC4

projects.title: The Machers - long term volunteering for Jewish Culture Festival in Kraków
projects.description:
JOIN US FOR A LONG-TERM VOLUNTEERING EXPERIENCE and help us create the 35th edition of Jewish Culture Festival!

Where? 
Kraków, Poland
How long? 
3 months, starting from 15.05

 Who are we looking for?
- one person with graphic design skills (it would be great if you knew your way around Canva and/or Photoshop) and who’s ready to be a part of our adventure!

 What we can offer?
- a chance to meet new people, help create a community and see how the Festival is run from behind the scene
- an opportunity to help us work with Studio Otwarte, an award-winning branding agency
- as a part of European Solidarity Corps programme we cover expenses such as travel, accommodation and pocket money

Don't miss the chance to get to know how one of the largest Jewish culture festivals worldwide is made!

APPLY NOW and send us your CV and portfolio at: themachers@jewishfestival.pl

If you have any questions don’t hesitate to contact us!

projects.title: The Machers: volunteering at the Jewish Culture Festival in Kraków
projects.description: Jewish Culture Festival in Kraków is one of the biggest of the cultural events in Poland and the staple of Kraków's musical and social scene since 1988. The Machers - our group of volunteers form all over the world - participate and co-create all of the Festival's events, including concerts, workshops, lectures and sightseeings. During the preparator period before the start of the Festival, they participate in the meetings with the members of the local Jewish community and discover the historical and cultural background of Jewish people in Poland. They also learn about the behind-the-scenes organisation of large scale cultural events. All the Machers are also invited to develop their own projects, in order to learn, gain experience, make new friends and participate in the multucultural society.

projects.title: Conservation Opportunity in Western Uganda
projects.description:
The volunteer sent by VC Dublin will work on the AVCA (Amplifying Voice for Climate Action) project, This is an ESC Humanitarian Aid initiative in Uganda, hosted by VC Uganda with the Justice and Peace Commission Hoima and the Bulindi Chimpanzee and Community Project. Hoima faces environmental pressures from population growth, oil development, deforestation, and habitat loss, affecting local livelihoods and biodiversity. Volunteers support environmental education, tree planting, habitat restoration, conservation awareness, and sustainable agriculture in schools, communities, and conservation areas. Typical work is Monday to Friday, 35 hours per week, combining fieldwork, engagement, and reflection. The project aims to strengthen environmental awareness, foster practical climate action, support locally led sustainable development, and promote intercultural learning between volunteers and host communities.

VC -INFO-PACK-UGANDA-2026-2027 available at https://shorturl.at/HKWSv

projects.title: Digital discoveries
projects.description:
Our daily center Lumea Lui Pinocchio has the main mission to support disadvantaged children by offering them a safe space. Every day, the children benefit from non-formal educational activities, help with their homework, as well as a warm lunch and snack.
Most of the children come from the Roma community, where families often face high levels of illiteracy and unemployment. 
Social media plays a vital role in supporting the promotion of The Pinocchio Center’s daily activities and programs. 
Tasks:
Creating content (pictures and posts) for the center’s social media platforms.
Promote events and highlight activities
Community Engagement: managing interactions on social media.
Collaborate with Staff: work with them to gather information and visuals
Propose digitalization activities for the kids 
Assist the children with their homework
Work alongside staff and other volunteers to foster a supportive, inclusive environment for the children.

projects.title: Social Inclusion
projects.description:
The volunteering experience takes place in a social organization working with people in situations of high social vulnerability, including children, young people and adults. Volunteers support daily activities focused on care, inclusion and community participation. This includes accompanying children in their routines, assisting with educational and recreational activities, and contributing to a safe and respectful environment.

In addition, volunteers collaborate in the general functioning of the organization, supporting tasks related to social inclusion, teamwork and community life. Depending on their interests, they may also contribute to communication tasks, helping to document activities and share the project’s impact.

The experience is designed as a learning process, where volunteers actively engage, take responsibility and develop personal, social and intercultural skills through direct involvement in real contexts.

projects.title: Growing with music and art
projects.description:

Prepare visual art classes,

Facilitate storytelling and creative writing activities to boost imagination and language skills.
Offer encouragement and support to shy or hesitant participants through a positive environment for them to feel comfortable.
Assist the children with their homework
Work alongside staff and other volunteers to foster a supportive, inclusive environment.

projects.title: Sports as a tool for well-being
projects.description:

projects.title: Volunteers for Forest Family Club Kaluznicek
projects.description:
Forest Family Club Kaluzníček (www.kaluznicek.cz) was founded as one of the first outdoor nursery schools in the Czech Republic. It is located in the village of Lomnička, near the town of Tišnov. From Tišnov, there is a good train connection to Brno (27 km), the second largest city in the country.
Kaluzníček is a small nursery school with a maximum of 18 children (aged 3–7) per day and 2–3 pedagogical staff. We emphasize learning through natural experiences and plenty of outdoor activities. There is generous space for free play, creativity, and projects, both outdoors and indoors — the club operates in a yurt, beside a stream and forest.
Volunteers contribute by actively taking part in daily activities, sharing their passions, or simply spending time with the children. They can also join a wider community of families and volunteers connected to Kaluzníček and nearby alternative schools (Montessori, democratic, etc.).

projects.title: Volunteering For a Better World
projects.description: Volunteering within our project involves engaging in daily non-formal educational, child-centered activities for children and young people from day centers, schools for kids with special needs, nurseries, primary schools, after-school programs, and kindergartens in disadvantaged areas of Reșița (Calnic), Bocșa, Dognecea, and Ocna de Fier. Volunteers will help facilitate learning experiences that foster tolerance, inclusion, and social skills. Additionally, we organize cultural and volunteering activities that promote values such as solidarity and voluntary work, and encourage positive interaction within the community. During the summer, volunteers will take part as team members in short-term projects, wearing personalized t-shirts, where they will have the opportunity to lead teams and help facilitate team-building activities, allowing them to improve their leadership and collaboration skills.

projects.title: Musical Animal Farm de Goerge Orwell
projects.description: El objeto de este proyecto será la de reunir un grupo de Italianos y Españoles con la finalidad de representar una versión musical de Animal Farm en diversos escenarios municipales de la Comunidad Valenciana y en especial aquéllos afectados por la Dana. La versión propuesta es una obra original del Maestro Marco Maiello cantada con música de cámara interpretada en directo por el grupo italiano. El grupo español se encargará de la escenografía y lo formarán actores y actrices preferentemente con capacidad de cantar. El proyecto puede transformarse en un Intercambio Juvenil Erasmus Plus si las condiciones lo requieren

projects.title: Short-Term Project-,,Volunteering For a Better World"
projects.description: Our ESC volunteering for a better world project aims to improve the area where we live, bring people closer together, increase civic engagement and combat discrimination and racism. Our activities will focus on painting the walls of schools where children from disadvantaged backgrounds learn, setting up greenhouses that will be transformed into places for gardening workshops, greening campaigns, non-formal education for children from disadvantaged areas and providing help at various public events. We will have a group of at least 20 volunteers, to which will be added the 10 long-term volunteers who are already here for a year. Local transportation is provided by the host organization in collaboration with municipality of Resita and volunteers will receive bus and tram ticket passes, to get to the locations where we will work. For the locations outside the city, transportation is provided by the host organization, with its own vehicles.

projects.title: Youth Empowerment Project 23 April 2026 - 16 June 2026(55 days)
projects.description:

projects.title: ESC in a Public School of a Greek Island from September 2026
projects.description:
The volunteers will take active part in the realization of different projects at the local Primary Schools and Kindergartens.
The tasks of the volunteer depend of the needs of the cooperating Institutions, the capacity of the volunteer and will be around Education, Environment, New Technologies, Culture and Sports.
Under guidance and help of the institution’s stuff, they will work on the realization of Educational, Cultural, Sports and “New Technologies” activities for the children of the school.
They will also “Learn by Producing" Articles and Presentations for New Technologies Projects, create new ideas and realize of activities in projects organized by the schools.
Will also promote the the ESC Program by publishing the results of our activities at the web sites of the H/O.
Create recordings and articles for the H/O’s internet radio station www.chiosradio.gr and its web site.
Realize a “Personal Project” will be defined in cooperation with the Hosting Organisation.

projects.title: Empowering youth and women in local communities - Jerada, Morocco
projects.description:
Isaaf Jerada solidairty and Developpement is an oganization dedicated to local developement and empowering local communites located in Northeaster morocco. The organization works in the protection of the rights of young people by managing a center dedicated to young people in difficult situations and a child protection unit. It also operates in spaces for the psychological support of children and young students through the promotion of animation and sport. ISAAF also articulates spaces and workshops for women, supporting skills and autonomy developpement through capacity building trainings, language classes or physical activities. 
The volunteer will contribute to empower the local communities by working directly with children and women groups, supporting them in day-to-day activities. Tasks may include planning and organizating daily activities such as educational workshops (art, IT, music), improving language and academic skills, and raising awareness about child protection.

projects.title: Looking for volunteers
projects.description: Aluksne Children and Youth Centre wants to provide intercultural learning possibilities for different aged people in Aluksne, as well as develop a cooperation between generations in learning process. Volunteer will work with pre-school kids, spend time with children and young people in Youth Centre "Pa GALMS" and provide English club (or their native language) and other workshops for different aged people. There will be many people who have broaden their horizons, intercultural learning experience, improved their foreign language skills and become more opened to new experiences!

projects.title: 2025-1-TR01-ESC51-VTJ-000346152
projects.description: This project is aiming to build a relationship of locals with sport activities as an important social tool for having a healthy and inclusive life. The volunteers will give their contribution in this regard. The volunteers that will be hosted, will be involved in activities which offer them a personal development and same time contribution in local society by involving them and raising awareness.The volunteers that we are willing to host will take part in the planned activities which are fitting with their interests and abilities. Volunteers will increase the interest in the activities conducted and will contribute to the popularization of amateur sport among young people. In addition, volunteers, using their organizational and creative skills, will support the preparation and organization of international activities aimed at youth organized by the club. https://www.facebook.com/ankarayounginitative/,https://www.instagram.com/gencgirisim06/

projects.title: Volunteering in a kindergarten: Share your culture and interests with children!
projects.description: Break cultural barriers & inspire young minds! Join our volunteering mobility in the vibrant student city of Wrocław, Poland. What’s in it for you? 1️⃣ Share your culture with children through language activities, art, music, cooking, and traditional dances 🎨🎵and bring your hobbies and passions into the classroom! 2️⃣ Gain insight into the Polish education system and preschool child development.  3️⃣ Get a hands-on teaching experience by supporting teachers in daily activities. 👉 Check the INFO PACK for more details: https://tinyurl.com/kindergarten-2026-2027 and 🔍 find the stories of our ex-volunteers on our INSTAGRAM: @esc.wroclaw or FACEBOOK: @EVSinWroclaw 📢 How to apply? projects.title: Volunteering in a Democratic School
projects.description: Join our volunteering mobility at Galileo – a democratic school in Wrocław, Poland, where students and staff share decision-making and learning is driven by curiosity, independence, and creativity. What’s in it for you? 1️⃣ Engage with students aged 6–18 by leading activities based on your interests—art, music, culture, sustainability, languages, sports, dance, or other creative classes. 2️⃣ Learn about and experience the school’s unique approach to education and contribute to projects. 👉 Check the INFO PACK for more details: https://tinyurl.com/school-2026-2027 and 🔍 find the stories of our ex-volunteers on our INSTAGRAM: @esc.wroclaw or FACEBOOK: @EVSinWroclaw 📢 How to apply? projects.title: Colours Daycare 2026-2027 Volunteering
projects.description:
Colours is a daycare for children aged 0-3 with a team of dedicated childcare educators based in Nicosia, Cyprus. We believe that learning is an exciting journey that begins at birth. Our mission is to nurture the body, develop the mind, and inspire the soul of every child we serve.

We are looking for 3 motivated individuals (including those with fewer opportunities) to join us for a transformative experience for 4-5 months, starting from now (April) until August 2026. As a volunteer, you will assist our teachers in planning learning activities, setting up learning stations, implementing play and learning activities, and assisting with our digital marketing and communications.

Applicants are required to complete this application form: https://forms.gle/G38oA4Bs39JWjNYS8

projects.title: Summer Camp in Litke
projects.description: Tarisznya Alapítvány (Knapsack Foundation) is a Hungarian NGO promoting equal opportunities for Roma children from disadvantaged backgrounds through child-centered, project-based education. Since 2016, it has supported youth in Nógrád County by creating playful, community-focused learning environments that build confidence, skills, and life opportunities. Its main program, Tarisznya Tanoda in Litke, offers educational, creative, sports, and community activities led by local staff and volunteers, fostering belonging, growth, and curiosity. Volunteers support afternoon activities (14:00–20:00) for children aged 6–14, including games, workshops, sports, outdoor and cultural activities. Working with an international team, they help create a positive, inclusive environment, build trust, and boost children’s confidence. No experience is required—enthusiasm, openness, patience, and teamwork are key.

projects.title: Summer Camp in Jászberény
projects.description: Helyet! Alapítvány (Space! Foundation), based in Jászberény, Hungary, supports disadvantaged individuals, families, and communities through social services and inclusive programs. Since 2015, it has developed initiatives such as daily care, supported housing, and educational activities, including Kis-Csillag Tanoda, to promote independence, inclusion, and long-term opportunities for vulnerable groups. Volunteers in the summer camp will support community engagement through creative workshops, team activities, and social interactions with local participants. They will help strengthen community spirit, build connections across generations, and contribute to an inclusive environment. Volunteers play a key role in boosting children’s confidence, building trust, and creating positive experiences. No prior experience is required—this is a valuable opportunity to learn about social support work and contribute to meaningful change.

projects.title: Summer Camp in Szécsény
projects.description: Egyesek Youth Association has worked with young people in the disadvantaged Szécsény region of Nógrád County since 2012. Through experiential learning, volunteering, and community programs, it helps youth develop skills like communication, responsibility, and initiative, while encouraging active participation in their future and community. International activities also improve English skills and broaden cultural awareness. Become part of an international volunteer team and create wonderful memories together with children in Szécsény! Volunteers will participate in a variety of hands-on activities that celebrate cultural exchange - sharing songs, dances, and traditions - while also supporting the children’s English language development. Your creativity will shine through in leading games and sports activities. Your role goes beyond teaching: you’ll help them gain joy, confidence, and trust.  Join us and help fill this summer camp with color and meaningful connections!

projects.title: Summer Camp in Pétervására
projects.description: Hét Kútforrás Social Foundation works to prevent the cycle of extreme poverty and promote social inclusion, shared responsibility, and equal opportunities. In Heves County, it operates several Tanoda after-school centres, providing safe, supportive spaces where disadvantaged children and families can learn, grow, and build confidence through educational and creative activities.Volunteers will support the summer camps organized by the Hét Kútforrás Foundation, mainly for disadvantaged Roma children. The activities usually take place in the afternoons and are held at three locations: Pétervására, Szajla, and Erdőkövesd. Most of the children are between 6 and 10 years old. The program includes games, creative workshops, sports, and lots of fun together. The children especially love singing and dancing, so volunteers who are happy to teach songs or dances from their own culture are very welcome.

projects.title: Ambassadors for Europe 2026/2027
projects.description:
Eurowerkstatt is working as a sending and hosting, but mainly coordinating organisation in the European ESC-Program. We coordinate the application process, the prearrangement and the mentoring of the 10-13 volunteers coming to Jena each year. We work together with 10 hosting projects in Jena, which are mainly active in the field of child and youth welfare or international youth work. Currently the call is open for 5 Projects.
 The volunteers are involved in the daily work in kindergartens, youth centers or a sports club and get the chance to plan and organise their own projects. This gives you the opportunity to bring your culture closer not only to local children and young people but also to your new colleagues. Our goal is the creation of offers for young people, to develop social and vocational abilities, particularly intercultural abilities.

projects.title: VEIL - Rebuilding Roccalumera: Community Support after Cyclone
projects.description: Municipality of Roccalumera, recently affected by Cyclone Harry. Even though the town was only slightly affected by the cyclone, the limited local resources have been redirected to relief efforts. Consequently, the work of the volunteers will be helpful for the community, enabling initiatives that would otherwise be overviewed. This activity is part of ESC High Priority Area ‘VEIL-CORPS’ funded by the European Union in the frame of the European Solidarity Corps Programme.

projects.title: VEIL - Almond Camp Mafia free Interculture in Confiscated Space
projects.description:
The non-profit organization "I Girasoli" was founded in 2004 by then is involved in social project promoting hospitality. Protection and integration of refugees and asylum seekers. Main aim of the organization is providing work opportunities for refugees and asylum seekers, and sensitize local community about migration.

The organization manages several SAI (Reception and Integration System) offering hospitality and protection including an integration process aiming at refugees and migrants' persona feeds social andrientaliuel being. Health, bureaucracy and personal expression thanks to cultural and artistic activities. This activity is part of ESC High Priority Area ‘VEIL-CORPS’ funded by the European Union in the frame of the European Solidarity Corps Programme.

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Paide Youth Center in Estonia
projects.description: Paide Youth Centre is a welcoming youth centre in the heart of Estonia that offers young people a safe, supportive and inspiring environment for learning, creativity, socialising and active participation. The centre works with young people from different backgrounds and supports their personal growth, inclusion and confidence through non-formal learning and youth work. As an ESC volunteer, you would support daily youth centre activities, build connections with local young people, help organise workshops, games and community events, contribute your own ideas and talents, and share your culture in an international learning environment. This project offers valuable experience in youth work, community engagement and personal development. It is also a great opportunity to develop communication, teamwork and intercultural skills while making a meaningful contribution to the local community. MORE INFO & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/paide-youth-centre-and-skatepark/

projects.title: Atividades Tempos Livres
projects.description:
A key part of our work is the Second Chance School, involving young people aged 14 to 20 who have faced challenges in traditional education.
It provides a safe and supportive environment where they can rebuild confidence, develop skills, and re-engage with learning.
Creativity and artistic expression are central, helping to motivate and empower participants and support their personal and social development.

We are currently looking for a volunteer who is willing to collaborate or actively engage with these young people through dance activities. This role is important to encourage participation, self-expression, and group cohesion. Availability to start as soon as possible is highly appreciated.

We also have the ATL (After-School Activities) for children aged 10 to 15, offering homework support and free-time activities in a playful, inclusive, and intercultural environment, fostering socialisation and intercultural exchange.

projects.title: Ready to Act: Volunteering at the Kindergarten no 140 in Krakow, Poland
projects.description: We are searching for 2 ESC volunteers for the kindergarten in Krakow. Project starts in the beginning of September 2026 and ends in June 2027 (10 months). The main tasks of volunteers in the kindergarten will be to support children in their everyday routine and conduct own activities based on the culture and language of the country of origin. Volunteers will assist during scheduled activities, supporting the staff: helping to prepare materials for activities and deccorations for different event in the kindergarten, they assist during meetings with parents. They help during outdoor activites abd when children will go for trips. The age of the children is from 3 y.o. and volunteers will have a chance to work with children from different age groups.  Apart the kindergarten volunteer will participate in the activities prepared by IB Polska -  monthly meetings, workshops, evaluation meetings, which is also obligatory part of the project.

projects.title: Momento
projects.description: Il miglior modo d'imparare è attraverso l'esperienza, la partecipazione e vere interazioni umane, e questo progetto è nato per offrirti un ambiente sicuro e stimolante in cui l'apprendimento avviene tramite l'azione. Opererai tra molte piccole comunità che si trovano ad affrontare sfide come le scarse opportunità per i giovani, l'isolamento sociale tra gli anziani e il ridotto accesso all'educazione non formale. Diventerai protagonista attivo d'un cambiamento positivo, scoprendo al contempo il tuo potenziale. Non ti limiterai ad aiutare gli altri, ma crescerai in autostima, acquisendo competenze e individuando una direzione per il futuro. Il cuore delle tue attività saranno i laboratori educativi interattivi con scolari e studenti d'ogni età, le attività d'apprendimento informale, ludiche (in particolare gli scacchi), creative e di scambio interculturale, quelle di promozione del rispetto dell'ambiente e dell'inclusione sociale, e quelle di diffusione del progetto atttraverso i media.

projects.title: Environmental Education & Green Space Coordinator in Vietnam
projects.description:
The project is to raise awareness of local youth and local community about green lifestyle and environment protection through workshops (formal and nonformal) as well as hands-on creation of recycled playgrounds, indoor and outdoor green spaces.  
As the Environmental Education & Green Space Coordinator, the volunteer will have freedom in developing, designing and delivering planned actions in innovative and interactive ways with the engagement and support of local core team members including local youth and CSDS staff. 
Tentative activities are as follow: 
Plan and deliver interactive workshops on sustainability and eco-friendly lifestyles for children/students of all ages. 
Collect and organize recyclable materials for creative reuse
Monitor and evaluate the impact of workshops and green spaces
Design and implement recycled playgrounds and indoor/outdoor green spaces
Organize Clean-up events at public spaces in the local community and Green Campaigns. 
Prepare media posts

projects.title: Nature Community Volunteering Team Spring 2026
projects.description:
Join a European volunteer team at Nature Community, a rural eco-community in Bavaria near the Czech border. In a time shaped by uncertainty about the future and social, political, and ecological challenges, this project offers young people a concrete place to act, learn, and reconnect — with nature, with others, and with their own capacity to contribute.

Together, we will support the preparation of the European Ecovillage Gathering 2026 that takes place in Summer, an international event dedicated to community, sustainability, and social transformation. This is not just about helping with practical tasks. It is about becoming part of a living experiment in cooperation, shared responsibility, and future-oriented community life.

www.nature-community.de
www.ecovillagegathering.org

projects.title: ESC at Maarja Village
projects.description:
Maarja Küla is a heartwarming community in South Estonia, where adults with intellectual disabilities live, work, and grow together. Since 2004, they’ve welcomed volunteers from 15+ countries — and now, it’s your turn!

You will:
Create and lead arts, crafts, music & sports activities
Support daily workshops (wood, clay, gardening, art…)
Assist caregivers and prepare materials for activities
Spend meaningful time with residents — play games, share your culture, enjoy the moment

This project offers not only a unique living experience in a international setting, but also the opportunity to grow both personally and professionally. No special skills needed — just your open heart, patience, and curiosity to live in a unique rural community.

Volunteering duration: September 2026 until June 2027 (10 months). Dates are flexible.

If you are curious, visit our Instagram: instagram.com/noorngo or contact richard@erinoor.ee

projects.title: "STARRY" HumAid Volunteering in Morocco (Individual Volunteering)
projects.description: The volunteer mission will be carried out first in the city of Jerada, and secondly in the Al Haouz region in schools with children who were victims of the earthquake. The work will take place from Monday to Friday. The first axis of the project is intended to prepare specific activities for the psychological support of children victims of the earthquake. In this axis, volunteers carry out participatory workshops on activity proposals and tools to be available to intervene in the field. The second axis of the project will be used to highlight the action plan for children in the intervention locations, carrying out activities with the children. The last month of activities will be dedicated to the evaluation of the previous months in Jerada.

projects.title: ECO-TRIBE: grow, build, belong
projects.description:
We're looking for 13 enthusiastic individuals aged 18-30 to join our ESC volunteering project from 10th of July to 3rd of August 2026 in Hungary

We will spend our time gardening and learning how to process and preserve what we grow.
You can try your hand at eco-building, working with natural materials like mud and clay plaster. We are also going to build a community fire pit for our evenings together. 
Besides our home base, we’ll help out the local village with tree care and keeping the environment clean.
Experience the beauty and challenges of close to nature living firsthand as we work together to build a community rooted in environmental consciousness. Cultural exchange and sharing experiences are at the heart of our project, where participants from diverse backgrounds come together to learn from one another and grow as a community.

We can only accept applications through the following link:
Apply here: https://forms.gle/aHyMqXbmArSq25M77

projects.title: On The Hill Under The Rock 2026
projects.description: "On the Hill Under the Rock" is a didactic workcamp in collaboration with Fundación Vital, focused on sustainable living and environmental education. Volunteers will receive training on renewable energy, water use, recycling, and basic survival. Tasks include maintenance work (painting, sanding, repairs), firewood collection, organic garden care, and natural space cleanup. Volunteers may also support post-fair cleanup after the local cattle festival (Aug 18–20). Educational activities include workshops on climate change, flora and fauna identification, geology, and visits to see renewable energy systems like a hydraulic ram and microturbine. The project encourages cultural exchange, critical thinking, and practical learning in a stunning natural setting.

projects.title: RIVER III.
projects.description: This project is combination of nature conservation, permaculture and art. We will clean and repair the banks of the river to reduce the risk of flooding, we will clean up the illegal waste dumping sites and create places for short rest and reflection in nature. Simultaneously we will apply land art as a tool of communication and self-expression. At the end of the project, we will organise a local public event with an environmental theme.

projects.title: GREEN HORIZONS 1
projects.description:
WE ACCEPT APPLICATIONS ONLY THROUGH YOUTH PORTAL - WE WON'T CONSIDER THOSE WHO CONTACT US VIA EMAIL OR PHONE!
Unknown region of Croatia, called Lika, is rich in biodiversity and geodiversity, which provides great educational opportunities for volunteers and the local community. Goal of this project is to present the impact of modern way of life on our ecosystems, causes and consequences of climate change and to show the power of individuals and community, through education and actions, summer and language school for kids, sustainable development and sustainable use of resources. The aim is to empower the local community and participants in this project for active participation in recognizing and dealing with environmental problems, and to diseminate the results in their own communities. Think globally, act locally! More info:
