projects.title: MULTI KULTI 2026 | short term (summer time, team volunteering)
projects.description: MULTI KULTI is a short-term group volunteering project in European Solidarity Corps, which is carried out in the POLITES Association in Szczecin, Poland. This is the 12th edition of activities that aim in developing and strengthening key competences and to show cultural diversity in Europe by organizing and conducting MULTI KULTI holiday activities among European volunteers, Polish children and youth staying in Szczecin. In addition, the project aims to promote the diversity of volunteering (through working with children and young people, in non-governmental organizations, actions and initiatives for local communities) and presenting it as a valuable and interesting way to spend free time. MULTI KULTI is a volunteering teams project with 10 volunteers EU countries. More information - infopack, application form on ESC in POLITES, on website here: www.esc.polites.org.pl. REMEMBER to fill in the application form here: www.esc.polites.org.pl.

projects.title: Cyber Speak
projects.description:
During this project, you will contribute to teaching english language and digital skills to rural youth of Northern areas of Argeș County. Your role will include designing and delivering engaging lesson plans and supporting students in improving their abilities in a practical and interactive way. 
You will take part in organizing events such as cultural exchanges and digital workshops that promote the European Union values. All activities will be conducted in English, offering young participants valuable opportunities to improve their communication skills. 
Our goal is to develop a united and active community interested in participating in recreational, creative and educational activities where cultural exchanges bring value and give the locals an opportunity to learn about other cultures. 
Overall, you will play an important role in supporting the development of young people in the community, while serving as a valuable resource for those who are committed to helping them grow.

projects.title: Youth Empowerment Project 23 April 2026 - 16 June 2026(55 days)
projects.description:

projects.title: Volunteering in family gardens and agroecological practices - Amplifying the Voice for Climate Action (AVCA Project)
projects.description: The volunteer, sent by ASPEm, will support ASPEm and Yachay Chhalaku in strengthening the economic rights and autonomy of rural women who are survivors of violence, through sustainable and agroecological production processes. The activities focus on food security, income generation, reduction of economic vulnerability and promotion of initiatives through digital platforms. The volunteer will accompany women in the development and strengthening of family agroecological plots and home gardens, supporting sustainable agricultural production aimed at both self-consumption and local markets. They will participate in training activities on agroecological practices and contribute to the development of manuals, educational materials and communication strategies. Activities will take place mainly in the field, in both urban and rural areas, and will be combined with office-based work, such as documentation, report writing and preparation of material for social media.

projects.title: Volunteering for ecological restoration in protected areas - Amplifying the Voice for Climate Action (AVCA Project)
projects.description: The volunteer sent by ASPEm will support ASPEm and Armonía in reforestation activities, carried out in teams and during the early hours of the day, as well as in the production of seedlings - such as kewiña - in community nurseries, in collaboration with women participation. They will also contribute to monitoring planted areas and analyzing soil and environmental conditions, through tracking plant development, checking for pests or diseases, and managing irrigation. The volunteer will participate in logistical support activities for workshops focused on forest fire prevention and control. They will also take part in exchange activities and visits with students from local schools, fostering the sharing of local and technical knowledge about native plants and their benefits, and encouraging collective reflection on the importance of conserving high Andean forests, protecting watersheds, and ensuring water access for all.

projects.description: Kaunas Artists’ House brings fresh and unexpected cultural experiences, connecting local and international communities, and promoting openness and inclusion through culture. Kaunas Artists’ House is always on the lookout for new ideas, young artists, and diverse audiences through artist residencies, cultural education programs, and community events. projects.title: ESC at the after-school club of the International Montessori School Berlin
projects.description:
We are looking for a volunteer for the after-school club at the International Montessori School in Berlin-Wannsee. 
One of the volunteers’ main tasks is to support the permanent staff in implementing the set daily routine and its various activities for the children. Volunteers may therefore be asked to act as a point of contact for the children during the early morning session, free play or study groups. 
club children; for example, there are regular forest walks, a creative workshop and various sports activities. In addition, there are various after-school clubs where volunteers can support the teaching staff according to their own interests and preferences (e.g. school newspaper, sewing, crafts, gardening, etc.)
Most of the activities take place with seasonal themes, public holidays and festivals in mind.

projects.title: ♿ Korys – Care & Support Volunteering for People with Disabilities
projects.description: Volunteering at Korys, supporting people with disabilities through daily assistance, spending time together, and taking part in inclusive social and recreational activities. The role includes accompanying individuals outside for walks and outdoor activities, helping ensure their safety, comfort, and well-being. It also involves creating a friendly and supportive environment where people are encouraged to develop independence, confidence, and social skills. Working closely with staff and other volunteers, the focus is on promoting inclusion, equal participation, and meaningful interaction in everyday life

projects.title: Lesven high school 2026/2027
projects.description:
Jules Lesven is a general, technological and professional high school with 1400 pupils located on a school campus with 2 other high schools. 
The 2 ESC volunteers will work at the high school cafeteria, a confortable place, where they will both share an office and manage the cafeteria with some students (selling snacks, stock management, schedule to set up, etc.). 
They will organise smalls events and animations for students all year long, for i.e. : blind tests, games to win snacks, Christmas/Easter decoration workshop, exhibitions, playlists, language clubs, etc. They will have to offer projects/ideas to set up, it will be the heart of their project!

They can also lead workshops or project at the boarding school: yoga, movie nights, etc.

Last but not least, they will have to organise key moments: thematical weeks on health, environmental awareness, equality, European countries, etc., tournaments (baby-foot, football, etc.)

The project is coordinated by Bij de Brest.

projects.title: Orgogliosi volontari per la solidarietà 9: volontariato in un asilo linguistico
projects.description: T'invitiamo a candidarti per operare come assistente insegnante in un asilo privato a forte vocazione linguistica, dove i bambini imparano l'Inglese e altre lingue: i tuoi cómpiti saranno supportare nelle attività di cura dei bambini, in quelle d'auto-aiuto come vestirsi e mangiare, durante lezioni o attività all'aperto come i giochi nel giardino, le gite scolastiche e le ricorrenze; far conoscere l'Italia attraverso presentazioni ed eventi musicali, teatrali o culinarie per bambini e genitori; creare laboratori d'arte e artigianato in base ai tuoi interessi e alle tue competenze; ​​insegnare lingue straniere (in particolare Italiano e Inglese) attraverso giochi divertenti; portare le tue idee per migliorare l'estetica dei locali dell'asilo. Infine parteciperai a eventi che diffondono i valori dell'E.S.C. e i contenuti del tuo volontariato nella comunità locale durante picnic, fiere e feste di quartiere.

projects.title: Permaculture & Gardening in Vedic Farm community
projects.description: Basic insights into garden cultivation with the aim of self-sufficiency of a community of about 40 people. Participation in hands-on practice in permaculture and it's implementation. - Maintaining the Graden, raised beds, and greenhouses.  Helping in  preparing for winter and the autumn harvest - Preparing vegetables: Sowing, tending and harvesting, helping in the complete process of vegetable production. - Start your own project and bring your own ideas in the various fields under the guidance of gardening and environmental experts.

projects.title: Early English Start: Kindergarten Teacher Wanted
projects.description:
A volunteer will be volunteering in kindergarten Hlavička (hosting organization). The participant activities are: teaching English language, working directly with kids in the kindergarten by organizing educational activities and games, bringing new ideas, help with daily running of the kindergarten (including cleaning) and with organizing community events, a little of administrative work, cooperating on other activities with the staff. Hlavička is a small kindergarten in the heart of Bratislava situated in the family house. It offers family atmosphere in which small kids are being taught how to be independent, respectful to their friends and environment. It also welcomes children with other mother tongues than Slovak. Participant with fewer opportunities are welcome.
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ReWAS51DJik&feature=youtu.be

projects.title: Youth Education
projects.description:
Would you like to gain new experiences and work with children and young people? Then a volunteer project within the ESC at our Don Bosco education centre  in Benediktbeuern will be just right for you.
You will support the care of school classes and groups staying with us. Together you will take part in activities such as canoe trips, hiking or climbing. In the evenings, you will help with programs like disco or bar activities. You will also support educational workshops and seminars and gain valuable learning experiences.
Other tasks include welcoming guests at the reception, giving house and monastery tours, and helping in the kitchen, cleaning, garden work and maintaining sports facilities. You will have your own areas of responsibility and can bring in your ideas and skills.
In the education centre you will work with a team of 8-10 volunteers. 
If you are Interested please apply here: https://forms.gle/dXUgqCGV242fY1WW7

projects.title: Building an inclusive society, vol. 6
projects.description:
The project will take place in Zagreb, Croatia, from September 2026 to August 2027 and will be hosted by Amazonas. Amazonas is an organization dedicated to providing support and fostering positive change through learning, movement, innovative methods, and new experiences.

Within the project, three volunteer positions are available, offering a unique opportunity to become part of a dynamic and impactful team. POSITION 1: Media volunteer - TIK-TOK channel of Amazonas (two posts per week) Taking photos and creating videos of Amazonas activities and events POSITION 2: Leader of non-formal activities Language lessons of native language (of volunteer) and conversational English Organization of workshops Promotion of mobility at events in Zagreb Writing reports/blog articles a POSITION 3: Assistant on social projects Participation in capoeira training and capoeira workshops for children Preparing and implementing workshops for children on the topic of embracing diversity

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Kullerkupu Kindergarten in Tallinn, Estonia
projects.description: Kindergarten Kullerkupu has four groups – each group of 20-24 children, altogether around 90 children aged 1,5 to 7 years old. One of the priorities is innovation, to be modern. Kindergarten has joined the projects ” Free of Bullying“ and Eco school.  The importance of environmental protection is attached to everyday life. In addition to the daily learning activities taking place in kindergarten,  there are also music and sports. Kindergarten has a nice outdoor area and several events are held outdoors. The main purpose of the organization is a high-quality basic education for children. The mission is to welcome every child in their friendly family and to provide pleasant conditions for a child to contribute to the development of their personality. It is important to know that every child would feel welcome, safe and positive among the kindergarten family throughout the day. More information and how to apply: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/tallinn-kullerkupu-kindergarden/

projects.title: House of Generations - Where Care Meets Connection 👵
projects.description: Looking for a volunteering experience that is REAL, meaningful, and full of human connection? Welcome to the House of Generations in Kaunas 💛 Here, every day is different. You’ll become part of a unique community where around 40 seniors and young mothers with their children share the same space -creating a powerful mix of stories, energy, challenges, and growth. As a volunteer, you won’t sit on the sidelines. You’ll help organise fun activities, bring new ideas, support daily routines, teach simple language or digital skills, and most importantly - build genuine relationships. One moment you might be dancing or playing games at the Day Centre, the next you could be helping a young mum feel more confident about everyday life. This is not just about helping others - it’s about discovering yourself too. You’ll grow your patience, empathy, creativity, and confidence while experiencing what true intergenerational solidarity feels like 🌍🤝

projects.title: Dana HH 05
projects.description: The project will try to support different associations, schools, municipallities and stakeholders in the area of La Marina and also those contributing to the recovery of the areas and regions affected by Dana in 2024. that need our help. There will be a wide diverse of activities to develope that might be phisical , artistical, educational or social- We will also undertake agricultural work and part of the veggies will be distributed in Dana neighbourhoods. Additionally, there will be occasional educational activities with children, reconstructing activities and visits to senior centers or other social events to support the community organizations in the area, to complete 6-7 working hours a day. 2 days per week will be free. projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Kullatera Kindergarten in Tallinn, Estonia
projects.description: Tallinn Kullatera Kindergarten has nine groups in the kindergarten. In daily activities they have a mission: a kindergarten that cooperates with a playful, creative and innovative approach. Principal value: child- centered, safety, openness, reliability, humanity. Kindergarten activities keywords are safety, innovation, values, traditions, lifelong learning and caring of cooperation. Education and schooling process: child-centered playful learning. Kindergarten teaching activities keywords are child-centered approach, playfulness, using new methods and innovative approach, considering the child’s natural interest, development and accepting kids ideas. Kindergarten implements inclusive education, supports children’s individual/ speech development, offers different options to take part in hobbies. Kindergarten supports children’s wishes to take part in exhibitions and competitions. More information and how to apply: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/tallinn-kullatera-kindergarden/

projects.title: Supporting Children with Special Needs- ESC Volunteering at Kindergarten-School in Tallinn, Estonia
projects.description: Tallinna Laagna Kindergarten-School is a combined kindergarten and elementary school dedicated to supporting children with disabilities. Its aim is to provide education and help students develop essential social skills so they can lead independent lives in the future. The school creates opportunities for children's development by offering a safe, joyful, and comfortable environment, along with an individual approach tailored to each child’s needs. The target group consists of 36 school-aged children with special needs, ranging from 7 to 17 years old. Regular daily activities include lessons based on the national curriculum, as well as a variety of additional sessions led by teachers and therapists. After the obligatory classes, children enjoy a rest and lunch break, followed by optional leisure activities such as indoor and outdoor games. FOR MORE INFO & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/tallinn-laagna-kindergarden/

projects.title: Volunteering in a Creative and Social Cooperative in Italy
projects.description: The project of Color Cooperative takes place in a community-based context involving children, young people, families and local community. Volunteers will support educational, cultural, and social activities such as after-school services, summer camps, workshops, and community events, as well as communication and organisational tasks. The project promotes non-formal learning, intercultural exchange, and active citizenship within a multidisciplinary team working closely with local schools, social services, and community partners.

projects.title: Volunteer supporting and monitoring Health Projects with Médicos del Mundo in Sahrawi Refugee Camps
projects.description: The healthcare system in the Sahrawi refugee camps is managed entirely by the Sahrawi refugees themselves (Sahrawi Health Authorities) and relies financially on humanitarian aid. Health partners provide technical and financial support to maintain health services and infrastructure, including the supply of medicines and medical supplies, and to ensure that health programs comply with national and international standards.  The tasks of the volunteer:Support in implementing health protocols and procedures established by MdM; Record activities carried out and assist in data collection for the program’s health information system; Collaborate in the preparation of periodic activity reports; Review the content of training sessions for healthcare staff; Review health determinants; Accompany the technical team in health promotion and awareness-raising activities at the community level; Support the monitoring of training processes and the implementation of the SAGASTOCK Pharmacy application.

projects.title: ESC in Mugla, Türkiye - Looking for Long-Term Volunteers (1 June 2026 - 1 June 2027)
projects.description: Volunteers who will be included in our ESC project will support the youth work carried out within our association. They will increase the efficiency of the works with their contributions to our activities. It will enable our work to gain an international dimension, thus attracting more young people. Our ESC volunteers will join our activities 5 days a week within our association. Volunteers, who will help the activities within the scope of the draft program of approximately 35 hours, will support our activities in line with their knowledge and skills. Below are the activities that volunteers will participate in on a weekly basis. - Preparations of activities - Office works - Mind games - Turkish language course - Reading workshop - Digital youth work - Cultural learning night - Youth information activities - Local projects - Conversation club - R&D works - Evaluation implementations

projects.title: The Game School 2025 – 2026
projects.description: L’ORANGE BLEUE is looking for someone to participate in one of its main missions: activities aimed at early childhood, and in particular participate in the life of the school support, the little kid's library, the toy library and the Orange Bus, a mobile game bus. In the truly underprivileged district of Bas-Clichy, all questions relating to parenthood and childhood are important. That’s why the organisation is looking for someone to motivate with their questions and volunteers to help the local population. Helping children entering school for the first year, leading small workshops for parents and their young children, ensuring that all children can play together at the game library and helping to organize fun events are examples of what the volunteer might do. Of course, he or she can also create their own event in line with the overall project

projects.title: Umbúntu Social Project: community and cultural space with eco-friendly project in Alvorada Brazil
projects.description:
ICYE Brazil invites volunteers to join the CAVAN Project, a Humanitarian Aid ESC initiative. This program offers a 6-month voluntary experience with the Umbúntu social project in a disadvantaged district of Alvorada city. Umbúntu provides a community and cultural space with workshops on topics like edible plant processing, handicrafts, capoeira, percussion, and language teaching. Volunteers will have a hands-on experience in environmentally sustainable practices by participating in farming, permaculture gardening, construction and other manual activities of our project. The main aims are to provide humanitarian aid, raise awareness about climate change and encourage discussions on green alternatives. Join us now! 

Please note starting dates should be around May 2026.

projects.title: Environmental Education and Climate Awareness in Hanoi
projects.description:
Join us in a unique opportunity to support humanitarian aid efforts in cooperation with the Center for Sustainable Development Studies (CSDS) through educational activities focusing on education for environmental sustainability. As a volunteer, you'll engage in diverse tasks such as providing global education activities in schools and community learning centres, including language teaching and interactive discussions with local and children youth on environment protection and climate change, as well as other relevant topics. Make a tangible impact on communities in need while experiencing personal growth and cultural exchange. Apply now to be part of this transformative journey towards a brighter future! 

Please note starting dates should be around May 2026.

projects.title: Biodiversity Monitoring and Community Engagement in Ecuador
projects.description:
Volunteers participate in daily biodiversity walks, documenting local flora and fauna through observations as well as photo, video, and audio recordings while also exploring new trails together with community members. They help process this data by organizing, classifying, and uploading records to a shared Google Drive folder, using digital identification tools to make preliminary species identifications.

Together with local youth, volunteers also create social media content that highlights community activities, biodiversity, and cultural traditions. During dialogue circles, community members, the Despierta team, and volunteers exchange experiences and discuss environmental practices. Volunteers support the preparation and delivery of workshops aimed at strengthening community organization and skills. Additionally, they assist with environmental education for children and young people in local schools.

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Tihase Kindergarden in Tallinn, Estonia
projects.description: The goal of the kindergarten is to provide high-quality preschool education. It is important to make the children feel welcome, safe and positive throughout the day and happy to take part in learning activities. The priority for the kindergarten is outdoor education. In addition to the daily activities taking place in the kindergarten, children can participate in different activities like dancing, sports, music, playing zither and English lessons. In addition to celebrating traditional activities in kindergarten, international health days are very important. The kindergarten has 4 groups of children, ages of 2-7. The volunteer can participate in the activities and is expected to offer their own ideas and be creative. The volunteer will be assigned to one age group but has an opportunity to work with other groups too. Volunteer will have an experienced tutor, who is always be ready to help. MORE INFO & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/tallinna-tihase-kindergarden/

projects.title: Education, Healthcare, Capacity Building and Community Development in Central Ghana - Asikuma Community
projects.description: Join our Humanitarian Aid programme in Asikuma, Ghana, where you'll immerse in a vibrant community known for its cultural richness. Volunteers will address critical needs in education, healthcare, and community development. Tasks include assisting healthcare professionals, teaching, supporting infrastructure projects, providing language aid, facilitating youth programs, and conducting research. Your contribution will foster sustainable development and enhance community resilience. Make a lasting impact while experiencing a life-changing journey of learning and cultural exchange.

projects.title: Education, Healthcare, Capacity Building and Community Development in Central Ghana - Asikuma Community
projects.description:

projects.title: Theatre and Circus Culture in Motion
projects.description: Volunteering Team project, bringing together 15 young people from across Europe in Wiesbaden and Mainz, Germany. For two months in summer, participants will live and work together in an intensive international group setting. The project combines artistic practice, intercultural exchange and practical involvement in cultural activities with children and young people. Volunteers will alternate between creative work within the team and supporting local theatre and circus-based projects, contributing to playful and expressive learning environments. Alongside these activities, the group will collaboratively develop and present their own artistic performance. The topic of the performance is is decided on jointly by all involved and should include themes connected to contemporary European and global realities. The project is designed as an intensive learning-by-doing experience, where artistic exploration, teamwork and shared daily life are closely connected.

projects.title: Solidarity In Action short term
projects.description: The volunteers will be divided into four teams: The Environmental Team will be engaged in cleaning initiatives, environmental protection campaigns and restoration of hiking/biking trails. The Painting Team will focus on painting walls in local kindergartens. The Kids Team will conduct non-formal activities in kindergartens during the mornings and in parks during the evenings. The Media Team, consisting of 5 members, will be responsible for managing social media accounts and creating promotional materials. In addition, volunteers will actively participate in local festivals, concerts, and cultural events. Their involvement will encompass preparation, promotion, cleaning, and tending our stand during these events. We invite you on our instagram for further information: @nevo_parudimos

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Kristiine Kindergarten in Tallinn, Estonia
projects.description: The main goal is to support families in preparing children for school and to teach and develop children’s physical, mental and social skills. The values of the organisation are openness, creativity, tolerance, respect, caring and courage. The kindergarten has 12 classes for 1.5-7 years old children. The main activity is to teach children creativity through play. The kindergarten is in a green district of the Estonian capital within walking distance or short public transport trip from downtown. By including an international volunteer in our kindergarten, our goal is to improve together our main values through intercultural learning and get a fresh bystander view of our organization. At the same time, the volunteer can contribute with innovative ideas to engage with children, parents, teachers and the community. MORE INFORMATION & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/tallinna-kristiine-kindergarten/

projects.title: Soutien aux activités de PRAXIS - Médias et engagement citoyen à Serres
projects.description:
Une Terre Culturelle propose une mission de volontariat CES à Serres, au sein de l’organisation PRAXIS, une ONG grecque active depuis 1995 dans les domaines de la jeunesse, des médias, de la culture et des droits humains. Dans le cadre du projet MEDIART, l’organisation encourage la créativité des jeunes et leur implication dans des actions de sensibilisation autour de thématiques sociales et internationales.

- Participation à la gestion des réseaux sociaux et à la création de contenus (articles, vidéos, campagnes digitales)
- Contribution à l’animation d’une radio locale (création de spots, émissions, interviews)
- Organisation d’activités et d’événements autour des “international days" (sensibilisation, campagnes, actions locales)
- Animation d’ateliers linguistiques et d’activités avec les jeunes locaux

projects.title: Volunteering in training and technical support to community-based organizations in Totonicapán for the sustainable management of water and forests – PUENTES Project
projects.description: The volunteer sent by ASPEm within the PUENTES project will collaborate with the CDRO association in Totonicapán to support Water Committees, Forest Rangers, community-based organizations and rural community families in the efficient management and responsible use of water, as well as in the conservation of water sources and biodiversity, within a unique community-based management model. Among the main activities, the volunteer will contribute to strengthening the technical and ancestral knowledge of local organizations; support and guide conservation initiatives in line with Mayan spirituality; promote actions for biodiversity protection; accompany reforestation processes in areas where water sources are present; collaborate in the preparation and implementation of community meetings with local committees. Activities take place from Monday to Friday, with a commitment of 30–40 hours per week (excluding commuting time), combining office work and field activities within the communities.

projects.title: Volunteering in environmental communication and coordination of initiatives for ecosystem conservation – PUENTES Project
projects.description: The volunteer sent by ASPEm will support ASPEm in social activities related to the environment and the reduction of risks associated with climate change, carried out in collaboration with Asociación ARMONÍA, which focuses on wildlife and habitat conservation in coordination with local communities, and with Agua Sustentable, dedicated to promoting the sustainable management of water and the environment. The activities will take place in Tiquipaya and Quillacollo. The volunteer will provide logistical, technical, and practical support in the following tasks: communication management and creation of content for social media; support in organizing training workshops; drafting manuals; participation in reforestation activities during the rainy season; preparation of reports and collection of materials and results for dissemination at community and local events. A commitment of 30 to 40 hours per week is expected (excluding travel time).

projects.title: Education for the Future: Promoting emotional and social development in Southern Lima – PUENTES Project, Volunteer 2
projects.description: The volunteer sent by ASPEm as part of the PUENTES project will collaborate in the BVBP’s “Education for the Future” program, working in institutions in the southern area of Lima such as Santa María Reyna, Los Jardines de Manchay, IE San José and La Nueva Semilla. Activities involve supporting holistic education through playful, artistic and recreational workshops. Tasks include preparing materials and organizing cultural events. The volunteer will also contribute to workshops on gender equality, violence prevention and environmental awareness, aimed at fostering students’ socio-emotional development. They will act as support in school activities under the supervision of local staff, while learning educational methodologies. The commitment is 30–40 hours per week (Monday to Friday), with time off in lieu for weekend work. From October to December activities take place in schools; from January to March activities are extracurricular; from March onward regular school activities resume.

projects.title: Little Minds, Big World: Volunteer to Inspire Through Culture
projects.description:
Our English-speaking daycare is located in Sopron, Hungary, close to the Austrian border and is run by three enthusiastic workmates offering their laps, time, devotion to a handful of children aged between 1,5-5. After they outgrow daycare, we offer 90-minute afternoon classes and organize summer camps to ensure they continue to benefit from a diverse and multicultural environment.
We are looking for volunteers with their hearts set to help children grow and bloom in an open learning environment by sharing their cultural traditions, talent and language. If you are ready to support children's social development, understand their urge to explore the world around them and have ideas on how to bring it closer to them, please contact us!

projects.title: Youth and Sport Volunteers – STEM & Sport Festival (Bolu, Türkiye)
projects.description:
This project offers a unique volunteering experience that combines sports and science. Within the framework of the STEM & SPORT Project, volunteers will take an active role in organizing and implementing a festival that connects physical activity with STEM fields.

During the festival, participants will explore the scientific principles behind sports through interactive workshops, games, and activities. Volunteers will be involved in event organization, supporting workshops, guiding participants, and contributing to communication and visibility.

This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience, work in an international team, and develop skills in both event management and youth work.
INFOPACK : https://canva.link/d2urp0x44hfoqel

projects.title: SHORT-TERM: ECOLOGY AS A MODEL OF ACTIVE CITIZENSHIP IN SICILY
projects.description:
Serra Guarneri is an environmental education center located in the Madonie Mountains and run by the Palma Nana social cooperative. We engage both children and adults in learning about environmental awareness, conservation, sustainable tourism, permaculture, circular economy, and community-based living.
Set in a small village surrounded by woodland, we practice what we teach by living simply and in harmony with nature. Volunteers are invited to become part of this community, contributing to daily life, supporting various activities, and helping care for the facilities, the natural environment, and the people who live and visit here.

The project aims to revive rural life by fostering creativity and providing practical skills for sustainable living. Throughout the year, we host groups of children and adults for school trips, summer camps, training programs, yoga retreats, and other experiences. Our main focus is to welcome these guests and share our way of life with them.

projects.title: Rural Youth Festival 5
projects.description: The gr8 edition of Ruralympics festival needs your help to make it THE Festival of the year. Join a team of international and Romanian volunteers and bring fun, culture and great time to a rural community. For 35 days the group of young people will experience life in countryside, Romanian culture and beautiful landscapes, as well as living and working in a big international group. This is a Volunteering Team project, so its also open for people that did short/long term EVS/ESC. Check here previous editions of Ruralympics: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3CbWABebBrj2MkJ1HV6drFWyd1-kNuAU&si=8cd5ih8PnioqRoxy

projects.title: Attività con bambini e giovani a Vilnius
projects.description: Attraverso l’educazione non formale, le organizzazioni d'accoglienza  forniscono assistenza educativa e sociale a bambini e ragazzi con difficoltà personali o sociali, promuovendo il coinvolgimento della comunità per migliorare il loro benessere ed evitare l'emarginazione dalla società. L’obiettivo è sviluppare personalità responsabili, creative e civicamente attive, capaci di accogliere nuove esperienze e di realizzarsi nella società moderna. A seconda delle attività delle singole organizzazioni, sarai chiamato a operare in città o nelle aree rurali circostanti per creare spazi sicuri per il gioco e la socializzazione attraverso attività all'aperto che incoraggiano l'espressione personale e sviluppano capacità di cooperazione, creatività, concentrazione e comunicazione. Costruirai relazioni partecipando a eventi e guidando autonomamente attività condivise, campi estivi ed escursioni, ma potresti anche essere impegnato in ufficio, nella creazione di contenuti per i social media.

projects.title: Programma d'integrazione per stranieri
projects.description: Sei il benvenuto presso un'organizzazione d'accoglienza che si dedica ad aiutare rifugiati, richiedenti asilo e altri stranieri ad avere successo nella loro nuova vita in Lituania. Con due centri a Vilnius e nella vicina cittadina di Pabradė, tra i quali ruoterai, l'organizzazione offre una gamma completa di servizi pensati per dare forza e supporto ai migranti nel loro percorso. Spazi accoglienti offrono consulenza sociale, psicologica e legale, nonché opportunità di svago, apprendimento linguistico e sviluppo di competenze. La priorità viene data alla creazione d'un senso di sicurezza, appartenenza e comunità, affinché i migranti ospiti possano davvero rinascere come nuovi cittadini. Aiuterai nell'organizzazione d'eventi culturali, laboratori e attività ricreative per adulti, nell'assistenza alle attività per bambini e nella creazione d'una comunicazione inclusiva sui social media, svolgendo, con la passione che ci metterai, un ruolo chiave nel promuovere un ambiente accogliente.

projects.title: L'éducation bilingue dans une crèche franco-allemande
projects.description:
Nous sommes une crèche/jardin d'enfants qui accueille des enfants de 1 à 6 ans. Notre structure s'adresse aux enfants qui grandissent dans un milieu bilingue français/allemand.
Sous la responsabilité de l'équipe encadrante, voici ce que nous proposons au volontaire:
- Découvrir le métier d'éducateur/rice de jeunes enfants
- Accueillir les enfants, les observer pour comprendre leur comportement et suivre leur développement
- Répondre aux besoin des enfants en préservant leur individualité et en considérant leur environnement culturel
- Apprendre le respect et la tolérance au contact des enfants 
- Prendre des initiatives dans les activités à proposer aux enfants
- Travailler en équipe
- Faire partie intégrante de l'équipe pédagogique
- Découvrir et apprendre la langue allemande et sa culture
- Participer à l'élaboration de projets 
Important: Seules les candidatures rédigées en français seront examinées.

projects.title: Summer and sustainability, life in an eco-village
projects.description: Eco-community Sekier, a small permaculture farm in Zaježová, is a project run by Pospolitost pre Harmonicky Zivot NGO. It provides a space for young people to experience farm work and a sustainable life in community. The farm hosts 4-10 residents, guests and ESC volunteers at a time, offering hands-on learning experiences in permaculture, natural building, crafts, and self-sufficiency. With a permaculture garden and a small herd of goats and sheep, the farm produces a variety of dairy products and remains self-sufficient in vegetables year-round. You will learn about food forests, gardening, animal care, milking goats, about crafts and natural construction, as well as how to bake bread and make cheese. You will also learn a lot about community life. You will be involved our ongoing projects, work both on the Sekier farm as well as in other places of the local eco-village community where we cooperate with locals.

projects.title: We and nature
projects.description: "We and Nature"is a European Solidarity Corps volunteering initiative coordinated by Art Center – Karnolsky in Kardjali, Bulgaria. It will support six young volunteers in two long-term placements. The activities focus on community engagement, intercultural learning, and solidarity, with strong emphasis on inclusion of youth with fewer opportunities and the use of green travel. Volunteers will receive full organisational, financial, and learning support, including pocket money, accommodation, language assistance, and visa coverage where needed. The project contributes to the organisation’s accredited Quality Label goals, fostering diversity and equal participation.

projects.title: Long-term volunteer to Folk High School in Loimaa, Finland
projects.description:
APPLY THROUGH OUR WEBSITE: https://www.nuorisovaihto.fi/allianssi-youth-exchanges/volunteering-in-finland/long-term-esc-finland/project-6-loimaa-evangelical-folk-h/
Loimaa Evangelical Folk High School (LEKO) works in the fields of formal, non-formal education, social work, spiritual work, children’s welfare, and hospitality services locally, regionally, and internationally. The volunteer's tasks include for example assisting, organizing, and preparing free time activities for non-Finnish residential students (like homework hub, cooking, crafts, sports…), to help with languages (like hosting English Chatting evenings, a club of your culture and language), to take part in activities at children and youth development welfare centers, to give support in practical tasks in the folk high school when needed etc. Read more on our website: https://www.nuorisovaihto.fi/allianssi-youth-exchanges/volunteering-in-finland/long-term-esc-finland/project-6-loimaa-evangelical-folk-h/

projects.title: Communication for Human Rights Advocacy - Lima, Peru
projects.description: Paz y Esperanza is a human rights organization that works alongside children, women, indigenous populations, and people with disabilities to build a society free from violence and injustice. Within theEducational-Communication team, the volunteer will contribute to transform field results into impactful digital narratives. Daily responsibilities involve gathering information and testimonials from technical teams to create a strategic communication calendar. The volunteer will be responsible for the creative process, including drafting messages with a gender-sensitive lens and designing graphic or audiovisual assets such as reels and infographics. Beyond digital production, the role includes designing and coordinating campaigns to increase institutional visibility. This position is based in Lima, offering a professional routine that includes active participation in institutional meetings and events to ensure all content remains coherent with our mission of justice.

projects.title: Social worker for child protection and Empowerment - La Paz, Bolivia
projects.description: Fundación Munasim Kullakita operates the "Hogar Trampolín," a specialized protection center in Bolivia for girls and female adolescents (ages 10-17) who are survivors of human trafficking and sexual exploitation, focusing on the restoration of their fundamental rights. The volunteer supports the Social Work department in providing comprehensive care for girls and adolescents recovering from abuse and exploitation. Primary actions include conducting social assessments, developing genograms, and analyzing family and economic conditions to identify support networks. The volunteer assists the lead social worker in interviewing residents using active listening and empathetic techniques, ensuring a non-judgmental and confidential environment. Key tasks involve drafting follow-up and reintegration reports, managing medical appointments, and accompanying residents to health centers. By evaluating risks and personal needs, the volunteer helps design individualized intervention plans.

projects.title: Psychological Support for child protection - La Paz, Bolivia
projects.description: Fundación Munasim Kullakita operates "Hogar Trampolín" in Bolivia, a specialized center providing comprehensive protection and rights restitution for girls and female adolescents who are survivors of human trafficking and sexual exploitation. The volunteer supports the lead psychologist in the emotional recovery and identity reconstruction of survivors aged 10-17. The mission focuses on three axes: helping residents recognize themselves as victims to overcome guilt, empowering them as survivors through resilience, and fostering the ability to project a constructive future. Daily tasks include conducting psychological evaluations to guide staff interventions and providing individual and group therapeutic support tailored to cognitive development and cultural backgrounds. The volunteer assists in drafting monthly follow-up, monthly, and reintegration reports for legal authorities. A critical active component involves providing emotional containment during legal proceedings.

projects.title: Ready to Act: Volunteering at the Kindergarten no 83 in Krakow
projects.description: We are searching for 2 ESC volunteers for the kindergarten in Krakow. Project starts in the beginning of September 2026 and ends in June 2027 (10 months). The main tasks of volunteers in the kindergarten will be to support children in their everyday routine and conduct own activities based on the culture and language of the country of origin. Volunteers will assist during scheduled activities, supporting the staff: helping to prepare materials for activities and deccorations for different event in the kindergarten, they assist during meetings with parents. They help during outdoor activites abd when children will go for trips. The age of the children is from 3 y.o. and volunteers will have a chance to work with children from different age groups.  Apart the kindergarten volunteer will participate in the activities prepared by IB Polska -  monthly meetings, workshops, evaluation meetings, which is also obligatory part of the project.

projects.title: Ready to Act: Volunteering at the Kindergarten no 92
projects.description:
Project at IB Polska is based on working at the non-governmental organisation office and supporting projects for the local community as well as ESC projects. Volunteer will support the ESC team in the office by preparing materials for the blog (ESC teaches me something) and social media, taking photos and running own activites for teenagers, adults and seniors. Volunteer will work 5 days per week, up to 7 hours per day. It includes also working on weekends and taking free days during the weekdays instead. Working hours includes the time between 10 a.m. and 7 p.m., depending on the plan of the day.
Volunteer's task will be promoting volunteering, especially ESC projects among young people and organisations in cooperation with the ESC team and other volunteers. 
Volunteer will participate in the trainings provided by Hosting Organisation and Polish National Agency.

projects.title: Ready to Act: Volunteering at the Special School Complex no 4 - kindergarten
projects.description:
We are looking for one volunteer ready to join the ESC team in the Special School Complex no 4 in Krakow, Poland. The volunteer will work with the children with mental disabilities attending the kindergarten. Groups here are small and well organised. Volunteers task will be to play with children, help them to focus during their activities, assist during trips and offer her/his own activitities. 
Volunteer will work 6 hour per day from Monday till Friday (30 hours per week). Additionally volunteers will participate in the activities provided by the IB Polska at least once per month. Volunteers will participate in the trainings and meetings organised also by the Polish National Agency.

projects.title: Ready to Act: Volunteering at the School and Pre-School Complex no 11 in Krakow
projects.description:
We are looking for 2 volunteers ready to work in the primary school in Krakow. Their task will be to organise language contests for student, working with students with fewer opportunities, preparing workshops based on the culture and traditions of their countries, assisting during the trips and school events, preparing deccorations for the school events together with students.
Volunteers will work 6 hours per day in the school. They will have their own place to prepare materials for the planned activities.
Additionally volunteers will join activities provided by IB Polska for all ESC volunteers at least once per month. There are also oblugatory trainings provided by the Polish National Agency.

projects.title: Long-Term ESC in ISTANBUL (1 July 2026 - 1 July 2027)
projects.description:
Volunteers who will take part in our ESC project will contribute to youth work, project development, and career support activities carried out within our association. By bringing an international perspective to these activities, volunteers will help increase their impact and support reaching a wider group of young people. Volunteers will take an active role five days a week, within a program of approximately 30–35 hours, and will support the processes in line with their knowledge and skills.

The main weekly activities in which volunteers will be involved include:
- Project development and small-scale social projects
- Support in international mobility activities and youth work
- Contribution to reporting, documentation, and interview processes
- Project dissemination and promotional activities
- Volunteering events and alumni network activities
- Mentorship and volunteer/alumni meetings
- Career talks with volunteers and feedback processes

projects.title: Working With People and Volunteering Adventure in České Budějovice
projects.description:
For the summer of 2026, we are seeking volunteers mainly for Summer camps for kids from the Czech Republic and Ukraine.

Diocesan Charity České Budějovice (further simply DCHCB) provides support, coordination, and methodical assistance to 10 local Charities. The Centre of DCHCB provides its own social services (including the Volunteer Centre) and participates in projects in the Diocese of České Budějovice and abroad. The project supported by the European Solidarity Corps enables us to host foreign volunteers who can participate in several volunteering activities. These activities focus on four target groups: 
1) support of older people and people with disabilities
2) work with children and youth in the programme Young Caritas, 
3) helping people who have been affected by a natural disaster or war. 
Our activities are open to all young people (volunteers), including those with fewer opportunities.

projects.title: #activeEUROPE 2026-2027 | long term ESC
projects.description: CHECK THE INFOPACK :) Join our team of 21 volunteers and spend ten exciting months in our ESC project! More information on www.esc.polites.org.pl. POLITES Association is organizing a long-term individual volunteering project that will take place in Szczecin, Poland. Volunteers can either work in the kindergarten or office. It will last from Sept 26 to July 27. The aim of the project is to develop your key competences and gain life experience. Taking part in our project means working with kids, the youth and the local community. You will have a great chance to present yourself, your country and culture. Also, you will participate in different workshops and activities. During these ten months, you will be presenting your culture, country, ideas, and the creative approach towards many actions. More information on our website - contact us for more and fill in our application form here: www.esc.polites.org.pl. Apply here to get more information as well. See you soon!

projects.title: Let's E.S.C. 2026
projects.description: The volunteering activity of the Let’s E.S.C. (Environmental Social Cooperation) will take place in Braga, Portugal, promoted by the FAJUB. During this period, we will receive volunteers who will develop their Let's ESC project. This project aims to assert itself as a promoter of environmental and social awareness and territorial cooperation and associations, as well as awareness for the problem and involvement in activities for the development of personal, educational and professional skills, in collaboration with community agents in the district of Braga. This project developed that aims at cooperation between active agents of the district with the promotion and support of activities of member associations of the federation as well as partner institutions in order to enrich the volunteers and the project of the best skills and experiences of all the net.

projects.title: Tracing Roots - Humanitarian Aid Volunteering Team in Thailand
projects.description:
STILL ACCEPTING APPLICATIONS!! TO BE CONSIDERED IT IS REQUIRED TO FILL THIS FORM ( COPY&PASTE THE LINK TO YOUR WEB): https://www.rfr.bz/f2ce415 INFOPACK: https://www.rfr.bz/f3b0be5

This 45-day volunteer program in Chiang Dao, Northern Thailand, focuses on women’s empowerment and cultural preservation through community-based activities. Participants will engage in workshops, collaborate with local partners, and contribute to creating an online diary, summary video, and advocacy project. The experience emphasizes cultural exchange, inclusion, and sustainability, offering a transformative learning journey. A follow-up phase ensures continued support and mentoring for personal and community impact.

projects.title: VOLUNTEERING AT TIRANT LO BLANC PRIMARY AND PREPRIMARY  SCHOOL
projects.description: We are a nursery and primary school .Our center is for early childhood education (from 2 to 5 and primary education (6 to 12 ) and is located in the town of Alzira, Valencia (30 min by train). We are committed to developing projects that promote critical thinking, active living and healthy lifestyles, respect for nature as well. Thus, by welcoming a volunteer we want him/her to be integrated into our daily life, collaborating in the different projects. Always taking into account his/her well-being, priorities and preferences to. He or she will participate in the projects from 2 to 5 years and 1rst and 2nd grade of primary : preparation of activities, collaboration with teachers, support in activities... So we are looking for a profile of young people with experience with young children, and in addition, experience in environmental issues because one of its functions will be to collaborate to boost the use of our school garden and environmental care and awareness projects.

projects.title: Short-term volunteering in Korca, Albania (July - August 2026)
projects.description: *IMPORTANT: In order for your application to be validated, you need to complete this link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSds50_9Aqu75HbXAFilop5jtTdzJQ3SpiBZvsNywsNyQ_QDPw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108218518332668720086 . projects.title: Project developement & fundraising - Kathmandu, Nepal
projects.description:
Women for Human Rights (WHR) is a leading NGO in Nepal dedicated to empowering single women and vulnerable communities, focusing on rights, socio-economic inclusion, and disaster response.
The volunteer will work with the Program Department to strengthen organizational capacity in design and implementation. The focus is on assisting in project proposal development through research and drafting documents aligned with donor priorities. the volunteer's task may include: · Identifying funding opportunities and researching potential donors. · Compiling documentation and assisting in grant application preparation. · Tracking funding pipelines and maintaining records.
Daily routine involves a mix of desk-based and collaborative work: reviewing project concepts, gathering data, editing reports, and preparing presentations. The volunteer will participate in planning discussions and field visits to gain practical exposure to project design.

projects.title: Community Resilience & WASH field officer - Kathmandu, Nepal
projects.description:
Women for Human Rights (WHR) is a leading NGO in Nepal dedicated to empowering single women and vulnerable communities, focusing on rights, socio-economic inclusion, and disaster response. This project supports communities vulnerable to environmental risks through prevention, preparedness, and recovery initiatives. As part of the RISE project, the volunteer takes an active role in strengthening community inclusion through field-based humanitarian actions.
Daily tasks of the volunteer may include
·Organizing and facilitating awareness campaigns on hygiene (WASH), public health, and environmental protection.
·Assisting in technical disaster preparedness training and community outreach workshops.
·Supporting local teams in post-disaster recovery actions and long-term resilience building.
·Promoting sustainable environmental practices through direct community engagement and data collection.
The volunteers work alongside local staff to improve the well-being of vulnerable groups.

projects.title: Comunicazione ambientale
projects.description: L'organizzazione d'accoglienza è un'entità ambientalista alla ricerca d'un volontario motivato che s'unisca al suo team dedicato alla comunicazione ambientale. Le tue mansioni principali saranno: la gestione dei social media e la creazione di contenuti multimediali relativamente alle attività dell'organizzazione; la realizzazione di riprese video delle attività di conservazione ambientale e il relativo montaggio; l'elaborazione e la diffusione di materiali di comunicazione e disseminazione per il pubblico sulle tematiche di protezione dell'ecosistema; il supporto pratico nell'organizzazione d'eventi e d'attività d'interesse pubblico; il supporto occasionale presso la Fattoria Canyadell, nel vivaio forestale, nell'orto biologico, nella cura di base degli animali e in attività di pulizia e ripristino, dell'edificio.

projects.title: Pensa internazionale e agisci localmente - 2026
projects.description: L'organizzazione d'accoglienza è un'organizzazione informale con sede a Jelenia Góra, che opera nell'àmbito dell'accreditamento Erasmus+ Youth e del Corpo Europeo di Solidarietà. Supporterai il lavoro quotidiano con bambini e giovani, in particolare giovani rifugiati ucraini e bambini che vivono in centri di alloggio collettivo nelle campagne circostanti. Le attività includono laboratori, educazione all'aperto, escursioni in montagna, iniziative artistiche e cooperazione transfrontaliera con partners di Germania e Repubblica Ceca. L'organizzazione ha due sedi nel centro città: il CAO - Centro di Attività Comunitarie e il Centro di Integrazione per stranieri, dove è possibile organizzare clubs linguistici e giochi da tavolo. Combinerai il coinvolgimento della comunità locale con la cooperazione internazionale, creando spazio per progetti di solidarietà e iniziative guidate dai giovani nella regione dei Monti Sudeti.

projects.title: New Steps on the Camino — Youth for Heritage and Sustainability
projects.description: New Footsteps on the Camino”, promoted by the Portuguese Federation of the Camino de Santiago within the framework of the European Solidarity Corps Quality Label, aims to engage young people in the preservation, enhancement, and sustainable promotion of the Camino de Santiago routes in Portugal. Volunteers will support environmental and heritage conservation actions, collaborate with local communities, take part in awareness-raising activities, foster intercultural dialogue, and contribute to the production of the Federation’s digital content and tools. Activities include assisting pilgrims, clean-up and waymarking campaigns, collecting and systematising heritage information, community workshops, and promoting sustainable tourism.

projects.title: Long-term (6 months) ESC volunteering with EFM Poland
projects.description: The aim of ESC with EFM is to challenge youngsters from different backgrounds to develop their active citizenship & promote education, while developing themselves and their skills. The volunteer will be expected to support the work of an international NGO that works mainly the scope of non-formal education. The tasks of the volunteers will be:- support EFM's daily work; - writing of articles, and dissemination of projects; - support the activities of YouthMaSter, a (non-formal education) seminar for polish schools; - supporting with logistics of different activities; - support the running of EFM's channels and social media. - support with the maintenance of the office  and EFM headquarters (house, garden +backyard);ç pick trsh and support cleaning actions during summerç support the work of the NGO in repairing, cleaning and fixing damaged facilitiesç - Preparing videos, short movies, and/or podcast about different topics; - support the NGO in events that may occur in the community.

projects.title: Let's volunteer in Sem&Vol
projects.description:
Solidarités Jeunesses (SJ) is a national movement of non-formal education and is composed of a National Secretary based in Paris, and eight regional delegations across France. Our delegations host volunteers from France and all over the world throughout the year. Each regional delegation is unique, but all of the activities organized benefit the local community and share common ground: 
- to gather people from different culture and social background to participate in social, ecological and cultural development on the local level . 
- To contribute to the integration of people with fewer opportunities. 
Each project is dedicated to actions of solidarity and collective living. We believe that cultural exchanges are a key for personal Learning and offers to the volunteer a valuable opportunity to learn, to experiment and to undergo personal development.

projects.title: #Planet for youth. Play & Grow
projects.description: Our organization runs two day care centers for children aged 7–12. Many of the kids we work with face challenges such as difficult living conditions, emotional or behavioral struggles, learning difficulties, or a need for psychological support. Main tasks for volunteers include: Spending individual time with a child. Helping with homework, doing crafts, or teaching a foreign language in the day care center. Organizing creative workshops and fun activities. Joining children in various events happening around the city. Supporting the team in organizing evening events such as Christmas or Easter celebrations, movie nights, and more. Helping to plan and run a summer camp for socially disadvantaged children. Participating in and co-creating activities based on the ideas of local youth and the volunteer.

projects.title: Hope Without Borders: Volunteer Driver 2026 / 2027
projects.description:
Caritas Sofia brings new hope to different groups, including refugees from the Middle East and Ukraine, Roma children, homeless people, youth with disabilities, abandoned elderly, children at risk, and others. We achieve this through a network of dedicated centres and administrative support—there is a lot of work, and we need help on all fronts. You will have the opportunity to both contribute and learn. The volunteer should commit to the full duration (approximately 11 months).

Currently, we are looking for one volunteer to join a team of four volunteers in Sofia (including you). The role will mainly focus on supporting logistical activities within Caritas Sofia’s work

As a Driver, you will deliver food to the Romani community centre and to elderly or homeless people, and occasionally assist with Caritas catering services. You may also take part in other activities during your free time and support additional initiatives when needeed.

projects.title: Collaborative workshops for youth with rural communities in Eastern Poland
projects.description:
Join us in the small village of Przetycz Włościańska, located 80 km from Warsaw, and become part of an inspiring international volunteering experience!

Together with local partners, you will support a community centre by organising workshops and activities for children and youth. The workshops are based on your own ideas, culture, and interests — from art, music, and languages to sports, games, and environmental topics.

This project creates a space for intercultural exchange, learning, and building connections between volunteers and the local community.

You will work in an international team, develop your creativity, and gain experience in non-formal education, while contributing to local initiatives in a rural area.

projects.title: HOPE WITHOUT BORDERS: Social volunteer (SOFIA) 2026 / 2027
projects.description:
Caritas Sofia brings new hope to different groups, including refugees from the Middle East and Ukraine, Roma children, homeless people, youth with disabilities, abandoned elderly, children at risk, and others. We achieve this through a network of dedicated centres and administrative support—there is a lot of work, and we need help on all fronts. You will have the opportunity to both contribute and learn. The volunteer should commit to the full duration (approximately 11 months).
Currently, we are looking for volunteers to join a team in Sofia. The role will mainly focus on working with refugees and the Romani community, while also offering opportunities to engage in other areas of Caritas Sofia’s work. For this position, we are looking for two volunteers.
As a Social Volunteer, you will work with refugees, children with disabilities, and Romani children across different locations. You are encouraged to develop your own initiatives.

projects.title: HOPE WITHOUT BORDERS: Social Media / Communication Volunteer
projects.description:
Caritas Sofia brings new hope to different groups, including refugees from the Middle East and Ukraine, Roma children, homeless people, youth with disabilities, abandoned elderly, children at risk, and others. We achieve this through a network of dedicated centres and administrative support—there is a lot of work, and we need help on all fronts. You will have the opportunity to both contribute and learn. The volunteer should commit to the full duration (approximately 11 months).
Currently, we are looking for a volunteer to join our team in Sofia, focusing on communication and outreach efforts.
As a Social Media / Communication Volunteer, you will support the PR team with communication projects and social media channels. You are encouraged to create your own content and develop ideas for promotion, helping to raise awareness about Caritas Sofia’s work.

projects.title: Collaborative workshops for youth with rural communities in Eastern Poland
projects.description: Join us in the charming village of Przetycz Włościańska, located 80 km from Warsaw in eastern Poland, and experience an unforgettable time at our workcamp. The project is organized in partnership with the Association of Traditionally Modern for the Countryside, in collaboration with local leaders and groups. Together with them you are going to create an educational space full of warmth and engagement. The main tasks of volunteers will be running and facilitating workshops for local communities. You will be supported by the hosting organization and local leaders.

projects.title: HOPE WITHOUT BORDERS: Volunteer Ambassador 2026 / 2027
projects.description:
Caritas Sofia brings new hope to different groups, including refugees from the Middle East and Ukraine, Roma children, homeless people, youth with disabilities, abandoned elderly, children at risk, and others. We achieve this through a network of dedicated centres and administrative support—there is a lot of work, and we need help on all fronts. You will have the opportunity to both contribute and learn. The volunteer should commit to the full duration (approximately 11 months).

Currently, we are looking for a highly motivated volunteer to join our team in Sofia and take an active role in promoting volunteering.

As a Volunteer Ambassador, you will promote volunteering and inspire others to get involved, especially through the European Solidarity Corps (ESC). This includes organizing events, networking, and leading initiatives such as Young Caritas activities

projects.title: HOPE WITHOUT BORDERS: Social volunteer (Plovdiv) 2026 / 2027
projects.description:
Caritas Sofia brings new hope to different groups, including refugees from the Middle East and Ukraine, Roma children, homeless people, youth with disabilities, abandoned elderly, children at risk, and others. We achieve this through a network of dedicated centres and administrative support—there is a lot of work, and we need help on all fronts. You will have the opportunity to both contribute and learn. The volunteer should commit to the full duration (approximately 11 months).
Currently, we are looking for a volunteer to support activities in Plovdiv, working with children from diverse backgrounds.
As a Social Volunteer in Plovdiv, you will support after-school activities by helping children with homework and engaging them in educational or recreational activities.

projects.title: HOPE WITHOUT BORDERS: Outreach volunteer 2026 / 2027
projects.description:
Caritas Sofia brings new hope to different groups, including refugees from the Middle East and Ukraine, Roma children, homeless people, youth with disabilities, abandoned elderly, children at risk, and others. We achieve this through a network of dedicated centres and administrative support—there is a lot of work, and we need help on all fronts. You will have the opportunity to both contribute and learn. The volunteer should commit to the full duration (approximately 11 months).
Currently, we are looking for volunteers to support outreach activities focused on homeless beneficiaries in Sofia. For this position, we are looking for two volunteers.
As an Outreach Volunteer, you will support activities for homeless beneficiaries, including preparing and distributing food and clothing, assisting with outreach, and maintaining facilities. A valid driver’s license is essential, as this role involves transportation and distribution tasks.

projects.title: Fajny ART Camp
projects.description:
Join the Fajny ART Camp in Poznań and become a part of a creative summer experience with children and teenagers!
The project takes place over two weeks, each dedicated to a different age group (10–12 and 13–15). Volunteers will support and co-create artistic activities, with a special focus on theatre during one of the weeks. Together with professionals, you will take part in the process of creating a performance.
Throughout the camp, you are encouraged to share your own ideas and lead creative workshops based on your interests — from art and music to games and intercultural activities.
The camp will also include a community picnic, where volunteers can organise activities for children and their families.
This is a great opportunity to develop creativity, teamwork, and experience in non-formal education.

projects.title: My Intercultural Europe  ! 26-27
projects.description:
The Europe House in Nîmes – Europe Direct  would like to host a volunteer for a project of 12 months in Nîmes, a south-east city of France. The volunteer will take part to the activities of the Europe House to inform citizens of our departments of Gard and Lozère about current events and projects about the EU and more specifically mobility programs for young people. 
The aim of the project is to facilitate intercultural exchanges between the volunteers and the local community. As an important actor of our educational service dedicated to schools, his/her activities will be to promote this service and to create and animate workshops for young people. Most of the activities of the volunteer will be linked with European youth work, the animation and the information on current events of the EU and organizing intercultural events with other volunteers. Furthermore, she/he will be in charge of animating our social networks.

projects.title: Boarding Program at the International Peace School Cologne
projects.description:
At the International Peace School Cologne, students are introduced to bilingual literacy from primary school onwards. Teachers and fellow students come from over forty countries and diverse cultural backgrounds. 
The boarding house is affiliated with the International Peace School Cologne. The boarding house operates in both German and English. It accommodates students aged 15 to 18 in apartments. It has a total capacity of 18 students.  
Volunteer Role: 
• Integration in daily life: Supporting routines such as meal preparation, homework help, tutoring, and other daily activities
• Recreational projects: Designing and implementing activities such as sports, music, creative projects, or excursions, including weekends and school holidays
• Afternoon clubs: Afternoon clubs: Leading activities such as language training in the volunteer’s native language, music, sports, or creative sessions.

projects.title: Cultural exchanges between young Europeans ! 26-27
projects.description:
The Emmanuel D’Alzon Institute is a private, state-contracted educational institution that welcomes students from preschool through higher education. The volunteer will be based at the Nîmes high school campus, with assignments in both primary and secondary schools. 
"Nurture, Empower, Reveal": the credo developed by the Emmanuel D’Alzon Institute. This commitment translates into a constant focus on a single objective: to reveal the talents of each individual. This applies to our future volunteer, whom we will be delighted to see develop throughout their time with us. The presence of a European volunteer is simply an opportunity for mutual enrichment.
- In primary school:  
Facilitating intercultural workshops
Language initiation and awareness
Sharing European experiences
- Primary/High School:
Promoting European values
Pedagogical collaboration 
- High school:
Pedagogical cooperation and Educational cooperation within European and linguistic project sections

projects.title: Europe & languages in my Campus - 26-27
projects.description: The Europe House in Nîmes would like to host 1 volunteers for a project of 11 months in Nîmes, a south-east city of France, close to the seaside. The volunteer will participate to the activities of a training centre, Purple Campus. His/her tasks will be divided between two campuses, a business school, EGC, in Nîmes and an apprenticeship centre in Marguerittes, a village close to Nîmes. The objective of the project is to facilitate the intercultural exchange between the volunteers, the students and the apprentices. Actors of the educational service, his/her activities will be to create and animate workshops for young people using non-formal learning methods. Most of the activities of the volunteer will be in relation with European languages, non-formal learning and information about Europe and current affairs. The volunteer will also prepare and coach students that do European mobilities (Erasmus+) and will participate in debats and different events organized by Purple Campus ...

projects.title: Get a volunteering in the Cévennes (South of France) in environmental projects about the chestnut, a local resource - 2026
projects.description:
The Epi de Mains association is a small organization based in the south of France in the middle mountains called “Les Cévennes”. This organization work is mainly around social and environmental projects.
The association would like to host a volunteer for a long term project of 6 months at l’Espinas in the village of Ventalon-en-Cevennes, from July 2026 to December 2026. The volunteer will take part in the activities of the association especially in the Chestnut grove-School project like supporting the care and development of the place, the link with the volunteers, the organization of the collective harvest and dry of the chestnuts, host groups for discovering the place.
The volunteer will start in July by helping to take care of the pedagogical discovering path of the Chestnut Grove, cleaning the dead branches, taking care of the forest. The volunteer will support the colleagues and volunteers in the creation of chill areas in the forest for sitting, chatting, relaxing…

projects.title: Education and mobility 26-27 IFME
Mobility, Languages and Administration ! 26-27
projects.description:
The CCI Gard High School is located in the heart of the city of Nîmes, near the "Nîmes Centre" train station. Since 1976, this historic high school has offered vocational training closely linked to the economic development of the region.
The aim of the project is to encourage pupils, students, teachers and staff at the lycee to be more open-minded about Europe and to be more mobile.
As a part of the educational service, the activities will involve creating and running workshops for young people using non formal methods and helping to organize outgoing mobility.
Most of the volonteer’s activities will relate to European languages, non formal learning and and information about Europe.
The volunteer will have the opportunity to be involved one day per week in the activity of Maison de l'Europe de Nîmes close the high school.

projects.title: Bringing the international experience to life at our school ! 26-27
projects.description:
The high school Lycée Saint-Vincent de Paul is a sixth-form college catering for students from Year 10 through to postgraduate level. We are located in the city centre of Nîmes, in the south of France, just a stone’s throw from the train station and the amphitheatre, in a very pleasant setting. We have a dynamic team running a wide range of projects, including language initiatives, eco-friendly schemes and community-focused activities …
The aim of the project is to promote intercultural exchange between volunteers and pupils. As key players in the education sector, their activities will involve designing and running workshops for young people using non-formal learning methods.
Most of the volunteers’ activities will focus on European languages, non-formal learning, discovering Europe and actively participating in the school’s projects (sustainable development, etc.)

projects.title: Youth Empowerment : Animation, Erasmus & More ! 26-27
projects.description:
The House of Europe of Nîmes is a non-profit organisation promoting European citizenship and international mobility. It supports young people, especially with fewer opportunities, through Erasmus+ projects to develop skills, autonomy and intercultural awareness. The team organises events and workshops to raise awareness about European opportunities. We wish to host 2 volunteers to bring an intercultural dimension to our projects and encourage European exchange. Their presence helps energise activities, bring new ideas and create a strong connection with young people. It is also a mutual learning experience, where everyone grows in a supportive and engaged environment.
