Volunteers take part in recruiting participants of the internships Erasmus+, leading workshops (interculturality, EU citizenship, conflict management), and preparing Erasmus+ mobilities. They co-lead language sessions in English, support participants before and during their internships, and contribute to communication.

projects.title: Volunteering in the World of Geology and Nature - Geonatura Kielce
projects.description:
The main task of the volunteer will be to take part in promotional and educational activities carried out by the Geoeducation Centre as the headquarters of the UNESCO Global Geopark. The volunteer will support the creation of promotional materials in English and optionally translate materials into their native language.
Additionally, the volunteer may prepare short presentations in English about the natural and cultural heritage of their home country or region and present them during educational sessions at the Geopark. They may also assist in translating educational materials.
There is also an opportunity to develop a creative social media project showing their experiences and impressions from their stay at Geonatura (e.g. posts, photos, reels, or short videos for Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, or TikTok), helping to promote the institution and the region in an engaging way. Project launch: August–September.

projects.title: IntercCultural Learning in Action – Youth Engagement in Secondary School
projects.description:
The project takes place in a secondary school and focuses on working with young people in an educational environment. The volunteer will have the opportunity to support and co-create activities such as book clubs, language clubs, workshops, and other creative and interactive sessions with students.
The aim is to engage with young people, understand their environment, and introduce non-formal and innovative learning methods through intercultural exchange and daily contact with a different culture and language. The volunteer will help create a dynamic and open learning atmosphere that encourages communication, creativity, and mutual understanding.

projects.title: Humanitarian Volunteer in Project Management in Benin
projects.description: If you too believe that a better world is possible, join us! WeWorld works especially for girls, boys, women and young people, actors of change in every community for a fairer and more inclusive world. It helps people to overcome emergencies and guarantee a life worth living, by offering opportunities and a better future through programmes of human and economic development. We are looking for one volunteer, who has not participated in an ESC humanitarian aid individual volunteering, who will join our mission in Benin within the framework of the VOLACT project! You will learn how to support the project team in implementing and monitoring activities focusing on improving the protection of vulnerable children and access to inclusive and quality education. You will acquire knowledge on child protection and education and how to collaborate with local communities.

projects.title: Let's Change the World Together 2026. AUGUST
projects.description: The project addresses topics of ecological sustainability and self-sufficiency, which are of interest to all as the whole world is affected by it regardless of country, race, creed or socioeconomic status. Therefore, we believe that our volunteering opportunity will be attractive to young people and we look forward to invite participants interested in sustainability and self-sufficiency. By being a representative of a model community and showing practical examples of such operational community, we are able to demonstrate the importance of leading an environmentally friendly lifestyle and educate others regarding the methods for doing so. The goal of our program, therefore, is to show and educate interested people that one can achieve a quality way of life that is sustainable environmentally, economically and socially. Reconnecting ourselves to natural environment, we strive to lead a lifestyle that is not merely non-harmful for the environment but that actually nurtures it.

projects.title: Create, Connect & Contribute through Armenia’s Alternative Youth Centers
projects.description:
Are you living in Germany and looking for a meaningful international volunteering experience? Join Armenian Progressive Youth through the European Solidarity Corps and support youth work, creativity, and community action across Armenia.

Volunteers may take part in activities at the Yerevan, Charentsavan, Tsakhkadzor, and Vayk Alternative Youth Centers, supporting workshops, cultural events, youth participation activities, media and communication, creative spaces, and grassroots community initiatives.

AYP’s Alternative Youth Centers are safe and inclusive spaces where young people engage in non-formal education, community life, and youth-led initiatives. Volunteers are encouraged to bring in their own ideas, learn through practice, develop new skills, and become part of an active intercultural and community-based learning environment.

projects.title: Spreading the Makers culture with a rural FabLab and its local community
projects.description: JOIN US FOR 12 MONTHS IN A RURAL MAKERSPACE !> A year. A village. A community. A launchpad* LEARNING, MAKING AND SHARING (ALMOST) ANYTHINGThrough their immersion in the daily life of Mountain Makers, volunteers will discover a community-driven space where local citizens of all ages come to learn, create and fix things together, engaging with open FabLab sessions, bringing the maker spirit into local school classrooms, and taking part in intergenerational exchanges with the Seniors Makers group.* FABLAB AND GREEN TRANSITIONThrough their participation in Mountain Makers' environmental initiatives, volunteers will explore how a rural makerspace can act concretely on the ecological transition of its territory, joining the monthly Repair Cafés, discovering the creative potential of upcycling through the DIY vehicle race, and contributing to the development of a shared garden with the local school.

projects.title: Sommerwerft Theatre Festival
projects.description:
Volunteering for the sommerwerft gives the opportunity to 25 young people to come and volunteer for about a month with the association PROTAGON e.V. in Frankfurt-am-Main, Germany. 
The team of 25 people arrives a few days before the build-up of the festival starts. The volunteers will sleep in a living and working community, where about 160 people share a house and a big garden. To go to the festival place that is in the city center of Frankfurt, volunteers can take one of our bikes or use our shuttle service. 
The working tasks are NOT directly related to something artistical. Tasks include maintaining the community place, and helping to take care of a specific area of the festival (concert tent or stage, bar, caffee or food stand, children program...). The festival lasts 17 days.
The activity ends up with 3 build-down days of the festival, and some extra days where volunteers are invited to reflect and celebrate together.

projects.title: ESC Long Therm Project-Growing Together: Schools & After-School Adventures
projects.description:
Spend up to 12 months in Kielce and level up your life while living abroad. This is way more than just volunteering, it’s a chance to gain real experience, meet amazing people from different cultures, and figure out if working with children is your thing. You’ll support teachers in schools and after school spaces, work directly with kids, and learn by actually doing, not just sitting through boring theory.
  During the project, you’ll build confidence, communication, teamwork, leadership, creativity, and problem-solving skills that will help you in literally any future job.
  What makes this project extra special? The exclusive workshops only available for participants: self-defense, first aid, and communication + assertiveness training with a psychologist. These are real-life skills you’ll use long after the project ends.
  You’ll leave with unforgettable memories, international friendships, stronger self-confidence, and experience that will make your CV stand out big time.

projects.title: ESC Long Therm Project-Behind the Scenes of Culture Centres&Libraries
projects.description:
Spend up to 12 months in Kielce and gain valuable international experience while living abroad. This project takes place in cultural centres and libraries, where you’ll support the organisation of creative workshops, cultural and themed evenings, community events, and activities for children, teenagers, adults. You’ll work alongside experienced staff, help prepare events from behind the scenes, and discover how cultural institutions operate on a daily basis.

This is much more than volunteering.it’s a chance to develop communication, teamwork, leadership, creativity, organisation, and problem-solving skills through real hands-on experience. What makes this project truly stand out are the exclusive workshops available only for participants: self-defense training, first aid courses, and communication and assertiveness workshops led by a psychologist. These practical, real-life skills are rarely offered in volunteering projects and will stay useful long after.

projects.title: We and nature - Kardzhali
projects.description: "We and Nature"is a European Solidarity Corps volunteering initiative coordinated by Art Center – Karnolsky in Kardjali, Bulgaria. It will support six young volunteers in two long-term placements. The activities focus on community engagement, intercultural learning, and solidarity, with strong emphasis on inclusion of youth with fewer opportunities and the use of green travel. Volunteers will receive full organisational, financial, and learning support, including pocket money, accommodation, language assistance, and visa coverage where needed. The project contributes to the organisation’s accredited Quality Label goals, fostering diversity and equal participation.

projects.title: Behind the Scenes: Exploring the Magic of Performing Arts-Zodiak Circus-Szczecin/Poland
projects.description: Don't you like being bored? If your answer is a resounding "NO," we have an offer that will turn your daily routine into an extraordinary adventure. Fundacja Antygrawitacja is a place where circus, theater, and movement meet to create a space full of inspiration. We work with children and youth, helping them find themselves through creative expression. We are looking for two passionate individuals to join our team for one of three exciting paths. You could be our Social Media Hero, where reels, photography, graphic design, and content creation are your element. You might prefer being a Circus Tutor Assistant, supporting young artists, helping run workshops, and participating in festivals. Or perhaps you would thrive as our Stage Technical Staff, where working with stage lights, scenography, and tools like hammers and screwdrivers is the exact challenge you are looking for. You don't need to be an expert, as we value passion and a willingness to learn above all else. Come join us!

projects.title: Europa attiva 2026-2027: volontariato E.S.C. di lungo periodo in ufficio
projects.description: Supporterai l'organizzazione d'accoglienza (che si chiama Polítes) e altre entità con cui essa collabora nella gestione d'alcuni programmi di solidarietà nell'area di Stettino: gestirai i social media dell'organizzazione, preparerai posters e volantini, svolgerai attività di promozione del Corpo Europeo di Solidarietà, scriverai rapporti sull'andamento dei progetti, organizzerai corsi o seminari d'Italiano o d'altre lingue e altri eventi culturali, anche in collaborazione con le scuole locali. L'obiettivo finale del progetto è che tu acquisisca e consolidi le competenze necessarie a promuovere il volontariato come un modo interessante d'impiegare il tempo libero. Una parte delle tue attività sarà coordinata da Polítes, ma ci sarà anche spazio per lo sviluppo d'iniziative di tua invenzione, e ulteriori momenti liberi dove a essere messa alla prova sarà la tua capacità di gestire il tempo e le tue attività in un contesto che non è quello abituale di casa tua o della tua città.

projects.title: R.I.S.E.
projects.description: Project will have THREE main kind of activities: SOCIAL FARM:aimed at promoting disadvantaged people’s rehabilitation, care and/or the integration of people with ‘low contractual capacity’ (i.e.: psycho-physical disabilities, drug addicts, minors, emigrants). The special added value of social farming is the possibility for disadvantaged people to being integrated in a living context, where their personal potential may be valued and enhanced. DAILY CENTER WITH DISABLE PEOPLE The daily center is created for people with mental disability (children and adults). Every working day the volunteers have a chance to participate in man kinds of activity: manual art and do it yourself activities (make decorations, figures, painting etc.); recycling and kitchen workshop (participating in every step of preparing meals for the group, and getting to know even Italian cuisine better when cooking together MIGRATION CENTER activity with migrants adults and children in a daily center or houses.

projects.title: Youth Empowerment Project 31 August 2026 - 23 December 2026(115 days)
projects.description:
🌍 ESC Volunteering Opportunity with ABS!

📌 About the Project:
Join Active Bulgarian Society (ABS) in empowering youth and promoting sustainability, eco-friendly initiatives, and European values! As an ESC volunteer, you’ll help spread awareness of Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps opportunities through interactive events, workshops, and outreach activities.

📌 Your Role:
✅ Organize events & campaigns – Clean-ups, art clubs, DIY sustainability projects & more.
✅ Promote ESC & Erasmus+ – Info sessions, school visits, and creative outreach.
✅ Social Media & Communication – Create content, write articles, and share ABS initiatives.
✅ Develop Your Own Project – Turn your idea into a real community initiative!

🎯 Who Are We Looking For?
Proactive, open-minded, and motivated young people ready to make an impact! No experience needed—just enthusiasm for sustainability, creativity, and teamwork!

📩 Apply now and start your ESC adventure with ABS! 🚀

projects.title: Live the Festival, Close to Nature -  ART Summer
projects.description:
You arrive at an old railway station hostel. Trains pass by. Then you step into Białowieża Forest—not to take over, but to be part of something already alive. 🌳
This is a travelling outdoor theatre festival. You join the team that makes it happen—gently, responsibly, together.
You can:
— be on stage: act, move, join performances and parades 🎭
— support the tech side: sound, lights, keeping things running 🔌
— create content: photo, video, stories from behind the scenes 📱🎥
— co-run the festival café: simple things, good vibes 🍋
— ride a bike rickshaw: help people move through the festival space 🚲
You don’t need to be pro/perfect. You just need to show up, stay open, and respect the place you’re in.
Forest first. Then theatre.
Are you curious about new challenges? Or maybe you play an instrument? Do you sing? Have any artistic experience? Apply.

projects.title: Green Summit || Beglika Festival
projects.description: Green Summit is an ESC project of Green Association (greenassn.com) with a short-term volunteering team, which will take place in July and August 2026 and can be extended to a long-term mobility in case of interest from both sides. In this project 16 volunteers from program countries will be hosted in RURAL BULGARIA. The main part of the activities will take place at BEGLIKA FESTIVAL (https://beglika.org/en/) and the newly emerging SOCIAL CENTER of Green Association in Architectural Reserve Staro Stefanovo village. Green volunteers can get rich experience in EVENT MANAGEMENT, SUSTAINABLE LIVING, BUILDING WITH NATURAL MATERIALS and COMMUNITY BUILDING. Among the main activities to achieve our objectives are the RECONSTRUCTION and RESTORATION of the social center, organization of FESTIVALS promoting sustainable living, WORKSHOPS and other events that will provide valuable experience to our volunteers. InfoPack -> https://greenassn.com/greenpack/

projects.title: Point and Shoot with Local Youth 8
projects.description: The project is divided into 4 stages. In first stage, volunteers learn about multimedia—how to use photo and video equipment, how to edit content, and how to produce high-quality media products. This knowledge is provided by local experts who create professional content at both the national and international levels (e.g., Eurovision videos, MasterChef videos, etc.). In second stage, volunteers collaborate with local organizations, individuals, and our institution to produce high-quality content with the support of these experts. In third stage volunteers will prepare and execute workshops for kids in all primary schools in Medvode for 2 months. The final stage is dedicated to a personal project, in which volunteers create various multimedia content to demonstrate the skills and knowledge they have acquired during the project. During the project volunteers will record vlogs to represent their work. TO SEE MORE ABOUT THE PROJECT CHECK THIS LINK: https://linktr.ee/escmedvode

projects.title: Voluntariado Violeta
projects.description: La experiencia de voluntariado, será en LaTrebede, una asociación de mujeres de carácter local, que dinamiza una red de apoyo para familias en riesgo de exclusión social del municipio de Avilés. Algunas de las actividades son de acompañamiento, espacios de cuidados, grupos de apoyo, ocio y participación social. Las voluntarias se incorporaran a la programación 2026/27 de la Red Matriz, que incluye actividades como Espacio Infantil Inclusivo, Espacio de Salud, Sororidad y Autocuidado, Clases de Español "Mujeres con Mundo" y Acompañamiento intergeneracional "Rederas".

projects.title: Sensibilisation au développement durable
projects.description:
L’association IFKER d’éducation au développement durable est une association marocaine créée en juin 2014, œuvrant dans le territoire du Zerhoun, notamment à Moulay Idriss, dans la province de Meknès. Elle intervient dans le domaine du développement territorial durable à travers l’éducation à l’environnement, la protection de la nature.
Les volontaires (2) se verront confiés des missions individuelles autour de la sensibilisation au développement durable au sein de l'association dans la Région Fès-Meknès.
1	Appui à la planification des activités de sensibilisation et d'animation dans les écoles
2	Appui à la mise en place de projets locaux : en lien avec la protection du patrimoine environnemental, historique et culturel du territoire
3	Appui à l’intégration et aux activités mises en place dans l’accueil de groupes (programme Dépasser les Frontières)
4	Participation à la valorisation des animations proposées : communication
5	Découverte des autres activités de la structure

projects.title: Don Bosco Sozialwerk, Vienna (Don Bosco Volunteers)
projects.description: “Don Bosco Sozialwerk” in Vienna is a Salesian centre for refugees with homes, counselling and training programs with circa 50 staff members. Activities for volunteers are assistance in the educational programs, companionship in the homes (housekeeping, free time activities, accompaniment to doctors and appointments with authorities, etc.) and support in administrative tasks and building services. Don Bosco Volunteers offers many volunteering opportunities. The target group are especially kids and youngsters. The tasks of the volunteers are, for example, the organizational help for a day of games and fun, the educational support of young refugees, sports and leisure activities with children and young people or the organization of joint excursions. European Solidarity Corps volunteers bring their youthful vibrancy and are positively present and close to children and young people. Their presence opens up a space for mutual learning processes and underlines the European idea.

projects.title: Appui à la communication et à la gestion des activités
projects.description:
Le volontaire sera en soutien à la promotion des activités de l’association sur les canaux de communication ainsi que de la préparation de différents ateliers de sensibilisations à l’environnement et autres thèmes. Elle participera également à la mise en place de certaines activités de l’association. Il. elle sera en contact avec sa tutrice, le staff administratif du Centre social, les membres actifs de l’association et les bénéficiaires de divers projets développés par l’association.
 Le.la volontaire sera en soutien à:
-Préparation des ateliers de sensibilisation pour les élèves des institutions scolaires impliquées dans les projets de Nabta. 
-Participera à l’entretien des jardins pédagogiques, à la récolte, au séchage et mise en sachet et au marketing pour l’animation des ateliers de sensibilisation 
-Contribuera à différentes activités de l’association (formations, sensibilisation, organisation d’évènements, sorties scolaires, activités de gestion administrative…).

projects.title: Don Bosco 4 Youth, Vienna (Don Bosco Volunteers)
projects.description: Since 30 years the Salesians of Don Bosco have been offering orientation days for school classes. We give pupils the space to ask themselves questions about life, togetherness and faith. We offer age-appropriate methods and current topics in order to be able to tie in with the lifeworld of young people. Depending on the topic, we work with methods from different pedagogical disciplines (social, religious, play, experiential, environmental, theatre pedagogy, etc.). Through the various dimensions of methodological engagement, it is possible to accompany young people holistically and to respond to the interests of the young people. Don Bosco Volunteers offers many volunteering opportunities. The target group are especially kids and youngsters. Volunteers of the European Solidarity Corps contribute their youthful dynamics and they are positively present and close to kids and youngsters. Their presence opens a space for mutual learning processes and underlines the European idea.

projects.title: Appui à la gestion des projets menés en permaculture
projects.description:
La volontaire participera à la poursuite et au développement des projets de l’association Nabta Maroc notamment ceux menés en permacultures. Elle sera en contact avec sa tutrice, le staff administratif du Centre social, les membres actifs de l’association Nabta, les jardiniers, et les bénéficiaires des projets menés en permaculture.
Le.la volontaire sera en soutien à:
-Veille à l’entretien et au suivis des jardins pédagogiques menés en permaculture, assurer le séchage des PAM et à leur mise en sachet. (Tenu d’un carnet de suivi des plantations, des récoltes et de leur distribution)
-Préparation des ateliers de sensibilisation pour les élèves des institutions scolaires impliquées dans les projets de Nabta (Formation au tri, au recyclage des déchets et à la mise en place de bac à compost)
-Contribution à différentes activités de l’association (organisation d’évènements, campagnes de sensibilisation à l’environnement, sorties scolaires, activités de gestion administrative…).

projects.title: European Volunteer for Educational Program "Opening to the world"
projects.description: Apprentis d’Auteuil is a Foundation composed of more than 300 youth centers. Its goals are to welcome, educate, train and insert more than 40,000 young people in distress and accompany their families. We develop the individual talent and personal skills of each young person and help them to find their place in society. Your main mission will be to accompany young people with learning disabilities in their school lives. More especially, you will : -In conjunction with the teams, implement educational projects with an international, sport or cultural / intercultural focus. -Participate in school life and be a force of proposal to animate school life time with the young people -Contribute to school follow-up and support (homework help, tutoring, learning in sub-groups) in conjunction with the school life educators and the teachers.

projects.title: Baltic Sea Archipelago Adventure Livonsaari Finland team
projects.description:
The team highlights the significance of the Baltic Sea, its ecological importance and impact of human beings and how to promote practical, everyday steps towards environmental sustainability.
Volunteer tasks will be adaptable, tailored to local circumstances, weather conditions, and the needs of the community, including gardening work, building with natural materials from archipelago region, cooking with local harvest and produce from the Baltic sea region, learning about the impact of reed onto Baltic Sea ecosystem and various local reed usage innovations, a trip to neighbouring islands with a ferry to see the local impact on nature, getting to know local lifestyle and participate to daily tasks, Baltic sea inspired art and impacting through art, co-operation with local youth activities,
 More information and applications please visit https://www.nuorisovaihto.fi/allianssi-youth-exchanges/esc-vthpa-baltic-sea/baltic-sea-archipelago-livonsaari/

projects.title: Die Kunterbunte: "Eine Zeitschrift von Kindern für Kinder"
projects.description: With the start of the 2026/27 school year, the Luxembourg Red Cross is placing a strong emphasis on non-formal education in its 16 Maisons Relais, which cater for circa 3,860 children aged between 3 and 12. Around 500 education professionals are committed every day to providing children with an environment in which they can freely develop their interests. Non-formal education, as practised in the Red Cross Maisons Relais, places the competent child at the centre of its concerns. ‘We see the child as a competent individual who is actively building his or her educational path. Our mission is to accompany them on this journey’. Our structures follow the concept of open workshops. In the Maisons Relais, there are different functional areas covering themes such as nature, rest, movement, media and construction. The children aare free to pursue their interests and use the spaces according to their needs. The educators play a central role in encouraging children to develop their own skills

projects.title: Ecoparco Polis 2: Woodcraft & Kalabria Eco Festival 2026
projects.description:
Are you ready to take part in a hands-on volunteering experience focused on sustainability and rural life in southern Italy? This ESC project invites volunteers to support environmental, educational, and community-based activities promoting local culture and sustainable development.

Participants will engage in practical tasks such as permaculture, regenerative agriculture, and the care of green and forest areas, while learning more sustainable lifestyles. Volunteers will also support local events, environmental workshops, and educational activities with children, including art, creative writing, and nature-based learning.

This experience offers the opportunity to connect with local communities, discover rural traditions, and develop skills such as teamwork, adaptability, and environmental awareness through non-formal learning, while actively contributing to positive change in Calabria.

projects.title: A4ACTION ESC VOLUNTEERING PROGRAM - LONG TERM
projects.description: The aim of the project is to support the personal, educational, and social development of children and young people in Snagov through non-formal learning, intercultural exchange, and community engagement, while empowering volunteers to develop key competences, active citizenship, and professional skills in youth work. As part of this project, volunteers will: - Organize and implement non-formal activities at the A4ACTION After School program for children aged 7 to 10 years; - Organize and implement workshops in local schools (middle schools and high schools), including cultural events, skills and soft skills development, civic engagement etc. - Design activity plans for every activity conducted at the A4ACTION Youth Center and in local schools. - Complete various administrative tasks, such as filling out weekly reports, activity reports, and maintaining the activity calendar. - Contribute to the development of the A4ACTION Virtual Youth Center.

projects.title: Volunteering in St Amand Montrond 2026 – 2027
projects.description: 10-month mission, 24 hours/week, built around three main areas: 1. Fostering intercultural understanding among students and schoolchildren (conversation workshops, oral language practice, and participation in educational events); 2. Promoting Europe and people-to-people exchanges (Activities at the Youth Workers’ Residence ages 16–30 (organizing Europe Day, preparing trips abroad with residents, and developing projects about Europe and global cultures)); 3. Bringing intercultural understanding to life: Building bridges between generations since kids till elderly people or families; 4. Intercultural activities and support for children at leisure centres during the school holidays; 5. Bringing the FJT social restaurant to life (Once a month, a friendly and festive meal is organise at the Young Workers’ Hostel restaurant. This event is open to everyone (residents, partners and residents, as appropriate) and aims to foster a sense of community in a warm and welcoming atmosphere)

projects.title: Next Chapter 5.0
projects.description: !!! Read Next Chapter 5.0 infopack & apply here: http://tiny.cc/68a3101. Next Chapter offers a unique volunteering experience focused on community living, well-being, creativity, and connection with nature. Are you interested in hands-on projects, outdoor activities, community life, and creative expression? Then this volunteering experience might be for you. As a volunteer, you will stay at the Synergy House in Dzhurovo, where you’ll live with volunteers from different countries. Throughout the project, you will have the opportunity to help improve the center through activities such as gardening, building, painting, and various DIY projects. Beyond the practical work, you’ll also connect with local people, share your hobbies and skills with fellow volunteers, and become part of a supportive and vibrant community. Gain new experiences and contribute to a shared project!

projects.title: Volunteering Department Officer with TECHO Peru
projects.description:
TECHO Peru has diversified its projects in line with the needs of local communities, launching food donation campaigns to tackle food insecurity, and setting up vaccination programmes and health centres to improve infrastructure and expand service capacity.
Since 2001, TECHO Peru has worked in over 650 informal settlements across the regions of Callao, Lima, Ica, Piura, La Libertad, Lambayeque, Ancash, Arequipa, Moquegua and Tacna. To date, we are active in 34 informal settlements in Lima.
This represents a support role in the recruitment, organisation and mentoring of TECHO Peru volunteers, helping to strengthen the processes of recruitment, training and deployment in local activities. You will be responsible for providing support in putting together teams based on profiles, participating in or leading training sessions, and supporting field leaders, ensuring a well-organised, meaningful volunteering experience that is aligned with the organisation’s mission.

projects.title: Come help grow a living experiment in community, sustainability, creativity, and human connection in rural Sweden!
projects.description:
Fridhem offers a unique long-term volunteer experience in a close-knit ecological community in Sweden. Focused on sustainability, permaculture, shared living, and personal growth, the project gives volunteers the chance to develop practical skills while becoming part of everyday community life.

Activities change with the seasons and may include gardening, growing and harvesting food, communal cooking with local and homegrown ingredients, building and restoration projects, maintenance, workshops, and community events. Volunteers are encouraged to contribute their own ideas, interests, and strengths.

Life at Fridhem is built around cooperation, cultural exchange, and learning together. Volunteers receive regular support from a dedicated coordinator through meetings and daily check-ins. By the end of the experience, volunteers leave with practical knowledge, stronger confidence and communication skills, and a deeper understanding of sustainable living and community building.

projects.title: Housing and Habitat Volunteer with TECHO Peru
projects.description:
The volunteer will provide direct support to TECHO Peru’s Housing and Habitat Department, contributing to the technical design, implementation and monitoring of housing improvement projects in low-income settlements in Lima. They will work in a hybrid capacity: in the field alongside communities and from the office, coordinating technical activities with a focus on rights and community development.
● Prepare plans, technical specifications and project files for housing improvement projects in low-income settlements.
● Design and deliver training workshops for families on housing, safe housing and environmental improvement.
● Manage projects in this area: planning, scheduling, monitoring of activities and impact indicators.
● Conduct field visits to communities for technical assessment and to support families.
● Assist with the systematisation of technical information and the preparation of progress reports and project monitoring.

projects.title: Volunteering in Nonformal Education in TIMISOARA ESC7
projects.description: Welcome to an exciting ESC Volunteering Project set in the vibrant city of Timisoara, Romania, the European Cultural Capital of 2023. This unique opportunity invites volunteers in a life-changing experience, working with kids through non-formal education, creativity activities, entrepreneurial education and language enhancement. The participants will be engaged in a diverse range of activities that focus on enriching the lives of young minds and fostering cultural exchange. Timisoara, known for its cultural heritage and progressive spirit, provides the ideal backdrop for a project that thrives on creativity, connection, and community. Volunteers will be at the heart of this project, as they collaborate daily with children from the local community. Through non-formal educational approaches, participants will engage the young learners in interactive workshops and games.

projects.title: One long term ESC volunteer vacancy at our school in Spain
projects.description: We are looking for 1 outgoing young person between 22 to 30 years old who is interested in the field of children and youth. Our volunteer has three main tasks: 1. Helping children in the classroom along with the teachers mainly in the English subject. Our school has students from 3 to 18 years old. 2. Hosting conversation sessions for both teachers and students. This involves preparing conversation topics and working with a group of students. We will offer you materials to work with. 3. Design three projects to work with the students based on European values (environment, health, culture...). The Erasmus coordinator of the school will help you with the designing and running of the project. The project is addressed to the primary students to learn more about European values. Last year the projects helped students learn about 'healthy habits', 'endangered animals' and 'blood donation' and we celebrated a blood donation day. We also learnt about how to help the environment.

projects.title: Europa attiva 2026-2027: volontariato E.S.C. di lungo periodo in asilo
projects.description: Farai parte d'un gruppo di 17 volontari distribuiti in 3 asili, due a Stettino e uno nella vicina città di Stargard, dove supporterai il personale nella cura dei bambini e nell'insegnamento delle competenze di base, compreso il Polacco, e nell'organizzazione e conduzione d'attività volte a promuovere lo sviluppo fisico, mentale e sociale attraverso giochi, arte, artigianato, musica, narrazioni ed  eventi. Al di là delle attività specifiche nell'asilo, l'obiettivo finale del progetto è che tu acquisisca e consolidi le competenze necessarie a promuovere il volontariato come un modo interessante d'impiegare il tempo libero. Una parte delle tue attività sarà coordinata da Polítes, che è l'organizzazione capofila del progetti, ma ci sarà anche spazio per lo sviluppo d'iniziative di tua invenzione, e ulteriori momenti liberi dove a essere messa alla prova sarà la tua capacità di gestire il tempo e le tue attività in un contesto che non è quello abituale di casa tua o della tua città.

projects.title: Buzz regeneration! - Communication, Agroforestry and Permaculture project in Puglia
projects.description: Regen is based in an Agroforestry farm now containing more then 15.000 different fruit trees, shrubs, herbaceous plants and vegetable gardens. Our association regularly organizes training courses for young people and adults on Agroforestry, Permaculture and Regenerative Agriculture, with practical and theoretical parts. We carry out different activities related to the training of participants in many areas within the framework of agro-ecology, bio-construction, ecology in general. Currently we work and collaborate in the development and establishment of different projects with agroforestry and agroecological models. The association has been offering different courses related to Agroforestry, soil regeneration, hydrological management, bioconstruction and some other topics related to ecology for about 8 years.

projects.title: Help Build Regeneration! - Eco Building, Agroforestry and Permaculture project in Puglia
projects.description: Regen is based in an Agroforestry farm now containing more then 15.000 different fruit trees, shrubs, herbaceous plants and vegetable gardens. Our association regularly organizes training courses for young people and adults on Agroforestry, Permaculture and Regenerative Agriculture, with practical and theoretical parts. We carry out different activities related to the training of participants in many areas within the framework of agro-ecology, bio-construction, ecology in general. Currently we work and collaborate in the development and establishment of different projects with agroforestry and agroecological models. The association has been offering different courses related to Agroforestry, soil regeneration, hydrological management, bioconstruction and some other topics related to ecology for about 8 years. We need minds and hands to build new structures on the farm <3

projects.title: YOUTH 4 Inclusion
projects.description: Youth4Inclusion is a project primarily designed to work directly with young people in vulnerable situations. The main goal of the project is to promote the social and educational inclusion of the youth we support, as well as to improve their family environment. We work towards this goal through daily activities at the COJ – Youth Occupational Centre, where we help young people explore new possibilities in life through workshops, visits, intercultural exchanges, and more. In addition, we conduct parenting education sessions for families and the wider local community. The activities developed by Abrigo Seguro are mainly educational. The volunteer’s tasks will be planned to offer a diverse and meaningful set of experiences. Volunteers will have the opportunity to work directly with the community, contribute to the organization’s key projects, and also take part in broader community events.

projects.title: Youth, Environment & Adventure
projects.description: The community of Avintes and Vila Nova de Gaia, located in the second largest district of Portugal, places great importance on raising awareness among children and young people about the need to preserve and protect nature. Volunteers will support us in a variety of activities related to environmental education and non-formal learning. Through the practice of adventure sports and the organization of outdoor activities, they will help develop a project designed to engage young people with fewer opportunities or at risk of social exclusion. Using non-formal education methods, the goal is to promote both social and educational inclusion. Volunteers will bring fresh perspectives to our project while enjoying the chance to connect with the local community and gain a truly enriching volunteering experience. We currently run several ongoing projects, and volunteers will have the opportunity to participate in all of them, experiencing different people and places along the way.

projects.title: Solidarity in Action - Short Term
projects.description:
The volunteers will be divided into four teams:

The Environmental Team will be engaged in cleaning initiatives, environmental protection campaigns and restoration of hiking/biking trails.

The Painting Team will focus on painting walls in local kindergartens.

The Kids Team will conduct non-formal activities in kindergartens during the mornings and in parks during the evenings.

The Media Team, consisting of 5 members, will be responsible for managing social media accounts and creating promotional materials.

In addition, volunteers will actively participate in local festivals, concerts, and cultural events. Their involvement will encompass preparation, promotion, cleaning, and tending our stand during these events. 

We invite you on our instagram for further information: @nevo_parudimos

projects.title: Venti di Scambio - Innovation and Creativity
Volunteering at Askov Højskole
projects.description:
Please see our website for details and how to apply:

https://www.afs.dk/frivillig-udlandet/evs-hosting-opportunities-in-denmark/#afs-nav-askov-hoejskole

If you want to apply for this volunteer position you have to fill out an online form that you can find on the link above. 

* Please be aware that we do not receive or consider applications sent through email.
* AFS Interkultur handles the initial call of application and recruitment process for this project, if you have any questions, please contact us directly at evs-denmark@afs.org rather than reaching out to Askov Højskole.

projects.title: Care for unaccompanied minors (Orléans) 1/2
projects.description:
As part of a dynamic team of volunteers and staff, the volunteer will take part in the association’s activities. Their main role will be to animate actions to young isolated migrants to access services, leisure and culture to better integrate the local community. The volunteer will team up with another European solidarity corps volunteer and one or two French Civic Service volunteers. Together, they will accompany some minors to their appointments (administration, health, school…) and invest in these moments together to exchange, understand their desires, needs and expectations.
Host a daily drop-in center for minor migrants with coffee, tea, biscuits, games and a moment to talk and feel at ease. Put in place collective actions (sports activities, cultural outings, debates on the news, games, initiations to sports of the country of origin ...) with young French Red Cross volunteers and other actors of the territory: sports associations, cultural institutions, etc

projects.title: Care for unaccompanied minors (Orléans) 2/2
projects.description:
As part of a dynamic team of volunteers and staff, the volunteer will take part in the association’s activities. Their main role will be to animate actions to young isolated migrants to access services, leisure and culture to better integrate the local community. The volunteer will team up with another European solidarity corps volunteer and one or two French Civic Service volunteers. Together, they will accompany some minors to their appointments (administration, health, school…) and invest in these moments together to exchange, understand their desires, needs and expectations.
Host a daily drop-in center for minor migrants with coffee, tea, biscuits, games and a moment to talk and feel at ease. Put in place collective actions (sports activities, cultural outings, debates on the news, games, initiations to sports of the country of origin ...) with young French Red Cross volunteers and other actors of the territory: sports associations, cultural institutions, etc

projects.title: Suomenlinna Sea Fortress Baltic Sea Team Finland
projects.description:
This volunteering team is organised in co-operation with The Governing Body of Suomenlinna which is a unit of Finnish Heritage Agency maintaining the Sea Fortress of Suomenlinna, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Volunteers will participate in maintenance, restoration, and landscaping work in the Suomenlinna area and surrounding islands, under the guidance of site management and specialists as well as take part in shoreline cleaning activities. The work is primarily physical and takes place outdoors under all weather conditions.
More info and application https://www.nuorisovaihto.fi/allianssi-youth-exchanges/esc-vthpa-baltic-sea/suomenlinna-sea-fortress-finland/

projects.title: MOVE - Mobility - Open mind - Volunteering - Exchange
projects.description:
The MJC is a nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting non-formal education and ensuring access to culture for everyone. We are looking for 6 motivated participants to join a 10-month socio-cultural volunteering programme. Throughout the year, volunteers will contribute to different missions linked to youth engagement, education, creativity, solidarity and community life, while developing new personal and professional skills in an international environment. Depending on their interests and profiles, participants will be involved in one of the following fields: Science, New Technologies, Solidarity, or Parent & Child Activities. Missions may include supporting educational workshops, creating multimedia content, participating in scientific and cultural activities, assisting with digital projects in the Fab Lab, helping with French language learning activities, or supporting family and inclusion initiatives. 

Infopack : https://canva.link/mjcelbeuf-10months-sept2026-july2027

projects.title: Loviisa Youth and Culture Baltic SeaTeam Finland
projects.description:
ESC volunteering team will be involved in implementing various events in a small seaside town of Loviisa in Finland,  together with Loviisa Youth and Cultural Services, local associations and young people.
This year`s  theme of the Loviisa City festival is the Baltic Sea and there will be several events in the area during ten days in August. The volunteering team will be involved in organising the Night of Young  Arts -event as well as other local traditional cultural events. There will also be a Baltic Sea Day celebration on the Baltic Sea Day. 
The aim is that the volunteers will get to know the pearl of the Baltic Sea, Loviisa, and its interesting history and thriving cultural life. They will get to know everyday life in a small Baltic Sea seaside town and have lots of cultural exchanges with local people.
More info and application form here https://www.nuorisovaihto.fi/allianssi-youth-exchanges/esc-vthpa-baltic-sea/loviisa-youth-and-culture-baltic-se/

projects.title: Alla scuola per bambini con bisogni speciali
projects.description: L'organizzazione d'accoglienza è una scuola che dal 1970 s'occupa dell'istruzione d'alunni con gravi bisogni educativi speciali, per  prepararli a vivere nel modo più indipendente possibile dopo aver terminato gli studi. Vieni ad aiutare questi bambini con bisogni speciali a socializzare, superare le difficoltà comportamentali e altri ostacoli all'apprendimento! Non immagini quanto tu sia importante per loro, e nello stesso tempo apprenderai molte cose nuove. Opererai in team con gli insegnanti che ti formeranno sulle sottigliezze della comunicazione con gli alunni con bisogni speciali. La maggior parte di loro non parla, ma utilizza mezzi di comunicazione alternativi che imparerai a decifrare e utilizzare. Aiuterai in diverse attività didattiche durante le lezioni, supporterai gli studenti nella gestione dei comportamenti problematici e parteciperai a varie gite fuori dalla scuola con insegnanti e studenti. Sarà un'esperienza emotivamente coinvolgente e professionalmente formativa.

projects.title: Volunteer at the House of Generations - Make a Difference Across Generations 👵
projects.description: Looking for a volunteering experience that is REAL, meaningful, and full of human connection? Welcome to the House of Generations in Kaunas 💛 Here, every day is different. You’ll become part of a unique community where around 40 seniors and young mothers with their children share the same space -creating a powerful mix of stories, energy, challenges, and growth. As a volunteer, you won’t sit on the sidelines. You’ll help organise fun activities, bring new ideas, support daily routines, teach simple language or digital skills, and most importantly - build genuine relationships. One moment you might be dancing or playing games at the Day Centre, the next you could be helping a young mum feel more confident about everyday life. This is not just about helping others - it’s about discovering yourself too. You’ll grow your patience, empathy, creativity, and confidence while experiencing what true intergenerational solidarity feels like 🌍🤝

projects.title: Create Change for Our Planet – World Clean Up & Storytelling in Gran Canaria ⭐
projects.description:
Join an international ESC team in beautiful Gran Canaria and help create positive change for our planet. Together, we work towards World Clean Up Day 2026 through clean ups, upcycling, environmental awareness activities and community actions.

Live and learn with young people from different countries while experiencing a plant based and slow living lifestyle. Activities include clean ups, gardening, creative reuse of materials, photography, video making and social media storytelling.

The project combines environmental action, teamwork, intercultural exchange, nature connection and non formal learning. Gain new skills, make international friends and create impact together.

Due to the strong interest in this project, a selection process is necessary. Selected candidates will be invited for an interview. If you have not received a message from us before 30 June 2026, this means you have not been selected for this project round.

projects.title: 📱 Volunteer at Patria Volunteering Centre - Shape Our Social Media Story
projects.description:
*Representation and promotion of A.C. Patria on social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook)
*Creation and management of social media content (posts, stories, reels, videos, captions)
*Development and maintenance of a social media content calendar and communication strategy
*Promotion of A.C. Patria activities, volunteering opportunities, and events online
*Design and implementation of online campaigns and promotional materials for social media
*Engagement with online audience (responding to comments, messages, and building community presence)
*Monitoring social media trends and adapting content to improve reach and visibility
*Event photography and visual documentation of A.C. Patria activities and events for communication purposes
*Support in other A.C. Patria activities when needed (events, initiatives, and daily organizational tasks)
*Occasional assistance in documenting activities and events for online use (photos, short videos, storytelling)
*Other activity

projects.title: ♿ Korys –  Creating Impact in Disabilities Support
projects.description: Volunteering at Korys, supporting people with disabilities through daily assistance, spending time together, and taking part in inclusive social and recreational activities. The role includes accompanying individuals outside for walks and outdoor activities, helping ensure their safety, comfort, and well-being. It also involves creating a friendly and supportive environment where people are encouraged to develop independence, confidence, and social skills. Working closely with staff and other volunteers, the focus is on promoting inclusion, equal participation, and meaningful interaction in everyday life.

projects.title: Volunteer at Kaunas Region Social Service Center - Hands to Help, Hearts for Community 💛
projects.description:
The center was established to support children with disabilities and meet the needs of their families.
Our services are provided to children aged 7–18 with intellectual, physical, and multiple disabilities, as well as psychological developmental disorders.
During the day, children are supported by staff through a variety of engaging activities such as sports, creative arts, and everyday life skills. Together, they learn, develop, and discover new abilities in a safe and supportive environment.
Our main goal is to enrich children’s lives by strengthening their skills, knowledge, emotions, and unique strengths.
TASKS:
Assist children with disabilities in daily activities such as sports, arts, music, games, and life skills. Communicate with children using English, Lithuanian, or non-verbal methods, ensuring their individual needs are met and building supportive relationships. After getting familiar with the center, the volunteer will lead a weekly group activity.

projects.title: REGENERATE ODEMIRA IV - Project Earth
projects.description: Looking for a volunteering experience, in rural and natural context, contributing to environmental causes and the preservation of local culture? REGENERATE ODEMIRA IV is the ESC project coordinated by the Municipality of Odemira in 2026/2027. It combines the need to develop youth work in a rural territory with the urge to protect natural and cultural resources, thus contributing to environmental action. 4 positions are currently open, for long-term volunteers in 2 different organizations: - PROJECT EARTH "Art, Ecology and Community" - ROTA VICENTINA "Responsible Tourism in SW Portugal" | FULL DESCRIPTION: https://www.cm-odemira.pt/viver/desporto-e-juventude/juventude/voluntariado-internacional/regenerate-odemira-4-long-term-volunteering | APPLY until the 19th June 2026, through the on-line application: https://www.cm-odemira.pt/p/longterm_volunteering. | For more information write us: juventude@cm-odemira.pt

projects.title: REGENERATE ODEMIRA IV - Rota Vicentina
projects.description: Looking for a volunteering experience, in rural and natural context, contributing to environmental causes and the preservation of local culture? REGENERATE ODEMIRA IV is the ESC project coordinated by the Municipality of Odemira in 2026/2027. It combines the need to develop youth work in a rural territory with the urge to protect natural and cultural resources, thus contributing to environmental action. 4 positions are currently open, for long-term volunteers in 2 different organizations: - PROJECT EARTH "Art, Ecology and Community" - ROTA VICENTINA "Responsible Tourism in SW Portugal" | FULL DESCRIPTION: https://www.cm-odemira.pt/viver/desporto-e-juventude/juventude/voluntariado-internacional/regenerate-odemira-4-long-term-volunteering | APPLY until the 19th June 2026, through the on-line application: https://www.cm-odemira.pt/p/longterm_volunteering. | For more information write us: juventude@cm-odemira.pt

projects.title: Volunteering in Nonformal Education in TIMISOARA ESC7
projects.description: Welcome to an exciting ESC Volunteering Project set in the vibrant city of Timisoara, Romania, the European Cultural Capital of 2023. This unique opportunity invites volunteers in a life-changing experience, working with kids through non-formal education, creativity activities, entrepreneurial education and language enhancement. The participants will be engaged in a diverse range of activities that focus on enriching the lives of young minds and fostering cultural exchange. Timisoara, known for its cultural heritage and progressive spirit, provides the ideal backdrop for a project that thrives on creativity, connection, and community. Volunteers will be at the heart of this project, as they collaborate daily with children from the local community. Through non-formal educational approaches, participants will engage the young learners in interactive workshops and games.

projects.title: Volunteering at the Department for European Affairs, Bremen, Germany
projects.description:
Are you interested in creating a project to make Europe more visible and accessible? Do you want to empower young people to take part in European mobility and democratic debates? If the answer is “Yes”, then this opportunity is your chance – come to Bremen and support the Department for European Affairs at the Senate Chancellery in their mission to bring Europe closer to the citizens! One of the Department’s tasks is providing information on European topics for different target groups in the cities of Bremen and Bremerhaven. The mission is to make Europe visible, accessible, and understandable for civil society. This work is being done via a number of main channels, in particular: 
1. The Erasmus Coordination Unit: Promoting mobility and education opportunities.
2. The EuropaPunktBremen:  Regional EU Direct information centre for the public.
3. The Europawochen (European Weeks): A major annual event series in May involving workshops, exhibitions and dialogue formats across the city.

projects.title: Volunteering in "Local Connections" with NaturKultur Bremen e.V., Germany
projects.description: Are you an outgoing person that wants to engage with people and network? Have you ever had the desire to work in a fun, outgoing, creative and multinational team with lots of experience in the field of international youth work? The main Goal – to help us find new connections with other organisations in Bremen – such as schools, youth houses, initiatives and organisations in the cultural field. Tasks: Network with other organisations in the city and surrounding area, such as with youth houses, universities, NGOs, initiatives, the city council and potential new hosting organisations. Give presentations about volunteering and international youth work Organising city tours, local activities and projects, such as clean-up actions, workshops on your favourite topics and activities for the other ESC volunteers in Bremen. Helping out with website maintenance, creating materials for publicity, etc. Develop your own project ideas and learning goals.

projects.title: Empowering regions through volunteering (POLAND)
projects.description: Project in Wola town, in headquter of FRSP foundation for period of 6 months. Proposed activities: 1)help in realized by FRSP projects, during the volunteer’s presence(technical and logistic help;supporting participants during the mobility;preparation and implementation some of the workshop sessions;preparation project documentation;help in promotion & in recruitment processes 2)Office work 3)PR and promotion activities 4)Possibility to learn how to write a project application and apply for a grant. II)Promotion, development and dissemination entrepreneurial attitudes (sharing knowledge and skills in the field of entrepreneurship;Dissemination and promotion volunteering;organizing own mini projects to entertain local inhabistants ) III)Promotion of European Union and European Solidarity Corps Programmes. MORE DETAILS: https://volo.frsp.eu/en/2025/11/25/volunteering-project-in-silesia-culture-a-way-to-integration/

projects.title: European Education - Europe Direct Centre
projects.description:
The EUROPE DIRECT centre in Pau, run by Pistes-Solidaires, aims to make Europe more approachable. EUROPE DIRECT centres are accredited by the European Commission and their mission is to inform, animate and advise on European policies, programmes, countries, etc. 
The volunteer will assist the “Europe Direct” coordinator in her work of providing information on the opportunities offered by the European Union at local level; lead workshops on the EU for children, young people (schools, educational establishments, etc.) and other types of audience; help to organise events such as Cafés des Langues, debates, etc; develop tools for activities on European issues; help to update and communicate on the centre's digital channels;update the centre's stock of documentation, gadgets and exhibitions.

projects.title: Volunteering Summer Fest 2026
projects.description:
For 25 days, become a volunteer in the beautiful village Bergolo, placed in a region of north Italy, Piedmont. 
Volunteers main tasks: Renovation works as scratching old paint from walls and repaint them, create furniture out of recycled wood, build flower beds and more. Promote health and wellness among local youth. Take care of green areas: Weeding pedestrian roads and other activities on green areas. Helping in the garden. 
Our approach is “can → do” applying the methods of non-formal learning, experiential learning and learning by doing. Volunteering experience is a full-time occupation, you will be involved in activities 35 hours/week

projects.title: Green Officer Volunteer - Pistes-Solidaires
projects.description: Join Pistes-Solidaires as a Green Officer Volunteer and take part in a Living Lab where sustainability, experimentation, and collective action come together. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to turn green ideas into real action. You will help care for our garden and aquaponics greenhouse, support activities in and around the Living Lab, and contribute to the green transition of the organization. This includes improving daily practices, reducing waste, encouraging eco-friendly habits, and thinking about greener mobility and resource use. Based in Pau, at the foot of the Pyrenees, Pistes-Solidaires offers a dynamic environment where local action meets European values. We are looking for someone motivated, curious, open-minded, and ready to work both outdoors and indoors, in teamwork and with initiative.

projects.title: Logistician assistant (6 months)
projects.description:
ADRA Serbia is humanitarian organization dedicated to reducing poverty and protection of vulnerable people. By partnering with communities and organizations, we can improve the quality of life of Roma people, homeless, and young people leaving care, through our programs in disaster relief, education, economic empowerment, and protection. Psycho-social support, prevention, and protection from gender-based violence is mainstreamed in the projects.
Working alongside our logistician, you’ll see how a humanitarian operation runs from the inside. You’ll help shape a new inventory database, co-create a fact-sheet on our support reaching 2,000+ people, take part in donor outreach, and join the team at humanitarian distributions in the field. A learning-by-doing role with real impact for vulnerable communities in Belgrade.

projects.title: Youth Mobility Volunteer - Pistes-Solidaires
projects.description: Join Pistes-Solidaires as a Youth Mobility Volunteer and help young people discover European opportunities through mobility, intercultural exchange, and international learning. You will support the promotion of European mobility, help prepare young people before departure, and contribute to the organization of youth exchanges, workshops, training courses, and group hosting activities. This is a hands-on and dynamic role where every day brings new people, new ideas, and new experiences. You will also help welcome international groups and ensure that activities are well organized, inclusive, and engaging. We are looking for someone curious about Europe, motivated by youth work, open-minded, proactive, and comfortable working in teams and with people from different backgrounds. Based in Pau, Pistes-Solidaires combines a strong local identity with a deep European outlook.

projects.title: Supporting Inclusive Community Spaces and Youth Work in Tbilisi, Georgia
projects.description:
Join Act for Transformation’s Caucasus Office in the heart of Tbilisi and become part of community-based peace education and intercultural work in Georgia.

As a volunteer, you will support activities focused on peacebuilding, nonviolent conflict transformation, intercultural exchanges, and youth participation through our “Fairtogether” methodology. You will work together with local communities, young people, refugees, and international partners in an intercultural environment.

Your activities may include:
👉 Supporting workshops and trainings on peacebuilding, nonviolent communication, etc.
👉 Supporting youth and refugee community activities
👉 Assisting in or leading English or German language activities
👉 Supporting communication, creative activities, and community initiatives
👉 Developing your own small-scale project or initiative

projects.title: Solidarité locale et internationale – Engagement citoyen et interculturalité
projects.description: La mission favorise le lien social, la solidarité et le dialogue interculturel à travers des actions locales et internationales. Le·la volontaire co-animera des ateliers (jeux, arts, jardinage, écologie), participera à des événements (Festisol, Alimenterre, Cinémaplanète…), contribuera à des actions de sensibilisation sur les ODD et l’écologie, et à des projets européens (Erasmus+, CERV). Il·elle soutiendra la communication (articles, vidéos, réseaux sociaux) et pourra développer sa propre initiative solidaire. Une expérience riche pour s’engager, apprendre et créer du lien.

projects.title: KNJIŽNICA POD KROŠNJAMI
projects.description: Pridruži se peti sezoni knjižnice pod krošnjami na kmetiji Zelena centrala v Jurovskem Dolu -  postani knjižničarka, knjižničar! Kako je to videti? Knjižnica bo odprta vsak petek in soboto od 19. junija do 29. avgusta; od 10h dopoldne do 19h zvečer. Delo v knjižnici poteka v paru ali v trojki; infrastruktura (poličke s knjigami, ležalniki, stolčki, blazine in info tabla) je shranjena v posebni sobi na kmetiji. Postaviš, čuvaš, skrbiš, pospraviš. In vmes še ustvarjaš dogodke za obiskovalke in obiskovalce - bralne urice z otroki iz vrtca, pravljične dopoldneve, lutkovne predstave, literarne večere za odrasle s priznanimi ustvarjalkami in ustvarjalci. Ideje dobrodošle! Na kmetijo prideš v četrtek zvečer ali v petek zjutraj, ob 9h jutranji sestanek. Sledi postavljanje in celodnevna skrb za knjige in revije, komunikacija z obiskovalkami_ci, občasna pomoč pri izvedbi dogodkov. Ob 19h pospravljanje. V soboto isto. Občasno večerni dogodki. Odhod s kmetije v soboto zvečer ali v nedeljo.

projects.title: CineVolunteers 3.0
projects.description: Join the THF in Odorheiu Secuiesc, Romania for an unforgettable 10-month volunteering experience that combines filmmaking, communication, and youth work — all through the lens of environmental awareness and creative storytelling. What’s waiting for you: – Support local youth events and educational activities in schools 🏫 – Help raise awareness on environmental topics and social issues 🌍 – Contribute to photo and video projects that tell real stories 📸 – Assist in creative workshops and community programs 🎨 ✨ What you’ll gain: An authentic experience of working with young people, learning by doing, and expressing your creativity while discovering a new culture.

projects.title: Voluntariado en Sicilia con el Magazzino Culturale “Ex Oleificio”
projects.description:
El “Magazzino Culturale Ex Oleificio” es una antigua almazara renovada que funciona como centro cultural multifuncional en Milena. Es un espacio dedicado a la creación de proyectos e ideas y al desarrollo de oportunidades para la comunidad local. Acoge talleres artísticos, eventos culturales, presentaciones, actividades deportivas y musicales, además de reuniones sobre temas juveniles y sociales, promoviendo la inclusión e integración de personas migrantes y en situación de vulnerabilidad. También sirve como residencia para artistas, alojamiento para voluntarios y refugio para peregrinos de la Magna Via Francigena.

En este contexto, las personas voluntarias del Cuerpo Europeo de Solidaridad colaboran con el equipo local en la gestión general del centro, la organización de actividades culturales y artísticas, la logística (montaje de espacios, organización y limpieza), la acogida de peregrinos, la actualización de archivos y la gestión de redes sociales.

projects.title: 👀LONG-TERM VOLUNTEERING IN POLAND | EU ONLY
projects.description:
INPRO is a youth-focused NGO dedicated to non-formal education and international mobility. As a volunteer, your primary role is to provide organisational and logistical support for our hosted projects. You will assist in planning activities, managing schedules, and ensuring youth exchanges and training sessions run smoothly. You will support trainers by facilitating workshops, games, and team-building exercises using provided guidelines. Additionally, you will lead intercultural evening programs. A vital part of this role involves facility management: preparing and resetting accommodation and activity spaces, and managing participant check-ins/outs at the INPRO hostel. 
❗❗Important: Due to legal regulations, we can only host volunteers who do not require a visa to enter Poland. Please review the infopack before applying: 🔗 https://shorturl.at/9StpO

projects.title: Projekt krótkoterminowy w Turcji (only Poles)
projects.description:
As Pi Youth Association, we organize trainings, workshops, and seminars for young people,
especially the disadvantaged ones, in 10 different parts(districts) of İzmir. Moreover, we try to
provide opportunities for their personal development, healthy living skills, and inclusion in social
life.
The volunteer can assist us in 2 different fields (depending on their skills and willingness):
 Organizing activities for local youth: Volunteers will organize indoor/outdoor local activities
(trainings, workshops, language conversation clubs, etc.) depending on their abilities. These
will take place at our organization's office, municipalities’ youth centers, and primary/high
schools in both the city center and rural areas of İzmir.
 Assisting the office team: The volunteer will support the ESC/Erasmus+ departments of our
office team (e.g., helping coordinate Erasmus+ and ESC programs) and promote these
opportunities to our local partners and youth centers.

projects.title: Living on the Land in Community
projects.description: During this volunteering experience you will become part of the daily life of Lighthouse Osada.Earth, a small community exploring regenerative living and cooperation with nature in troubled times. This is a hands-on opportunity to learn by doing, spend time outdoors and experience a different rhythm of life close to nature. Volunteers will take part in gardening and caring for plants and soil. Late summer is the time of harvesting vegetables from the garden and fruit from the old and young orchards and then preparing various preserves for the winter. Together we will also contribute to the construction of our community wooden house using natural building methods. You will also support international events taking place in the space, helping in the community kitchen or taking care of guest area. Living in a community also means spending time together and sharing daily challenges and joys of life. We invite you to the enriching experience of working on the land in the community.

projects.title: Volunteering in Nonformal Education in TIMISOARA ESC7
projects.description: Welcome to an exciting ESC Volunteering Project set in the vibrant city of Timisoara, Romania, the European Cultural Capital of 2023. This unique opportunity invites volunteers in a life-changing experience, working with kids through non-formal education, creativity activities, entrepreneurial education and language enhancement. The participants will be engaged in a diverse range of activities that focus on enriching the lives of young minds and fostering cultural exchange. Timisoara, known for its cultural heritage and progressive spirit, provides the ideal backdrop for a project that thrives on creativity, connection, and community. Volunteers will be at the heart of this project, as they collaborate daily with children from the local community. Through non-formal educational approaches, participants will engage the young learners in interactive workshops and games.

projects.title: Volontariat dans la Ligue de l’Enseignement du Cher 2026 – 2027
projects.description:
4 missions sont proposées pour 4 volontaires internationaux travaillant en binôme avec un volontaire français.

1. Mobilité internationale : création d’activités ludiques pour intervenir en milieu scolaire et chez les partenaires. Participation à l’organisation d’échanges linguistiques et d’activités interculturelles. Contribution à la création de contenus numériques et au suivi de projets européens et internationaux.

2. Prévention et inclusion : mise en place d’actions ludiques autour du bien-être des jeunes. Animation d’ateliers de sensibilisation et participation à des activités créatives et collectives. Contribution au développement du projet « Bulle Jeunesse ».

3. Culture et sport : participation à des actions de médiation autour de la lecture. Organisation d’activités ludiques et sportives ouvertes à différents publics.

4. Numérique : création de podcasts et de contenus en réalité augmentée, ainsi que soutien aux publics moins à l’aise avec l’informatique.

projects.title: Wellbeing European citizenship and communication
projects.description:
Jonzac is a small town of 4,000 inhabitants in western France, located in the Charente-Maritime department. The town offers facilities such as a cinema and an aquatic center. Bordeaux about 1 hour away by train.
Our vocational high school, labelled “High School for Health and Social Care Professions,” wel-comes around 200 students supported by a team of 20 teachers.
The school holds several labels: E3D, Euroscol, and CES. It offers the following diplomas:
•	Vocational Baccalaureate in Personal Care, Support and Services (ASSP)
•	CAP in Senior Citizens' Assistance (AAGA)
•	CAP in Food Service Production and Service (PSR)
The school promotes a strong project-based approach, co-teaching, and digital skills develop-ment. Numerous projects focus on sustainable development, health, and prevention.
We would be delighted to welcome a volunteer and support their integration, while benefiting from their contribution to our European and intercultural openness.

projects.title: Phoenix
projects.description:
"Phoenix" is a 42-day, short-term volunteering project in Bergolo (Alta Langa, Italy) for two young people aged 18–30. Focused on personal growth and renewal, the program offers three main areas of involvement:
- Garden: Sowing, harvesting, and maintaining the seedbeds.
- Events: Logistics and practical support for village festivals.
- Project Support: Assisting with international initiatives like Erasmus+ and volunteering teams.

Infopack: https://canva.link/rxobjdbvrxmvkt1

projects.title: L’Arche Croatia is looking for volunteers (m/f) in the community Arka – Korablja (L’Arche Zagreb), Croatia
projects.description:
The Korablja community is a meeting place for people with and without intellectual disabilities. We are also called the Arka community because we are part of the large international federation L'Arche International. 
If you believe in the ability and creative potential of people with intellectual disabilities, you have come to the right place.

Start of volunteering: September/October 2026
Duration of volunteering: 9 months
Age of volunteers: 18 – 30 years

Some of the activities/tasks:

Assistance with work activities (making greeting cards, jewellery, decorative items and other creative activities)
Preparing weekly meetings with community members – designing activities, inviting guests
Organization of monthly birthday celebrations for members of L’Arche Zagreb
Creating and implementing short plays, board games and other creative activities
and other... see on our web site:

https://korablja-arka.hr/want-to-live-and-volunteer-at-larche-zagreb/

projects.title: Interculturality and transmission! Volunteer at a French Vocational High School
projects.description: LEAP Lestonnac is a vocational High School focused on People care and Services to territories professions. The school is located in a rural environment and provides vocational training for pupils aged between 13 and 20. We are looking for one volunteer to promote international mobility and interculturality! The volunteer will have to develop ways to interact with students during non-formal periods (such as breaks, meals, outings, evening time at our boarding school, etc.) to support the learning of the Spanish language not only inside but also more importantly outside of the classroom. He/She will also be able to develop personal projects related to the promotion of international mobility and interculturality, social and language exchange, etc. These are some of the activities in which the volunteer will support the team and share with the other volunteer on-site (International Civic Service). The volunteer will also help with our students’ annual 2-week mobility internship in Spain.

projects.title: YOUNG FOLKS CAMP&FEST (Tent camp for teenagers & youth festival)
projects.description:
CAMP&FEST is an ESC Team Volunteering opportunity on 9-22 July 2026 in Riga and Veczemju Klintis, Latvia. The project brings together international volunteers (+local camp leaders and youth workers) to support a summer camp for teenagers aged 12-16 and and youth festival programme for 100+ people.
The mobility includes preparation and team building in Riga, a tent-based camp in Veczemju Klintis from 13-17 July and the festival programme on 18-19 July. Veczemju Klintis is a beautiful coastal area with a sea beach and red sandstone cliffs
Volunteers will help lead activities, facilitate workshops, support daily camp life, create media content and help build a safe and inclusive space for young people.
We are looking for responsible and open-minded volunteers who are ready to work with teens, live in outdoor camp conditions and actively contribute with their skills, ideas and energy.
More info&application form: https://forms.gle/Y2MaWnk8cfGRJjJN6
Follow our updates: @erasmusyf(inst)

projects.title: Long-term ESC volunteering in TFS Fryshuset Stockholm
projects.description: The long-term ESC volunteer in the Together for Sweden project at Fryshuset will be actively involved in all project activities, supporting young people through educational, social, and community-based initiatives. The volunteer will assist with communication and visibility on social media, contribute to storytelling workshops, and support various administrative tasks connected to the project. They will also become part of the wider community of ESC volunteers at Fryshuset, participating in shared activities, trainings, and intercultural exchanges.
