projects.title: Técnica/o de apoyo en Gestión de Proyectos
projects.description:
Movimiento por la Paz – MPDL es una organización social, pacifista, feminista y antirracista que trabaja desde hace más de 40 años por sociedades más justas, inclusivas y pacíficas.

En el marco del proyecto ACT4PEACE "Solidarity, Inclusion andn Action for Peace", que promueve el voluntariado juvenil como herramienta para la defensa de los derechos humanos y las culturas de paz en América Latina y la región MENA, MPDL ofrece una oportunidad de voluntariado internacional en Marruecos.

La persona voluntaria se integrará en el equipo de MPDL en Jordania, apoyando la implementación y gestión de proyectos con enfoque de derechos humanos, género e inclusión. projects.title: Social inclusión in Community Hosting Organisation
projects.description: Volunteers support community members in various occupational workshops, assisting in the design and implementation of educational programs focused on values, environmental awareness, and sports. They create and run creative and educational activities such as painting workshops, crafts, and recycling initiatives, particularly engaging children. Volunteers accompany residents in workshops, coordinate activities, monitor user progress, and evaluate potential participation in different projects. They provide emotional support, develop psycho-educational initiatives, and foster social integration by promoting active involvement in community spaces. Volunteers participate in daily community meetings and training sessions, attend volunteer meetings, and share communal meals, interacting with residents during breakfast at 8:00 and lunch at 14:30. They work 35 hours per week alongside community members to strengthen solidarity and inclusion.

projects.title: Summer Camps
projects.description: The Summer Camps program is organized by the foundation, focusing on half-day activities such as handcraft workshops, sports, cultural events tailored for children. Responsibilities of Volunteers include designing workshops aligned with participants' talents, skills, and interests, conducted in English. Additionally, They will prepare cultural presentations, sports activities, and promote a healthy lifestyle. They will also facilitate activities aimed at fostering cultural appreciation and traditions through games and artistic endeavors. Volunteers, in collaboration with long-term volunteers and coordinators, will host a music and handcraft festival for young people. Participants may commemorate diversity and shared ESC goals through relevant actions. Furthermore, participants will collaborate in an office setting with a diverse team comprising multiple nationalities. We invite you to join us.

projects.description:
PLEASE apply by writing an E-Mail to esc-application@aha.or.at, with your CV and Motivation Letter!* We are looking for a volunteer in the Plant nursery section. 
Sunnahof is a biodynamic farm and a social organisation. Our principle is “people need people” no matter if you have any disabilities or not. A volunteer at Sunnahof, you will gain invaluable experience for working with people with intellectual disabilities. You will learn about disability issues and topics facing the local community. You will  learn how to work along with people with disabilities and how to increase their skills and promote their independence. Plant Nursery: substantial work around plants.

·cuisine workshops

·thematic evenings
·exhibitions
·creation of media (ex: tiktok @agoraservices)
·European citizenship awareness
·Link between generations

projects.title: Communication Assistant in Alianza Bolivia– Humanitarian Volunteer
projects.description: ActionAid tiene como objetivo promover una ciudadanía activa que luche contra las desigualdades y por el reconocimiento de los derechos humanos. Desarrolla proyectos de cooperación al desarrollo y de educación para erradicar la violencia de género, defender los derechos de las personas migrantes y promover la justicia climática. ¡Únete a nuestra oficina en Bolivia! Aprenderás sobre gestión de proyectos, teniendo la oportunidad de trabajar mano a mano con un gran equipo de profesionales. Apoyarás en la formulación de proyectos, la preparación de informes, la gestión de información relevante para la justificación de acciones, la coordinación con otras organizaciones y donantes, así como en actividades de captación de fondos. projects.title: Heritage restoration at the Gombervaux castle 2026
projects.description:
Presentation of the site : Gombervaux is a castle of the 14th century in Vaucouleurs (East of France, department of Meuse). It is classified as an historical monument since 1994. The association Gombervaux is a member of the REMPART Union. The missions of Gombervaux are : restore the castle, create life on the site and study the site.

The missions :  
The main mission for the group of 10 international volunteers will be : the restoration of a tower of the castle. The work consists to cut stones and learn traditional masonnry techniques in order to make seals and replace damaged stones. One stonecutter will lead you to achieve those missions.

projects.title: Individual volunteering: Sustainable Coffee Farming & Outdoor Work - Amplifying the Voice for Climate Action (AVCA Project)
projects.description: You will work closely with the local workers to support the daily agricultural activities on the VISIONEERS Coffee Farm in the remote village of San Andrés as a volunteer sent by VC. Your tasks will include establishing and maintaining crops, planting and caring for coffee and other plants, and supporting sustainable cultivation practices on the coffee fields. You will help design and maintain garden areas, vegetable beds, and new garden spaces, contribute to compost systems, and assist in caring for the finca. This role involves hands-on outdoor work and offers the opportunity to learn about sustainable agriculture, coffee production, and farm systems, as well as hand-on crafts and work. You will also collaborate with the other volunteers in planning and implementing environmental and community-focused projects on the finca. This position is ideal for volunteers who enjoy practical work in nature and want to contribute to a meaningful sustainability initiative in a rural setting.

projects.title: Ukraine Centre Finland long term volunteer
projects.description:
Ukrainian Center was founded by Ukrainian Association in Finland in April 2022. Aim is to unite Ukrainians around common values, to provide a safe space and friendly environment for Ukrainians to support their wellbeing and smooth integration into Finnish society, share knowledge about Ukraine and strengthen Ukrainian-Finnish cultural and people ties through various activities for the Ukrainian community in Finland, including educational classes, integrational webinars and seminars, cultural events, wellbeing and hobby clubs for adults and children. Volunteering at Eureka School means contributing to the development of responsible global citizens who understand the importance of sustainability and environmental protection. projects.title: ECOLOGY AND CITIZENSHIP IN EREA
projects.description:
Saint Aubin le Cloud à 1800 habitants (https://www.saint-aubin-le-cloud.fr/accueil.html)
There are all the basic businesses, structures for sports and leisure, culture (a very rich associative fabric) 
Facilities for people with reduced mobility have been made in the municipality.
The nearest railway stations are Niort and Poitiers. A bus system allows you to arrive in St Aubin le Cloud via Parthenay.
Our school establishment, EREA-LEA Françoise Dolto has a middle school and vocational high school. 
130 young people aged 11 to 18, mostly internal

Teams motivated on school time, and boarding time (clubs, vigils and wednesdays) to give more to these young people who have less.

We coordinate volunteer and training programs both in Finland and abroad (ESC, Erasmus+, international volunteering). We are involved in community projects engaging youth and actions increasing awareness on environment, climate justice, sustainability, diversity and youth wellbeing.  We look for a volunteer for 11-12 months with interest in working with and for young people. The volunteer works with a variety of tasks depending on the skills and interests of the volunteer as well as the current activities of the organization The volunteer will do social media, co-organise events and act as a group leader, so interest towards these is seen as an asset.

projects.title: BioArt Village - Solidarity (Individual)
projects.description: Individual volunteering from half of April and onwards: Are you eager to help us out with our daily activities at a unique off-grid location, where you can develop practical skills in animal care, renovation, and green maintenance? Want to try something out of your comfort zone? This is a project for those who love practical outdoor work, aren't afraid to get their hands dirty, and have a go-getter mentality with a proactive attitude. projects.title: Last call: The Heart of a Home, Growing Together in Community
projects.description: Anffas Sibillini Aps is a social promotion association founded in 2013, located in a mountain municipality near the Sibillini Mountains. The association is dedicated to supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, as well as those facing relational challenges. Volunteer involvement is highly valued, as those supported by the association benefit greatly from direct interaction. Volunteers play a key role in the activities offered, enriching the quality and impact of these experiences. The main activities include: recreational, sports, and training activities; preparatory programs for supported employment; the creation of an educational garden; hosting school groups and elderly individuals; managing a space called WOW; participating in markets, events, and fundraising initiatives; and welcoming volunteers. Volunteers find in the association an opportunity to engage with disability, explore new activities, learn new skills, and feel welcomed.

projects.title: Up to You(th): Art Residency Project
projects.description: This project is for a young artist willing to have an impact on the community. Progetto Giovani, the youth department of the Municipality of Padua that offers services and opportunities for local young people, is looking for 1 volunteer to join its Creativity team. The selected volunteer will take part in a cultural and artistic journey as part of “MAC Studi d’Artista”, a shared artist studio program developed to encourage and support emerging artists. This setting will allow the volunteer to work on their own creative project, while also connecting and collaborating with Italian young artists. Together with the other artists, the volunteer will design and lead workshops – tied to their personal artistic practice – aimed at engaging both local youth and adult communities, contributing to the revitalization of an urban area. Other activities include assisting the Creativity team with cultural event planning and organization.

projects.title: Up to You(th): Volunteering with Children in Pre-primary Schools and Kindergartens
projects.description: Love kids? The Municipality of Padua is looking for one motivated volunteer interested in the social and educational field. The volunteer will design and lead activities with young children (such as linguistic and cultural workshops using creativity, art, music and non-formal education methods) in English and/or Italian, promote intercultural education  and support staff in kindergartens and pre-primary schools (reading stories to the children, helping staff manage conflicts, providing emotional support, reminding children of important rules for their safety, putting them to sleep, and other tasks that require clear communication, understanding and bonding). The volunteer will also have the chance to participate in events for the promotion of EU funded mobility programs and develop a personal project based on his/her interests.

projects.title: 🚀LOOKING FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS | EU ONLY
projects.description:
🚀We are looking for photographers to join our team.
If you want to put your skills to work in a real international setting, INPRO has an open spot. The role centres on photography/videography and visual content creation, alongside assisting workshops, and promoting Erasmus+ and ESC in schools. You'll get experience in photography, videography, marketing, and more, all while working directly with young people and contributing to something that has real community impact.
We have cameras, lighting, and the equipment you need, so you can focus on the work itself. The offer also involves helping with facility management: preparing and resetting accommodation and activity spaces, and managing participant check-ins/outs at the INPRO hostel. 

Are ready to apply? Read the infopack before applying 👉https://shorturl.at/9StpO

projects.title: Be the Change: Support and inspire young minds in Antwerp, Belgium. (Start date from July or later in Summer: 6 months to 1 year)
projects.description:
Are you ready for a meaningful adventure abroad? Would you like to make a difference to young people in Belgium? Join Wingerdbloei, a dynamic youth care organization in Antwerp, Belgium! We support children and teens (ages 3–21) facing tough challenges - family issues, trauma, behavioral struggles or refugee backgrounds - helping them grow into strong, independent individuals. 
As a volunteer, you’ll be a trusted companion and role model, bringing fresh energy and perspective as a motivated, open-hearted young person from abroad. Your presence can truly inspire our youngsters and be impactful! You’ll help by: Organizing fun activities: games, crafts, sports, cooking, cultural nights, … Accompanying youth on outings, appointments, or camps. Assisting with daily tasks: meals, shopping, setting up events. Launching your own creative ideas: we love new initiatives that enrich the lives of our young people. 
For more concrete information: www.wingerdbloei.be/volunteering

projects.title: Volontariato E.S.C. con adolescenti a Haltegriff
projects.description: L'organizzazione d'accoglienza offre sostegno a giovani di età compresa tra i 16 e i 21 anni che affrontano problemi a casa o nell'istruzione, sono disoccupati o hanno difficoltà che li portano verso l'esclusione sociale. L'istituzione li aiuta a sviluppare l'indipendenza, sia personale che professionale. Ci sono due équipes: l'équipe d'accompagnamento al lavoro che organizza tirocini e laboratori per sviluppare le competenze lavorative, e l'équipe della struttura abitativa, la quale offre alloggio a un massimo di 16 giovani e ne supervisiona la vita quotidiana. Tu supporterai entrambe le équipes, fornendo assistenza in vari àmbiti, come sessioni di formazione, visite ad aziende che offrono stage, incontri con insegnanti e scuole o con assistenti sociali, attività per il tempo libero, monitoraggio delle abilità sociali dei ragazzi, assistenza nei loro cómpiti quotidiani e partecipazione ad attività all'aperto ed escursioni. Collaborerai con pedagogisti, assistenti sociali e psicologi.

projects.title: Prancing Platypus Camp
projects.description: Come and join us on a camp where you will climb out of your shell to meet new people, try new things, and get busy as a bee helping to restore an old anabaptist residence. Don’t be an ostrich and sign up for the Prancing Platypus Camp to perk up! Prancing Platypus is a great opportunity to meet new people and better understand their origins. Together, we will experience 14 days full of adventures, volunteer work, new experiences, and, most importantly, new friendships. You also get a tremendous opportunity to learn more about local culture and traditions. The camp is designed to learn more about the cultures of other participants.

projects.title: Watermelone time
projects.description:
The traditional mowing camp is here! 
Experience 14 unforgettable days in the picturesque town of Valašské Klobouky in the Czech Republic and participate in nature conservation. 20 people from around the world will come together to form a harmonious group and participate in traditional meadow mowing in Wallachia region. 

More information about the program can be found in our Infopack. Please ask it on the email: international@brontosaurus.cz.

Only participants who fill out the application properly will be included in the selection process; we will not respond to other contacts. 

Infopack with all details:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hTP5cibpXwWYgB1WhT9MMKu8Tx37Zc4P/view?usp=drive_link

Application form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSedzG4CuArQiJdJTN2BeucWwS2-o4qq9TP8t6Mci7eAO6P2WA/viewform

projects.title: KCAT Arts Centre
projects.description: KCAT Arts Centre is a multidisciplinary arts centre where artists with and without disabilities create alongside one another. It’s a place where an individual’s differences are celebrated, and creativity is nurtured. We’re a small but mighty Arts Centre in Callan, Co. Kilkenny, that’s been leading inclusive and accessible arts practice in Ireland for over 25 years. We have practicing visual artists in studio, a theatre group, and offer learning courses and open studio for artists in the community.  KCAT Arts Centre has been hosting and coordinating volunteers through the EVS/ESC, since 2010. Volunteers support art facilitators and artists in our programmes and more. They bring life and fun into KCAT and enrich the social aspect of KCAT by sharing their own culture and language and learn all about Ireland and the people. We aim to recruit for 3 ESC volunteers, 1 for the KCAT Studio, 1 for Courses and Open Studio and 1 for the Equinox Theatre Group.

projects.title: Volunteering at Youth Centre Jugendcafe ARENA in Gratkorn, Austria
projects.description:
APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED HERE: https://www.logo.at/logo-eu/application-for-esc/esc-application-at-youth-centre-jugendcafe-arena-gratkorn.
Check the link for current application. We’re looking forward to hear from you. Working with young people? Want to be part of a creative and supportive space where your ideas matter? Join us as a volunteer at the Youth Centre Gratkorn for an unforgettable experience! The Youth Centre ARENA is an open and welcoming space where young people can relax, get creative, learn, and connect with others. We believe in inclusion, participation, and empowerment — every young person deserves a place where they feel safe, heard, and valued. Be part of our team on voluntary base.
Whether it's playing games, cooking, working on art projects, sports, parties, or just chatting - the centre is all about building trust and community. We are open for your ideas as well.

projects.title: CREATIVE COMMUNITY VOLUNTEERING AT SIENA ART INSTITUTE (ITALY) – 6 MONTHS FROM July 2026
projects.description:
6 months of creative and community-based volunteering with the Siena Art Institute ETS. Activities include creating media content, supporting events and workshops, engaging in community gardening, practicing language exchange, and assisting with social media and outreach. A great opportunity to grow personally and contribute to a vibrant cultural scene.

Infopack: https://canva.link/38jh38rqv5acd2y 
Google form: https://forms.gle/HxEBUCBpAqnv7HLV8

projects.title: Soutenir l'animation des promenades dans l'histoire de Madère à Funchal, Madère
projects.description:
Le ou la volontaire présentera la culture et l’histoire de Madère par des visites guidées et d'autres activités comme des expositions ou des concerts de fado. Les tours auront lieu dans différents lieux de Funchal (centre-ville, hôtel de ville, collège des Jésuites, etc.). En guidant et informant les visiteurs et visiteuses, le ou la volontaire joue un rôle important dans la promotion des programmes de soutien social. Il ou elle collaborera aussi aux activités de l’Union des étudiants : organisation de visites, accueil dans les points de service (25 h/semaine), recherche sur des publications scientifiques (5 h/semaine), rédaction d’articles, traduction de documents, participation à la promotion d’événements culturels. Il ou elle pourra aussi proposer et développer des projets personnels dans ce cadre.
Selon les disponibilités, la mission peut commencer entre début juin et mi-juillet.

projects.title: Become our Digital Media & Youth Empowerment Volunteer!
projects.description:
Ready to empower the next generation while developing your own skills? At aha – Youth Information Liechtenstein, we connect young people with opportunities, create spaces for participation, and shape the future together.

As our ESC volunteer, you will be an active part of our team and gain hands-on experience in different areas, with the chance to focus on your interests after an introduction phase.

Your tasks may include:
• Creating social media content, videos, and interviews for youth channels
• Supporting youth participation projects and workshops
• Assisting young people at the youth information center
• Helping organise events, activities, and youth camps
• Gaining insights into NGO work and administration

Check out our vibe on Instagram: @aha_liechtenstein or visit www.aha.li

projects.title: Short-term project for eco-activists in the mountains of Bulgaria
projects.description: The Association for Shared Learning ELA is renovating its Green educational centre in the mountain village near Sofia, Bulgaria. After many years of work on various national and European projects, we have focused on creating a Green Education Center in the village of Sturgel in the mountains of Bulgaria, where we can continue to support children in their growth by implementing our programs for non-formal education. For these two months, we need enthusiastic young people who don’t mind living in basic conditions in a village, surrounded by nature, to communicate with the elderly.

projects.title: AHH: Community Empowerment in Togo
projects.description: Volunteers will support the local team by working directly with street children and vulnerable girls in Togo, contributing to activities that support ongoing social programs. Working alongside trained staff, they will take part in awareness activities and provide basic educational support for children. Volunteers will help prepare materials for workshops, support peer educators during community outreach, and participate in actions related to social justice, health, hygiene, and sexual and reproductive health. They will also assist in creating simple advocacy materials and engage in community activities. All activities take place in a safe and supportive environment, with volunteers working in teams and receiving guidance in their daily tasks. Their contribution will strengthen local capacity, support ongoing initiatives, and contribute to long-term efforts to improve the well-being of vulnerable children and youth.

projects.title: Sensibilisation au développement durable et soutien à l’organisation d’activité de tri
projects.description:
La structure d'accueil est un groupe laïque de scouts tunisiens Hay Habib, créé en 1976. Elle a pour objectif d'assurer des activités de scoutisme et des animations socio-éducative pour des enfants et des jeunes entre 6 et 17 ans. La mission consiste à:
•	Etre en soutien aux activités de tri/recyclage des déchets de l’association : aide à la gestion de la propreté des espaces,  du tri de papier dans l’association et associations partenaires (Ifriqiya)
•	Appuyer les activités de sensibilisation au développement durable
Proposer et mettre en place des activités éducatives et ludiques sur la thématique de l’environnement
•	Participations à d’autres activités des Scouts
Appui à l'animation et à la création d'ateliers ESCI à destination de divers publics sur des thématiques comme l’interculturalité, les stéréotypes et préjugés, la santé, le développement durable, le genre…

projects.title: Young German-speaking Leader wanted for MAXIM youth center in Berlin
projects.description: The youth club is located in Berlin-Pankow. During their ESC the volunteers will learn all different facets of children and youth work in a theoretical and practical approach. They will have several opportunities to make contact with volunteers from other youth clubs. During their daily work, they will participate in team consultations, intern and extern meetings and professional trainings. The volunteers will work in a team and be responsible for certain tasks. It is possible to choose a project on which they can focus due to their interests and talents. These projects could be: Music pedagogical projects (e.g. volunteers may organise the regular live concerts of school bands and supervise the pupils), creative offers for children and adolescents or networking between youth institutions for the organisation of a major musical event. Furthermore, it is possible to develop a project together with volunteers of other youth clubs.

projects.title: Corleto Monforte Rural Lab 2026 - 2nd flow
projects.description: Join us for a 6-week volunteering experience in Corleto Monforte, a medieval village in the Cilento area (Southern Italy), starting from April 8th. Located in the heart of the Cilento, Vallo di Diano and Alburni National Park and part of the UNESCO Man and the Biosphere Programme (MAB Reserve), this rural community is facing rapid depopulation, and we need your support for a long-term revitalization project. You'll help preserve and expand the village’s Emotional Archive (photo cataloguing and video editing), create trekking routes, design and promote co-living and co-working spaces, support the Natural History Museum (including species fact sheets and Walter Maioli’s video editing), and promote the town’s natural attractions, local businesses, and cultural events. Volunteers will live in close contact with nature and the local community, experiencing the charm of a quiet, authentic Italian village.

projects.title: Make it Green 2026
projects.description: ACARBIO is a Non-Profit Organization from the small town of Tramonti on the rural area of the Amalfi Coast, working for the preservation of the local environment and local cultural heritage presented by the terraced landscape. We implement Youth projects, awareness raising activities, environmental and naturalistic activities, sustainable agricultural projects, outdoor education, and preservation of the terraced landscape. The OBJECTIVES include Landscape and patrimony protection of the terraced landscape; Rural development of Tramonti; and Promotion of sustainable development and solidarity by volunteers. The ACTIVITIES will include some of the following activities to support the local environment and do activities for the local community, such as Environmental clean-up’s; Cleaning hiking paths from vegetation; Doing artistic murals; Help local farmers; Renew public spaces; and Similar activities. Please mind that arrival and departure days will be 14/7 and 27/8.

projects.title: Go4Green4
projects.description:
Go4Green4 is a 59-day European Solidarity Corps short-term team project taking place in Craiova, Romania, from 22 June to 20 August 2026. It brings together 16 volunteers, 8 local and 8 international, to create a sustainable and therapeutic urban garden inside the Women’s Detention Center in Craiova.
The project aims to combine environmental action, inclusion, and wellbeing by using gardening as a practical and therapeutic activity for young people in a detention setting and raise awareness in the local community about sustainability, inclusion, and the positive role of green spaces in rehabilitation and social change.
The project will engage volunteers in a range of environmental activities, including  gardening, river cleaning, and forest waste collection, with the aim of promoting sustainability, ecological responsibility, and active community involvement.

projects.title: Summer hospitality, administration and attendance volunteer job
projects.description:
With us, you are right in the middle of the outdoors, close to the vibrant city of Rotterdam and you work with national and international groups. 
You help to ensure our guests have an unforgettable time – while you simultaneously develop your own skills and experience.

YOUR ROLE
- Reception & Hospitality; You are the first face groups see. You welcome them, guide them through check-in, and you are the main point of contact during their stay. Upon departure, you ensure a smooth check-out.
- Info & Activity Point; You help groups get started by handing out game materials, explaining possible activities, camping and how to use the camping fields.
- Small maintenance, cleaning jobs and administrative tasks; Together, we ensure the camp site looks top-notch.

Remark; Please note flexibility is needed in working times!

** PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE A EU PASSPORT - SADLY WE CANNOT ORGANISE EU-WORK PERMIT **

projects.title: Field Notes
projects.description: ⋆˚✿˖° To be eligible, please fill out our Application Form through Google: http://bit.ly/4eNS6XD⋆˚✿˖° Field Notes is a 3-week long volunteering opportunity which grew from a feeling many of us might recognize. Uncertainty about the world we live in and the futures we are expected to fit into. The project invites young people to step away from passive consumption and engage more directly with questions around community, resilience, sustainability and alternative ways of organizing life together. Participants will explore what becomes possible when people actively shape their environment together instead of simply adapting to it.

projects.title: Community Engagement in the Bavarian Forest
projects.description:
This volunteering experience takes place within a farm and Bhakti yoga community, offering a hands-on introduction to sustainable living and community-based work. Volunteers engage in a variety of activities, including garden cultivation, kitchen support, and general maintenance tasks such as cleaning and event & festivals preparation.

A central focus of the program is contributing to the self-sufficiency of a vibrant young community of approximately 30 people. Participants gain practical experience in permaculture and its implementation, working directly with raised beds and greenhouses while learning sustainable growing techniques.

Seasonal activities include preparing for the autumn harvest and winter, as well as the full cycle of vegetable production—from sowing and tending to harvesting and processing. Volunteers are encouraged to take initiative by developing their own small projects and contributing ideas, supported by experienced gardening and environmental practitioners.

projects.title: Volunteer in the shelter working with elderly and people in need (6 months)
projects.description: Philanthropy has been implementing emergency and development programs since 1991, focusing on marginalized and vulnerable groups. Its activities include psychosocial support, social services, education for the unemployed, economic empowerment, agricultural development, and capacity building of local communities. As a volunteer, you will provide professional support (social welfare, art, occupational, or other) at the Shelter for Homeless Persons in Kragujevac. You will also take part in community events aimed at preventing homelessness and support the distribution of food, hygiene kits, and cash or voucher assistance (CVA) to people at risk. Additionally, you will help assess homelessness risks in target communities and collaborate with stakeholders such as the Red Cross and the Center for Social Welfare, promoting Philanthropy’s standards in service delivery.

projects.title: ESC project in cultural center MOK - Poland
projects.description: Project in cultural center MOK,in Myslowice city, Silesia region in Poland.The propsed tasks and activites: -Activities in MOK branches-Volunteers get acquainted with the work in particular branches,located in 7 city districts.The activities will be directed to kids, youngsters and adults - Running volunteer’s native language/English speaking clubs for local community -Help in organizing events with MOK(concerts;events for children and families;workshops) -Running extra classes/workshops for children e.g.graphics, photography,film-making,music,cooking,sports,board games; -Assistance in promoting events–participation in videos and other activities to promote joint events,preparation posters,photos,happenings; -Promotion of the European Solidarity Corps and Erasmus+ Programmes -Help in office work -Organize own special event according to your idea More detailed information you can find here: https://volo.frsp.eu/en/2025/11/18/volunteering-project-in-mok-2/

projects.title: Favoriser l’apprentissage de la langue français par les activités d’éducation non-formelle
projects.description:
The main activities of the volunteers will be the organization and realization of French language classes through creative and artistic workshops and non-formal education methods with children, teenagers, youth and adults.  
The activities for French speaking volunteer will consist on: 
•	Work in the bilingual French - Serbian kindergarten, 
•	Organizing French lessons for children through games, communicative situations, explanation of vocabulary, music, explanation of cultural point of view, cooking with them etc. 
•	activities in art, theater, music, telling tales,  video and photo projects, dance, stage presentations, creating decorations, costumes
•	creating games, preparing drawings for activities
•	organization of intercultural activities
•	Looking for new partners 
•	Participation in youth exchange projects, working on the website, Facebook,
•	Promotion of the youth Mobility

projects.title: Volunteering in Münich
projects.description:
Volunteers will support different residential and social care projects for children, young people, adults, elderly people, and people with physical or mental disabilities in Munich. The project takes place in several living and support centres connected to organizations working in the fields of inclusion, rehabilitation, independent living, and social care. Volunteers will actively contribute to residents’ daily lives and support their participation in social and community activities. The tasks are based on the organizations’ current needs as well as the volunteers’ interests, motivation, and skills.
The activities may include helping during breakfast and meals, accompanying residents in daily life, supporting leisure activities, assisting with walks and shopping, participating in creative or cultural activities, and supporting social interaction and communication. Depending on the placement, volunteers may also support children and young people with disabilities.

projects.title: LAST CALL: ESC IN ASK ART I SOCIAL I KITCHEN 2026
projects.description: This activity aims to promote new environmental (but also social and economic) sustainability starting from critical reflection on food consumption. Thanks to food education workshops designed from the bottom up, for everyone, the aim is to develop a new culture of food sustainability that avoids consumerism and waste; this volunteering activity could also support the organization of an innovative civic food network that has the aim of building new food supply chains (short, ethical and respectful of the environment), and willing to experiment with new forms of conviviality and participation that are hosted in ASK. ASK is a new space in Fonti for social refreshment, a multifunctional place for relationships and is permeated by cultural initiatives such as concerts, book presentations, meetings with authors, talks, tastings, workshops and laboratories, intercultural nights and linguistic tandems. ASk is the new space of Centro Fonti San Lorenzo and the activities are always colegated

projects.title: Ready to Act: Volunteering at the Autism Centre in Krakow
projects.description: We are looking for one person to our project in the Autism Center in Krakow. The volunteer's tasks will be to support students from the centre in their everyday activities: learning languages, gardening, sport activities, therapy, ceramics, art and music, computers and other. Volunteer will be supported always by the coordinator from the hosting organisation. Volunteer work 6 hour per day in the Autism Centre and additionaly in the activities offered by the IB Polska. Volunteer has 2 additional free days per full month. We contact only people who fulfil the form for the volunteer which you will find below. The next step is always online meeting with candidate.

projects.title: European Solidarity Corps – PAIMPOL Middle School - Supporting Intercultural Education in a Secondary School
Green-up your community - the short term experience
projects.description:
LAST MINUTE VOLUNTEERING OPPORTUNITY!!
Currently looking for volunteers for short term - starting in June.
We are an NPO from the small town of Tramonti in the rural and mountainous area of the Amalfi Coast, working for the regeneration of the local environment and local cultural heritage. The project will include NATURAL BUILDING and PERMACULTURE. You will be part of our community, build natural buildings, support for the local family farmers (including working in food conservation and food traditions) in Tramonti (including working with wood, cleaning of hiking paths and more), Social media account management, English teaching and text writing, and Sustainability workshops for recycling and reusing. You will stay in our community in Tramonti and get to know local activities and environmental projects and learn how to be part in them.

projects.title: Eco-Construction & Agroecology Camp
projects.description: Join a 3-week international volunteering experience in the Hungarian countryside with Cargonomia! This ESC volunteering team takes place in Zsámbok, a small rural village about one hour from Budapest, where Cargonomia develops activities around with an organic farm partner Zsamboki Biokert: agroecology, permaculture, eco-construction, low-tech solutions, community cooking, and community-based sustainable living. Participants will live together in a temporary eco-community, camping in tents, sharing daily life, community cooking, and collective organisation. The main practical activity of the camp will focus on the renovation of an old adobe house using ecological and traditional building techniques, combined with gardening, low-tech experimentation, and rural sustainability workshops. More info: https://www.szatyorgoesabroad.org/come-to-hungary/volunteering/2026-july-group-volunteering-in-zsambok

projects.title: International Youth Work through Sports
Young Leader from Austria wanted for Project at the Youth Centre “Oktopus” in Berlin!
projects.description: During the ESC, the volunteer will learn about different facets of children and youth work in a theoretical and practical approach. The Oktopus offers creative, pottery and wood workshops, a music room, a sports room, gaming, cooking and baking activities. The volunteer will work in a team and will be responsible for certain tasks. The main task is to provide a great variety of leisure time activities like the ones mentioned. It is possible to choose a project on which she or he can focus referring to his/her interests and talents. These projects could be, for example: environmental, creative projects or networking between youth institutions. Another task is to help prepare a little buffet before opening time for the children and adolescents. The volunteers might also design posters and flyers for public relations and manage our Instagram accounts. On Mondays we have cooperations with the school nearby and we do media workshops with the students.

projects.title: ESC Volunteer (female) at Children and Youth Center „HeldInnen Raum“
projects.description:
„HeldInnen Raum“ is a children and youth center looking for one female volunteer. The center offers children aged 6–13 from different social and cultural backgrounds to spend meaningful free time together: They can participate in creative, recreational activities and are supported in developing their individual skills.
During the ESC project, the volunteer will gain insight into different aspects of children/youth work. She will support the team in everyday tasks, participate in team meetings and professional trainings. Typical tasks may include: supporting arts and crafts activities, playing games with children, assisting during creative workshops and leisure activities, preparing snacks and tea, doing grocery shopping, helping with organizational and practical tasks in the center. 
Depending on her interests the volunteer may also contribute her own ideas and small projects, for example in the fields of arts and crafts, music, re-/upcycling, nature or environmental awareness.

projects.title: Conservation opportunity in Western Uganda
projects.description:
The volunteer will be sent by VC Dublin and will work on the AVCA (Amplifying Voice for Climate Action) project. This is an ESC Humanitarian Aid initiative in Uganda, hosted by VC Uganda with the Justice and Peace Commission Hoima and the Bulindi Chimpanzee and Community Project. Hoima faces environmental pressures from population growth, oil development, deforestation, and habitat loss, affecting local livelihoods and biodiversity. Volunteers support environmental education, tree planting, habitat restoration, conservation awareness, and sustainable agriculture in schools, communities, and conservation areas. Typical work is Monday to Friday, 35 hours per week, combining fieldwork, engagement, and reflection. The project aims to strengthen environmental awareness, foster practical climate action, support locally led sustainable development, and promote intercultural learning between volunteers and host communities.
VC -INFO-PACK-UGANDA-2026-2027 available at https://shorturl.at/HKWSv

projects.title: Youth Empowerment Project 31 August 2026 - 23 December 2026(115 days)
projects.description:
🌍 ESC Volunteering Opportunity with ABS!

Join Active Bulgarian Society (ABS) in empowering youth and promoting sustainability, eco-friendly initiatives, and European values! As an ESC volunteer, you’ll help spread awareness of Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps opportunities through interactive events, workshops, and outreach activities.

📌 Your Role:

Proactive, open-minded, and motivated young people ready to make an impact! No experience needed—just enthusiasm for sustainability, creativity, and teamwork!

📩 Apply now and start your ESC adventure with ABS! 🚀

projects.title: Project and Gender Management Support Officer.
projects.description: Would you like to be part of a project that promotes gender equality and defends women’s rights? As part of the “PUENTES: Programme for Unity and Equity in the Regions with a Focus on Solidarity” project, you will work with MPDL Guatemala to support its various projects aimed at preventing gender-based violence and protecting women human rights defenders. You will also be part of Movimiento por la Paz, a pacifist, feminist and anti-racist organisation with over 40 years’ experience fighting for a fairer world. The volunteer will work 30 to 38 hours per week, tailored to the organisation’s needs, and will receive ongoing support and training. The main activities will take place in Quetzaltenango, with possible travel to nearby communities where projects are being implemented.

projects.title: Project and Gender Management Support Officer
projects.description: Would you like to be part of a project that promotes gender equality and defends women’s rights? As part of the “PUENTES: Programme for Unity and Equity in the Regions with a Focus on Solidarity” project, you will work with MPDL Guatemala to support its various projects aimed at preventing gender-based violence and protecting women human rights defenders. You will also be part of Movimiento por la Paz, a pacifist, feminist and anti-racist organisation with over 40 years’ experience fighting for a fairer world. The volunteer will work 30 to 38 hours per week, tailored to the organisation’s needs, and will receive ongoing support and training. The main activities will take place in Quetzaltenango, with possible travel to nearby communities where projects are being implemented.

projects.title: Step by Step Türkiye
projects.description: It is planned that our young volunteers will engage in activities in areas such as art, sports, informatics, etc. Volunteers are directed according to their areas of competence and it is planned to benefit local youth in this regard. In addition, each volunteer participates in artistic activities to learn Turkish culture.

projects.title: Children’s Nature Summer Camps
projects.description:
ONE Slovenian volunteer needed :)
This will be the 3rd summer that GAIA is organizing environmental summer camps for children from the local community. Ranilug is a rural municipality situated along Binačka Morava River, consisting of 13 villages, predominantly populated with the Serbian minority. Children in Ranilug do not have many opportunities to participate in extracurricular activities, in particular about the environment or nature. Our summer camps provide a unique opportunity for around 40 children to learn about nature and environmentally responsible behaviour. The activities include diverse outdoor workshops on biodiversity, camping, orientation and so forth. Free time is used for sports, games, art and excursions to the mountains. There will be two age groups (7 to 10 and 11 to 14), each in the camp for 5 days.
Activities are taking place from 9 am to 4 pm, children sleep at home. One or two overnight might be organised with the older group if they show interest.

projects.title: Contributing to the activities of the local network of libraries and organising specific activities for library users and readers on EU citizenship at Saint Brieuc Armor Agglomération
projects.description: We are looking to host a European volunteer to lead educational activities in our network of local libraries.  The volunteer will contribute to the life of the libraries network, the libraries activities and organise workshops to raise awareness among library users about European citizenship and world cultures.

projects.title: raising awareness of europe among children and youth in rural aeras
projects.description:
project with children and young people in a rural area. 
There are 4 different missions:
a mission with children between 3 and 12 years old in a leisure center
a mission with teenagers between 13 and 18 years old
a mission with sports educators to carry out sports activities
a mission of animation to promote mobility and intercultural
Joint projects such as the organization of a language café, intercultural meals and mobility promotion actions
French courses are offered every week
with a teacher.
the 4 volunteers live together in a large house with one bedroom each, two bathrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a large garden

projects.title: Aisling Project European Solidarity Corps Volunteering
projects.description: Aisling Project is an after-school initiative located in Ballymun, Dublin. Aisling Project works to provide children and young people with a secure and enjoyable environment where they can spend time after school, be part of a programme that focuses on building relationships with others, fosters a sense of responsibility and encourages a sense of identity and self-worth. It was set up in 1997 and has Five Centres in Ballymun. The aim of each project is to prevent early school leaving, to benefit the community of Ballymun by advancing education through an after school service for the children in the area. A hot nutritious meal is provided each day that the child attends, homework supervision and support is also provided and planned developmental activities take place each day.

projects.title: Técnica/o de apoyo en Comunicación en Guatemala
projects.description:
Movimiento por la Paz – MPDL es una organización social, pacifista, feminista y antirracista que trabaja desde hace más de 40 años por la construcción de sociedades más justas, inclusivas y pacíficas.

En el marco del proyecto ACT4PEACE, que busca promover el voluntariado juvenil como herramienta para la promoción de los derechos humanos y las culturas de paz en América Latina y la región MENA, MPDL ofrece una oportunidad de voluntariado internacional en Guatemala.

La persona voluntaria se integrará en el equipo de MPDL Guatemala, apoyando labores de comunicación y gestión de proyectos desde un enfoque de derechos humanos, género e inclusión, contribuyendo a fortalecer los procesos de desarrollo y construcción de paz en el país.

projects.title: Artistic and cultural events with Courteline
projects.description:
The Courteline Socio-Cultural Association develops activities and services centred on three key areas: Social work, Educational activities, Cultural activities.
The volunteer will join the Association’s leisure and culture team to help look after children (aged 4–6), Supervise art workshops (children, teenagers, adults), Support sewing workshops (teenagers, adults), the organisation of cultural events, promote these workshops and events (social networks, videos...), Develope activities or projects proposed by the volunteer, Highligh the work of all the organisation’s volunteers (8 people).
32 hours per week (including 4 hours of French lessons).
The volunteer will work from Monday to Friday during the Association’s opening hours; occasionnally, work carried out in the evenings or at weekends.
2 days holidays per month completed.

projects.title: European Solidarity Corps at Lycée Jean Moulin in Saint-Brieuc
projects.description:
They will have two main responsibilities:
- Raising awareness among young people about international mobility, particularly through Erasmus programs. They will assist students with their plans for internships abroad. In particular, they will help students prepare for life abroad by discussing issues such as travel, food, culture, etc. Erasmus exchanges take place with Poland and Portugal.
- Raise awareness about citizenship and international solidarity. They will help prepare and organize the Solidarity Festival and participate in other events. The volunteer will be able to propose and organize events and work on developing educational and communication tools.
He/she will participate in the activities of the MDL, the student association: taking part in activities and cultural outings.

projects.title: European Solidarity Corps – Lycée Sacré Cœur – St Brieuc – Citizenship, Interculturalism, and Ecological Transition
projects.description:
The European Voluntary Service offers volunteers a variety of assignments working with middle and high school students, focused on promoting cultural and European openness and the ecological transition.
The assignments include:
Raising awareness about Europe and volunteering.
Cultural exchanges about their countries and interests.
Intercultural activities.
Leading the middle and high school eco-delegate group (supporting and encouraging student-led initiatives related to the ecological transition within the school)
Researching and organizing awareness campaigns for students on the challenges of the ecological transition. (Exhibitions, guest speakers, etc.)
Contributing to language learning (participating in classes, leading school activities in a foreign language).
Creating educational content (videos, podcasts, role-playing games).
Participating in European projects (Erasmus+, eTwinning).
Organizing special events (theme days, festivals).

projects.title: VOLUNTEER IN PROJECT ASSISTANCE & COMMUNICATION
projects.description: You will support the organization in the development of Project proposals, implementation and grants management. You will conduct research and data analysis and assist the Mission in Project Communication/Visibility tasks. Your activities will be devoted to mapping of actors and potential partners, desk research, data analysis and visualization of information; networking with partners and key stakeholders, assisting the project drafting and management, monitoring and reporting, and supporting initiatives such as workshops/trainings/conferences. You will update social media and Website with regular posts, develop project communication/visibility materials (Leaflets, posters, banners, videos, pictures etc.). You will facilitate project/organization events (closing events, conferences, etc.) and develop project communication plans and follow up. Update staff on utilizing communication and visibility tools/protocols, brand identity and visibility guidelines.

projects.title: Creative workshops for seniors in Social Welfare Home in Gdynia
projects.description:
Social Welfare Home in Gdynia  is a residential care home for elderly people who need daily support.
Some residents may have difficulties with moving around, taking care of their health, or managing everyday tasks, so they are supported by professional staff.
The home is located in a cosy and green area, close to a forest, and has its own garden. It is home to 79 residents who form a small community. For them, it is important not only to receive care, but also to have social contact, stay active, and feel included. The centre offers different activities that help residents maintain their physical and mental wellbeing. These include rehabilitation, therapeutic activities, Senior Club meetings, and various social and cultural events.
As a volunteer, you will mainly support occupational therapy activities. This type of therapy helps residents stay active, develop their interests, and enjoy their time. You will also help organise holidays and special events.

projects.title: European Solidarity Corps – St. Charles High School in St. Brieuc
projects.description:
At a secondary school (approximately 950 students), the volunteer will offer cultural and intercultural activities to high school students, lead student and CVL initiatives focused on international outreach and intercultural discovery, facilitate school activities in a foreign language, organize field trips, exhibitions, and connections with organizations that promote mobility, raise student awareness of European and international mobility, and assist students in finding international mobility opportunities. They may also interact with international students at the school.
Outside of class hours, they will provide language support. This includes assisting with exchange programs, for example.
The CVL (Club de Vie Lycéenne) is now a hub for exchange and coordination. The volunteer will bring a dimension of cultural activities and international outreach by leading initiatives—in collaboration with the school’s student life office—based on their own ideas and those

projects.title: "Unity Voices"
projects.description:
This projects gives us the opportunity to maintain an informational platform about our region and promote educational, social and cultural events, so that we can stimulate people to be a more active part within the community. We communicate with different people and we try to share about young people with diverse backgrounds and diverse stimuli, who can serve as a motivator for the local people to constantly develop and follow their goals.

Detailed info pack and an application form here: https://forms.gle/Rfo9EP6gbyL5Ce9z5 
If you really want to apply, fill in the application form, please!

projects.title: SANSUSĪ VOLUNTEERING SUMMER '26 (SVP 26 TEAMS)
projects.description:
Apply here: https://tinyurl.com/SVP26summerapply 
Sansusī Summer '26 is a volunteering teams activity that aims to promote solidarity among the Sansusī community and communities it is connected with through volunteering, artistic and cultural activities. Activity is for 16 young people from EU and program countries. Idea is to create, develop and grow as human beings and improve inner artistic side of each volunteer. Everyone will stay in a rural area of Latvia - Susēja Artist Residence Centre - around 150 km from Rīga in Aknīste municipality. Residence centre also hosts a contemporary academic music and arts festival Sansusī on August 7-9. Planned dates for activity 09.07-12.08.2026 (excluding travel days) More info: https://tinyurl.com/SVP26info

projects.title: Citizen's house Gisèle Halimi / Istres
projects.description:
The citizen’s house develops projects aiming at consolidating social cohesion, with the help of 8 volunteers : 6 french volunteers and 2 international volunteers.

For 9 months you will work in a team with 6 other French volunteers and 1 European volunteer. During this time, you will create strong bonds within your team, as you have to work on all the projects together as a group. You can look forward to the two cohesion seminars with the team, as they are an amazing bonding experience! 
There will be 7 – 11 missions overall that you will be working on. While most missions have an allocated time slot in the week, your weeks will look different every time depending on what needs to be done.
While the missions are never the same each year and are always very diverse, the framework stays the same. You will be working with senior citizens, children in a primary school, and children with disabilities.

projects.title: Support the student of the highschool Valabre
projects.description:
You will do your mission in the high school that is based in the countryside, near a city called Gardanne. But you will live in a flat based in the city center of Marseille, with 3 other volunteers. To go to the high school, you’ll have to take a train and then a bus (the travel is payed by Hors Pistes). The travel is 50 minutes long. Be ready for this! 

Your main mission will be helping the spanish teacher and the mathematic teacher during lessons : you can propose some activities and workshops, help the pupils. You can also help organising a school trip in spain (organising visits, contacting the school in spain, etc). You can help at the library (CDR), and prepare activities for the «café lecture». You can develop your personnal project on the subject of your choice, that will be exhibited at the library.

For this mission, you need to be interested in working with teenagers, language and mathematics!

projects.title: Social Media Guru
projects.description:
We are looking for a creative Social Media Guru for a long-term ESC volunteering project at Svitene Youth Centre!

The main task is to help make youth centre activities, volunteering experiences and local community stories visible on social media.

The volunteer will create short videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok, take photos and videos of events, workshops and daily activities, help record podcasts, and prepare posts for Instagram and Facebook. They will also contribute ideas for campaigns, video series and stories about young people, volunteering and European values.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys social media, photo and video content, creativity and communication with people. Professional experience is not required — motivation, willingness to learn and courage to try new ideas are the most important.

projects.title: Activities for youth and children
projects.description:
The volunteer will take part in the daily life of the youth centre in Svitene and Pilsrundale and support different activities for children and young people. This may include creative workshops, games, outdoor activities, cultural events, informal learning activities and small community initiatives.

The volunteer will prepare, organise and run activities. Volunteer will also have the opportunity to create  own ideas, such as workshops connected with media, photography, video, music, culture, games or other personal interests. Their main support person in daily activities will be the second volunteer, who will focus on creating social media content and sharing the youth centre’s stories online.

Through these activities, the volunteer will support young people’s creativity, communication, teamwork and active participation in local community life.

projects.title: Eco-Ambassadors of European Values
projects.description: At Maison de l'Europe Bordeaux-Aquitaine (MEBA), we defend the idea that the European spirit is forged from simple daily actions that shape the common European identity. It's already been 11 years the MEBA has carried out the project ‘Ambassadors of European values’, aiming to contribute to the creation of a better and more peaceful environment through solidarity, team spirit, joy and optimism. But what do we do concretely? We present our countries, their culture, heritage, languages, gastronomy, politics, etc. through educational workshops at schools (primary-secondary-high schools), lead linguistic cafés, create a podcast and our own weekly radio shows, organise cultural events, create social media contents, participate at events organised by the city and meet local MPs, promote European mobility programmes, active citizenship, sustainability, environmental inclusion and solidarity in our society. Check us out on IG @maisondeleurope

projects.title: Developing outdoor leadership skills
projects.description: At Outward Bound Romania Youth Center in Sovata for 2026 we have 1 NEW open spots for volunteers who would like to develop in outdoor experiential education and practice outdoor youthwork. Tasks of the volunteer: participation in the organization and implementation of adventure education courses, involvement in equipment management, support in the logistics of outdoor education programs, some of them working on social media campaigns and editing videos about the programs, projects. We offer: in total 1 places for 5-month volunteering period, composed of a personal experience, approx. 10 days of training and a minimum of 60 days of experience, leading outdoor educational programs for divers group. During the volunteering, you will have the opportunity to learn to independently design, facilitate, and conduct outdoor education programs. The volunteers will acquire basic outdoor skills, pedagogical competencies, and will also develop their personality, solidarity, and green skills.

projects.title: Supporting youth workers in keeping the centre buzzing
projects.description: Our mission is to create a safe and welcoming space where young people can grow, discover their strengths, develop their potential, and learn responsibility at their own pace. The volunteer will act as an assistant youth worker, supporting daily operations during weekday open evenings by developing trust through informal communication, active listening, and participating in casual activities like games, cooking, and conversations. Key responsibilities include assisting the team with tournaments, movie nights, workshops, seasonal events, sleepovers, and youth-led initiatives, supporting summer camps, outdoor activities, and excursions during school holidays, as well as assisting youth with homework or practical skills. Additionally, the volunteer will be encouraged to design and lead their own personal project, such as a club, workshop, or special event, based on their unique interests and the needs of the youth centre. Looking to host 2 volunteers.

projects.title: Dana HHH 06
projects.description: The project will try to support different associations, schools, municipallities and stakeholders in La Alcudia and Alcasser and also those contributing to the recovery of the areas and regions affected by Dana in 2024. that need our help. There will be a wide diverse of activities to develope that might be phisical , artistical, educational or social, mainly organising a Summer Camp for children in La Alcudia and doing environmental and social activities in Alcasser with local youngsters. Additionally, there will be occasional educational activities with children, reconstructing activities and visits to senior centers or other social events to support the community organizations in the area, to complete 6-7 working hours a day. 2 days per week will be free. Flexibility and desire to act as a real volunteer is a  MUST in this project.

projects.title: Engagement volontaire au sein de la ludothèque de Castres 2026/27
projects.description:
The ”Ludothèque Castraise” is a non-profit association whose main objective is to make a large number of toys and games available to everybody and to convey certain values through this like respect for cultural diversity. The association offers various services; including the "cité du jeu" (an animation space with more than 2500 games and toys) and a leisure center which welcomes children from 3 to 12 years old during school vacations and every Wednesday.
We offer to 2 volunteers to participate for twelve months in the life of the association. They will be part of the team which takes care of the children, and they will have the opportunity to set up their own personal project within the objectives of the association. The presence of volunteers supports our objectives and reinforces the European dimension and the values of solidarity that we promote. With this project we want to make Europe and cultural diversity more accessible.
For more info:  www.laludoc.wordpress.com/volonariat

projects.title: Engagement volontaire au sein de la ludothèque de Castres

The ”Ludothèque Castraise” is a non-profit association whose main objective is to make a large number of toys and games available to everybody and to convey certain values through this like respect for cultural diversity. projects.title: CHILL - Support a Medieval festival
projects.description:
CHILL stands for Community Hub, Living Labs in Inland and is a project that connects Basilicata Link (in the role as coordinator) with the National Network RIFAI which promotes the activation of rural towns with cultural and social activities. This project sees the hosting of a group of 7 foreigners and 3 local volunteers, supporting the historical reenactment of the “Conspiracy of the Barons”, the most important cultural event in the town of Miglionico, located in the province of Matera. The event takes place 12, 13 and 14 August and commemorates a historical episode that happened in 1485 during the Kingdom of Naples.
Read all information here on the infopack  -   https://canva.link/7woj7dhzg1y9hpc  -  and apply on the google form: https://forms.gle/g5m95HJ2XadCCmLw7    (copy past the links)

projects.title: Individual volunteering for 59 days in North Macedonia
projects.description: This volunteering activity implemented by Coalition SEGA is in duration of 59 activity days. The activity will be actively addressing the issue of inclusion and diversity as a societal challenge The volunteers will be actively involved in daily work in the office of the organization SEGA, working on different tasks, local activities and projects with young people in Prilep - Macedonia. The project activities will be actively addressing the issue of inclusion and diversity as a societal challenge. Furthermore, activities implemented will be related to digital transition aiming to boost digital skills, foster digital literacy, promote the use of virtual and digital components such as information, communication and technology tools in all activities. Detailed plan of the activities and dynamics will be developed together with volunteers and organization team.

projects.title: ArtImpact Vol.2
projects.description: Do you believe in the power of art to drive social change? If so, we invite you to join kitev's self-organized, artistic team dedicated to supporting structural change from the grassroots level. kitev (Kultur im Turm) is a dynamic laboratory for unconventional interventions, located in the iconic water tower at Oberhausen's central train station. This unique venue serves as a hub for high-quality artistic activities and a welcoming space for project-based residencies in the region. At kitev, we support innovative, experimental, and interdisciplinary artists, fostering dialogue between diverse artistic practices and actively engaging with the local community. Our projects operate at the interface between art, architecture and urban planning and a lot with citizen participation. Our key focus areas include: Practicing art for social change Urban development Integrating migrants into the local community

projects.title: SparkLab
projects.description: SparkLab is a dynamic volunteering project based in a youth community space where creativity, ideas, and people come together. Volunteers will organize activities, support young people, create inspiring events, and help build an open, inclusive community full of energy, learning, and connection.

projects.title: Little Roots
projects.description: This volunteering project takes place in a German minority kindergarten, where volunteers become part of a warm and multicultural environment full of creativity, learning, and joyful everyday moments. By supporting children through games, activities, and community programs, volunteers help create a caring space where cultures, languages, and smiles grow together.

projects.title: PlayGrow
projects.description: This volunteering project takes place in a kindergarten, where volunteers become part of a warm and multicultural environment full of creativity, learning, and joyful everyday moments. By supporting children through games, activities, and community programs, volunteers help create a caring space where cultures, languages, and smiles grow together.

projects.title: Ambassadors of Europe and Mobility - La Maison de l'Europe en Mayenne 26/27
projects.description: 2 volunteers of the House of Europe will prepare workshops for schools and youth organisations about the European Union, including the foreign languages and cultures beginning from primary school to high school. The volunteers will also be able to promote environmental problems, digital transition, fight against discrimination and democracy by creating workshops. Furthermore, he/and she will be an Ambassador of the EU and international mobility (presenting the programme the ESC to youth, such as Erasmus+, DFJW/OFAJ, etc.). Every year we celebrate the Europe's Day, Christmas in Europe organize next events (debates, conferences, etc.). The volunteers will be working together with the team to develop those events and the European projects. He/and she will also work on communication tasks (social networks, website, create posts). Furthermore, the volunteers will be asked to create his/and her own animations and activities about his/and her country and culture.

projects.title: Ambassador of Europe and Mobility - Habitat Jeunes Laval 26/27
projects.description:
Habitat Jeunes Laval is a youth organisation designed to promote social mixing and diversity with 3 residences in the city of Laval for young people. They facilitate meetings between inhabitants, and contribute to a spirit of openness, tolerance and solidarity. It offers homes, restauration, animations every week evenings. The volunteer will work in the 3 residences. 

Her/his tasks will be: 
- Creating European animations and events for the evenings (cultural evenings, sport events, movies, etc.) 
- Creating long-lasting projects with the inhabitants (about Europe and European priorities like environment, fight against discrimination and democracy, etc.) 
- Participating in the creation of documents such as flyers, posters, etc. 
- Managing social networks and a newsletter 
- Setting up activities linked with European mobility 
- Supporting the animators in daily task.

projects.title: Supporting disadvantaged young people and families in rural areas
projects.description:
Apprentis d’Auteuil is a Foundation composed of more than 200 youth centers. Its goals are to welcome, educate, train and insert more than 40,000 young people in distress and accompany their families. We help them to gain confidence in themselves and the adult world. We develop the individual talent and personal skills of each young person and help them to find their place both professionally and personally.

You’ll join “Maison des familles “ in Montdidier, a small town in a rural area. The family center in Montdidier is responsible for supporting disadvantaged families and their childrens (administrative assistance, job search, parenting support).

Your main task will be to support disadvantaged families and young people in their extracurricular life, training, leisure and integration. You will : - Set up activities/workshops/games for children and their parents on the themes of the environment, ecology, digital technology, food, etc.

projects.title: Youth Empowerment Project 31 August 2026 - 23 December 2026(115 days)
projects.description:
🌍 ESC Volunteering Opportunity with ABS!

📌 About the Project:
Join Active Bulgarian Society (ABS) in empowering youth and promoting sustainability, eco-friendly initiatives, and European values! As an ESC volunteer, you’ll help spread awareness of Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps opportunities through interactive events, workshops, and outreach activities.

📌 Your Role:
✅ Organize events & campaigns – Clean-ups, art clubs, DIY sustainability projects & more.

📩 Apply now and start your ESC adventure with ABS! 🚀

projects.title: Youth work in Tampere, 6-12 months
projects.description:
We at Tampere Youth Services are looking for two volunteers for a 6–12-month period. The starting date and the total length of the period can be negotiated. 
Tampere Youth Services is the main provider of youth work in the city of Tampere. We provide activities for youth between 9-29 years, mostly in their free time. 

The volunteers will work mostly at their individual ‘home base’ youth centres. The tasks include organizing and carrying out activities for youth at youth centres, events, and other youth work locations, as well as updating our Instagram account.
We are looking for volunteers to:

1. a local youth centre: we value knowledge and experience of sports and physical activities 

2. the cultural youth centre: we expect an interest and/or skills in creative methods, such as arts, crafts, media, and music

The volunteering project includes work in the evenings and on weekends, still in total 5 days / week. You will work closely with other volunteers and youth workers.

projects.title: RISE - 12 MONTHS IN VITERBO ITALY
projects.description: Project will have THREE main kind of activities: SOCIAL FARM:aimed at promoting disadvantaged people’s rehabilitation, care and/or the integration of people with ‘low contractual capacity’ (i.e.: psycho-physical disabilities, drug addicts, minors, emigrants). The special added value of social farming is the possibility for disadvantaged people to being integrated in a living context, where their personal potential may be valued and enhanced. DAILY CENTER WITH DISABLE PEOPLE The daily center is created for people with mental disability (children and adults). Every working day the volunteers have a chance to participate in man kinds of activity: manual art and do it yourself activities (make decorations, figures, painting etc.); recycling and kitchen workshop (participating in every step of preparing meals for the group, and getting to know even Italian cuisine better when cooking together MIGRATION CENTER activity with migrants adults and children in a daily center or houses.

projects.title: Ambassador for international mobilty, independent travel, culture, sports, and civic engagement among young people aged 16-25 at Mission Locale of Fougères
projects.description: The European Solidarity Corps (ESC) volunteer assists a project manager with initiatives related to international mobility, vacations, sports, culture, and citizenship. They help welcome and provide individual support to young people, sharing their own experiences to inform and motivate them to go abroad. They contribute to organizing trips in France and across Europe (planning, leading activities, and evaluation) as well as group workshops (on mobility, citizenship, and language). Through progressive training, they progress from observation to co-facilitation and then to greater autonomy. They take part in group activities (English conversation cafés, events, exhibitions) and assist with administrative or translation tasks. They also support young people with their vacation plans and participate in programs promoting access to sports, culture, and civic engagement, while developing their personal and professional skills.

projects.title: Social media organizer
projects.description:
You are welcome to Latvia, Jēkabpils. We are looking for 2 volunteers for 4 month. "Vidusdaugava`s NGO Center" have 10 years’ experience to organize European volunteering job. projects.title: Bring life to Dupuy high school 2026/2027
projects.description:
The Dupuy de Lôme high school is a general, technological and professional high school with around 950 pupils. The volunteer will be supported by the senior school administrator.
The roles of volunteer in Dupuy de Lôme:
➡️Organising and leading an English club or in hisher mother tongue, depending on the nationality)
