projects.title: Creating Together Across Generations
Volunteering at AFS Interkultur - supporting Swedish participants
projects.description:
We are looking for one ESC volunteer in AFS Interkultur to support our activities with the Swedish AFS team.

Please be aware that we do not receive applications through this database.  Please read all about the position and how to apply here: https://www.afs.dk/frivillig-udlandet/evs-hosting-opportunities-in-denmark/#afs-nav-afs-interkultur-swedish-collaboration

projects.title: GSW - Green Summer Workcamp
projects.description:
Le Quai Culturel, founded in 2016, is a Tunisian association committed to creating opportunities for young people through youth exchanges, training courses, and volunteering projects across Europe and the Mediterranean region.
The organization focuses on social inclusion and active citizenship, addressing topics such as migration, inclusion of people with disabilities, environmental sustainability, marine biodiversity, green technologies, and outdoor education. The project aims to:
• Promote environmental awareness and encourage young people to adopt more sustainable lifestyles.
• Foster recycling, waste reduction, and environmentally responsible practices within the local community.
• Strengthen intercultural dialogue and mutual understanding between Tunisian and Italian youth through collaborative activities and shared experiences.
• Support community engagement in Ben Arous by involving local residents, organizations, and young people in environmental and social initiatives.

projects.title: EXPERIENCE COMMUNITY LIFE
projects.description:
During this funded volunteering opportunity you will live and work in the dynamic ecovillage of Bergen. You will develop new competences, make
friends and actively become part of a regenerative culture. This ESC opportunity is for EU residents/citizens until the age of 30 interested
in developing ecological and social skills and curious about the ecovillage movement. You will be living and working in Ecovillage Bergen. As a volunteer you will participate in various activities, from gardening to cooking and from building maintenance to help organizing events.

projects.title: EXPERIENCE SIMPLE LIVING WITH OTHERS IN NATURE
projects.description: During this funded volunteering opportunity you will live and work in the dynamic ecovillage Land van Aine in Ter Apel and contribute to the national Dutch ecovillage network. You will develop new competences, make friends and actively become part of a regenerative culture. This ESC opportunity is for EU residents/citizens under 30 interested in developing ecological and social skills and curious about the ecovillage movement. You participate in various activities, from gardening to cooking and from building maintenance to eventmanagement. Moreover, you will be part in communal events such as yoga, meditation and sharingcircles.

projects.title: OFF THE GRID TINY HOUSE EXPERIENCE IN A PERMACULTURE FOOD FOREST
projects.description: This ESC opportunity is ONLY for EU citizens (18 - 30 years) interested in developing ecological, social skills and curious about living off the grid. You will be working with permaculture teacher Bouwie, experience life in a (food)forest, and participate in various activities, from harvesting to building. Become part of a regenerative culture for a period of one month. Please apply directly to bouwie@aardecollectief.nl with your motivation.

projects.title: Pécsvárad Youth Club 26/27
projects.description: The Association for Youth Participation, is a public benefit organization, which members are young and active young adults, who were earlier part of the Youth Municipality of Pécsvárad. The main fundamental aim of the organization is to support and help the local, regional (national) youth initiative. It is an important goal for us, to still help and support, the young residents of the city (between the age of 13-25). Furthermore, we are cooperating and helping the local youth municipality. Our association in the last few years started to continually focus on broadening and improving the quality of the areas of local youth work. Our association currently has multipule aims: - Provision and improvement of the local youth work - Encourage the settlements in the area of Pécsvárad for local youth work, and building partnership with them - Create opportunity for local young people, and for those who live in the area, for participating in international youth programmes.

projects.title: Join the construction of a nursery and reforestation activities in Sadaani natural reserve
projects.description: STORM C project is looking for a team of 15 volunteers to join a 59-day mission in Tanzania supporting local communities living in Sadaani Natural Reserve. We will help the village community of Tumbilini construct a nursery for 50 children who now need to go 6 km back and forth daily through the bush to attend kindergarten as well as support SANA seed bank/conservation project in collecting, storing and re-planting tree species to strengthen the ecosystem surrounding Gongo village. This is a project for nature lovers and people who are not afraid to go through a digital detox. You will be surrounded by nature, bugs, wildlife, interact daily with local communities and learn first hand about community resilience and forest restoration. Besides being in a multicultural team with 14 other volunteers you will improve team work skills, communication and collaboration, learn to adapt to change and overcome challenges being focused on solutions that cater for those less privileged.

projects.title: A Two Way Journey
projects.description: "A Two-Way Journey" is a high-priority volunteer project with a focus on the sustainable socio-economic integration of Ukrainian women and children in Ankara, Türkiye. Given the high number of women and children within the community and the significant challenges they face, this initiative is designed to respond to urgent social needs while promoting community cohesion and resilience.

projects.title: A Two Way Journey
projects.description: "A Two-Way Journey" is a high-priority volunteer project with a focus on the sustainable socio-economic integration of Ukrainian women and children in Ankara, Türkiye. Given the high number of women and children within the community and the significant challenges they face, this initiative is designed to respond to urgent social needs while promoting community cohesion and resilience.

projects.title: Help Build Regeneration! - Eco Building, Agroforestry and Permaculture project in Puglia
projects.description: Regen is based in an Agroforestry farm now containing more then 15.000 different fruit trees, shrubs, herbaceous plants and vegetable gardens. Our association regularly organizes training courses for young people and adults on Agroforestry, Permaculture and Regenerative Agriculture, with practical and theoretical parts. We carry out different activities related to the training of participants in many areas within the framework of agro-ecology, bio-construction, ecology in general. Currently we work and collaborate in the development and establishment of different projects with agroforestry and agroecological models. The association has been offering different courses related to Agroforestry, soil regeneration, hydrological management, bioconstruction and some other topics related to ecology for about 8 years. We need minds and hands to build new structures on the farm <3

projects.title: Buzz regeneration! - Communication, Agroforestry and Permaculture project in Puglia
projects.description: Regen is based in an Agroforestry farm now containing more then 15.000 different fruit trees, shrubs, herbaceous plants and vegetable gardens. Our association regularly organizes training courses for young people and adults on Agroforestry, Permaculture and Regenerative Agriculture, with practical and theoretical parts. We carry out different activities related to the training of participants in many areas within the framework of agro-ecology, bio-construction, ecology in general. Currently we work and collaborate in the development and establishment of different projects with agroforestry and agroecological models. The association has been offering different courses related to Agroforestry, soil regeneration, hydrological management, bioconstruction and some other topics related to ecology for about 8 years.

projects.title: MY GREEN STEPS THROUGH THE FOREST
projects.description: My Green Steps Through the Forest is a short-term European Solidarity Corps volunteering project taking place in Arrouquelas, a small rural village in central Portugal. The project aims to promote environmental awareness, forest preservation, and active citizenship through practical and community-based activities. Volunteers will support the maintenance of green and public spaces, participate in forest surveillance and fire prevention initiatives, contribute to recycling campaigns, and help organize awareness-raising workshops and intercultural events. Participants will work closely with local residents, learn about sustainable rural development, and experience life in a multicultural environment. The project also encourages creativity and teamwork through the creation of social media content, exhibitions, and educational materials.

projects.title: WHO WE ARE??? A JUMP!!!
projects.description:
Volunteers will support activities related to active citizenship, social inclusion, community engagement, cultural exchange, and youth participation. Through workshops, awareness-raising campaigns, digital storytelling, creative activities, and community-based initiatives, participants will gain practical experience in teamwork, communication, leadership, and project development.
The project promotes European values, intercultural dialogue, equality, and solidarity while encouraging young people to become active citizens in their local communities. Volunteers will work in an international environment, collaborate with local stakeholders, and contribute to activities that foster social responsibility, inclusion, and mutual understanding.

projects.title: Volunteers in Iceland
projects.description: Our main goal is to organize projects where people of all backgrounds, cultures, and nationalities can live and work together for a common purpose — contributing to meaningful community-based initiatives that promote cooperation, understanding, and positive social impact.

projects.title: Volunteer in the shelter working with elderly and people in need (9 months)
projects.description: Philanthropy has been implementing emergency and development programs since 1991, focusing on marginalized and vulnerable groups. Its activities include psychosocial support, social services, education for the unemployed, economic empowerment, agricultural development, and capacity building of local communities. As a volunteer, you will provide professional support (social welfare, art, occupational, or other) at the Shelter for Homeless Persons in Kragujevac. You will also take part in community events aimed at preventing homelessness and support the distribution of food, hygiene kits, and cash or voucher assistance (CVA) to people at risk. Additionally, you will help assess homelessness risks in target communities and collaborate with stakeholders such as the Red Cross and the Center for Social Welfare, promoting Philanthropy’s standards in service delivery.

projects.title: Community Engagement Coordinator (9 months)
projects.description:
Philanthropy in Ruma provides home care for 35 older adults with a social worker and two caregivers. The office has a Second Hand shop and a computer classroom, supported by volunteers. In villages, older volunteers run creative workshops. A weekly IT class helps seniors, while humanitarian aid—food, hygiene, and clothing—is distributed daily, assisting 200 people monthly. 
Your tasks will be: 
✔️ Assist in raising community awareness about humanitarian initiatives
✔️ Strengthen relationships with the community and support humanitarian engagement
✔️ Support the daily distribution of food, clothing, and essentials for vulnerable and homeless individuals 
✔️ Track and document the distribution process 
✔️ Receive, sort, and organize humanitarian aid 
✔️ Participate in field activities for older persons, including creative workshops, doctor visits, and computer courses 
✔️ Help create simple communication materials in line with data protection and safeguarding

projects.title: Youth Support and Empowerment Volunteer
projects.description:
Are you passionate about empowering young people and making a real difference in their lives? Join Association Merkuri in Zugdidi, Georgia, to lead dynamic youth programs that actively engage children and young adults aged 8 to 25.
In this role, you will provide vital support to at-risk youth, raise awareness about domestic violence, and facilitate impactful workshops and discussions tailored to their unique needs. You will collaborate with young people and local stakeholders to develop clubs, social education initiatives, and creative projects that foster personal growth and community involvement.
As a mentor and coordinator of local volunteers, you will promote informed decision-making, contribute to monitoring and evaluation, and share best practices to continuously improve the program’s reach and effectiveness.

projects.title: Climate Resilience and Disaster Preparedness Volunteer
projects.description: This volunteering opportunity is suited to someone interested in community engagement, climate resilience, and disaster preparedness. The volunteer will support local activities that help communities better understand environmental risks and improve preparedness for floods, extreme weather, and other climate-related challenges. Tasks may include helping organise workshops, discussions, awareness-raising events, and small community initiatives, as well as supporting communication with participants, preparing simple materials, and assisting with documentation and feedback collection. The volunteer will work closely with local communities, especially active residents and women, in a practical and people-centred environment. This is a meaningful opportunity to contribute to resilience-building while gaining hands-on experience in community work, local participation, and climate-related action.

projects.title: Volontariato in asili: condividi la tua cultura e i tuoi interessi con i bambini!
projects.description: T'invitiamo a collaborare alla vita d'asili pubblici, con bambini d'età tra 3 e 6 anni, come assistente insegnante, con cómpiti come: supportare nelle attività di cura dei bambini, in quelle d'auto-aiuto come vestirsi e mangiare, durante lezioni o attività all'aperto come i giochi nel giardino, le gite scolastiche e le ricorrenze; far conoscere l'Italia attraverso presentazioni ed eventi musicali, teatrali o culinarie per bambini e genitori; creare laboratori d'arte e artigianato in base a tuoi interessi e  competenze; ​​insegnare lingue straniere (come Italiano o Inglese) attraverso giochi divertenti; portare le tue idee per migliorare l'estetica dei locali dell'asilo. Avrai anche la possibilità di fare esperienze di supporto didattico. Organizzerai e parteciperai a eventi che diffondono i valori dell'E.S.C. e i contenuti del tuo volontariato nella comunità locale, durante picnic, fiere, feste di quartiere e attraverso trasmissioni radiofoniche. L'orario sarà di 35 ore a settimana.

projects.title: Women Digital and Financial Empowerment Volunteer
projects.description:
As a Women Digital and Financial Empowerment Volunteer, you will be at the heart of empowering women’s groups by enhancing their digital skills and financial literacy. Working hand in hand with local communities, you will identify practical digital tools, train women to use them effectively, and open doors to financial services that can transform their lives.
Your role includes supporting women’s groups to adopt digital platforms for smooth group operations and data-driven decisions, helping them build financial records to access credit, and advocating for marginalized groups to gain greater inclusion. You will also monitor and evaluate the project’s impact, collect and analyze data, and deliver trainings aimed at sustaining digital and financial inclusion over time.

projects.title: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Volunteer
projects.description: GDCA seeks a skilled and proactive Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Volunteer to strengthen its internal systems and practices. The role is intended for someone with prior M&E experience who can review existing processes, identify gaps, and help build more structured, reliable, and sustainable systems. The volunteer will assess current M&E tools and practices across projects, improve data collection, reporting, and evaluation processes, and develop practical tools, indicators, templates, and internal guidelines. They will support project teams in integrating M&E into design and implementation, ensure data quality and usability, analyse and visualise field data, contribute to internal and donor reporting, and work with field teams to strengthen monitoring activities. They will also train and mentor staff and promote a culture of learning, reflection, and data use across the organisation.

projects.title: 2 places left - volunteering in day care center in Riga, Latvia
projects.description:
Would you like to make a meaningful difference in your community? We are looking for caring, enthusiastic, and motivated volunteers to support activities in day centres across Riga.

As a volunteer, you can help in many ways – spending time with participants, leading creative activities, assisting with events, supporting daily programs, or simply being a friendly and supportive presence. Every contribution matters and can have a positive impact on someone's life.

💙 Volunteering is a great opportunity to gain valuable experience, meet inspiring people, develop new skills, and become part of a community that creates positive change.

Join us in building a more inclusive, supportive, and connected space. Your time, kindness, and energy can make a real difference.

📩 Get in touch to learn more and become a volunteer. We look forward to welcoming you to our team! 😊

projects.title: European Ambassador of volunteering - Cournon d'Auvergne, France
projects.description: The volunteer will work with kids and teenagers in a Municipal Animation Center in the city of Cournon (Auvergne, France). His/her main role will be to introduce European dimension and “intercultural opening-up” to the actions of the city council's educational department and its partners. The idea is to raise awareness of local youngsters on European countries and help them to be more open-minded about multiculturalism through various leisure activities, taking place out of regular school hours. You can find more information in a call for participants, please follow the link : https://canva.link/p7lm1e4u3lkswzh Please note that to apply for this project you need to fill in the application form, withouth this your application will not be considered! To do so, please, follow the link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdqMP7qa9eJ7Y9lGpi0DhsvSs4UwOLezOp0G26eq_33RNZLlw/viewform?usp=sf_link

projects.title: Digital Skills and Inclusion Volunteer
projects.description: GDCA seeks a proactive, creative volunteer to strengthen its digital presence, internal tech capacity, and community digital inclusion work. The role combines IT, digital communication, staff training, and community empowerment. The volunteer will manage GDCA’s social media, especially Instagram and LinkedIn, create engaging content, support branding consistency, and improve outreach and visibility. They will provide basic IT support, improve internal digital organisation and data management, and introduce simple tools to make workflows more efficient. Every 1–2 weeks, they will deliver digital skills training for staff on digital tools, online communication, data organisation, and basic cybersecurity. They will also lead digital literacy training in rural communities, adapting methods to low-resource contexts, and develop an independent digital innovation project with lasting local value together with GDCA staff.

projects.title: Digital Empowerment Volunteer in Ghana
projects.description:
Kongo Community Development Association (KoCDA) is a community-based organization located in Kongo, in Ghana’s Upper East Region. The organization is seeking a proactive individual to support ICT development among school children and the wider community in Kongo and Nabdam.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a grassroots organization in rural Ghana that is working to equip young learners with essential digital skills, support their growth, and prepare them for future opportunities in an increasingly digital world. The volunteer will help strengthen computer awareness among students and promote the use of ICT in teaching and learning.

projects.title: Volunteer supporting French language skills
projects.description:
Kongo Community Development Association [KoCDA] is a community-based organization in West Africa, Ghana, specifically, in Kongo in the Upper East region. The Organization seeks an active individual to help drive the skills of French language, particularly among school children and community members in Kongo/Nabdam. 
This vacancy is an interesting position in a grassroots organisation in rural Africa, aimed at equipping young students with essential French language skills. The Upper East region of Ghana is bordered by two French West African speaking countries,  Burkina Faso and Togo. Nonetheless, French is not promoted to facilitate good neighbourliness, trade and business opportunities. The long term objective is to encourage French in the Nabdam district. It aims to bridge cultural gaps, fostering better understanding and stronger relationships with communities in neighbouring countries. The volunteer is to help increase French awareness among students.

projects.title: Entrepreneurship and employability Volunteer
projects.description: The Entrepreneurship and employability Volunteer is responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing vocational skills development projects aimed at enhancing the employability and entrepreneurship capabilities of target beneficiaries. This role involves continuous engagement with stakeholders, including trainees, trainers, master crafts, parents, Technical and vocational training   institutions, and community organizations and empower participants to achieve economic independence. The Vocational Skills Advisor will also provide career guidance, monitor program effectiveness, and support the continuous improvement of vocational training initiatives.

projects.title: Health and Gender Equality Volunteer in Ghana
projects.description: Kongo Community Development Association (KoCDA), a community-based organisation in Kongo, Upper East, Ghana, is seeking a European volunteer to support health initiatives and gender equality in the Nabdam district. The region faces serious challenges, including high maternal mortality, teenage pregnancy, unequal access to health services, and limited access for young people to accurate information on sexual and reproductive health, mental health, rights, and gender equality. Girls face higher dropout rates due to persistent preference for boys’ education, while women remain underrepresented in decision-making and have less access to education, land, income, and leadership opportunities. The volunteer will support community education, youth empowerment, and advocacy to improve health awareness, promote gender equality, and strengthen inclusive participation and resilience.

projects.title: Inclusive Education Volunteer
projects.description: Kampala School for the Physically Handicapped (KSPH) is a Ugandan primary school for children with physical disabilities, founded in 1968 by parents of children with cerebral palsy. Its aim is to educate, rehabilitate, and equip learners for self-reliance and development. The school follows the national curriculum and offers sports, music, dance, drama, spiritual fellowship, and education tours. It also provides vocational training in tailoring, screen printing, crafts, tie and dye, and basic computer skills for children who cannot continue to further education. KSPH has 100 pupils aged 6–18 with disabilities such as cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, spina bifida, and polio. It has 13 teachers, 5 trained in special needs education, including 2 disabled former students. Volunteers support classroom learning, extracurriculars, wheelchair repair (voluntary), therapy exercises, teacher training, fundraising, and basic computer teaching.

projects.title: Climate Change Resilience and Preparedness Volunteer
projects.description:
Mondo Estonia is sending a volunteer to Northern Ghana, where communities face persistent poverty and heavy dependence on rain-fed agriculture. Climate change is worsening these challenges through erratic rainfall, drought, rising temperatures, and flooding, with serious effects on farming, water security, livelihoods, and employment. Rural communities therefore need both immediate adaptation measures and long-term resilience-building strategies.

The volunteer will support key activities including conducting climate vulnerability assessments, identifying practical intervention options, building local capacity in energy saving, reduce-reuse-repair-recycle practices, food management, income diversification, and sustainable farming using organic inputs, as well as strengthening networking and stakeholder engagement in climate action.

projects.title: Women’s empowerment and livelihoods volunteer
projects.description:
Are you ready to be a catalyst for real social change by actively contributing to the economic and social empowerment of women? Join KoCDA and its partner Mondo in this unique, hands-on opportunity at the heart of Kongo in Ghana’s Upper East region.
You will participate in innovative empowerment programs focused on supporting women’s economic activities such as shea butter production, basket weaving, and cloth weaving. Your role will be to help strengthen women’s skills, build lasting cooperatives, and foster sustainable economic independence.
Additionally, you will engage with school-age children in the community, creating an intergenerational impact and promoting inclusive development rooted in cultural understanding.
A key part of your mission will be to open new European markets for these artisanal products, creating economic opportunities and building strong bridges between local communities and international buyers.

projects.title: School and Society Support Initiative
projects.description:
At the Agrupamento de Escolas Terras do Ave school, volunteers will support the school during the summer break in preparing for the new academic year. In addition to activities such as garden maintenance, minor repairs, and landscape improvement, they will also carry out amateur-level artistic activities introducing Turkish culture.

Volunteers will also support community service activities taking place on specific days of the week at the association with which the school is partnered. Volunteers are also expected to regularly take photos and videos as part of the project activities and share them with the sending organization.

projects.title: Volunteering teams supporting Ukranian Refugees in Botosani - Romania
projects.description: ActionAid Spain and FJTB are looking for a team of young people to improve the assistance of Ukrainian refugees from a gender perspective, join us at the headquarters of FJTB in Botosani! The project Vol4Refugees offers young, motivated volunteers the chance to support the integration of Ukrainian refugees into the Botoșani community through educational, cultural, social, and sports activities. The project emphasizes gender-sensitive support and encourages active civic engagement. Volunteers will help organize workshops, assist with youth programs, lead non-formal education sessions, and coordinate sports or recreational events that promote inclusion and intercultural dialogue. This experience allows volunteers to develop key personal and professional skills while contributing to a more inclusive and resilient local society. If you are migrant, refugee, if you live in rural areas, if you have limited economic support or any other context don´t hesitate to sign up!

projects.title: Exploring the Magic of Performing Arts-Zodiak Circus-Szczecin/Poland
projects.description: Don't you like being bored? If your answer is a resounding "NO," we have an offer that will turn your daily routine into an extraordinary adventure. Fundacja Antygrawitacja is a place where circus, theater, and movement meet to create a space full of inspiration. We work with children and youth, helping them find themselves through creative expression. We are looking for two passionate individuals to join our team for one of three exciting paths. You could be our Social Media Hero, where reels, photography, graphic design, and content creation are your element. You might prefer being a Circus Tutor Assistant, supporting young artists, helping run workshops, and participating in festivals. Or perhaps you would thrive as our Stage Technical Staff, where working with stage lights, scenography, and tools like hammers and screwdrivers is the exact challenge you are looking for. You don't need to be an expert, as we value passion and a willingness to learn above all else. Come join us!

projects.title: La Tchicass - Liège
projects.description: Founded in 1979, the non-profit organisation La Tchicass was born out of the observation that many children from immigrant backgrounds and disadvantaged Belgian families were facing serious difficulties at school. Much more than just a homework club, the association is above all a place of welcome, exchange and activity, for both children and adults. In concrete terms, this translates into a strong commitment to combating school dropout, illiteracy, difficulties in accessing culture and prejudices of all kinds. In this context, the volunteer will support workers and local volunteers in their daily work in two of the three projects run by La Tchicass with children (homework school), teenagers (homework school and private lessons) and adults (literacy classes and French classes).

projects.title: URGENT: Join a team building community center and sustainable garden in Uganda
projects.description:
STORM project is looking for 3 volunteers to join a local community project in Namayumba, Uganda where together we will help create a youth vocational education center. The activities include helping local builders during the erection of a training facility as well as setting up a greenhouse/own vegetable garden. The volunteers will learn how to collect and utilize rain water for sanitation and gardening. Parallel to those activities, the volunteers will also engage with children from St. Joseph Primary School in Namayumba as well as in recruiting local unemployed youth with vulnerable background who can join the carpentry, dressmaking and weaving workshops at the UYSTO center.
The project is about rural community support and resilience through empowerment of the local youth. We welcome motivated, sociable and energetic volunteers who would like to join an active, intense and dynamic program with immediately visible result and impact.

projects.title: Uroczysko Festival Volunteer Team
projects.description:
We are looking for 25 participants from 25.07 till 10.08 to join us in festival Uroczysko(24.07&11.08 Travel Days). We’re assembling a team to help  build the festival’s physical spaces, contribute during the event in sanitary work, and support the post-festival reorganization. All of this will happen in a vibrant, communal atmosphere alongside local volunteers.  INFOPACK WITH GOOGLE FORM ATTACHED AT THE END WE WILL CONSIDER APPLICATION
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1z-GcjO5MFQ793r8TRpItzTPTmDb_XgfO/view
WITH FILLED OUT GOOGLE FORM ONLY!

projects.title: Proposal writing and Fundraising for Local Youth Center in Uganda
projects.description: Project SOLARIC seeks 1 volunteer willing to spend 6 months supporting a newly build youth community centers for vocational training and empowerment of girls and young women in Namayumba, Uganda. The volunteer will be hosted by Uganda Pioneers Association and join a local team working at UYSTO community center in the village of Namayumba. Team SOLARIC wishes to contribute to a strong and resilient local community where youth can grow and develop to their full potential for independent living. The volunteer will join UYSTO team and help their project management and fundraising activities aiming to provide support for the construction of the training center and in-house vocational workshops for girls and young women who help them become financially independent and encourage entrepreneurial spirit.

projects.title: ESC Volunteering at Experimental Movement Center in Tallinn, Estonia
projects.description: This project takes place at the Experimental Movement Centre in Tallinn, Estonia, a non-profit organisation promoting circus, acrobatics, dance, and performing arts for children, youth, and adults. The centre focuses on developing creativity, independence, and confidence through non-formal learning and artistic expression. The volunteer will support training sessions as an assistant coach, working with children of different age groups, and may also help organise events, performances, and competitions. Depending on their interests, the volunteer can contribute to creative activities such as choreography, costume design, social media, or visual content creation. Through the project, the volunteer will gain hands-on experience in circus and movement-based activities, develop teaching and organisational skills, and build confidence in a creative and dynamic environment. MORE INFO AND HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/experimental-movement-centre-in-tallinn/

projects.title: Técnica/o de apoyo en Intervención Social
projects.description: ¿Te gustaría ser parte de un proyecto que promueve la igualdad de género y defiende los derechos de las niñas, niños y adolescentes? En el marco del proyecto “IdeM: Igualdad y Derechos de las Mujeres en América Latina”, colaborarás con El Abrojo apoyando los diferentes proyectos que tiene en el país, para promover el pleno desarrollo personal y la inclusión social de niños, niñas y adolescentes y garantizar el ejercicio pleno de sus derechos.  Además, formarás parte de Movimiento por la Paz, una organización pacifista, feminista y antirracista con más de 40 años luchando por un mundo más justo. La persona voluntaria tendrá una jornada de 30 a 40 horas semanales, ajustada a las necesidades de la organización, y contará con acompañamiento y formación continua. Las actividades principales tendrán lugar en Montevideo, y tendrá posibles desplazamientos a comunidades cercanas donde se implementan proyectos.

projects.title: Juggle, Perform, Inspire – Volunteer with Our Circus Project in Rostock (Germany)!
projects.description:
Fantasia AG is a community of interest for cultural and integrative leisure activities for children, young people and adults. We stage plays, have our own band, tour all over the world and invite small and large artists of circus culture to our Zirkus Fantasia every summer. For some years now we have been running our own circus school, which regularly offers various courses in juggling, trapeze artistry, acrobatics and varieté for children & adults. In addition to our circus courses, we offer various leisure activities for adults with disabilities: a play group, coffee rounds, theatre and band projects.
Our two European volunteers support our trainers with school projects and afternoon classes. They are invited to contribute their own skills and ideas and, depending on their motivation and ability, also lead their own group. Our office team also welcomes their support in the areas of social media, project documentation, participant acquisition & event preparation as well as follow-up.

projects.title: Volunteering in Marseille, France - Cultural exchange and non formal education - July and August
projects.description:
Marseille (France). Number of volunteers: 1
Bokra Sawa aims to promote common values through non-formal education and to fight against prejudices, in order to gather together the Mediterranean’s two shores.

Missions:
- Participate in the daily life of the association
- Animate the pedagogic tools during local events
- Participate in the conception and creation of a pedagogic tool
- Promoting our mobility projects
- Promotion of the association's activities through participating in local event.

Bokra Sawa works on 3 main areas: 
- Cultural mediation: we create pedagogical tools in order to inform and raise awareness about the culture, art, biodiversity, gender equality etc of the south Mediterranean region.
- Mobility: we offer mobility projects (European Solidarity Corps and Erasmus +) to the local youth
- International exchanges: we organise and conduct international seminars for young workers and youth exchanges for the youth.

http://www.bokrasawa.org

projects.title: Digital communication - European Network
projects.description:
Pistes-Solidaires is an organisation committed to non-formal education and the promotion of active methods, encouraging attractive, practical education adapted to real life. 
During your voluntary, you will join the team to support the implementation of Europe Direct projects. You will be responsible for communicating on the LE.MO.N project (LEearning MObility network), the first European network dedicated to the quality, impact and visibility of international youth and education projects. 

Your main missions will be : managing social networks accounts, creating and publishing content on our social networks, creating videos, writing articles and publishing them on the website, research work and contribution to the elaboration of some reports or articles, implementing activities to promote European citizenship and implementing activities to support a more sustainable Europe.

projects.title: Supporting the Kalabria Eco Fest
projects.description:
Volunteers will take part in supporting the construction and setup of the festival area, one of the two main objectives of the Kalabria Eco project. Tasks will include site setup, kitchen and bar support, workshop and market areas, wellness area creation, parking and logistics management, infopoint, audio-visual technical support, and forest maintenance. Volunteers will be divided into groups on site, guided by activity leaders. Activities will take place in the morning and afternoon, with breaks agreed collectively.
The second objective is the co-creation of a community. Each day, recreational activities such as games, sports, and nature walks will be organized. Volunteers will be encouraged to propose activities to the group, fostering shared participation and actively contributing to community life.

projects.title: culture at the heart of education
projects.description:
The volunteer will have to intervene in the educational institutions. The volunteer will have to inform young people about the ESC, youth exchanges, but also the tools available for mobility. Local youth who welcome young people on time after school will be the place to liven resource also moments of exchange with the volunteer.
Educate youth 15-25 years in the Erasmus + Program.
   Participate in the wake of European consciousness of young people.

projects.title: Ambassador of Europe and Mobility - MFR Craon Oudon 26/27
projects.description: The volunteer will be an ambassador of Europe and mobility in the Maison Familiale Rurale of Craon Oudon which in a rural associative middle and high school with general classes and vocational trainings. He/she will promote the EU opportunities and mobility programmes among the student and support the Erasmus+ Team of the school for example by developping partnerships with other rural schools in Europe to engage new mobilities. The volunteer will also contribute to the daily life of the school: administrative tasks, supporting teenagers with homework, co-animation of workshops or classes with the teachers, taking care of the animation every evening on Thursday. He/she will also participate in the local events by preparing games and workshops for different public.

projects.title: AGESDER Volunteers-ES.2026.S. (İSPANYA KISA DÖNEM GÖNÜLLÜLÜK)
projects.description:
The starting point of our project is to add a European dimension to our local activities and to provide information and opportunities for young people. As an association, we carry out many activities in our province. In this context, our aims are:
* To add a European dimension to our volunteering activities.
* To improve the quality of our information activities for young people.

projects.title: Education for Tomorrow
projects.description: We expect the magic to unfold through your participation in the Education for Tomorrow project. Are you interested in non-formal education and the inclusion of children with fewer opportunities? Do you believe that every child deserves a chance to experience something different than the environment in which he grew up? You will be part of the process of building self-confidence in children, giving a sense of belonging to their community, which then contributes to the understanding that they do have a role in their community, that they do matter! Get ready to develop with us different projects aimed to strengthen our community from a cultural, social and linguistic perspective. Let us focus especially on the local area, by giving children the opportunity to learn how to care for plants, animals and forests in our community. Are you ready for this challenge?

projects.title: European Volunteers Go Local
projects.description:
You in Europe team is looking for 2 new long-term volunteers!  We are an NGO based in Nea Moudania, Greece, and we are looking for two motivated young people (aged 18–30) to join us for the new volunteering season!

Position 1: Social Media & Communication.If you’re creative and digitally savvy, this role is for you!  Your tasks will include:
 Managing our social media platforms
 Creating and implementing engaging content ideas
 Supporting graphic design and media content
 Assisting with overall media administration

Position 2: Volleyball Activities Support. Perfect for sports enthusiasts who enjoy working with young people and kids! Your tasks will include:
Supporting the training of young players
Assisting with exercises during training sessions
Organizing volleyball-related activities and events

to create and run a podcast together
organise local activities in the village
spread awareness about Erasmus+ and ESC programs

projects.title: FRUITS AND CAMPFIRES: CLAY&PLAY
projects.description:
Have you ever thought of joining a team of volunteers and spending two weeks in a permacultural community in the Latvian countryside where everyone works together? 

Volunteers tasks - 
Eco-construction with clay and straw
Create new Construction projects using natural materials
pizza oven
clay plaster for the garden wall
firewood shed
lime plaster for the duck house

Landscaping
clean up the nature-protected river
create a relaxation area by the pond (dig sand for a volleyball court)
paint the outdoor shower (restore the existing design)
gardening + creating a hot compost pile

Other
firewood work
kitchen help
making social media posts

Bicycles can be used to move around;
Internet connection is ensured;

projects.title: “NOBODY IS EXCLUDED IN OUR WORLD” 2076 -2026
projects.description: The volunteers will participate and help in the daily activities of SFA and help us to develop our work and the lives of disabled people. They will be important part of our team with several different options to contribute and make a difference. The volunteers will work with our disabled participants, with other volunteers and with our staff members, so openness to working with mentally disabled people and ability to cooperate are essential.More specifically Helping in classes as assistant Leading a class Permanent help with certain disabled participant Creating needed materials for the classes Helping to document the work done by staff and volunteers Taking photos and videos and editing them for use Drafting materials for raising awareness and training volunteers Helping in general organizing of events and classes Searching for cooperation partners and places for actions Checking new ideas Looking for suitable training courses and cooperation partner etc

projects.title: Creative Multimedia & Graphic design
projects.description: Youth center Koper is a non-profitable organization, established in the year of 2015. CMK has 4 main goals: - providing quality programs and projects that contributes to empowerment of young people - providing mentoring to young people (assistance in organizing various events, through counseling on open calls for funding etc.) - providing space for quality leisure time for young people (meeting space, point project planning, playing social games etc.) and use of all equipment - billiards, table football, projector, table, etc. - free of charge) - support for young artists (free use of the music equipment, a fully equipped recording studio; we have exercise room for theater groups and mentoring for young poets and writers, etc.). projects.title: Ambassador of Europe and Mobility - Don Bosco High School 26/27
projects.description: The volunteer will be able to bring a help to a local high school by promoting Europe and mobility. He/she will be able to meet the public of Mayenne and to testify of his/her experience, as a volunteer, to make students to discover his/her culture in schools. The tasks for the volunteer include various activities such as assisting librarians in the European Space of the Documentation and Information Center, coordinating projects related to Erasmus+, organizing Erasmus Days, ecological initiatives within the « Tomorrow the Earth » project, cultural exchanges with young people, activities related to student safety, and school and boarding school activities on Wednesday afternoons.

projects.title: Experience Nature
projects.description: The Centre SNJ Hollenfels offers children and youth groups a wide range of activities for direct experience in nature and the environment. The primary goal of all activities is to experience, understand and do things together in nature. The Centre SNJ Hollenfels also offers training in the field of nature and environmental didactics for teachers and educators in non-formal education. The aim is to inspire educational professionals for nature education and to expand their skills in this area. Task description: - Support for the administrative and educational team - Educational work with children and young people - Design of new activities and teaching materials within the educational team’s working groups - Assistance in organizing training courses, seminars and conferences - Support for the educational team in their network work (national and international)

projects.title: Youth Empowerment Project 31 August 2026 - 23 December 2026(115 days)
projects.description:
🌍 ESC Volunteering Opportunity with ABS!

📌 About the Project:
Join Active Bulgarian Society (ABS) in empowering youth and promoting sustainability, eco-friendly initiatives, and European values! As an ESC volunteer, you’ll help spread awareness of Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps opportunities through interactive events, workshops, and outreach activities.

projects.title: Skill EXchange
projects.description:
The main focus of this activity is to combine digital tools and environmental awareness through solidarity, cooperation, and skills sharing within the group. We are looking for 6 international volunteers who would like to take part in a variety of activities, including:

- creative workshops (including learning more about upcycling)

projects.title: Education Support Volunteer
projects.description:
Join Uganda Pioneers Association and Mondo in a rewarding role aimed at transforming education in a rural community school. As a volunteer, you will lead workshops and training sessions to strengthen school management by equipping teachers with innovative practical and theoretical teaching methods. You will support subject teachers across diverse disciplines, raising community awareness on the vital importance of education.
Your role also includes sourcing partnerships to enrich the school library with learning materials, organizing and supervising extracurricular activities, and ensuring students enjoy a well-rounded, holistic education. Moreover, you will actively contribute to the success of Mondo’s community projects, supporting both primary and secondary schools through continuous follow-up and engagement.

projects.title: REGENERATE ODEMIRA IV - Rota Vicentina
projects.description: Looking for a volunteering experience in rural and natural context, contributing to environmental causes and the preservation of local culture? projects.description: The volunteer will play a key role in facilitating knowledge building and sharing among UPA staff by conducting targeted trainings on digital skills, communication, and marketing strategies tailored for social media platforms. In addition to managing and upgrading UPA’s digital platforms to boost online engagement, the role involves building capacity through ICT training sessions for UPA staff and local partner organizations such as schools and community-based organizations. These efforts strengthen digital communication and marketing strategies, empowering teams to effectively leverage technology to enhance their work and outreach. projects.title: Volunteering On & Off Stage 2026/2027
projects.description: PLEASE DO NOT WRITE TO OUR EMAIL INBOXES! Join independent theatre and cultural association of a year. Teatr Brama is for cultural workers, photo, audio and video artists, social media managers and more to join our daily life in Goleniow, Poland. Teatr Brama was founded in 1996. The theatre began first as an informal club and shortly after became a community theatre group. Today, Teatr Brama is well known in Poland and in European world of independent theatre. Brama creates a living cultural environment in Goleniow. Brama’s motivation, from both an artistic and culture shaping point comes from the desire to revolutionize the relationship between artist and the audience. Performance is an occasion for meeting and creates the space for dialogue. As an Association, Teatr Brama utilizes informal education to create possibilities for improving the quality of life in the local community, while creating rich cultural life in Goleniów.

projects.title: Summer Pulse of Youth
projects.description: The individual volunteering project takes place in a vibrant youth centre that is full of energy, activities, and opportunities for involvement. Every day, young people gather to play volleyball, football, and basketball on the sports courts, while others enjoy board games, billiards, darts, or table tennis tournaments. Children and young people regularly bake cookies in the kitchen, build model airplanes in the workshop, and rehearse music in the music room. Volunteers are encouraged to join existing groups and activities, but they are also welcome to develop and lead their own projects based on their interests, skills, and ideas. The youth centre offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere where there is always something happening. Whether it is a creative workshop, a sports activity, or simply a board game with friends, there is always an opportunity to connect with others and become an active part of the community.

projects.title: Let's build together, in Le Créneau
projects.description: The goals of Le Créneau is to meet one another, to create a constructive dynamic, as well as to break stereotypes and stigmas by working and living together! The activities revolve around collective life, working together (35h/week) and environmental protection. The volunteers' tasks include: - Renovation of the buildings - Organization of the daily collective life - Hosting events and groups - Organization and participation in cultural events, in workshops and meetings, with various publics - Leading international workcamps for young volunteers during summer (adults and teenagers) - Gardening and animal care - Promotion of volunteering and communication on the actions /!\ Le Créneau is located in a very isolated and rural area. Volunteers should take this into consideration when applying!

projects.title: ROOTS AWAKENING 3.0
projects.description:
Roots Awakening 3.0 is a volunteering project that aims to support and develop the community and individuals through short term individual and team volunteering. The programme focuses on  development of green skills and personal key competences, physical and mental health, entrepreneurial competences and participation and support for the development of the local eco-community. projects.title: Youth centres for young people - The Youth by FNT
projects.description: Embark on a transformative journey, where you use your skills in organizing activities that resonate with the needs of young people, while highlighting your personal strengths. Our main focus is on impacting the local youth aged 14 to 35. At the same time, we place a strong emphasis on your development as a volunteer. Every event and initiative offers you the opportunity to engage, learn, and grow through practical experiences. Main activity areas include: Facilitation: Prepare and deliver events/workshops/activities, evaluate & report them. Media and Promotion: Take photos and videos, write articles, create content for online promotion. Events Logistics: Help prepare spaces, set up equipment, make lists of materials, maintain activity spaces Outreach Actions: Distribute flyers, organize flash mobs and awareness campaigns. projects.title: Baltic Regional Fund, Youth Studio “BaMbuss”
projects.description:
Baltic Regional Fund (BRF) is an NGO in Riga dedicated to fostering civil society development, social inclusion, and intercultural dialogue through non-formal education.  As a central component of its youth work, the foundation has a Youth Studio BaMbuss, which is a multifunctional and progressive space in Riga providing a safe environment for young people to learn and grow.
As a volunteer, you will be actively involved in the daily life of BRF and #jsBaMbuss, supporting ongoing activities and helping to organise events, community activities, workshops and information campaigns on topics relevant to young people and to you, like art, book, language or sports clubs, as well as activities on EU values and youth opportunities. You will have the chance to develop your own initiatives and explore different cultures. A part of the volunteer work will be the creation and publication of social media content for the youth studio.
The working language will be English.
Instagram - @jsbambuss

projects.title: Riga Youth Centres KAŅIERIS and KALNCIEMA STUDIJA
projects.description:
Riga Youth Centres KAŅIERIS and KALNCIEMA STUDIJA support young people and youth organisations by offering free spaces, resources and guidance for non‑formal education activities and youth initiatives. It provides rooms for events, advises young people on implementing their ideas and participating in European programmes, offers training for those involved in youth work, and collaborates with schools and other youth‑sector partners. Young people can organise and join workshops, discussions, game and movie nights, sports activities and events on topics such as art, climate, LGBTQ+, participation, travel, media literacy and cultural diversity. 
Together with the team volunteers will be involved in planning interactive activities for young people, finding ways of telling young people about local and European opportunities, and doing social media work.
The working language will be English.
Instagram: @kaniera15 and @kalnciema_studija

projects.title: Ķekava Youth Center “Jaunu ideju centrs”
projects.description:
Ķekava Youth Center “Jaunu ideju centrs” is an open, creative and non‑formal learning space for young people in the Ķekava region, next to Riga. It provides daily activities, workshops, events and opportunities for young people to develop their skills, express themselves and participate in community life.
Volunteers together with youth workers will plan, organise and lead non‑formal educational activities like cultural evenings, creative workshops, board games and activities promoting EU values for young people aged 12–25 in Ķekava county while helping to maintain a positive and inclusive environment. Volunteers will also collaborate with local youth to create social media content that highlights upcoming activities and strengthens communication.
The working language will be English.
Instagram: @kekavasnovads_jauniesiem

projects.title: Volunteering in the FACKtory, Altenburg
projects.description:
FACK e.V. is a youth organisation creating spaces where young people can take responsibility, develop ideas and shape their local community. Our work is built around the FACKtory, youth-led events, project meetings, community activities and international learning opportunities. As an ESC volunteer, you will become part of this active environment and support young people in developing their own projects. With 19 employees creating 10,000+ participation moments a year, we can promise many opportunities to learn and grow!

Your tasks may include helping with workshops, youth meetings, local events, communication, social media, documentation, logistics and community work. You may also support open youth activities in the FACKtory, help young people prepare their own events, contribute to international projects and bring your own ideas into the organisation. The focus is on practical youth participation, intercultural learning, democracy, inclusion, sustainability and solidarity.

projects.title: Long Term volunteering Youth Centre Don Bosco De Takel
projects.description:
Do you want to experience youth work in a different context and country? Do you want to live in the Belgian coast? 
Then, here is your opportunity! The project consists of at least 10 months of volunteering in the Flemish Don Bosco Youth Centre De Takel, in Oostende, Belgium. The aim of youth centre is to create an enjoyable and safe space for youth in the city. Young people between 12 and 25 years enjoy their free time with us and also participate in activities and trips we organise. Everyone is welcome but the main group that joins is youth from disadvantaged neighbourhoods of Oostende, immigrant background, refugees and asylum seekers. This creates a very multicultural environment always full of fun and learning opportunities. The volunteer is expected to participate in daily activities, but also be active- coming up with activities and carrying them out. Furthermore, we have two ongoing projects: about promotion of sports and active lifestyle; and female youth empowerment.

projects.title: Kindergarten Assistant Teacher
projects.description: Based in the Kano Plains of Western Kenya, this placement supports early childhood education in low-income communities. Volunteers work alongside local teachers at Ahero Community Resource Center and nearby private pre-primary schools, helping strengthen children’s physical, cognitive, and emotional development through play-based learning, literacy support, and creative activities. The focus is on capacity building and sharing skills that contribute to sustainable, long-term improvements in education. Volunteers support the daily activities of preschools, daycare centres, and kindergartens, mainly working with children aged 3–6. The centre’s kindergarten serves around 90 children who are affected by poverty, orphanhood, or HIV/AIDS. They receive free education and meals during the day and return home in the evening to their caregivers or guardians.

projects.title: ICT Trainer
projects.description: This innovative project, led by CIVS Kenya in partnership with MONDO, takes place at key resource centers in the Kano Plains region of Kisumu County, specifically Nyakach and Kuth Awendo. These centers serve as vital community development hubs offering ICT training, climate-smart agriculture, early childhood education, and more. Addressing a critical digital skills gap especially among youth and vulnerable children the project aims to boost employability and resilience by enhancing digital literacy. These skills are essential to unlocking new educational and career opportunities in an area facing growing challenges from climate change.

projects.title: Environmental Expert
projects.description: The project, implemented by CIVS Kenya, will be carried out at two Resource Centers located in Nyakach and Kuth Awendo in the Kano Plains of Kisumu County. This region is largely dependent on agriculture as the main source of livelihood, yet it is frequently affected by seasonal flooding, which significantly impacts food security and economic stability. In response to these challenges, the BRIDGE project will place strong emphasis on environmental resilience and sustainability. Volunteers will work with community members to raise awareness on climate change adaptation, promote climate-smart agricultural practices, and lead tree planting campaigns. These activities are aimed at reducing the environmental impact of flooding, restoring degraded land, and improving long-term agricultural productivity. Volunteers will also help organize community workshops and school outreach programs to educate both youth and adults on sustainable land use, soil and water conservation.

projects.title: Smallholder Farmers Support Expert
projects.description: The project promotes economic and environmental sustainability by strengthening farmer incomes, improving food security and nutrition, and increasing resilience to social, economic, and environmental stresses. Volunteers work in resource centres, model farms, and directly with small-scale farmers to support sustainable agriculture, climate adaptation, and income diversification. Activities include soil conservation, reduced pesticide use, soil regeneration, and vertical vegetable gardening as practical responses to food insecurity. The project also strengthens farmers’ digital skills through simple record-keeping, invoicing, and the use of weather forecasting and mobile advisory tools to support better planning and decision-making. In environmental conservation, volunteers support tree planting, nursery management, and seedling distribution with schools, community leaders, and women’s and youth groups, contributing to ecological restoration and stronger local ownership.

projects.title: PROMOTING EUROPEAN VALUES AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT
projects.description:
1. Promoting the school’s European and international engagement
•    Supporting mobility projects 
•    Acting as an ambassador for European values 
•    Communicating and promoting projects
•    Organising intercultural activities 
2. Supporting sustainable development projects and civic engagement
•    Participating in the school’s ESD projects: supporting initiatives to raise awareness of eco-friendly practices; taking part in communication campaigns on: recycling, waste reduction, and the fight against food waste.
•    Developing practical projects: circular economy projects (recycling schemes, giving objects a second life, upcycling); organising eco-citizen challenges within the school; solidarity and collaborative initiatives with local associations; creating a dedicated space or display for sustainable initiatives
•    Awareness-raising and activities: Organising participatory events or workshops; Encouraging pupils’ involvement in civic and environmental projects

projects.title: Ferajna - beyond the classroom
projects.description:
Do you enjoy working with kids, organizing creative projects, or managing social media?
As a volunteer, you will support non-formal education activities in our alternative school, working directly with children and teenagers. This includes helping with language classes and leading workshops on topics such as human rights, ecology, and culture. You will also help create a safe, engaging, and supportive learning environment.
Make sure to fill out the application form to join us:
