projects.title: Volunteer Across Generations 🌟
projects.description:
Looking for a volunteering experience that truly matters? 💛
Join the House of Generations in Kaunas and become part of a unique community where seniors, young mothers, and children share everyday life together.
As a volunteer, you'll organise activities, support daily routines, share your ideas, and build meaningful connections across generations. One day you might be leading games or creative workshops, the next helping someone gain confidence in their daily life.
This experience is about more than volunteering - it's about personal growth, new friendships, and discovering the power of human connection. 🌍🤝

projects.title: Volontariato al Centro Giovanile Echo
projects.description: L'organizzazione d'accoglienza è un centro giovanile il cui target è composto da giovani provenienti da un contesto multiculturale. Bambini e adolescenti vi possono trascorrere il loro tempo libero, partecipando ad attività come giochi, attività al chiuso e all'aperto, sport, laboratori, supporto educativo, lezioni di cucina, feste, seminari, progetti di espressione creativa e altro ancóra. E se hanno domande su temi sensibli che loro interessano, come la scuola, la crescita, l'amore, come risolvere i litigi con gli amici, problemi familiari, soldi o il loro futuro, sanno d'essere nel posto giusto: nell'atmosfera accogliente del centro riceveranno supporto per trovare le risposte e sviluppare le proprie competenze. Quindi, il tuo ruolo in tutto questo è quello di supportare il gruppo di lavoro del centro e la sua attività quotidiana, collaborare nei diversi laboratori e progetti, e realizzare anche iniziative ideate da te. Il tuo impegno sarà nei pomeriggi dal martedì al sabato.

projects.title: Short-term project for eco-activists in the mountains of Bulgaria
projects.description: The Association for Shared Learning ELA is renovating its Green educational centre in the mountain village near Sofia, Bulgaria. After many years of work on various national and European projects, we have focused on creating a Green Education Center in the village of Sturgel in the mountains of Bulgaria, where we can continue to support children in their growth by implementing our programs for non-formal education. For these two months, we need enthusiastic young people who don’t mind living in basic conditions in a village, surrounded by nature, to communicate with the elderly.

projects.title: Always on the move
projects.description: We are currently searching for 1 volunteer for the movement team of the LSB Sportservice Brandenburg gGmbH approved project "Always on the move" in Potsdam. The volunteer will get familiar with the "on the move and health oriented" educational method by supporting the staff in their daily activities. Sport, movement and healthy lifestyle are the key words in the work of the Movement team. The volunteer will help the staff, will communicate with children and lead them to a healthier lifestyle. Main project activities: getting to know Brandenburg´s sports facilities as well as the organisation´s local and regional pre-schools; supporting the implementation of the educational concept "on the move" in the health and sports oriented childcare institutions of LSB SportService; supporting the team by providing children with a sport and healthy oriented lifestyle; supporting the team in the implementation of the annual motoric and eye movement (oculomotor) tests for children.

projects.title: Volontariato con i media e progetti interculturali
projects.description: L'organizzazione d'accoglienza gestisce tre centri giovanili e di accoglienza sociale, il cui target è composto da giovani provenienti da un contesto multiculturale e da migranti. Persone di varia provenienza vi possono trascorrere il loro tempo libero, partecipando ad attività varie, progetti di espressione creativa e altro ancóra. Si vive in un'atmosfera accogliente e nel centro riceveranno supporto per trovare le risposte e sviluppare le proprie competenze. Il tuo ruolo in tutto questo è quello di supportare il gruppo di lavoro del centro e la sua attività quotidiana, collaborare nei diversi laboratori e progetti, e realizzare contenuti multimediali e per i social media. In particolare, sarai chiamato a collaborare per un progetto che vuole dare voce a chi non ce l'ha, lottando contro le discriminazioni e le disuguaglianze, con un contributo sia online che offline. La tua esperienza darà un grande aiuto alla comunità, creando opportunità di integrazione nella comunità locale.

projects.title: AUXILIUM - a special experience of volunteering
projects.description: Auxilium is a social enterprise created in 1984 in Altamura; a Type A cooperative which manages social healthcare services. Auxilium operates in the sector of psychiatric, disability, the elderly, schooling, training and volunteering. The volunteer will take part in the implementation of various rehabilitation activities carried out in 2 different structure, to support educators and users. The volunteer will be initially trained about a correct approach with people with disabilities, working methods, spaces, roles and rules within it. Finally, the volunteer, assisted by an educator, will be involved in the daily life of the Centres, in its relations with users and the realization of activities. The volunteer has to take part in all the activities and to learn from every sector of the structure that is provided for the users. After the first months the volunteer will choose the activities he/she wants to develop more or/and develop a personal project inside the structure

projects.title: Communities on work for social justice
projects.description: This 3-month project will take place in Palermo and focuses on engaging young people in meaningful community work while addressing some of the social challenges present in the city. The project also aims to strengthen participants’ understanding of European values such as solidarity, inclusion and active citizenship.Young volunteers aged 18–30 from different European countries will take part in practical activities that support the local community. Throughout the project, volunteers will collaborate with local organizations working with people who experience social marginalization and limited opportunities.Volunteers will contribute to our work for social and environmental justice and will have the chance to bring their own ideas and creativity into the project. They will support educational and social initiatives for young people, and promote intercultural exchange by sharing their language, culture and experiences.

projects.title: Support Socio-Cultural Space
projects.description:
WE INFORM YOU THAT WE WILL ONLY REVIEW THE PROFILES OF THOSE WHO FILL OUT THIS FORM. THANK YOU! https://forms.gle/5e8BQjbD45f9S63h7 
Casa Kuna is a non-profit organization dedicated to supporting vulnerable people and promoting social inclusion through a social, multicultural, and ecological approach. It offers non-formal training in trades such as sewing, woodworking, marketing, and natural cosmetics to enhance employability. Its initiative “Re-Made in Granada” creates sustainable products through upcycling. Casa Kuna also organizes cultural activities addressing migration, racism, and social exclusion. It manages a sales space focused on circular economy and supports volunteering, engaging over 30 participants last year. Additionally, it promotes intercultural mediation, community dialogue, and provides psycho-social support through individual and group activities.

projects.title: Kids in Action 13 - United in Solidarity
projects.description:
Become a part of an international team working with children and young people in Škofja Loka. Through creativity, learning, sports, cultural exchange, and community activities, you will help create a positive and inspiring environment where young people can grow, learn, and have fun.
We are looking for 4 volunteers who can choose between volunteering in 4 vacancies: 
- Daily youth center Blok
- Project learning for young adults (PUM-O+)
- Primary school
- Youth Institute of Škofja Loka
In general, you will help mentors with everyday tasks, prepare and lead workshops and activities for different groups, help with creating a monthly programme, and support organisations' users in their free time. Specific tasks at the Youth Institute include hands-on repairs, technical assistance at events, organisation and production of events and creating visual content and promotion. 
More info here: https://familija.eu/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Infopack_2026-_predcasni-s.pdf

projects.title: Communication Officer - Fair Fashion Fest
projects.description:
Gent Fair Trade is a partnership between the City of Ghent and Oxfam Worldshops in Gent. The City of Ghent and Oxfam Wereldwinkel Gent-Centrum are putting fair trade on the map, together with a broad group of partners.
We promote Fair Trade practices and a sustainable lifestyle toward the inhabitants of Ghent, people who visit, shop, work, study... (in) the city, support entrepreneurs that sell ethical products and promote fair trade in general. 

The focus of this position is on content creation, campaigning and networking.

Check the position descrition here: https://gentfairtrade.be/esc-vacancies-2026-2027

projects.title: Growth in Motion
projects.description: As part of this project, volunteers will be actively involved in organising and delivering non-formal educational activities for children and young people in placement centres, primary schools, and kindergartens located in disadvantaged areas of Reșița. Through workshops, games, creative activities, and intercultural learning experiences, volunteers will support participants in developing essential life skills, building self-confidence, enhancing creativity, and discovering new interests. The project aims to encourage active participation, inclusion, tolerance, and mutual respect while creating a positive environment where children and young people feel supported and motivated to learn and grow. During the summer, volunteers will also coordinate and work alongside short-term volunteers, helping to plan activities, facilitate teamwork, and ensure a meaningful learning experience for everyone involved.

projects.title: Let's volunteer in Vir'Volt
projects.description: Solidarités Jeunesses (SJ) is a national movement of non-formal education and is composed of a National Secretary (Paris), and eight regional delegations across France. Our delegations host international volunteers throughout the year. Each regional delegation is unique, but all of the activities organized benefit the local community and share common ground: - gather people from different culture and social background to participate in social, ecological and cultural development. - contribute to the integration of people with fewer opportunities. Each project is dedicated to actions of solidarity and collective living. We believe that cultural exchanges are a key for personal learning and for the volunteer to experiment and undergo personal development.

projects.title: [La Rochelle] Solidarité avec nos Séniors / Solidarity with our elders
projects.description: Solidarité Seniors is a program that responds to the challenge of « aging well ». In to 2 teams of 8 (4 French and 4 Europeans in each team, you will be in pairs, 1 French and 1 European). Each team will have to carry out the following activities: One team: Visit isolated elderly people, having previously prepared these visits, which will be carried out in pairs (1 French and 1 European) / Organize and set up group activities for older people, develop a relationship of trust with eldery people, The other team: Act with structures (retirement home, library) to participate in the animation of the place through play (tablets and set up health e-sport games on console switch), and organize 2 competitions in the year, develop a relationship of trust with elderly people, and also visit isolated seniors at home, In addition, the volunteers will implement intercultural actions within the housing residence. Joint mission: Organization of intercultural evening in your home.

projects.title: Let's volunteer in Citrus !
projects.description: Solidarités Jeunesses (SJ) is a national movement of non-formal education and is composed of a National Secretary (Paris), and eight regional delegations across France. Our delegations host international volunteers throughout the year. All of the activities organized benefit the local community and share common ground: - gather people from different culture and social background to participate in social, ecological and cultural development. - contribute to the integration of people with fewer opportunities. Each project is dedicated to actions of solidarity and collective living. We believe that cultural exchanges are a key for personal learning and for the volunteer to experiment and undergo personal development. You will find all the information about our available projects and application process in this page : https://www.solidaritesjeunesses.org/volunteeringinfrance

projects.title: Let's volunteer in Sem&Vol !
projects.description:
Solidarités Jeunesses (SJ) is a national movement of non-formal education and is composed of a National Secretary based in Paris, and eight regional delegations across France. Our delegations host volunteers from France and all over the world throughout the year. Each regional delegation is unique, but all of the activities organized benefit the local community and share common ground: 
- to gather people from different culture and social background to participate in social, ecological and cultural development on the local level . 
- To contribute to the integration of people with fewer opportunities. 
Each project is dedicated to actions of solidarity and collective living. We believe that cultural exchanges are a key for personal Learning and offers to the volunteer a valuable opportunity to learn, to experiment and to undergo personal development.

projects.title: Digitisation and ethical communication
projects.description:
The call for volunteers is fully described in the following link: https://sci-italia.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Call-Com-ESC-2026.docx.pdf

We recommend you to read carefully the activities and to describe your motivation and interested based on this call

projects.title: Volunteering in Sicily in a housing community for at-risk boys and children
projects.description: Istituto Walden is a social cooperative that manages different houses and services for minors located in the island of Sicily. They are looking for ESC volunteers to support the educators in a shelter for young boys (13-18 years old) and children (0-10 years old) who are on a path towards rehabilitation and social inclusion. The youngsters live together in the shelter as a community and the volunteers will share part of their daily life. Tasks: - Support youngsters’ and childrens' education with afterschool activities (homework support, lessons of foreign language, educational workshops) - Create fun and engaging workshops: cooking, theatre, music... - Language exchange - Organize celebrations for special occasions/festivities - Manage the daily life in the community: prepare meals to share with everyone, keep the space clean and welcoming, help the residents with their everyday needs - Discover the town and surrounding area accompanying the youngsters on trips.

projects.title: CRECER - Supporting Tránsito Amaguaña School and communities in Quito
projects.description:
Volunteers will support activities at Tránsito Amaguaña School, in Mercade Mayorista in Quito. Tasks include:
-Educational and classroom support, daily tutoring and learning reinforcement to children at the school, supporting teachers during lessons, assisting children with reading, writing, and basic math, preparing simple educational materials, and helping with small group or one-on-one activities. 
-SkillBoost workshops: Every three months, you help facilitate a workshop on topics like peace, digital literacy, innovation or higher education. 
-Youth circles: You will assist in organizing and facilitating peer group sessions focused on emotional well-being, identity and shared challenges. Tasks may include preparing discussion topics, guiding group dynamics, encouraging participation and creating a safe and respectful space for open dialogue.
-Community outreach: Participate in and support the organization of activities involving parents, educators and local community members.

projects.title: CRECER - Supporting schools and communities in Nuevo Chimbote
projects.description: Volunteers will collaborate in vulnerable communities in District of Nuevo Chimbote, in Ancash region in Peru. Under the management of the Brigada de Voluntarios Bolivarianos del Perú, project volunteers work directly with communities of 3 de Octubre and Primero de Mayo. They will work alongside educators, families, and local youth volunteers to create learning spaces based on mutual respect. Activities will be developed in partnership with the educational institutions Fe y Alegría N° 14 and César Vallejo. Volunteers will provide academic reinforcement in reading, writing and mathematics and support in Physical Education and Art classes. Through SkillsBoost methodology, focused on non-formal education, they will lead emotional well-being workshops to help young people identify their feelings, as well as social theater activities, collective murals, and creative reading clubs. Core component of the project is youth empowerment and leadership collaborating with the community.

projects.title: Youth centres for young people - Oradea Youth House
projects.description: Embark on a transformative journey, where you use your skills in organizing activities that resonate with the needs of young people, while highlighting your personal strengths. Our main focus is on impacting the local youth aged 14 to 35. At the same time, we place a strong emphasis on your development as a volunteer. Every event and initiative offers you the opportunity to engage, learn, and grow through practical experiences. Main activity areas include: Facilitation: Prepare and deliver events/workshops/activities, evaluate & report them. Media and Promotion: Take photos and videos, write articles, create content for online promotion. Events Logistics: Help prepare spaces, set up equipment, make lists of materials, maintain activity spaces Outreach Actions: Distribute flyers, organize flash mobs and awareness campaigns. Further details in the info pack: https://canva.link/ckq3yd0uu8t3bts  !!! THE ONLY WAY TO APPLY IS THROUGH THE PORTAL !!!

projects.title: Piece of My Heart Vol. 8
projects.description: Piece of My Heart 8.0 is an ESC volunteering project of Association Co-Efficient in Budapest. It is based in the EKH Community House, an inclusive and accessible space where young people with and without disabilities can meet, learn and participate together. Volunteers help organise local clubs, workshops, school activities, youth exchanges and community events. They also support young people with disabilities through personal assistance, accompaniment, mobility support and inclusive social activities. The project exists because many young people still face social, physical and communication barriers that limit their participation in community life. By using non-formal education, solidarity and everyday cooperation, the project creates safer, more welcoming spaces and helps build a society that adapts to diverse needs instead of excluding people.

projects.title: Outreach and Communications Volunteer at EuroClio
projects.description:
You will join EuroClio (European Association of History Educators) to support communications and outreach efforts that strengthen history, heritage, and citizenship education across Europe. Your tasks will include:

- Content Creation: Develop creative content and social media campaigns to help EuroClio reach wider audiences. Create videos, Reels, interviews, behind-the-scenes content, and other multimedia materials. Support the implementation of communication campaigns for projects and events, including social media planning and audience outreach.
- Research & Writing: Produce engaging articles on history, history education, and citizenship education through research, interviews, writing, editing, and fact-checking.
- Podcast: Support the development of EuroClio’s 2 podcasts, through research, guest outreach, content preparation, recording, editing, and promotion.
- Newsletter: Contribute to the preparation and publication of EuroClio’s monthly newsletter.

projects.title: International Youth Work Camp
projects.description: The International Youth Work Camp is a project hosted by International Forum of Solidarity EMMAUS and the activity that brings together young people from different European countries for 14 days in Srebrenica and Doboj, Bosnia and Herzegovina. During the camp, the young people will participate in various volunteering and community support actions, as well as intercultural learning and group activities. Volunteers will also have the opportunity to take part in “Camp Olympics” and the Silver Frame Film Festival on the 16th and 18th of July. This ESC Team project aims to promote solidarity, intercultural dialogue, teamwork, and active participation of young people through volunteering and shared activities.  |  Infopack available here: https://l1nk.dev/fs2qvv2  |   Applications will be considered valid only if this form is completed: https://l1nk.dev/2o2jenm

projects.title: Become a Spanish volunteer for the City of Angers! - VEIA project
projects.description:
We are looking for a SPANISH volunteer to promote Spanish culture in Angers and to support the city in its partnership with Valencia. The selected Spanish volunteer will work at the city hall and live in a shared apartment with the ambassadors from Austin and Osnabrück. Here are some examples of tasks: - Promoting Spanish culture with workshops for children 
-Assisting the exchange of exhibitions 
-Facilitating connections and partnerships with Valencia 
-Helping with cinema exchanges -translation, communication...
-Participating in city events MORE INFO : https://www.angers.fr/l-action-municipale/relations-internationales/index.html 

VEIA is a project created by the Parcours le Monde that brings together 25 ESC volunteers and aims to promote intercultural understanding, mobility, European values, and diversity throughout the Pays de la Loire region, targeting young French people directly.

projects.title: Management of a Volunteer House
projects.description:
We are looking for a proactive volunteer to manage our volunteer house, "Casa Jazmín", in Sanet i els Negrals, Alicante. You will welcome and support different volunteer groups (teens/adults) arriving every 12 days, making them feel at home. As part of De Amicitia, you will assist camp leaders with logistics, shopping, space organization, car maintenance, activities, cooking, and cleaning. Taking care of the house plants and our lovely cat, Bartolomeo, is also part of the daily life! Initiative and a hands-on attitude are essential.

Requirements:

European driving license (Type B) and experience driving manual cars is mandatory for logistics and shopping.

High motivation and adaptability.

Proactivity and willingness to help in all daily tasks.

Two days off per week to rest and explore the area. The beach is 20 min away; the small village has a pool. Valencia and Alicante are 1 hour away.
 Join our team and experience NGO management from the inside!

projects.title: Researcher for the Network of Concerned Historians at EuroClio
projects.description:
You will join the Network of Concerned Historians (at EuroClio) to campaign for the protection of historical freedom, ethical research, and the documentation of censorship worldwide. This is a unique chance to gain hands-on experience in an interdisciplinary field that combines history, human rights advocacy, journalism, and digital archiving. You will participate in two core activities:

- Compiling information about censorship of history (e.g. unlawful education curricula revisions; unlawful restriction of archival access) and persecution of bona fide history producers (including murder, arrest, dismissal, travel bans, etc.);
- Constructing an archive of global censorship of history since Ancient times, including a memorial for killed historians, a database of history-related legal cases and professional codes of ethics.

For this volunteer activity, you will research censorship of history and the persecution of historians worldwide and document cases for the NCH Annual Report.

projects.title: CONCF-23701-ESC - Rock'n'wall
projects.description:
Welcome to Aubigne Racan, a small but dynamic village in the middle of the Loire Valley! Come and take part in the wall renovation to continue the work that was started by a first group of volunteers. 
For a dozen years now the mayor and the villagers are very enthusiastic to welcome international groups. For this year’s work, you will learn how to rebuild the wall, supported by professionals in masonry, including a Compagnon du Devoir, the prestigious craftsmanship school.
If you wish to learn professional masonry techniques in a joyful and international atmosphere, this project is for you!

projects.title: Bring your projects to life with students at Coëtlogon High School
projects.description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic volunteer who would like to share their experiences, knowledge, and interests with our students through various projects.
At Coëtlogon Vocational High School, you will have the opportunity to:
•	Join and observe lessons
•	Organize your own workshops and projects in your classroom (language games, exhibitions, quizzes, presentations, tasting sessions, discussions/debates, etc.)
•	Present your country and culture
•	Promote the student mobility program and support students who are interested throughout the process
•	Join excursions and school field trips
•	Participate in projects related to international topics and Erasmus+ initiatives
•	Participate in a collective project with other volunteers

projects.title: Youth Bridge
projects.description: Are you ready to make a difference, grow personally, and explore Turkish culture? Engage with local students by sharing your experiences, inspiring them, and supporting educational activities, or dive into the world of media in our media center. Which is perfect for those who want to develop skills in content creation, video editing, photography, and digital storytelling. We also have a large professional TV studio and radio stations where volunteers can demonstrate their abilities in broadcasting, audio production. Volunteers can enjoy our sports and arts facilities, including a gym, swimming pool, basketball court, and art courses in guitar, piano, violin, and bağlama. In addition, volunteers take part in the distribution of humanitarian aid to disadvantaged groups, provide psychosocial support to refugees and earthquake victims, and participate in environmental activities in our forest area, where we work together on tree planting, maintenance, and protecting nature.

projects.title: Individual Volunteering in digital FabLab
projects.description: The 'FabLab Fougères Agglomération' is located next to the main square of the city, close to restaurants, shops, and services. As the FabLab has recently moved locations, the links with the stores in the area have yet to be made, and you will have the opportunity to be part of this new space getting established. Built around the idea of creating a collaborative and creative space focused on digital fabrication, the FabLab is free and open to everyone to realize their projects, develop their skills and knowledge of technology, repair, recycle, and more. Events and workshops are also organised on a regular basis. In addition to that, local businesses and artists can reserve the space and benefit from our support and technical know-how.

projects.title: Together We're Better
projects.description: Are you ready to make a difference, grow personally, and explore Turkish culture? Engage with local students by sharing your experiences, inspiring them, and supporting educational activities, or dive into the world of media in our media center. Which is perfect for those who want to develop skills in content creation, video editing, photography, and digital storytelling. We also have a large professional TV studio and radio stations where volunteers can demonstrate their abilities in broadcasting, audio production. Volunteers can enjoy our sports and arts facilities, including a gym, swimming pool, basketball court, and art courses in guitar, piano, violin, and bağlama. In addition, volunteers take part in the distribution of humanitarian aid to disadvantaged groups, provide psychosocial support to refugees and earthquake victims, and participate in environmental activities in our forest area, where we work together on tree planting, maintenance, and protecting nature.

projects.title: Internationalization & Digital Communication at VET School (Zaragoza, Spain) ¡CONTAMOS CONTIGO!
projects.description:
The CPIFP Corona de Aragón seeks volunteers for its Internationalization & Digital Communication team to boost outreach and Erasmus+ mobilities.
Tasks include:
- Language Training: Leading small-group conversation classes, creating cultural workshops, providing pre-mobility preparation for European internships, and guiding incoming foreign students. 
- Digital Communication: Producing dynamic multimedia content to showcase European initiatives, managing social media, and utilizing Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to design bilingual educational resources.
*** Please fill out our application form to help us get to know you better. ***Copy and paste the following link into your browser to apply: https://forms.gle/paQoMaAMs9ZXFXVr8

projects.title: Inclusive Education for Every Child: ESC Volunteering at Vivere School in Tallinn, Estonia
projects.description: At Vivere School, we believe that every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive in an environment where diversity is valued and everyone feels included. As a volunteer, you will become part of a dedicated team working to support children with diverse learning needs in an inclusive educational setting. Through everyday interactions, creative activities, and non-formal learning methods, you will help create meaningful learning experiences while promoting understanding, empathy, and equal opportunities. This project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a more inclusive society, gain valuable experience in education and social inclusion, and make a lasting positive impact on the lives of young people. MORE INFO & HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/vivere-school-inclusive-education/

projects.title: Volunteer in Alternative Education / Volontaire Education Alternative
projects.description: The Agile School (www.ecole-agile66.com) offers an alternative and engaging learning environment based on trust. We are a social and solidarity association where children learn at their own pace, developing their individual talents and skills. The volunteer is free to participate in the democratic school life, for example: - organise workshops based on their interests and skills (for example: sport, IT, geography, languages…) - help children, aged 6 to 19, with individual learning - resolve conflicts through mediations - take part in the vegetable permaculture garden - set up projects and organise excursions. If you are interested in applying, please fill in the following form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScP4tskaH6gZ6mIyQiaT6YTwwy7fIDMi-emwYOMJellYeU-Pw/viewform

projects.title: Beyond the Feed
projects.description:
Beyond the Feed is a long-term ESC volunteering project hosted by MC Idrija, where two international volunteers will become part of a dynamic youth organisation and contribute to everyday youth work.
MC Idrija is a youth centre working locally and internationally through projects, school collaborations, youth exchanges, mobile youth work, workshops, events, and support for young people.
As a volunteer, you will be fully included in this environment and encouraged to explore different areas of youth work based on your interests, skills, and ideas.
The project offers a flexible and supportive space to learn, try new things, and co-create activities with our team.
You may also help share MC Idrija’s activities with the wider community through creative social media storytelling (such as videos, photos, reels, or posts), giving visibility to the work we do with young people. This is one of several ways you can contribute, alongside many other opportunities within youth work.

projects.title: Volunteering in Athens
projects.description: Through the project, part of the European Solidarity Corps, the volunteer, will participate actively in the actions of the facilities of IASIS NGO.The main goal is to learn how to develop and deliver non-formal learning activities for youth and people with mental disabilities, create an intervention to the local community, combat social exclusion of vulnerable groups, create equal opportunities and fresh perspectives for vulnerable groups of the population, and to promote mental health.

projects.title: Feel the Forest 2026
projects.description: We are an outdoor education youth center and we offer for July-August, a three week long volunteering opportunity for those who don't currently work or study. For example if you didn't manage to get into the studies for this autumn, no problem, this is a perfect opportunity to start with ESC volunteering, maybe you will later on find a longer project as well! In this project the volunteers work daily with tasks related to preserving and creating new outdoor spaces in the forest which are used in our educational programs. Some tasks can be indoors as well, especially when rainy weather. More detailed tasks will be shared day by day. Best is to join the project with a curious mind and a good attitude, and flexibility to work together. Volunteers work never alone, always with a work leader and each other. The idea is to develop group working skills, communication skills, all kind of useful skills for future working life and studies! No previous experience needed!

projects.title: Local heritage, events and activities at the Villandraut Castle
projects.description: We are seeking volunteers for a variety of work projects, ranging from carpentry to timber framing. The experience will be punctuated by an event in our community: a concert inside the medieval castle, to which we warmly invite volunteers to take an active part in both participation and organization. If you enjoy castles, communal living, music, and the countryside (Villandraut is a small village!), then we would be delighted to have you join us!

projects.title: Leisure, sport & daily care activities at LaFACT FUPAR Adults w/ disabilities
projects.description:
The HOSTING ORGANIZATION, LaFACT FUPAR is a private, non-profit social entity that provides care to more than 330 people with disabilities. The Leisure Service of the LaFACT Foundation, as well as the Occupational Center, organizes and encourages the participation of people with intellectual disabilities in socio-educational and sports activities.. We are looking for 5 ESC volunteers to support the Leisure and Sports department and the Occupational Center daily activities to improve the autonomy of adults with mental disabilities. 

In relation to the tasks of the volunteers, we expect that they will actively participate in the activities and that will proactively propose new dynamics in the implementation of the activities. The main function will be offering accompaniment and social support, establishing a significant link with the person with disability.

The coordinating organization, La Víbria Intercultural is the one that will contact you for the selection process.

projects.title: Leisure & Occupation activities at Jeroni (adults w/ disabilities)
projects.description:
The HOSTING ORGANIZATION, Center Jeroni de Moragas SCCL, is a nonprofit social cooperative of professionals, with a 45 years trajectory. We care for more than 100 people in Sant Cugat del Vallès. Our goal is to present services oriented to social and labor inclusion of adult people with functional and intellectual diversity, mental illness and autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The team is a group of professionals made by psychologists, social workers, social educators, occupational therapist and social integrators; who are in charge of the planification and implementation of the therapeutical, occupational and pre-labour activities, with the aim to improve the quality of life of the people that we care for. We are looking for 2 ESC volunteers that will support the direct attention team of the Occupational Center. The main task is to be and create a significant link with the people!

The coordinating organization, La Víbria Intercultural will contact you for the selection process.

projects.title: Leisure, Sports & Social Inclusion at Prodis (Adults w/ disabilities)
projects.description:
The HOSTING ORGANIZATION, Prodis is a non-profit social entity that works for and with adults with intellectual disabilities, cerebral palsy, mental disorder in Terrassa and its natural environment. We offer work services, in a protected environment, occupational therapy services, occupational insertion services, housing services, sports and leisure. The volunteer will support Prodis in daily activities, most of them the sports ones. The volunteers will help in the Occupational Center with the daily activities (dinner, arts and craft, memory activities, etc) and the Sport Club, where they will be able to give support  in the following activities: zumba, basketball, swimming pool, adapted sports, athletics, hockey or soccer. The main task is to be and create a significant link with the people!

The coordinating organization, La Víbria Intercultural is the one that will contact you for the selection process.

projects.title: ESC-ELLENCE Vol. II Inside the Experience
projects.description:
The hosting project foresees the hosting of 3 European volunteers, who will be involved in one of the following areas. Each of the operational areas gathers 2 or more services characterized by a common macro objective:
- Inclusion & Care: volunteers will work in the daily centers for people with disabilities
- Youth & Active participation: volunteers will work in Youth Centers developing informal or non-formal tools. The daily tasks include participation in the promotion of EU projects, mobility and orientation
- Educational services: after-school centers offer to kids a wide range of activities designed to engage children in productive and fun ways once the school day ends.
- Migration & International cooperation: opportunity to work in the migration and refugee centers and participate in preparing and managing regional or international projects.

Applications are accepted only through the European Youth Portal. Email applications will not be considered.

projects.title: Voluntary project with elderly people (near Strasbourg)
projects.description:
The volunteer will work with elderly people in a retirement home in Bischwiller (close to Strasbourg): 

- Create and take part in activities (music, creative workshops, games, themed evenings, movie nights, DIY, gymnastics etc.)
- Go along with residents on outings (going to cultural activites outside, going on strolls, but also going to the hairdresser or to other appointments)
- Provide some time for discussion, newspaper reading and to increase their social life

The volunteer can suggest projects according to their interests

projects.title: Promoting international solidarity, cultural diversity & european mobility among a young public in LE RHEU high scool
projects.description:
The volunteer's mission will consist : 
Raise students’ awareness of international solidarity and cultural diversity.
Take part in organising festivals and events.
Encourage young people to open themselves up to the international community.
Contribute to the preparation and organisation of the International Solidarity Week.
Raise awareness among students about European mobility opportunities and support young people in developing their mobility projects, particularly within the framework of our school accreditation and ECHE Charter.

projects.title: Volunteering in Sicily in a housing community for at-risk boys and children
projects.description: Istituto Walden is a social cooperative that manages different houses and services for minors located in the island of Sicily. They are looking for ESC volunteers to support the educators in a shelter for young boys (13-18 years old) and children (0-10 years old) who are on a path towards rehabilitation and social inclusion. The youngsters live together in the shelter as a community and the volunteers will share part of their daily life. Tasks: - Support youngsters’ and childrens' education with afterschool activities (homework support, lessons of foreign language, educational workshops) - Create fun and engaging workshops: cooking, theatre, music... - Language exchange - Organize celebrations for special occasions/festivities - Manage the daily life in the community: prepare meals to share with everyone, keep the space clean and welcoming, help the residents with their everyday needs - Discover the town and surrounding area accompanying the youngsters on trips.

projects.title: No Eido: Permaculture project for the creation of an edible forest
projects.description: We seek to revitalize the forest through the creation of an edible forest with the participation of citizens, to encourage sustainable forest management and effective and environmentally friendly food production. We seek to turn the forest into a place for citizens to spend their leisure time, with environmental education activities and the promotion of natural and cultural heritage. The project aims to provide the community with an edible forest to promote local and ecological production, as well as to empower citizens in self-cultivation and responsible consumption, and, finally, as well as promoting the consumption of harvest products. Volunteers can also collaborate with the rest of the environmental education activities that we promote.

projects.title: Project Management Specialist – Migration and Humanitarian Programs in Costa Rica
projects.description:
Servicio Jesuita para Migrantes Costa Rica (SJM-CR), which supports migrant populations arriving in Costa Rica is seeking support in project management, social and policy advocacy, and training for migrants and refugee population. Main responsibilities: 
- Management and monitoring: support in designing a MEAL system, reviewing logical frameworks, theories of change, operational plans, and drafting project proposals.
- Resource mobilization: mapping donors, cooperation agencies, and strategic partners to ensure sustainability.
- Policy advocacy: developing technical materials (briefs, infographics, position papers) and supporting dialogue with various key stakeholders.
- Training and innovation: facilitating workshops focused on DESCA rights and the use of artificial intelligence tools applied to projects implemented by civil society organisations. 
Commitment: 40 hours per week. Work primarily in San José, with the option of 1 day of remote work per internal policy.

projects.title: Promoting socio-cultural activities and sport in a center for asylum seekers
projects.description:
 APPLY HERE BY FILLING THE APPLICATION FORM: https://forms.gle/TpUyXb4R6AK3wFTD7  YOU WILL FIND MORE INFO ON THE MISSION HERE : https://urlr.me/AMzxuk

projects.title: Families animation in a social association
projects.description: The Courteline association develops activities and services around three axes: social action, educational action and cultural action. The volunteer will be integrated into the family animation team. As such the volunteer will participate into parent-child entertainment during school vacation periods (creative workshops, cooking, music, cultural discoveries...). He will take part in recreational outings (cinema, walks, sport activities...), in family outing (3 outings per year in leisure parks, cultural visits...), and in school support for children. The volunteer will also help to run workshops on gender equality and the fight against all forms of discrimination. He/she will also be involved in running the child and parent drop-in centre, which helps to socialise very young children, and the local library. Artistic skills and an awareness of gender equality would be a plus for this role. He/she will work with a French volunteer, from Monday to Friday, sometimes on week-end or evening.

projects.title: Community Empowerment and Local Rights Advocacy near Lima, Peru
projects.description:
Mano A Mano is a Peruvian NGO enhancing life in Lima's vulnerable neighborhoods. With 80% of staff and beneficiaries from the local community, this mission focuses on empowerment and internal growth. The volunteer will balance administrative structuring with capacity building to help the NGO reach higher standards. 
The volunteer will perform the following activities:
· Lead capacity-building workshops for staff and community on non-discrimination, gender equality, transparency, and security protocols.
· Structure the administrative committee and synthesize internal management and governance documents.
· Conduct rights advocacy and awareness-raising within the neighborhood regarding vulnerable communities' rights.
· Support community initiatives like organizing Useful Holidays for 150 children, eco-fairs, or retaining wall construction.
Through these actions, the volunteer will strengthen community resilience while ensuring long-term sustainability.

projects.title: MOMENTUM
projects.description:
MOMENTUM is a European Solidarity Corps (ESC) Volunteering  project implemented by Voluntariat Pentru Viață Association in Mărășești, Romania.The project aims to support youth development through non-formal learning, community engagement, and meaningful volunteering experiences. Momentum provides young people with a safe and inspiring environment where learning takes place through action, participation, and real human connections.Many small communities face challenges such as limited opportunities for young people, social isolation among vulnerable groups, and reduced access to non-formal education. Through their involvement, volunteers become active contributors to positive change while developing valuable personal, social, and professional competences.
Volunteers participate in educational activities in primary, secondary, and high schools, creative workshops with children, community initiatives, environmental awareness campaigns, intercultural activities.

projects.title: The Community Crew: Build, Share, Grow Fall 2026
projects.description: Park Istra will host up to 16 volunteers for the 'Solidarity in Primorska' project, starting on February 14, 2024, for a duration of two months. Volunteers will engage in a range of meaningful activities, such as helping people in need with renovation work, supporting local communities and NGOs, assisting farmers, and working with children and elderly care homes. If you're looking to make a positive impact, develop new skills, and work alongside volunteers from across Europe, our volunteer center offers a unique opportunity. In 2021, this project was honored with a nomination as one of Europe’s top five volunteering projects by the Salto Awards. Please apply online through EU youth portal and fill in application form on this link: https://forms.gle/rbeT5E5weLXisPJR7

projects.title: Communications, Project Management, and Innovation Specialist for Humanitarian Action and Migrant Rights in Costa Rica
projects.description:
Servicio Jesuita para Migrantes Costa Rica (SJM-CR), which supports migrant populations arriving in Costa Rica is seeking support in project management, social and policy advocacy, and training for migrants and refugee population. Main responsibilities: 
- Activities in communication, social media management, and other public outreach channels.
- Management and monitoring: support in designing a MEAL system, reviewing logical frameworks, theories of change, operational plans, and drafting project proposals.
- Policy advocacy: developing technical materials (briefs, infographics, position papers) and supporting dialogue with various key stakeholders.
- Training and innovation: facilitating workshops focused on DESCA rights and the use of artificial intelligence tools applied to projects implemented by civil society organisations. 
Commitment: 40 hours per week. Work primarily in San José, with the option of 1 day of remote work per internal policy.

projects.title: Support Youth in a Community Special Needs Centre
projects.description: Uganda Pioneers Association (UPA) is a community-based development organization established since 1989 in Uganda dedicated to the promotion of community-based development, intercultural dialogue, and youth participation. The center in which the volunteer will be based is committed to unlocking the potential of children with disabilities by providing them and their families with opportunities for better access to quality healthcare, education, and sustainable livelihoods. Volunteers will support children and young people with disabilities through activities such as therapy support, educational and vocational training, community outreach, parent support programmes, production of low-cost assistive devices, and the organisation of sports, recreational, and creative activities.

projects.title: Volunteering in a bilingual french/ italian elementary school in Briançon
projects.description:
The elementary school of Forville is a Bilingual School French/italian.
The particularity is that, half of teaching time in italian and half in french.
The volunteer will come to promote multiculturalism by learning a foreign language, respect of the nature and other human beings.

You will take part in the school daily life by organising activities for the children. As activities that you could set up, during your mission,
mostly cultural and ecological workshops. You could also be invited by the volunteer hosted in the highschool of Briançon to create common activities.

30 hours per week
From monday until friday
Holidays must be taken during the school holidays

projects.title: Volunteering opportunity for a Steiner-Waldorf primary school Ireland
projects.description: We have volunteering opportunities at our school, a Steiner-Waldorf school in County Kilkenny, rural Ireland. The ages of the children are 4 - 12 years. You will be a volunteer classroom assistant. One position is to primarily assist with a child with special needs, the other/s to assist in various classes and age groups, as required. You will volunteer under the guidance and mentorship of the class teacher. Depending on the position, daily tasks are set out at the beginning of the week and can include helping clean the classroom, as well as possibilities for self-development and creativity. You will become part of our school community. Experience with children is essential, as well as being able to communicate in English. Studies in teaching, and exposure to Steiner-Waldorf education are not essential but a bonus in selection. Positions are for one full school year (August 2026 to June 2026)

projects.title: CONCF-23503-ESC - BALLS AND WALLS
projects.description: Come and experience an exhilarating adventure by participating in a workcamp in the heart of Brittany! The town of Merleac welcomes you to its first international workcamp and needs your help to renovate the perimeter wall of its petanque court! You will work on rebuilding this structure, originally built during the time of the presbytery and now collapsed. This will be an opportunity for you to learn traditional masonry techniques, as well as to make unforgettable connections with young people from all over the world and warm-hearted locals who will welcome you with open arms.

projects.title: “Learning is FUN” | 6 months opportunity in Faenza, Italy 🇮🇹
projects.description:
Learning is FUN! 🌟
Join us for 6 months of volunteering in Faenza, Italy, with PiGreco - SEMI di Intercultura APS! You’ll support non-formal education through workshops, summer camps, and after-school activities, while promoting European opportunities for youth in the local community. Be part of a dynamic team, make an impact, and grow personally and professionally!
More info -  https://www.canva.com/design/DAHLs2LI7H0/h79fBhKUsJA4u11TYoEk2w/view?utm_content=DAHLs2LI7H0&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=uniquelinks&utlId=h72dc13ce16
