projects.title: Join the Rietavas Open Youth Center Team as an ESC Volunteer in Lithuania!
projects.description: Rietavas Open Youth Center is looking for motivated international volunteers (aged 18–30) ready to make a tangible impact while developing their own personal and professional skills. In this role, you won't follow a rigid routine; instead, you will co-design your daily schedule upon arrival, focusing on youth leisure, health, culture, and communication. Your main tasks will include launching your own initiatives—such as workshops, language classes, or arts and sports events—and supporting youth workers with daily activities, tournaments, celebrations, and camps. Additionally, you will become our digital storyteller by creating videos and other social media content to promote the center, alongside visiting local high schools to inspire students about European volunteering opportunities. More information you can find here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ct7X9xTsGFLfHYCfHS6uTM66Crcz-GJ9/view?usp=sharing

projects.title: Supporting Inclusive Living and Youth Work in Rural Georgia
projects.description: Join TEMI Charitable Union in rural Georgia for a volunteering experience. Live and work in an inclusive community supporting people with disabilities, young people, and vulnerable groups. Contribute to educational activities, daily community life, and social inclusion, while also engaging in sustainable practices such as organic farming, eco-tourism, and winemaking. Volunteers support the development of Peace Camp Gremi, helping organise youth exchanges, workshops, and intercultural learning activities. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in youth work, sustainability, and community living, while developing personal, social, and intercultural competencies in a diverse international environment.

projects.title: Have you ever tried living differently?
projects.description: ⋆˚✿˖° To be eligible, please fill out our Application Form through Google: https://bit.ly/4vrTofQ ⋆˚✿˖°For six weeks, participants become part of a small international community shaped by nature, seasonality and collective responsibility. At Cold-hill Shelter, nature becomes part of your daily environment. You wake up with it. Work in it. Rest in it. Pay attention to it. You begin noticing things that often disappear behind screens and schedules: the rhythm of your own energy. Some days you will work outdoors, help improve community spaces. Other days you'll cook together, learn new practical skills or participate in workshops and discussions. Some evenings will be spent around a fire. Others under the stars. Life at Cold-hill Shelter follows a different rhythm than most of us are used to. The weather matters. The seasons matter and the people around you matter.

projects.title: I know how, empower the group, and heal the Earth, (duration 4 months - 15 weeks) between April and July 2027
projects.description: Welcome to Vegetarium community! To live and grow together in this wild area of the Balkan Mountains: enhancing biodiversity, social unity, and personal growth! Master permaculture, discover other eco-projects in Bulgaria, and share authentic lifestyle! During your stay we will be focused on: -Self-improvement, family, and community life: healthy daily routine, morning trainings, sharing circle, healthy nutrition, teamwork. - Autonomy, climate resilience and crisis preparedness. -Helping family and eco projects. - Developing green skills: handling different tools, grow food sustainably, renovate and build a home, organise an eco-friendly householding, balance between nature, local community, markets, and institutions. - Regenerative ecology and agriculture: ability of local creation of living environments that are sustainably productive under changing conditions. - Facing climate change. Welcome to Vegetarium Community Home! Please, read: http://vegetarium.info/our-rules/

projects.title: Become a Short-Term ESC Volunteer for 2 Months!
projects.description: Are you ready for an unforgettable 2-month volunteering adventure? ✨ Within the scope of this program, you will take part in activities related to sports, arts, education, environment, healthy lifestyles, and disaster awareness. You will gain new skills, meet people from different cultures, and have the opportunity to contribute to the community while developing yourself personally and professionally. To learn more about our activities, don’t forget to visit our website and follow us on social media: 🌐 sorged.org 📸 @sorged Come and be part of this unique volunteering experience. We are waiting for you! 💙

projects.title: VOLUNTEERING IN THE CAMPHILL MOVEMENT SOCIAL THERAPY VILLAGE IN LATVIA
projects.description: The participant, as a volunteer, is involved in the daily life and work of Camphill Rožkalni, carrying out various indoor and outdoor tasks within the premises of the organisation. These include activities in specialised workshops: dairy farming, gardening, papermaking, herbal tea and spice preparation, and assisting in food preparation, in accordance with the established volunteering schedule and activity plan. Other voluntary tasks may be planned depending on the needs of the organisation. All activities are carried out in cooperation and interaction with the staff and clients of Camphill Foundation “Rožkalni” – adult persons with intellectual disabilities. https://www.camphillrozkalni.lv/en/home/

projects.title: Volunteering at Generation for Change CY 2026-2027
projects.description:
Generation for Change CY is a grassroots, non-profit organization striving for a diverse and inclusive society in Cyprus. We support and empower vulnerable and marginalized communities, including refugees and people of low socioeconomic status, and advocate for social justice in migration, human rights, and interculturalism.

We are looking for motivated young individuals living in the EU, aged 18-30, who are ready to make a tangible impact through different volunteering roles. You will contribute to our mission, gain lifelong skills, and experience Cyprus’ diversity while supporting our three pillars: Humanitarian Aid, Empowerment and Integration, and Interculturalism and Advocacy.

Applicants are required to complete this application form: https://forms.gle/aQVtY9kUnD6E2cTV7

For more information about the program, please refer to our info kit: https://drive.google.com/file/d/15s_aPwzL9_TyD-bFpSJHy4wQNjG9iEo3/view

projects.title: Volunteering in Catholic community – from July, 6–12 months
projects.description: We are Christian Catholic NGO called VIAC – Institute for youth support and development. Nowadays we are looking for long-term (1 year or 6 months) volunteers, preferably those who have positive attitude to Christianity and are willing to share those values among young people. Also, we are looking for someone who has skills to create posters, videos etc. All the description of the place and positions you can find on this website: https://volunteering.ozviac.sk. Please, check the website before applying. Please, do not write motivational statement using AI. Volunteering starting dates can be discussed with us.

projects.title: Volunteering in Catholic community – Short term
projects.description: We are Christian Catholic NGO called VIAC – Institute for youth support and development. Nowadays we are looking for 6 short-term (2 month) volunteers, preferably those who have positive attitude to Christianity and are willing to share those values among young people. Volunteers will help with maintaining our youth centre and also with work in different camps and in our community centres and prepare and lead activities for youth. Please, do not write motivational statement using AI. Volunteering starting dates can be discussed with us. All the description of the place and positions you can find on this website: https://volunteering.ozviac.sk.

projects.title: ☀️Summer International Volunteering Team: Youth Day in Krosno | POLAND ONLY
projects.description: Join us this summer in Krosno, a charming town in Podkarpacie, for a 3-week international volunteering project bringing together 20 young people from Poland and abroad. Volunteers will support the preparation and organisation of a city event celebrating Youth Day in Krosno. Together, we will work on creative, cultural, promotional and organisational tasks, helping to make the event welcoming and engaging for the local community. The project is a chance to gain practical experience in teamwork, communication, event organisation and intercultural cooperation. The activity dates are fixed: 04.08.2026–22.08.2026. Participants must arrive on 03.08.2026 and leave on 23.08.2026. These dates are not negotiable. Staying in Poland a few days before and/or after the project may be possible only at the participant’s own cost. Apply as soon as possible. Recruitment is ongoing and places may be filled before the official deadline.

projects.title: Volunteering in a residential community for minors in Equality, Italy
projects.description: We work for the social integration of people living in uneasiness and social marginalization with special attention to people involved in prostitution, victims of trafficking in human beings for sexual or labour exploitation, minors and young adults in specific conditions of vulnerability. The proposed activities for the volunteers will mainly be directed to the minors hosted in our residential care house. The volunteers will primarily support the educators’ job with unaccompanied minors, victims of human trafficking, minors who committed juvenile penalties and vulnerable minors with: the creation of an environment where it is possible to build social ties and relationships based on respect, sharing and legality, domestic activities such as cooking, cleaning and management of the rules within the house, accompaniment to autonomy of the beneficiaries, accompaniment to social-health services, organization of workshops, orientation and support for research and work placement.

projects.title: Volunteering in Foundation Semper Aavanti Opole
projects.description:
The short-term volunteering project focuses on summer activities for children. Volunteers support educators in organizing and conducting workshops, games, recreational activities, and educational sessions. These activities cover a variety of areas, including sports, theatre, languages, mathematics, music, and more.
It is important that volunteers enjoy working with children, are creative, and have plenty of ideas for engaging and inspiring activities.

projects.title: Hope Without Borders: Social Catering Enterprise
projects.description:
Volunteers will support the development and promotion of Caristo, a social catering enterprise preparing and delivering authentic Lebanese food. Owned by Caritas Sofia, it reinvests profits into social projects supporting people in vulnerable situations. Volunteers will contribute to both business growth and social impact.

The main focus is increasing visibility and building relationships with clients and partners. They will help promote services via social media by creating content, sharing impact stories, and engaging with audiences. They will also support communication with potential customers such as companies, event organizers, and private individuals.

Volunteers may assist in promotional events, tastings, and community activities, presenting the enterprise to new audiences. They can contribute ideas for marketing campaigns, support branding, gather feedback, and help with contact databases, outreach documentation, and promotional materials.

projects.title: Hands-on for Community Building
projects.description: This is a call for a short term volunteering team opportunity, that offers a meaningful blend of hands-on work, learning, and community living. Volunteers will actively participate in one of the renovation or improvement phases of the Community House — a central space being transformed to support sustainable, local development. The experience includes both theoretical and practical sessions on permaculture fundamentals, as well as seasonal or landscape work in the surrounding rural area. Volunteers will also explore social permaculture, contributing to self-organized co-living dynamics and community care. Additionally, participants will take part in a practical local community building activities, supporting personal growth and the development of individual projects. Project duration: 14 days+2 travel days (4-6 days for green travel), starting on 11th of July, 2026.

projects.title: Aumentare la consapevolezza europea tra bambini e giovani delle aree rurali
projects.description: Sei stufo di vivere in città fredde e senza rapporti personali? T'invitiamo a fare volontariato in una zona rurale composta da 44 villaggi dove tutti si conoscono. La tua missione sarà suddivisa tra cómpiti specifici e attività in comune con altri volontari: il tuo cómpito specifico sarà svolgere attività d'animazione con bambini e adolescenti tra i 10 e i 18 anni nel tempo dopo la scuola, e supervisionare campi estivi sulla costa. Talvolta sarai chiamato a lavorare anche in centri d'animazione, in attività sportive o con adolescenti in un centro di formazione. Le attività in comune sono: organizzazione d'un caffè linguistico una volta al mese, animazione interculturale per bambini d'asili e scuole, partecipazione a eventi su mobilità giovanile e temi interculturali. L'obiettivo principale del tuo volontariato è condividere gli aspetti delle tue cultura e lingua, lavorando in squadra con gli altri volontari. Normalmente il tuo impegno andrà da lunedì mattina a venerdì a mezzogiorno.

projects.title: Al Centro giovanile Jugendcafé Arena a Gratkorn!
projects.description: L'organizzazione d'accoglienza è uno spazio in cui i giovani possono entrare in contatto tra loro, esplorare vari àmbiti della vita e crescere come persone. Offre un ambiente sicuro e di supporto in cui possono trascorrere il tempo libero, scoprire interessi e costruire relazioni significative. Il lavoro del Centro giovanile è radicato nell'inclusione, nella partecipazione e nell'empowerment. Diamo supporto a giovani dai 12 anni in su provenienti da contesti diversi e li incoraggiamo a plasmare le proprie esperienze. Che vengano per rilassarsi, per dare sfogo alla loro creatività o per cercare una guida, il Centro giovanile è aperto alle loro idee e alla loro energia. Diventerai un componente del team locale coinvolto in molti aspetti del lavoro quotidiano, come il supporto alle attività dei giovani, l'aiuto a gestire seminari o eventi, l'operare sui socials e nella creazione di documentazione, il creare un progetto personale che rappresenti le tue idee, interessi o cultura d'origine.

projects.title: Steps II
projects.description:
Hellenic Youth Participation, shortly HYP, is based in Athens, Greece and it stands for intercultural dialogue, non-formal education, mutual understanding and solidarity. 2 volunteers will take part in Steps project for the period 08/09/2026-14/03/2027. 
The volunteers will:
1. support organizations in Athens with various activities (e.g. cooking & distributing food, multicultural library) according to their interests,
2. create and deliver workshops to adults and teenagers,
3. support HYP's activities,
4. create online awareness campaigns about social issues for Instagram, create content for and manage social media (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook),
5. organize local events (clean-ups, cultural workshops etc.),
6. create podcast episodes.

Application and Infopack here: https://forms.gle/Wojm6ugf1dyjLj7aA

projects.title: Progettazione sociale & Youth Work
projects.description:
The call for volunteers is fully described in the following link: https://sci-italia.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Call-Pro-ESC-2026.docx.pdf

We recommend you to read carefully the activities and to describe your motivation and interested based on this call

projects.title: Roumanie : Permaculture dans une communauté rurale - LAST MINUTE CANCELLATION
projects.description:
După Gard est une organisation située en Transylvanie, en Roumanie, qui œuvre pour la permaculture, l’agroécologie et les modes de vie durables. Son projet vise à promouvoir une relation plus respectueuse entre l’être humain et la nature à travers des pratiques agricoles écologiques et des principes de durabilité. L’organisation propose des ateliers, des événements et des séjours immersifs, offrant aux participants l’opportunité d’apprendre de manière pratique, de développer leur autonomie et de se reconnecter à l’environnement naturel. După Gard se présente ainsi comme un lieu d’apprentissage, de partage et de sensibilisation aux enjeux écologiques actuels.
Les missions seront les suivantes : 
Participer aux activités quotidiennes d’un projet de permaculture (agriculture durable, entretien du site).
Contribuer à des projets de construction naturelle (ex. construction en terre/pisé, aménagements écologiques).
Aider au développement et au soutien de projets écologiques locaux

projects.title: Long-term ESC volunteering at Fryshuset Stockholm Restaurang & Café
projects.description:
As an ESC volunteer at Fryshuset Stockholm Restaurang & Café, you will support the daily operations of the café and restaurant while gaining valuable experience in hospitality, customer service, teamwork, and event support. Tasks may include helping prepare and serve food and beverages, assisting with catering and internal orders, maintaining clean and welcoming spaces, supporting stock management, and contributing to the smooth running of the café throughout the day.
Beyond the café, you will be part of Fryshuset’s international volunteer community. You will help organize and facilitate cooking and art workshops, promote mobility opportunities for young people, and support communication activities, including social media content creation, depending on your interests. This placement offers a dynamic environment where volunteers can develop practical skills, creativity, intercultural competence, and confidence while contributing to a vibrant youth organization.

projects.title: Albanie, Korca - Culture et Inclusion (Juillet - Août)
projects.description:
L’association Beyond Barriers a été créée en juin 2004 à Tirana, en Albanie. BBA est une organisation non gouvernementale à but non lucratif qui défend les droits et les intérêts des jeunes. La mission de BBA est de donner aux jeunes Albanais les moyens d’agir en favorisant la participation active, l’inclusion, l’égalité des chances et une meilleure qualité de vie.
Les missions des volontaires :
- Soutien aux activités du centre jeunesse local et de l'office du tourisme.
- Promotion de l'inclusion, du travail d'équipe et de la participation communautaire à travers des activités menées par des bénévoles.
- Animation d'ateliers dans une école locale qui enseigne la langue française.
-  Promotion des programmes E+ et ESC à travers des activités sur place et une campagne sur les réseaux sociaux.
- Mise en place de campagnes de sensibilisation à l'environnement à travers des activités de nettoyage.

projects.title: Volunteering in school and permaculture garden
projects.description:
Ikšķile Free School is a place where people come together to create positive change. Our community is made up of active, responsible and enterprising people who do not wait for others to make things happen — we look for solutions, take action and create new opportunities for children, families and the wider community.
At our school, we deeply value freedom, nature, community, sustainable living and Latvian traditions. We use a holistic approach to personal development and believe that every person is naturally good, capable of growth, self-expression and meaningful contribution. It is important for us to accept each person as they are, to respect their unique experience and to create an environment where everyone can feel a sense of belonging.
We are offering: -Interesting work with kids -Pocket money -Place to live -Healthy vegetarian lunch -Fantastic experience working outdoors - Duration - 8-10 months

projects.title: Albanie, Korca - Culture et Inclusion (Septembre - Octobre)
projects.description:
L’association Beyond Barriers a été créée en juin 2004 à Tirana, en Albanie. BBA est une organisation non gouvernementale à but non lucratif qui défend les droits et les intérêts des jeunes. La mission de BBA est de donner aux jeunes Albanais les moyens d’agir en favorisant la participation active, l’inclusion, l’égalité des chances et une meilleure qualité de vie.
Les missions des volontaires :
- Soutien aux activités du centre jeunesse local et de l'office du tourisme.
- Promotion de l'inclusion, du travail d'équipe et de la participation communautaire à travers des activités menées par des bénévoles.
- Animation d'ateliers dans une école locale qui enseigne la langue française.
-  Promotion des programmes E+ et ESC à travers des activités sur place et une campagne sur les réseaux sociaux.
- Mise en place de campagnes de sensibilisation à l'environnement à travers des activités de nettoyage.

projects.title: Conservation Assistant
projects.description: BirdLife Malta is looking for a candidate to assist the conservation department in fulfilling a number of duties related to our core work. Depending on the candidate’s experience, interest and qualifications, conservation assistants will fulfil a combination of the roles from fieldwork to protect birds on migration, data handling, report writing and injured bird rescue and care.

projects.title: Community Development and Resilience Building in Slum Communities
projects.description:
With support from the Uganda Pioneers’ Association (UPA), an indigenous youth-led NGO, the volunteer will be assigned to Community Empowerment For Village Development Uganda (CEFOVID-UG). The charity supports marginalized slum dwellers, focusing on orphans and vulnerable children and youth in the suburbs of Kampala.

The project aims to enhance access to social and economic services to address and reduce vulnerability, including poverty and lack of awareness and skills for self-sustainability.

Volunteers should prepare to assist with one or more of the following:
• Conduct outreach and awareness campaigns on sanitation and hygiene 
• Provide after-school support to children 
• Organize recreational activities (sports, arts) 
• Assist with fundraising for vulnerable households 
• Train staff on social media management 
• Participate in home and school visits to document success stories and follow up with beneficiaries

projects.title: Trainer – Fashion, Design & Knitting for Women's Empowerment
projects.description: The project empowers disadvantaged girls and women in slum community by providing training in sewing, tailoring, brand building, and financial literacy, equipping them with income-generating skills. It enhances access to comprehensive social and economic services while addressing the root causes of vulnerability, such as poverty, lack of awareness, and limited skills, to promote self-sufficiency. As a volunteer, you will support and engage in the following activities: 1) Empowering young people by teaching fashion design and knitting skills, 2) Developing new products based on local market demand, 3) Marketing youth center products locally and internationally, 4) Organizing exhibitions and exposure tours/visits, 5) Providing basic financial literacy training, 6) Developing a quality control system, 7) Strengthening relationships with existing partners and identifying new partnership opportunities.

projects.title: MEAL Assistant (flexible duration, open to candidates with prior EU volunteering experience)
projects.description: Merhamet Sandžak is committed to supporting IDPs, returnees, and vulnerable families through humanitarian aid and long-term development projects. As a MEAL Officer, you'll help ensure the projects are effective, responsive, and focused on the needs of the communities. If you’ve worked on projects before and are curious about how to track impact and improve results, this role could be a great fit. // Key Responsibilities: • Support data collection activities such as surveys, interviews, and community feedback • Help track project indicators and contribute to regular monitoring reports • Assist with organizing evaluations, focus group discussions, and learning sessions • Help document what works well (and what doesn’t) so we can continuously improve our programs • Work closely with project staff and partners to make sure voices from the community are heard and reflected in our work. You don' need to be a MEAL expert - we’re looking for someone organized, curious, and motivated to learn.

projects.title: Volunteering in Palermo | Creating Cultural Crossroads with GIOSEF Italy VOL.4
projects.description:
Spend 9 months volunteering in Palermo, Sicily, and become part of GIOSEF Italy's international team. This European Solidarity Corps project offers hands-on experience in youth work, communication, community engagement and international cooperation in one of the most multicultural cities of the Mediterranean.
Volunteers will support communication and dissemination activities, podcast production, educational initiatives, community projects and European programmes. They will contribute to activities promoting youth participation, social inclusion, sustainability, intercultural dialogue, anti-mafia education and active citizenship.
Through local initiatives, Erasmus+ projects, Youth Exchanges and Training Courses, volunteers will gain practical experience in non-formal education, international youth cooperation and community-based work while living in a vibrant Euro-Mediterranean environment.

projects.title: YOUTH SKILLS DEVELOPMENT VOLUNTEER (flexible duration, open to candidates with prior EU volunteering experience)
projects.description:
Merhamet Sandžak is committed to empowering young people from vulnerable communities by helping them build the skills and confidence needed for their future. As a Youth Skill Development Volunteer, you’ll support youth in discovering their potential, exploring opportunities, and gaining practical tools for education and employment. // Key Responsibilities: • 
Provide basic career mentoring and skills advice to youth, including identifying strengths and setting goals. • Assist with CV writing, job or school applications, and interview preparation. • Map local opportunities for education, training, volunteering, and employment. • Help organize and lead informal workshops or sessions on career orientation and soft skills. • 
Motivate and encourage youth to explore their options and take proactive steps toward their goals. // No formal experience in career counseling is needed - just enthusiasm, patience, and a desire to support youth on their journey.

projects.title: “La Città dell’Utopia" project
projects.description:
SCI Italy's project “La Città dell'Utopia” started in 2003 and it is located in the neighborhood of San Paolo, Rome, a popular suburban area inhabited mainly by elderly people, university students, and migrant families coming from Latin America, northeastern Europe, Asia, and Africa. The building is used to host several groups and associations working on active citizenships, especially in relation to migration, environmental sustainability, antifascism, gender, and self-determination of food and consumption.
The main activities carried out in “La Città dell’Utopia” are:
Organizing and hosting of international workcamps, trainings, and international youth meetings.
Organizing and running awareness-raising events
Organizing meetings, festivals, exhibitions, thematic meals, farmers’ markets, and courses on music, group dancing, language courses, gardening. 
Read the full call: https://sci-italia.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Call-LCU-ESC-26-27.docx.pdf

projects.title: ESC Voluntary Service in the Sinnberg Grundschule in Bad Kissingen, Germany.
projects.description: The Sinnberg Grundschule is a public elementary school of around 330 children with 16 classes going from 1st to 4th grade. A whole series of offered classes and workshops should give to the children the opportunity to develop their personality. The special offers in music, sport, reading, English, theatre, bicycle, experiencing nature and social interaction are going to shape their day at school. The all-day classes stay in school until the afternoon where the children are taken care of and receive diverse free- time offers. The volunteer will support the teacher and the students during the school day.

projects.title: Mobility Ambassador in France
projects.description: As part of its efforts to promote European and international mobility, the Youth Hub is stepping up its initiatives to encourage young people’s engagement by recruiting mobility ambassadors. Working in partnership with the European Solidarity Corps (ESC), the volunteers’ role is to promote mobility, civic engagement and an international outlook among young people in the region. The volunteer will contribute to local initiatives and the Youth Hub’s activities and events

projects.title: EUROPEAN YOUTH IN SAINT QUENTIN
projects.description: This mission is carried out by Concordia in partnership with the city of SAINT QUENTIN. The missions will take place in connection with the youth pole of the city and could be: - Working on youth programs and mobility projects for young people – Intervening in schools with children aged 3 to 10 years old - Accompanying children during school time, after school and during the lunch break by proposing activities that promote immersion in the English language - Participate in activities for the population in social centers and associations in SAINT QUENTIN - Take part in thematic workshops organized by the Youth and Senior Centers - Promote your culture - Help prepare a meeting with young Europeans, - Discover the territory of SAINT QUENTIN, work on your future project and youthpass. We would like to welcome two volunteers on this mission. Interviews will be scheduled in July. Volunteers will be asked to present a clean criminal record as some of the missions are in contact with kids.

projects.title: Guardería Montessori Munketal Jena
projects.description: Eurowerkstatt actúa como organización de envío y de acogida, pero principalmente como organización coordinadora dentro del programa del Cuerpo Europeo de Solidaridad (ESC). Nos encargamos de coordinar el proceso de solicitud, la preparación previa y el acompañamiento de los 10–13 voluntarios que llegan a Jena cada año. Actualmente, estamos buscando un voluntario/a para la guardería Montessori Munketal, situada en la ciudad alemana de Jena. Esta guardería es bilingüe, los niños aprenden español, por lo que en mandatorio que el voluntario/a sea español.

projects.title: Youth center Westside - Jena
projects.description:
The youth center  Westside formerly know as Treffpunkt is a municipal institution, which is situated in Jena Lobeda-Ost. At our open space, kids and young people from the age of 12 to 21 can hang out and spend their leisure time. Our different offers vary from sports activities, cultural and educational projects to cooperation with other institutions within the district. Our visionis that all young people have the opportunity to develop anddiscover themselves in a safe environment, guided by values  such as openness, gender equality, opportunities forparticipation, voluntariness and a focus on the world aroundthem.
Our volunteers support us to run the place and help with daily procedures. There is a lot of time to participate in any activities with the kids: play games, just talk and hang out and listen to very loud music. The volunteers give our place the extra spirit to make it a happy place for all of us.

projects.title: Media, languages , European citizenship and well-being : get involved and help our students engage !
projects.description:
Main tasks
• Reinforcing the concept of European citizenship and raising awareness on topics such as European mobility within
the school community .
• Getting involved in sustainability-related activities, as well as in health, prevention and well-being projects within
the school.
• Enriching and promoting the culture of modern languages within the school: setting up a “café des langues” at
school and/or in the local community. Supporting students in their language learning processes.
• Organizing the European Day of Languages and the national “Semaine des Langues” 
• Setting up activities, in partnership with Year 10 pupils from Borda high school, to facilitate the transition from
middle school to secondary school
• Developing the Gazette des Langues project and/or other media-related projects: he/she will participate in the
actions implemented by the staff. He/she will offer individualized support to students in the creation of various
media materials

projects.title: Create, Connect, Inspire: Join Vedogiovane in Italy
projects.description: The main working base for volunteers will be the Vedogiovane office in Borgomanero, Northern Italy. From this hub, volunteers will take part in a wide range of activities supporting young people, local communities and social innovation projects. They will contribute to communication and storytelling by creating content, documenting activities and supporting social media. Volunteers will also be involved in youth centres and community spaces, helping to organise workshops, events and participation activities for young people. They may support community welfare and inclusion initiatives carried out with local organisations, including activities promoting solidarity, intercultural dialogue and active citizenship. During the summer, volunteers may participate in camps, youth exchanges and residential programmes. Throughout the project, they will work alongside experienced youth workers and educators, gaining practical experience in non-formal education, communication, community development

projects.title: L'Elba del Vicino
projects.description: The volunteering experience takes place on Elba Island, one of the most beautiful islands in the Mediterranean Sea. Hosted by Elba del Vicino, volunteers will become part of a community-based project that combines youth work, social inclusion, environmental awareness and community life. The project offers a unique opportunity to experience island life while contributing to activities that support local children, young people and the wider community. Volunteers will work alongside educators, youth workers and local staff members in a supportive and international environment.Volunteers will support educational and recreational activities for children and young people during after-school programmes, holiday activities and summer camps. They will help create a welcoming environment, organise games, sports, creative workshops and outdoor activities, while encouraging participation, inclusion and intercultural learning.

projects.title: Volunteering in Klubicko 2026/2027
projects.description: We are searching for 1 volunteer who is strongly motivated to work with children in the field of creativity and cultural enrichement. Klubicko Kromeriz is a Family Center located in the east of the Czech Republic in town Kromeriz. The volunteers will join our daily activities such as: Children Groups for kids 2-6 years, Afternoon club for elementry school aged kids, Kindergarten for preschoolers, Nursery for toddlers, Free time activites – English, French, Montessori Morning and Afternoon Groups, Folklor Dance Classes, Mornings with mothers and toddlers – everything for children, Summer camps during July and August. Volunteer might participate in the partner organizations events/presentations/workshops which generally take place in local primary schools, secondary schools, grammar schools and the library.

projects.title: Volontariat 8 mois à la mission locale de Lille Avenirs
projects.description:
Volontariat de 8 mois au pôle citoyenneté de la mission locale de Lille Avenirs, une structure de réinsertion social et professionnel qui agit auprès des jeunes de 16 à 25 ans qui ne sont pas en parcours scolaire, ni à l'emploi. Les missions se feront principalement dans le domaine de la mobilité internationale et de l'interculturalité. Les missions principales seront : 
- développer et animer des ateliers d'anglais pour des jeunes en préparation au départ, 
- co animer et proposer des ateliers d'éducation populaire pour les sessions de préparation au départ, 
- participer au développement des partenariats internationaux (rencontres en visio, échanges sur des thématiques), 
- faire connaître sa culture, son pays auprès des jeunes sous forme d'ateliers ludiques pour leur donner envie de partir, 
- promouvoir la mobilité et la citoyenneté européenne, 
- participer aux réunions d'équipes, 
- accompagnement des jeunes (aide au CV en anglais et LM, aide aux entretiens).

projects.title: Albanie, Tirana : Animation et Inclusion (Short-term - June)
projects.description:
Beyond Barriers Association (BBA) est une organisation non-gouvernementale albanaise fondée en 2004 à Tirana par un groupe de jeunes avec et sans handicap. Elle œuvre pour l’inclusion, la participation active et l’autonomisation des jeunes, notamment ceux issus de groupes marginalisés (jeunes en situation de handicap, jeunes Roms, LGBTQ+, etc.).
Les missions des volontaires : KUB FRANCE : Organisation d’événements, animation d’ateliers de technologie VR, promotion de la culture française, création de contenu pour les réseaux. - 
TEN Youth Center : Cours de français et de culture pour les jeunes, préparation des cours de langue.
- Activités avec des personnes ayant des handicaps intellectuels : Activités sportives, thérapies musicales et artistiques, jeux de groupe, de société et puzzles.
- Support aux projets de BBA : Travail à la serre éducative, au centre de poterie, organisation d’événements culturels et interculturels, aide au développement du contenu pour les réseaux sociaux.

projects.title: From City to Countryside Living V
projects.description:
From City to Countryside Living is a 30 day volunteering team ESC project which will take place in Raches, Central Greece.
Our goal is to motivate young people to move from the cities to the countryside by giving them practical skills and choices for a sustainable life.
We will together learn how to build sustainable structures, grow our own food, make more eco-friendly choices, earn a living and experience countryside by being connected to ourselves and the others through workshops, sports and culture.
You can also find the infopack here :
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-cvHFugERS3hzEwQXwhLFZbvU_EPTNj1/view?usp=sharing

projects.title: Interculturality and exchange! Volunteer at a French rural High School
projects.description: LEAP Lestonnac is a vocational High School focused on People care and Services to territories professions. The school is located in a rural environment and provides vocational training for pupils aged between 13 and 20. We are looking for one volunteer to promote international mobility and interculturality! The volunteer will have to develop ways to interact with students during non-formal periods (such as breaks, meals, outings, evening time at our boarding school, etc.) to support the learning of the Spanish language not only inside but also more importantly outside of the classroom. He/She will also be able to develop personal projects related to the promotion of international mobility and interculturality, social and language exchange, etc. These are some of the activities in which the volunteer will support the team and share with the other volunteer on-site (International Civic Service). The volunteer will also help with our students’ annual 2-week mobility internship in Spain.

projects.title: Looking for a volunteer in a Montessori school in Würzburg
projects.description: The volunteers will support the daily school life in the Montessori Wuerzburg Schule. She or he will get to know how the students develop the learning process based on Maria Montessori’s pedagogy. The volunteers will have the opportunity to get involved in different activities and groups within the school and they have the option to develop specific offers for kids matching their interests and skills.

projects.title: Voluteer in children's education at an alternative school in France
projects.description: We are looking for 2 volunteers to stay with us from September and for the whole school year :) The association’s purpose is really to broadcast a creative and open minded parentality, but also to propose an alternative to classical education, opened to the world and respectful to our environnement. We have an educationnal approach based on different pedagogies: Montessori, Freinet, Steiner, pedagogy of projects and pedagogy by the nature. We also use some innovative tools like non violent communication, cooperation, emotions management…. The opening vision on the world is one of our pedagogic project’s pilar. We follow some interesting adventurer’s project to discover the world and to approach different kind of subjects like the environment, the animals, the ocean’s pollution… We love practicing foreign languages used in rituals context and discover others cultures and countries, songs, movies, cooking… We also go to the forest every friday morning to discover and learn with nature.

projects.title: Volunteering at the Red Cross in Portugal | Acting Local Changing Global
projects.description: Spend 5 months volunteering for the Red Cross in Portugal! This European Solidarity Corps project offers hands-on experience in community engagement and direct interaction with vulnerable target groups of the population. Volunteers support a range of activities, including logistics at the Food Bank, activities at the elderly nursing home and rehabilitation centre (for people recovering from addictions), activities at a local primary school and permaculture farm. Volunteers also have the chance to be involved in activities connected to pilgrim shelter, environmental initiatives and local fundraising events. Tasks are varied and practical. This is a role that better suits people who prefer staying active and working in the field rather than sitting behind a desk.

projects.title: Volunteering at the Red Cross in Portugal (Long Term)
projects.description: Spend 8 months volunteering for the Red Cross in Portugal! This European Solidarity Corps project offers hands-on experience in community engagement and direct interaction with vulnerable target groups of the population. Volunteers support a range of activities, including logistics at the Food Bank, activities at the elderly nursing home and rehabilitation centre (for people recovering from addictions), activities at a local primary school and permaculture farm. Volunteers also have the chance to be involved in activities connected to pilgrim shelter, environmental initiatives and local fundraising events. Tasks are varied and practical. This is a role that better suits people who prefer staying active and working in the field rather than sitting behind a desk.

She or he will get to know how the students develop the learning process based on Maria Montessori’s pedagogy. The volunteers will have the opportunity to get involved in different activities and groups within the school and they have the option to develop specific offers for kids matching their interests and skills.

projects.title: Youth home and work training HALTEGRIFF
projects.description: APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED HERE: www.logo.at/esc | “Haltegriff” is an institution offering living and work training for young people aged 16 to 21 with NEET status (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) who cannot live at home. "Haltegriff" helps them develop independence both personally and professionally. There are two teams: the work coaching team, which organizes internships and workshops to build job skills, and the living facility team, which provides accommodation for up to 16 youngsters and supervises their daily lives. The teams consist of pedagogues, social workers, and psychologists. "Haltegriff" supports youths facing issues at home or in education. The team of workers helps them develop social and professional skills. There are many activities offered, such as workshops, outdoor days, and trips, to enhance personal growth. The volunteer will support both the work training and living facility teams, providing assistance in various areas.

projects.title: Accompany young people in great difficulty in their schooling, education, leisure and integration - Ste Thérèse Paris
ESC TEAM: Green maintenance in the mountains of northern Italy
projects.description:
“Farfalle nella testa” is a cooperative society in Bordano (Friuli Venezia Giulia) that deals with communication of science and public engagement with science. The volunteers will provide support the cooperative and the local community in green maintenance and cleaning the lake shores in Ecomuseo Val del Lago. The tasks also include cooking meals, cleaning the shared spaces and promoting the ESC programme with photos and videos.
 The volunteers will have the opportunity to participate in sports and creative workshops such as: rafting, bike ride, flight approach tutorial, ceramic and craft, drum circle, yoga etc.

projects.title: Accompany young people in their schooling, education, leisure and integration - IES St Jean 1
projects.description:
The European volunteer will work alongside the pedagogical and educational team of the Saint-Jean middle and vocational high school, contributing to:

School and boarding facility life
Support students individually, be a trusted point of contact for young residents
Classroom support (reformulating instructions, refocusing students, small group work)
Break time activities with the educator (recess, lunch break)
School outings
Subject-based contributions depending on volunteer skills: arts, music, sports, ecology (educational garden), or digital tools
Homework support with the educator
Co-leading language classes (Spanish and/or English)
Occasional shift work

projects.title: Accompany young people in their schooling, education, leisure and integration - IES St Jean 2
projects.description:
The European volunteer will work alongside the pedagogical and educational team of the Saint-Jean middle and vocational high school, contributing to:
