projects.title: Bridges to Learning
projects.description:
This project offers you the opportunity to engage in meaningful activities, support local youth initiatives, and gain hands-on experience. As a volunteer, you'll grow personally and professionally while making a positive impact in the local area.

You will be part of a team of five volunteers who will bring along their own cultural background and personal
knowledge adding value to our Youth Center.

projects.title: Asistent/ica voditeljice kluba za mlade
projects.description:
🌴 Nudimo ti rad u klubu za mlade, druženje s brojnim mladim lokalcima i stjecanje novih iskustava - uz more, sunce i mediteranski stil života!

🇪🇺 Postani dio naše treće generacije ESS volontera i provedi devet mjeseci u Splitu (Hrvatska), od jeseni 2026. do ljeta 2027. godine.

🌍 Kao ESS volonter/ka volontirat ćeš na poziciji asistenta/ice voditeljice kluba za mlade i sudjelovati u:
- organizaciji događanja u klubu za mlade,
- izradi sadržaja za društvene mreže,
- pripremi informativnih sadržaja za mlade,
- aktivnostima zagovaranja interesa mladih.

⏰ Tvoj angažman uključuje petodnevni radni tjedan te dva dodatna dana odmora mjesečno. Ovisno o dodijeljenim zadacima, radit ćeš u jutarnjoj ili popodnevnoj smjeni, s dovoljno slobodnog vremena za istraživanje i uživanje u slobodnom vremenu.

⚠️ Nakon prijave na mail ti šaljemo dodatne informacije i kratak online upitnik o tvojim kompetencijama i interesima.

📩 Za sva pitanja javi se na ivana@infozona.hr

projects.title: ATAUNI ESC IN PORTUGAL
projects.description: This volunteering project will take place in Arrouquelas, Portugal, and will focus on environmental protection, sustainability, rural life and community engagement. Volunteers will support daily activities related to nature conservation, forest awareness, gardening, animal care, maintenance works and local community initiatives. Through practical tasks, teamwork and intercultural learning, participants will develop responsibility, solidarity, environmental awareness and active citizenship skills while contributing to the host organisation and the local community.

projects.title: ATAUNI ESC IN ITALY
projects.description: This volunteering project will take place in Poggiardo, in the Salento region of Southern Italy, and will focus on inclusion, active participation, intercultural learning and personal development. Volunteers will take part in activities based on experiential learning, supporting local initiatives, community engagement, youth activities and dissemination tasks. Through learning by doing, teamwork and reflection, participants will develop new skills, strengthen their sense of responsibility and contribute to the local community in a meaningful way.

projects.title: ATAUNI ESC IN ICELAND
projects.description: This volunteering project will take place in Iceland and will focus on nature-oriented activities, environmental awareness, intercultural learning and community contribution. Volunteers will support short-term international projects by taking part in the organisation, supervision and implementation of outdoor and community-based activities. Through teamwork, leadership, practical tasks and non-formal learning, participants will develop communication, responsibility and project management skills while contributing positively to local communities and nature-focused initiatives in Iceland.

projects.title: Keep calm and animate young people🌞 - Namur
projects.description:
Dynamo International is a youth service dedicated to individuals aged 13 to 25. Our primary goal is to provide support to young people in this age range, addressing the various questions and challenges they may face, whether in academics, family dynamics, or societal interactions. Additionally, our expertise lies in facilitating mobility and assisting them in realizing their projects in Belgium or abroad. This may involve organizing camps, youth exchanges, CES, working holidays, and more.

As a volunteer, your responsibilities will include participating in and coordinating weekly socio-cultural activities, organizing camps, and potentially facilitating youth exchanges within Belgium. You will also contribute to raising awareness to promote the association and its projects, actively engaging in the promotion of Dynamo International's initiatives through social media channels. Your creative input and innovative contributions to our activities will be highly encouraged and valued.

projects.title: Promoting mobility among young people - Bruxelles
projects.description:
Dynamo International is a youth service dedicated to individuals aged 13 to 25. Our primary goal is to provide support to young people in this age range, addressing the various questions and challenges they may face, whether in academics, family dynamics, or societal interactions. Additionally, our expertise lies in facilitating mobility and assisting them in realizing their projects in Belgium or abroad. This may involve organizing camps, youth exchanges, ESC, working holidays, and more.

As a volunteer, your responsibilities will include participating in and coordinating weekly socio-cultural activities, organizing camps, and, potentially, facilitating youth exchanges within Belgium. You will also contribute to raising awareness to promote the association and its projects, actively engaging in the promotion of Dynamo International's initiatives through social media channels. Your creative input and innovative contributions to our activities will be highly encouraged and valued.

projects.title: Lernimpuls Witten e. V.
projects.description: Creative youth work, hands-on workshops and inspiring activities with children and young people – full of energy, learning and meaningful experiences.

projects.title: Moi, citoyen européen
projects.description:
The specific activities of the hosted volunteers will focus on 5 strategic objectives: 1. promoting European citizenship and democratic participation 2. promoting European mobility among young people and disseminating different cultures 3. Introducing the European Green Pact and raising public awareness of EU sustainable development issues 4. participate in and/or develop local solidarity and inclusion initiatives Examples of activities : - Design and run activities for children, young people and adults on a variety of themes (mobility, citizenship, environment, rights, discrimination, discovering different countries, languages) - Work with local associations, depending on the volunteer's interests (solidarity, culture, environment, etc.). - Assist the association in designing actions and in communication. - Raise young people's awareness of international mobility, by sharing your own mobility experiences.
More informations : www.maisoneurope47.eu

projects.title: Restoration of memorial sites in Krzyżowa
projects.description:
Join us in a meaningful volunteer initiative dedicated to restoring and maintaining the dignity of a historic cemetery for war prisoners in Poland and a unique outdoor exhibition the "Courage and Reconciliation".Your efforts will help preserve these important sites, honor those who suffered and sacrificed, and ensure that their memory endures for future generations. No prior experience is needed - just a willingness to contribute and make a positive impact through activities such as cleaning, landscaping, and general upkeep. Together, we can pay tribute to history and help maintain a respectful resting place for our shared heritage. 
Spend a month connecting with people from around the world, learn about the history and importance of these memorial sites, and contribute to their upkeep and preservation.

projects.title: Volunteering in kindergarten in Pułtusk
projects.description: Przedszkole Miejskie no. 5 is one of three municipal kindergartens in Pułtusk. It provides everyday care and education to children aged 3–6. The main activities are: didactic and outdoor activities, free play, excursions, events, art activities, meals and self-service activities. The main idea behind volunteering in the kindergartens is to implement an intercultural aspect into the education program. The volunteers assist teachers, but besides that, there is a lot of space for personal initiative, such as organizing workshops, presentations and classes, which introduce their culture and language to the group. The volunteers teach foreign languages (mostly English) in an informal way through games, exercises, etc.

projects.title: Promoting culture and reading in municipal library in Przasnysz
projects.description: The library serves the inhabitants of Przasnysz town and its neighbourhood. It performs the traditional role of a library and conducts activities in the field of culture and education aimed at different age groups. Volunteers will be supporting the staff in the preparation and running of activities aimed at readers and inhabitants. They will create content and manage social media, such as TikTok and Instagram. They will also have the opportunity to realize their own initiatives, especially those adding an intercultural dimension. Examples of tasks: Supporting events such as excursions, workshops, and concerts - Organizing educational activities such as language cafes and meetings at high schools, handicraft, and STEM workshops - Promoting reading and organizing meetings with children - Taking photos and creating videos for Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube. Infopack: https://www.spw.ngo/przasnysz-infopack

projects.title: ESC @ Nachbarschaftsschule - After school care (2 volunteers)
projects.description: *WE ONLY ACCEPT PARTICIPANTS VIA OUR APPLICATION FORM BELOW. The "NaSch family" is non-profit organization for the after school care center and nursery. Since the beginning of 1999, the community of the neighbourhoo school has been in free ownership of the initiative "Nachbarschaftsschule Leipzig eV". Teachers and parents founded the Neighborhood School (NaSch) with the idea of creating a school, which opens up inside and outside. We support the individual strengths and talents of the kids as possible. To realize this, we use approved reform-educational forms of organization and methods. Within the educational and educational mission, it is particularly important for us to develop values and to live them - values such as the joy of learning, democracy and conflict management, freedom from violence and a willingness to take responsibility for themselves and others.

projects.title: ESC @ elementary school & eco village
projects.description: !!!WE ONLY ACCEPT APPLICATIONS THROUGH OUR FORM BELOW!!! The project "Freies Lernen Jahnishausen" (Free Learning Jahnishausen) started in 2022, where members of the nearby community revived the old village school of Jahnishausen with a new primary school based on a very free learning concept: There is little frontal teaching, instead students work together on their learning. The school currently has around 20 pupils and follows a very inclusive approach, so that we can respond to the needs of the pupils. We also spend a lot of time on outdoor activities and are very open to your ideas. Two minutes walk from the school is an old knight's estate which houses our community (Lebenstraumgemeinschaft Jahnishausen) where the volunteer will live. Our community is part of the GEN network (Global Ecovillage Network) and we are very committed to an environmentally sustainable way of life. At the moment, we have about 57 residents (including 9 children).

projects.title: Volunteer at Kaunas Region Social Service Center - Be the Reason a Child Smiles Today 😊💛
projects.description:
Join our center and make a real difference in the lives of children and young people with disabilities. Through sports, arts, music, games, and creative activities, you'll help create a fun, safe, and inclusive environment where children can learn, grow, and shine.
As a volunteer, you'll become a friend, supporter, and positive role model. You'll join daily activities, encourage children to build confidence and life skills, communicate in English, Lithuanian, or non-verbal ways, and create meaningful connections through shared experiences.
Once you get to know the center, you'll have the chance to bring your own ideas to life by leading a weekly group activity based on your interests and talents.
Gain valuable experience, develop new skills, make unforgettable memories, and be the reason a child feels included, supported, and empowered to shine. 💛

projects.title: L.E.A.D with Synergy Bulgaria
projects.description: Check our Infoletter first and apply here: http://tiny.cc/rxu4101. Join Synergy Bulgaria for an 8-month ESC volunteering experience, starting ASAP! Spend almost a year in Bulgaria, develop your project, creative, and communication skills, and make a real impact. We are looking for 1 motivated volunteer for the role: Project/Event Manager OR photo- & videographer. You’ll be immersed in Erasmus+, ESC, event management, content creation, and youth work, gain mentorship, hands-on experience, and take part in local & international events. Perfect for 18–27, creative, proactive volunteers from EU program countries. ESC covers: travel, food & pocket money, accommodation in Sofia (utilities + internet), Henner insurance, local transport, and on-arrival & mid-term trainings. Ready for 8 months of growth, learning, and adventure? Register here: https://forms.gle/MjSvnB5SEtxf4zBt7.

projects.title: Make a real impact at AWO Begegnungszentrum Zuffenhausen: Social work in the local community
projects.description: AWO Stuttgart operates several Begegnungszentren (community meeting centres), which serve as meeting points for social interaction, cultural activities, and everyday support. Our facilities offer a wide range of programs, helping seniors lead independent and active lives. We look forward to welcoming you as a volunteer in our Begegnungszentrum Zuffenhausen if you are interested in helping us with the following tasks: • You will assist in planning, organizing, and carrying out recreational, educational, and cultural activities for the visitors (ex. game nights, craft sessions, lectures...) • You will support our visitors by providing transportation services • You will assist our visitors with everyday tasks such as filling out forms, accompanying them... • You will run errands for the facility or our visitors, whether it’s for daily needs or special events. • You will work with the team and take on general organizational tasks (event preparation, administration...)

projects.title: R.IS.E. 12 MONTHS PROJECT IN ITALY
projects.description: Project will have THREE main kind of activities: SOCIAL FARM:aimed at promoting disadvantaged people’s rehabilitation, care and/or the integration of people with ‘low contractual capacity’ (i.e.: psycho-physical disabilities, drug addicts, minors, emigrants). The special added value of social farming is the possibility for disadvantaged people to being integrated in a living context, where their personal potential may be valued and enhanced. DAILY CENTER WITH DISABLE PEOPLE The daily center is created for people with mental disability (children and adults). Every working day the volunteers have a chance to participate in man kinds of activity: manual art and do it yourself activities (make decorations, figures, painting etc.); recycling and kitchen workshop (participating in every step of preparing meals for the group, and getting to know even Italian cuisine better when cooking together MIGRATION CENTER activity with migrants adults and children in a daily center or houses

projects.title: A Step Towards a Fair Future - Plovdiv/2
projects.description:
Have you ever considered living, working, and exploring one of Europe's cultural capitals for six months? Plovdiv is the oldest livable city in the world, where you can explore different cultures. You will work with the team of Caritas Sofia and our volunteers and serve the community of Plovdiv and the municipality of Kuklen. In Plovdiv, you will work with the Community Support Center in Kuklen, we work with at-risk children and their parents and relatives living in the Kuklen municipality. As a volunteerof Caritas Sofia and our volunteer program in Plovdiv! We seek innovative and dedicated individuals who can use their talent and creativity to promote our cause and inspire others to join us. As a Volunteer , you will work closely with our team to promote the benefits of volunteering, encourage community involvement and support the development of volunteer programs.

 Do not apply unless you can not commit to the precise date of the position.

projects.title: Volunteering in Sicily in a housing community for at-risk boys and children
projects.description: Istituto Walden is a social cooperative that manages different houses and services for minors located in the island of Sicily. They are looking for ESC volunteers to support the educators in a shelter for young boys (13-18 years old) and children (0-10 years old) who are on a path towards rehabilitation and social inclusion. The youngsters live together in the shelter as a community and the volunteers will share part of their daily life. Tasks: - Support youngsters’ and childrens' education with afterschool activities (homework support, lessons of foreign language, educational workshops) - Create fun and engaging workshops: cooking, theatre, music... - Language exchange - Organize celebrations for special occasions/festivities - Manage the daily life in the community: prepare meals to share with everyone, keep the space clean and welcoming, help the residents with their everyday needs - Discover the town and surrounding area accompanying the youngsters on trips.

projects.title: Volontariato in un club giovanile e pianificazione d'un evento multiculturale
projects.description: L'organizzazione di accoglienza è un centro polifunzionale, con una lunga esperienza nell'educazione, multiculturalimo, arte e cooperazione, che unisce persone da tutto il mondo. Lavora principalmente sull'integrazione, i giovani e l'inclusività, portando avanti progetti quali il Flying Hub e l'evento internazionale Lelenfant, attività che promuovono l'inserimento sociale di gruppi marginalizzati e l'arte. In questo progetto si entra in contatto con ragazzi polacchi, bambini e gruppi artistici da tutto il mondo. Le attività principali sono suddivise in due periodi: la partecipazione al Flying Hub prima e l'organizzazione e la partecipazione all'evento Lelenfant, poi. Vi sono diverse mansioni quali: seminari, ricerche, coordinamento di progetti, preparazione di documenti e promozione delle attività. Ci sarà l'opportunità concreta di entrare a contatto con la cultura polacca, ma non solo! Lelenfant è aperto a tutti e ogni anno partecipano moltissime persone a questo festival mondiale.

projects.title: 🎉2-month International Volunteering Opportunity in Krosno | EUROPEAN UNION ONLY
projects.description:
Join us at BWA in Krosno, a charming town in Podkarpacie, for a 2-month international volunteering project bringing together 6 people from different countries. Together, we will work on creative, cultural, promotional and organisational tasks. The project is a chance to gain practical experience in teamwork, communication, event organisation and intercultural cooperation.The activity dates are fixed: 02.09.2026–30.10.2026. Participants must arrive on 01.09.2026 and leave on 31.10.2026. These dates are not negotiable.Staying in Poland a few days before and/or after the project may be possible only at the participant’s own cost. Apply as soon as possible. Recruitment is ongoing and places may be filled before the official deadline. 

You can find all the necessary information in the infopack ->INFOPACK

projects.title: EUROPAMOBIL 2026
projects.description:
Europamobil offers an exciting European experience for pupils and students. Each year, a group of 20 students from different European states visits several schools in a selected region to run workshops on European issues - this year in the land of Brandenburg in Germany. Europamobil aims to enhance commitment to and interest in European affairs by making Europe concrete. Europamobil informs pupils about concrete mobility opportunities within Europe. Through their cooperation in the context of Europamobil, students and pupils get to know their neighbouring countries and their people better. It is a way to increase their commitment to European issues and to create critical enthusiasm for the European idea. 
To apply, send the application form, a letter of motivation (approx. 1 page) and CV to bastos@stiftung-genshagen.de. For further info, check out our website: https://www.stiftung-genshagen.de/veranstaltungen/veranstaltungen-2026/ed/europamobil/ 

Applications only via Email!!!

projects.title: GREENBEATS – 12 Months Volunteering in Germany
projects.description:
Spend up to 12 months volunteering at CAIA academy in Lebensgarten Steyerberg, one of Germany’s oldest eco-villages and intentional communities. Surrounded by forests and nature, you will become part of a diverse community where sustainability, cooperation, and personal growth are part of everyday life.

As a volunteer, you will support the daily activities of our non-profit educational center. Tasks may include helping in the kitchen, preparing meals, supporting community events, maintaining shared spaces, and contributing to ecological and renovation projects. You will work alongside local and international community members while gaining practical skills and valuable intercultural experience.

This project is ideal for open-minded people who enjoy nature, community life, and learning through hands-on experience. Beyond volunteering, you will have opportunities to develop personally, improve your language skills, and experience a unique way of living together.

projects.title: Volunteering in Farm L'Arca
projects.description:
!Currently looking for 2 volunteer!
Fattoria l’Arca is a certified organic farm located in the South of Italy. It offers a retreat for guests looking to reconnect with nature and local products cultivated organically. L’Arca is looking for volunteers to be involved in farming activities. 
In this volunteering opportunity the project activities will include: organic gardening, cleaning areas of the animals, harvesting, support in the activities of the farmhouse, help in the kitchen with products from the garden and more!
Volunteers will carry out activities for 5 days per week with Wednesdays and Saturdays off and the beginning of activities is early in the morning starting from 6 am.
The duration of the project is 6 months starting from July 2026.

projects.title: Become a Short-Term ESC Volunteer for 2 Months!
projects.description: Are you ready for an unforgettable 2-month volunteering adventure? ✨ Within the scope of this program, you will take part in activities related to sports, arts, education, environment, healthy lifestyles, and disaster awareness. You will gain new skills, meet people from different cultures, and have the opportunity to contribute to the community while developing yourself personally and professionally. To learn more about our activities, don’t forget to visit our website and follow us on social media: 🌐 sorged.org 📸 @sorged Come and be part of this unique volunteering experience. We are waiting for you! 💙

projects.title: Short-Term Project-,,Volunteering For a Better World"
projects.description: Our ESC volunteering for a better world project aims to improve the area where we live, bring people closer together, increase civic engagement and combat discrimination and racism. Our activities will focus on painting the walls of schools where children from disadvantaged backgrounds learn, setting up greenhouses that will be transformed into places for gardening workshops, greening campaigns, non-formal education for children from disadvantaged areas and providing help at various public events. We will have a group of at least 20 volunteers, to which will be added the 10 long-term volunteers who are already here for a year. Local transportation is provided by the host organization in collaboration with municipality of Resita and volunteers will receive bus and tram ticket passes, to get to the locations where we will work. For the locations outside the city, transportation is provided by the host organization, with its own vehicles.

projects.title: YRIC II - Supporting the work of Youth & Refugee Integration Center
projects.description:
In 2023, we launched the YRIC project, bringing together young volunteers from Poland, Ukraine, Germany, Hungary, and France to renovate an old building in Rabka-Zdrój, Poland. This building has since been transformed into the Polish-Ukrainian Youth and Refugee Integration Center, named Kefirek. Ever since that project, the Center has been operating sucessfully, and it is attended by Polish and Ukrainian young people alike.

Our goal is to create a space where both Polish and Ukrainian youth can come together, share experiences, and engage in activities that foster personal growth and mutual understanding. Through non-formal learning, cultural exchange, psychological aid and community-driven initiatives, we aim to help young people build skills and resilience. We are also focused on professionalizing efforts around integration and addressing the specific needs of the local community. You can find more information in the infopack on this link: https://shorturl.at/labSO

projects.title: "Volunteering Connecting People" Long Term Volunteering Boarding School Ganshoren
projects.description: "Volunteering, connecting people" is a European Solidarity Corps project which will take place in DB Ganshoren, a residential educational youth centre close to Brussels. Next to residential care, you will also be involved in youth work, accompanying staff with different projects supporting the development of young people and children. Since belonging to the Brussels Region, the language of the service will be mainly in French, with the organisation and coordinator you will communicate in English. More specifically, the tasks of the volunteers will consist of: - Building a relationship with the children and youth living at the boarding school DB Ganshoren. - Organize cultural, sportive and educational activities for children and youth. - Support the oratory and youth center staff during their activities in the holidays and some saturdays. - Be a role model for children and youngsters that will live in the same facilities as the volunteers.

projects.title: Digital Empowerment Trainer
projects.description: The role introduces digital empowerment as a key innovation, tackling the digital divide in Uganda. By equipping youth workers and local communities with digital skills and creative tools, the project fosters innovation, productivity, and socio-economic transformation, especially in underserved areas. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Facilitate knowledge-building and sharing among UPA staff members on digital skills and communication; Conduct training sessions on digital communication and marketing strategies for UPA members, focusing on social media platforms; Assist in managing and upgrading UPA’s digital platforms; Design a training plan, identify beneficiaries, and find ways to implement the plan among UPA members and partners; Build capacity by conducting ICT training sessions for UPA staff and other local partner organizations/projects (including schools and other Community-Based Organizations); Conduct monitoring and evaluation activities before and after the trainings.

projects.title: Inclusive Education & Care Volunteer
projects.description: The care and support role for children with special needs challenges traditional stigma and neglect. It introduces inclusive practices that empower families, promote dignity, and influence systemic changes in service delivery and infrastructure. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Support the project team in the daily care and support of children at the center; Assist children in developing basic life skills, such as hygiene and station skills; Provide basic lessons focused on Early Childhood Development (ECD) and understanding; Collaborate with the team in providing various therapies to children; Conduct community visits to offer rehabilitation and support to parents/guardians; Identify and develop children's talents through games and sports activities; Liaise with other centers to promote the rights of children with disabilities; Assist in conducting basic research to promote inclusion.

projects.title: Education & Teacher Development Volunteer
projects.description: The community school support volunteer introduces progressive, learner-centered methods in education, enhancing teacher capacity and fostering intercultural understanding. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Assist in classroom activities, providing direct support to learners and ensuring effective instructional delivery; Support the planning and facilitation of co-curricular activities to promote holistic student development; Enhance the pedagogical skills of the teaching team through training and professional development opportunities; Assist in delivering computer and digital literacy lessons to staff and learners, promoting the use of technology in education; Contribute to strategies that aim to improve student academic performance through targeted support and instructional methods; Assist in initiatives to increase school enrolment by promoting educational programs and engaging with prospective students; Involving parents and caregivers in the learning process.

projects.title: Project Assistant
projects.description: The Project Assistant will contribute to initiatives that promote social inclusion and dignity for vulnerable groups, including homeless people, ethnic minorities, and care leavers. The work focuses on building economic, social, and educational capacities within communities, challenging harmful stereotypes, and raising awareness of equal rights and opportunities. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Support the project manager with communication, timeline, and deliverable management; Handle administrative tasks such as data classification, entry, and archiving; Draft documents and gather necessary information; Coordinate and prepare for meetings, workshops, and training sessions; Notify staff about meeting schedules and locations; Organize meetings and send agendas; Update project logs with assignment progress; Assist in project implementation assessments and status reviews; Support proposal writing (research, needs assessment, data analysis); Participate in field visits.

projects.title: Community Center Coordinator
projects.description: The Community Center Coordinator will be responsible for assisting the manager in overseeing and coordinating all aspects of the activities and services provided at the community center, with a particular focus on vulnerable groups such as children, youth, ethnic minorities, and other marginalized and vulnerable people. The coordinator will ensure that all initiatives are inclusive, sensitive to the needs of these groups, and designed to foster empowerment and social integration. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Coordinate activities and volunteers at the Community Center; Collaborate with partners and stakeholders on programs; Communicate services and programs to the local community; Refer service users to relevant services; Gather feedback from participants on program quality and needs; Present the Community Center’s work to interested parties; Maintain records of programs, events, and supporting documentation; Ensure safety, hygiene, and necessary materials for center operations.

projects.title: Media & Communication Assistant
projects.description: Merhamet Sandžak is a Muslim humanitarian organization based in Novi Pazar, Serbia, providing social and humanitarian support to vulnerable individuals and families in the region. The Communications & Medi Volunteer will support the organization's visibility and public engagement through strategic communication across multiple platforms. The role combines content creation, social media management, photo and video documentation, and campaign analysis to strengthen public awareness and trust in the organization's humanitarian and development mission. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Develop and implement communication strategies, including message crafting and channel selection; Manage social media channels by creating content, posting updates, engaging with followers, and maintaining brand consistency; Capture photo and video materials documenting the organization's activities and events for communication purposes; Track and analyze PR campaign results, adjust strategies as needed.

projects.title: Social Program Assistant
projects.description: Merhamet Sandžak is a Muslim humanitarian organization based in Novi Pazar, Serbia, providing social and humanitarian support to vulnerable individuals and families in the Sandžak region. The Social Program Assistant will support the planning and implementation of social inclusion initiatives for vulnerable individuals and families. The role combines direct program support, community outreach, and educational activities to strengthen the organization's social interventions and promote long-term empowerment. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Assist in project planning, proposal writing, and partnership building within the Social Program department; Plan and facilitate educational activities for at-risk youth and families; Conduct outreach to identify vulnerable groups and encourage participation in available services; Represent the organization at trainings, seminars, and workshops; Provide humanitarian and administrative support.

projects.title: Entrepreneurship Trainer
projects.description: The Entrepreneurship Trainer will support the economic empowerment of internally displaced youth and women by delivering practical training in business planning, financial literacy, and small enterprise development. The role aims to build participants' capacity to launch and sustain their own ventures, promoting self-employment, women's empowerment, and long-term community resilience. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Design and facilitate training sessions on entrepreneurship, business planning, and financial management; Provide guidance on developing viable business ideas and accessing microfinance or grants; Support participants in drafting and refining basic business plans; Encourage women and youth to take active roles in small-scale enterprises; Monitor progress and report on key indicators; Promote sustainable, community-based entrepreneurship models tailored to local realities.

projects.title: Little Kids, Big Horizons: Share Your Culture at a French School
projects.description:
Imagine being "Europe" in the eyes of a 5-year-old! In Saint-Georges-du-Bois, you'll join the heart of village life — its school, after-school care and cultural space — to open children's eyes to European culture, starting with yours.
You'll work on two main sites: the Trompe-Souris school group (nursery and elementary schools, school restaurant and after-school reception) and the municipal cultural space. Games, stories, songs, traditions from home... every activity you bring is geared towards cultural openness, solidarity and mutual aid. For these kids, you might be their very first encounter with another European culture — and that's a memory that lasts. Your presence widens their world, one playtime at a time.

projects.title: Make Europe Real: Inspire Teens in a Rural French School
projects.description: For 10 years, European volunteers have been shaking up daily life at our rural school — and now it's your turn! Your mission: bring Europe to life for our students, inside the classroom and beyond. Share your country and culture, invite fellow volunteers from across Europe into the school, and turn "abroad" from something scary into something exciting.You'll play a key role for our two final-year classes preparing for their 3-week Erasmus+ internship abroad: your own experience, stories and tips will help them leave with confidence — you'll even introduce them to the language and culture of their future host country. Day to day, you'll share our students' lives, building real bonds of trust through fun and educational activities created with the team. You won't just talk about mobility: you'll embody it.

projects.title: Supporting Youth work and Youth centers development in Krakow, Poland
projects.description: The role of the volunteers will be to organize, help with the organization and improve the quality of life in Europe4Youth Central office and Youth centers. With a daily routine that will include working as a team of 6 volunteers in our central office in Krakow and taking care of the daily shifts in our youth centers supported by the coordinators of E4Y, the volunteers will organize, lead and experience activities and events related to the world of Youth working in all it’s shapes. The events mentioned above will be of different nature, based on the volunteers' interests and passions, and organized accordingly to needs. From language classes to art events, from Board games to Sports, as long as the educational part related to Youth info will be there, the volunteers will be able to express them self as they prefer.  The volunteer will also take part in the international work of the organization taking place in the International and education center of Europe4YOuth in Rabka-Zdroj

projects.title: Youth Work in the French Countryside
projects.description:
Want to make a real difference in young people's lives — and grow along the way? Our youth centre in the heart of rural France is looking for a European volunteer to join the team. Welcoming you pushes us to question and evolve our practices, and gives local teenagers a living example of what European mobility can be — something they can dream of for themselves once they turn 18.
You won't be "extra help": you'll be a trusted adult by their side, sharing your passions — culture, arts, sports, environment, science... whatever drives you. Our youth sector supports young people's own projects, builds their confidence and empowers them to act. Your energy, your story and your skills will feed directly into that mission.

projects.title: ESC in ITALY at "Casa Colonica" with people with disabilities
projects.description:
The role of the volunteer will always be of support for the professional staff in order to understand the behaviour and attitudes of the 12 people with disability hosted in the house. He/she will help the social workers in recreational and educational group activities and in general in every aspect of everyday life. 
In particular his/her tasks will be:
-support the people with disability in knowing the neighbourhood, the local resources and the community where they live,
- organization of moments aimed at developing interpersonal skills with people with disability; 
- care activities for people with disability
-organization of leisure moments aimed at developing guests and volunteers personal hobbies;
- collaboration in planning socializing moments.

projects.title: Beyond the Village: Bring Europe to Young People in Sarthe
projects.description:
What if your year abroad could open doors — for you, and for an entire generation of rural French kids? By joining us, you become living proof for children and teenagers here that the world doesn't stop at the village limits: that culture, studies and opportunities are within their reach too.
For you, it's a one-of-a-kind adventure: dive into another culture, build a European network, and feel genuinely useful every single day. For us, your presence brings European citizenship to life — adding a linguistic twist to our projects and turning everyday activities into real intercultural encounters. You inspire them, they inspire you: that's the deal.

projects.title: ESC opportunities in Youth Office
projects.description: The volunteer will participate in the activities of the Consorzio Solidarietà Sociale (an organisation that works with several social cooperatives), in the field of Media&communication/Youth information, working at the department that manages the ESC. Tasks: -work at the office(preparing documents,copies, sending mails,etc) -keep on FB and IG page & blog dedicated to ESC(news,articles,opportunities,events,etc.). -supporting the organization of events with the goal of create moments of intercultural confront but also to promote the subject of solidarity and active citizenship; - support on the communication with the volunteers abroad and the young people interested on ESC or “Servizio Civile”(a type of italian Volunteering Service); -preparation of promotional or informative material about the activities of the Consorzio,etc.

projects.title: Communication, Social Media & Fundraising Officer
projects.description: The Communication, Social Media & Fundraising Officer will strengthen the visibility and financial sustainability of civil society organizations supporting IDP communities. The role combines strategic content creation, social media management, and fundraising initiatives to amplify the voices of displaced populations and secure support for ongoing programs. // RESPONSIBILITIES: Develop and implement communication strategies aligned with the organization's mission and goals; Manage social media platforms to grow audience engagement and reach; Create compelling content highlighting the organization's work and the needs of IDP communities; Organize and promote fundraising campaigns and explore alternative funding sources; Expand digital outreach tools such as newsletters and press materials; Monitor and report on performance metrics to inform ongoing strategy.

projects.title: Let's ESC in Ca' Rossa: housing community for people with mental healt issues!
projects.description:
This voluntary activity will be held in the “Ca' Rossa” (Red House), a residential house where about 12 people between 18 and 65 years old live. The users have mental health issues and/or intellective disability, with mainly rehabilitative needs and no need for continuous health care.
The living environment fosters individual and social emancipation processes and the personal independence of the guests who are invited to develop their hobbies and abilities and express specific needs. The volunteer will be involved in the every day activities connected to the autonomy of the users in daily life, recreactional activities and creative workshops.

projects.title: Digital Skills Instructor
projects.description:
The Digital Skills Instructor will empower internally displaced youth by building their digital competencies and improving their employability. Through hands-on training in tools such as MS Office, cybersecurity, content creation, and social media marketing, the instructor will equip participants with practical skills relevant to local and international job markets, while fostering peer-to-peer knowledge sharing within the community.
// RESPONSIBILITIES: Design and deliver practical digital literacy training tailored to IDP youth; Facilitate workshops on MS Office, cybersecurity, and social media platforms; Support participants in developing individual or group digital projects; Encourage peer-to-peer knowledge sharing and mentoring; Monitor progress and report on key indicators; Adapt training content based on participant feedback and market needs.

projects.title: Therapeutic Play & Social Inclusion for Youth in Hanoi, Vietnam (CSDS)
projects.description:
The volunteer will work at the Vietnam Friendship Village, a sanctuary for youth and veterans affected by Agent Orange. The role balances therapeutic play with community integration.
Activities include:
· Deliver structured play, occupational, and physiotherapy sessions for youth with disabilities.
· Adapt physical exercises, games, and outdoor activities to individual abilities.
· Provide one-on-one support to foster motor, sensory, and social skills.
· Lead group workshops, creative events, and design simple visual/play materials.
· Engage residents in gardening and farming within the village once or twice a week.
· Document session notes and track progress where required.

Additionally, you can participate in non-formal education programs for local youth empowerment alongside other volunteers. We seek empathetic volunteers ready to bring joy and care to an exceptional community.

projects.title: EXPERYMENT SCIENCE CENTRE - LEARNING THROUGH FUN
projects.description: EXPERYMENT Science Centre is a modern scientific and educational playground for amateur explorers and the „learning through fun” philosophy followers of all ages. It is an educational institution popularizing science in the form of interactive installations and shows. Its goal is to combine science and fun, and to conduct activities that promote science. ESC volunteers are joining the educational projects team of the Centre. Their task is to support the educational activities in the field of science with actions and ideas.

projects.title: Media volunteer in youth organisation
projects.description: Our aim is to educate young people from Poland and the whole Europe by providing them non-formal local and international experience in learning by doing. We organize international youth meetings and trainings and work with local groups on their ideas within Erasmus+ Programme as well as support organizations involving ESC volunteers. Our ESC volunteer will act as an assistant to the coordinators of our activities, including especially support for the promotion. Thanks to that experience you can gain an experience in videos and photos making for social media, e.g. creating graphics, taking and processing photos, creating stories for social media or Youtube videos. While organizing the Erasmus+ activities, the ESC volunteer can also be involved in the project’s management process. To learn more about the project and the tasks, read the detailed information here: https://cwm.org.pl/wolontariat-miedzynarodowy/531

projects.title: Youth for a Better Future - October 2026
projects.description: “Youth for a Better Future” aims to foster social unity and well-being by promoting a sense of belonging within the local community and European space, advocating for equality, tolerance, and open-mindedness among its members, and encouraging youth active participation in decision-making at all levels. Volunteers will play a vital role in supporting our NGO and maintaining our youth space, “Horizons,” through a variety of daily activities. Tasks will include organizing non-formal education workshops, leading recreational activities, assisting facilitators with material preparation for youth programs, and supporting general logistics, space maintenance, gardening, and planting. NOTE: This volunteering opportunity is fully open to young people from Romania.

projects.title: ESCalade Volunteering Mountain 5: Summer edition
projects.description: Coop. soc. Kara Bobowski is looking for 2 volunteers to be hosted in Modigliana (Italy), to work in a residential center for PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES and in our SUMMER CAMPS. Our main aim is INCLUSION, and we host also young people with fewer opportunities. The volunteer will be part of a team of 4 long-term volunteers from different nationalities. In the residential center for people with disabilities there will be a team of 2 volunteers, working on the morning or afternoon shift, 5 days a week. The volunteers will support the staff with the daily activities like creativity, games, gardening, music, reading, walking, eating, cooking workshop, and so on. It will be giving the possibility to create new activities connected with the volunteer's interests or hobby.

projects.title: Youth for Diversity and Inclusion - October 2026
projects.description: „Youth for Diversity and Inclusion” aims to foster a tolerant community rooted in human rights, creating a space where all citizens treat each other with respect and enjoy equal opportunities. Volunteers will play a vital role in supporting our NGO and maintaining our youth space, “Horizons,” through a variety of daily activities. Tasks will include organizing non-formal education workshops, leading recreational activities, assisting facilitators with material preparation for youth programs, and supporting general logistics, space maintenance, gardening, and planting. NOTE: This volunteering opportunity is fully open to young people from Romania.

projects.title: Help Desk YOUth
projects.description: Help Desk YOUth aims to support youth for personal and professional development, especially in terms of career guidance and planning. Young people will be supported to prepare their CVs, motivation letters, identify opportunities,  to prepare for an interview, support to look for different youth programmes and apply. Volunteers will play a vital role in supporting our NGO and maintaining our youth space, “Horizons,” through a variety of daily activities. Tasks will include organizing thematic non-formal education workshops, leading recreational activities, assisting facilitators with material preparation for youth programs, and supporting general logistics, space maintenance, gardening, and planting. NOTE: This volunteering opportunity is fully open to young people from Romania.

projects.title: Baltic Sea Nõva Summer ESC Vol Team Estonia 27.7.-11.8.26
projects.description:
This team will take place in a picturesque little village of Nõva located on Baltic Sea seashore in the North-West of Estonia, 90 km from Tallinn. Host organisation EstYES has organised international youth camps together with the sport club Lukas Basket for many years in Nova. 
The main focus of the team will be on seashore cleaning on the mainland as well as on the small islands nearby. The volunteers will express solidarity with the local community and contribute to intergenerational co-operation and wellbeing by tidying up and doing some maintenance works is public areas as well as helping elderly people living in Nõva in some household and garden duties. To promote sustainability there will be info events and a workshop on waste management with ideas how to reduce, reuse, and recycle things instead of just throwing away.  Volunteers can share their ideas on sustainability and learn from practices in other countries and get to know more about the state of Baltic Sea from experts.

projects.title: Long-term ESC volunteering with social media in Fryshuset Stockholm
projects.description: We are looking for creative and motivated volunteers interested in communication and social media to join us at Fryshuset’s International Department. Your role will be key in expanding our digital presence and making sure our content reaches a diverse audience. Volunteer tasks include: • Managing and optimising our communication channels (Instagrams: @fryshusetyouthmobility, @fryshusetglobal , LinkedIn, Fryshuset newsletter and website) • Creating and posting engaging content, including photos, videos and articles about our events • Raising awareness about Fryshuset’s International Department projects and activities • Promoting EU mobility opportunities for youth through information points, outreach events, workshops, and communication campaigns. As a part of our team, you will be involved in the work of the International Department, contributing your ideas to strengthen Fryshuset’s social impact.

projects.title: On the Path to Solidarity - Brasilian Jiu Jitsu Week 2026
projects.description: This activity is a Volunteering Team created to support the implementation of a big sporting event that is happening in September, that has been gathering Jiu Jitsu enthusiasts in Sardinia for over 10 years, proposing seminars and competitions, and which has become a reference point for sport, tourism and for the promotion of healthy lifestyles and intercultural dialogue through this powerful tool. An event that in addition to promoting sport and the active and healthy lifestyle, carries on a discussion of mutual respect, intercultural dialogue, personal values ​​and global, and a closer look at the cultural sphere of sport. The volunteers will take service for 33 days and will cooperate in the preparation, implementation and evaluation of the event, supporting internal and external communication, logistics, dissemination, engagement of participants and facilitation of dedicated activities, besides its evaluation. More information about the event here: https://bjjsummerweek.com/

projects.title: Long-term in Terra Franca with HRYO - Palermo
projects.description: Terra Franca is a volunteering project within the ESC Programme, open to 2 young people aged 18 to 30. You’ll become part of our community project based in Terra Franca, a piece of land confiscated from the Mafia and given custody to our organisation by the Municipality of Palermo in order to restore the good to the community. As a volunteer, you’ll help keeping the space accessible through activities that varies from outdoor work and local projects, to community events events and creative activities. You’ll learn by doing and gain practical skills that can be useful for your future! As a volunteer, you will help take care of the land through hands-on activities such as maintenance, planting, cleaning, and eco-building, making sure the space stays welcoming and accessible for everyone. You will also support the organisation of events, workshops and activities linked to the different projects of the organization, and helping taking care of our bees.

projects.title: Volunteering For a Better World -SHORT TERM PROJECT
projects.description: Our ESC volunteering for a better world project aims to improve the area where we live, bring people closer together, increase civic engagement and combat discrimination and racism. Our activities will focus on painting the walls of schools where children from disadvantaged backgrounds learn, setting up greenhouses that will be transformed into places for gardening workshops, greening campaigns, non-formal education for children from disadvantaged areas and providing help at various public events. We will have a group of at least 20 volunteers, to which will be added the 10 long-term volunteers who are already here for a year. Local transportation is provided by the host organization in collaboration with municipality of Resita and volunteers will receive bus and tram ticket passes, to get to the locations where we will work. For the locations outside the city, transportation is provided by the host organization, with its own vehicles.

projects.title: CONCF-23704-ESC - SUPPORT NATURE IN THE SWAMP
projects.description:
Welcome to Bourges City! Elected European cultural capital for 2028, the city is planning on hosting several cultural events in the next 3 years. This international workcamp is one of them!
For this project, you will discover the swamps of the city and reveal the beauty of this landscape with cleaning around, rehabilitating a walking path and creating wood panels to give indications to the visitors.
If you like nature and believe in the importance of keeping the cities green, this project is for you!

projects.title: ESC Volunteering project in the Don Bosco Berufsschule in Würzburg
projects.description: The volunteer will support the language course with young refugees and migrants, as well as help in the profession orientations courses. Don Bosco is a school tasked with ensuring the participation of disadvantaged and/or disabled young people in vocations in and around Würzburg. Don Bosco Vocational School and Consultation Centre provides personalized services in vocational orientation, preparation, training and in the transition into employment by offering individualized support services and qualification possibilities. Volunteers will be introduced to the various possibilities at our institution. The main part of the tasks will be supporting the young refugees during the German language course as well as helping in the professional orientation class.

projects.title: Tools for connection - team of volunteers
projects.description: This volunteer project unites 12 European participants in a heritage restoration chantier in Côtes d'armor from July 28th to august 25th. Over three weeks, the group will work on restoring historic buildings, focusing on masonry work on an old wall, guided by a professional technical leader. The mission emphasizes the importance of preserving cultural and natural heritage through hands-on restoration. It also promotes ecological transition by encouraging volunteers to adopt sustainable practices, such as reducing air travel and supporting local consumption, fostering a more eco-responsible approach to collective life. The project values the strength of community life, emphasizing teamwork, shared experiences, and cultural exchange with local residents. Alongside work, volunteers will have time for regional exploration, enriching their understanding of local heritage and fostering meaningful connections within the group and the community.

projects.title: ESC in HOSTEL Monte Barro IN ENVIRONMENT EDUCATION in Italy
Volunteer in Milan in the youth center IRDA
projects.description:
Centro Irda is a vibrant youth center for children and teenagers, where they can join after-school activities, connect with friends, and get the support they need.
Volunteer activities include:
-Helping kids and teens with their homework so they can stay on track at school ✏️📚
-Assisting with workshops on music, radio, sports, art, and more 🎶🎨⚽
-Supporting educators in organizing sports activities 🤝
-Coming up with new ideas to engage the local community 💡🌟
-Sharing your volunteer experience and promoting European opportunities among young people 🌍✨
-Assisting with social media and writing blog posts 📱✍️
-Showcasing the center’s activities by taking photos

projects.title: Volunteering in Animal Care Shelter
projects.description: Porcikomodi project is part of the Vitadacani initiative, an animal welfare organisation active in the protection and care of animals in Italy. This project is an animal welfare initiative based in Magnago, Italy, dedicated to giving a second chance to animals in need. The project has two parts: a sanctuary for rescued farm animals and a dog shelter for dogs that require medical assistance and live with chronic health issues. The sanctuary welcomes animals that are usually considered food and have been rescued, freed, or saved from situations of exploitation and suffering. The project does not ask about the animals’ origins and does not maintain any economic relationship with those who exploit or trade animals as commod

projects.title: Ambassador of Europe
projects.description: The mission of the European Mobility Ambassador is to raise awareness and support young people in preparing and carrying out mobility projects in Europe, while helping them develop their self-confidence and English skills through fun workshops based on non-formal education. The target audience includes school pupils (middle school, high school and IUT in Lisieux), as well as young people from the Local Mission with fewer opportunities.

projects.title: R.I.S.E. Rural Inclusion and Social Engagement
projects.description: Project will have THREE main kind of activities: SOCIAL FARM:aimed at promoting disadvantaged people’s rehabilitation, care and/or the integration of people with ‘low contractual capacity’ (i.e.: psycho-physical disabilities, drug addicts, minors, emigrants). The special added value of social farming is the possibility for disadvantaged people to being integrated in a living context, where their personal potential may be valued and enhanced. DAILY CENTER WITH DISABLE PEOPLE The daily center is created for people with mental disability (children and adults). Every working day the volunteers have a chance to participate in man kinds of activity: manual art and do it yourself activities (make decorations, figures, painting etc.); recycling and kitchen workshop (participating in every step of preparing meals for the group, and getting to know even Italian cuisine better when cooking together MIGRATION CENTER activity with migrants adults and children in a daily center or houses.

projects.title: Living better together animating the social life: from EU to local level to boost rural development
projects.description: The Foyer Rural CEPAGE in a project incubator in a rural area focused on Culture, Economie, Heritage, Facilitation and Study Groups. It is an association, created in 1988, for local development in rural area, which offers a variety of cultural, social and training services to the population. Our organisation have 5 employees and several volunteers. The volunteers will be involved in the following activities : participation into the activities of the social center, participation in supporting people to acquire digital skills , participation in the activities to improve the well living ans social cohesion, organization of English workshop and digital workshop for the local community. Creation of a local newspaper. Supporting activities of communication of our Europe direct center.

projects.title: Youth for Solidarity, Active Citizenship & Green Skills
projects.description: Youth for Solidarity, Active Citizenship & Green Skills is a 6‑month ESC project hosted by Youth Dynamics, bringing together young volunteers to promote solidarity, inclusion, environmental awareness, and youth participation. Volunteers will support non‑formal education activities, eco‑workshops, community clean‑ups, digital campaigns, and initiatives that encourage active citizenship and intercultural dialogue. The project aims to empower young people to develop life skills, green competences, and a sense of social responsibility while engaging with diverse local communities. Through hands‑on action and creative outreach, volunteers will help combat stereotypes, promote equality, and inspire sustainable lifestyles. The experience offers a supportive environment where young people can learn, grow, and contribute to a greener, more inclusive society.

projects.title: Photographer, Videomaker, Social Media and Content Creator
projects.description:
The activity offers learning experience for someone interested in arts, culture and youth work. The participant is welcome to contribute to daily operation and in-house duties of the cultural centre, event management, technical production or realisation of artistic projects and thematic events. Selection of activities:
- marketing, social media, production & promotion of content and events
- graphic design, website, ticketing
- documentation, photography, video making, writing blogs, interviews
- production of cultural/community events,
- park keeping, gardening

projects.title: Light and Sound Designer at cultural centre
projects.description: The project offers learning experience for someone interested in arts, culture and youth work. The participant is free to contribute to its daily operation and in-house duties, event management, technical production or initiate artistic projects and thematic events on their own. The organisation is located in the historical centre of Banská Bystrica and has a venue for concerts, performances, discussions, workshops and festivals. Training and Learning activities include: preparation and technical practice in cultural and community event management - venue maintenance, mundane repair works - sound engineering, light design – theatre, dance, concerts, installations - park keeping, gardening

projects.title: Technician and/or Gardener at cultural centre
projects.description: The project offers learning experience for someone interested in arts, culture and youth work. In the Záhrada cultural centre, the volunteer can contribute to its daily operation and in-house duties, event management, technical production or initiate artistic projects and thematic events on their own. Learning and Training activities in the field of technical preparation and realisation of cultural and community events - venue maintenance, mundane repair works - sound engineering, light design – theatre, dance, concerts, installations - park keeping, gardening.

projects.title: Volunteering for the environmental education of youth 2026
projects.description:
Within the ESC voluntary program, we are looking for 1 young people for a long-term, 2-month period (June-August 2026), who can participate in the nature conservation programs and environmental education of our association at the bases of the Green Circle in north-eastern Hungary - in Bodrogolaszi, Sárospatak and Bodrogkeresztúr settlements. Activities expectes of the volunteers are the following:
o assisting in the management of exhibitions related to nature conservation (in the role of animator and babysitter)
o assisting in nature classes (in the role of animator and babysitter, preparation of photo documentation)
o maintenance of educational trails, minor renovation works
o supervision and handing over of hiking equipment (kayak, canoe, bicycle) to hikers
o participation in events, helping in summer camps
o gardening
o participation in the daily community life of Bodrogolaszi

projects.title: Soften Our Steps
projects.description: The activities will take place in "Eko centar Latinovac" in a small village in Croatia. We will host 11 participants to work on sustainable and rural development, community building, promotion of volunteerism and multiculturalism. During this period we will focus on organization of activities at local events. This will include preparing and participating in the activities for local community. Besides that participants will help in the maintenance of our property, gardening, helping in the kitchen, helping people in the local community and renovating old school in the village. Participants will experience living and working in a community, rural lifestyle, sustainable practices, vegetarian cuisine and a lifestyle less affected by global challenges. Working time is 6 hours per day, 5 days per week, although the schedule can change depending on the weather.

projects.title: Soutenir la Croix Rouge Portugaise
projects.description:
/!\ Pour postuler à cette offre, veuillez fournir un CV en anglais /!\

La branche locale de Oliveira de Azeméis fait partie de la Croix-Rouge portugaise et du Mouvement international de la Croix-Rouge et du Croissant-Rouge. L'antenne opère en fonction des besoins de la communauté d’Oliveira de Azeméis. L'organisation offre de nombreux services dans trois domaines principaux : le secteur social ; premiers secours ; jeunessse et volontariat.

Nous recherchons 1 volontaire pour cettemission qui consistera à : apporter un soutien à un centre pour personnes en situation de handicap et/ou une maison de retraite ; animer des activités pour des enfants dans des écoles ; animer des activités dans un centre pour jeunes en difficulté : aider pour les devoirs, jardinage et ateliers de développement durable, cours
d’anglais ; participer aux banques alimentaires ; participer aux cleanwalks organisées par la Croix-Rouge ; création de contenu pour les réseaux sociaux.

projects.title: VOLUNTEERING IN MALAGA 11 MONTHS_START IN SEPTEMBER'26
projects.description: The Association IMAGINA is looking for 4 ESC volunteer from EU COUNTRIES motivated to work in Imagina association supporting different activities designed to promote youth work in a rural area (promoting European mobility, learning opportunities and activities based on non-formal education); inclusion of people with disabilities and promotion through Digital Marketing. This projects will focus on youth dynamization with different goals and target groups.

projects.title: A Two Way Journey
projects.description: LAST MINUTE SEARCH FOR 1 VOLUNTEER: A Two-Way Journey is a high-priority, two-month volunteer project based in Ankara, Türkiye, focused on promoting the sustainable socio-economic integration of Ukrainian refugees. With a significant proportion of the refugee population consisting of women and children, many of whom face serious integration challenges, this initiative aims to address urgent social needs while fostering community cohesion and resilience. The project will be implemented in the following days: From 29/06/2026 to 26/08/2026 (28 June and 27 August being the travel days).

projects.title: PASSAGE summer Camp 2026
projects.description: For two-weeks, 21/7 - 3/8 2026 the PASSAGE Festival will host a group of approx 15 YA, doing volunteer tasks for the street theatre festival: PASSAGE Festival. The festival takes place in and around Helsingør, Denmark, 27/7 - 1/8 2026. During the first week of the camp the YA will participate in group activities, preparations for the festival and work together on an artistic concept, which will be shown / exhibited at the festival. During the second week the participants will assist in solving volunteer task in connection to the festival: way finding, preparing sites, communication and documentation, handling audience, ticketing, preparing backstage and food etc. The tasks will be handled in accordance with the individual capability and interest, so everyone feels both comfortable and suitably challenged. The group dynamic and well-being of everyone is at focus at all times.

projects.title: ESC Volunteering: Connect, Inspire, Act- Youth Work at IZUM Youth Club in Tallinn, Estonia
projects.description: IZUM Youth Club is a dynamic mobile youth learning and development Center that has been actively engaged in Tallinn, Estonia since 1994. Our mission revolves around fostering non-formal education opportunities for youth aged eleven and above, both locally and internationally. We offer a diverse array of activities aimed at self-development, encompassing various aspects of youth culture such as theater, music, dance, and art. This project presents an invaluable opportunity for volunteers to immerse themselves in the areas of youth work, directly engaging with youth within our organization. Volunteers will have direct interaction with the local minority community, enabling them to make a tangible impact. MORE INFORMATION AND HOW TO APPLY: https://estyes.ee/en/projects/youth-club-active-in-tallinn/

projects.title: Hosting in diversity
projects.description:
Le programme de bénévolat CES à l’antenne de Saint Nazaire vise à promouvoir la citoyenneté active, l’engagement des jeunes et la solidarité internationale. Il met l'accent sur la promotion de la mobilité, de l'éducation interculturelle. Les bénévoles participeront aux activités d’accueil à l’auberge du Poulpe, aux actions  de loisirs et de sensibilisations interculturelles auprès du public enfant, ils participeront aux activités de promotion de la mobilité internationale. 
 Les principales activités comprennent: • Accueil des voyageurs dans notre auberge de jeunesse • Participer aux temps d’animation auprès des enfants sur le terrains d'aventure • Participation à des chantiers de jeunes• Témoignages lors des événements sur la mobilité.

projects.title: More than just a school
projects.description: The Gdynia Social School is the primary school run by the association. The Social School is run by the association to introduce alternative methods of education. It focuses on working with kids also with special needs e.g. children with sight impairment, autism and other disorders or health problems. It is a small institution for 160 pupils 6-15 years old. We work in small groups of max 20 pupils. You will work in a group of 3 volunteers from different countries under the supervision of the school’s pedagogist. You will create integration and energizing games for kids, organize workshops, help teachers during the classes, work with kids with special needs, organize charity events, teach languages etc. All depend on your skills and interests!

projects.title: Volunteering in the Waldorf School of Pécs, Hungary
projects.description:
Mandulafa Waldorf school is a small primary school with about 150 children in eight classes. The
school building is situated in a valley in the outskirts of the city, with lots of nature around, and a good opportunity to explore the nearby hills and forests. Waldorf is a well-known system of alternative education, characterised by the love of nature and arts, a cooperative rather than competitive atmosphere, educational focus on the individual child in a supporting community, balanced development of intellectual, emotional and physical capacities. Children in the school learn two foreign languages: English and Spanish. The volunteers presence encourages the pupils to practice their English and Spanish in different everyday situations, as well as to get experience with people from other cultures. The main task is to be part of the school's everyday life, take part in language and some other classes, excursions, afternoon activities, festivals and talking and playing with the children-

projects.title: Volunteer in Milan in the youth center QR52
projects.description: We are looking for a volunteer to join QR52 youth center in Milan, where local teenagers (13–18 years old) gather after school to socialize, learn, and grow in a safe and welcoming environment. As a volunteer, you’ll support and inspire young people through a variety of engaging activities: help teens with their homework and study support; assist in creative workshops on topics like citizenship, music, and art; help educators organize sports and recreational activities; propose and develop new ideas to involve the local community; share your ESC experience and promote European opportunities; accompany groups on summer camps, trips, and holidays.

projects.title: International Volunteering with the NGO IBO in Ferrara, Italy
projects.description:
Join IBO, a non-profit organisation based in Ferrara, Italy, working to make education accessible to everyone, especially children and young people facing fewer opportunities. Through volunteering, international cooperation, and educational projects, we support communities in Italy and around the world, including Africa, Latin America and Asia. As an international volunteer, you will become part of our team and gain hands-on experience in a multicultural environment. Your activities may include:
-Helping organise events and awareness campaigns
-Organising workshops in schools and community spaces
-Creating communication contents (social media, texts, visuals)
-Supporting solidarity workcamps
-Assisting with project management and communication with international partners and volunteers
This is a great opportunity to develop new skills, meet people from different cultures, and contribute to meaningful social projects. Apply to receive our detailed infosheet and learn more!

projects.title: EPVP - Eastern Partnership Volunteering Program 6.2®️
projects.description:
We are looking for 6 volunteers in Bucharest, Romania for 6 months (July - December 2026) as part of the European Solidarity Corps. You'll be actively organising 6 monthly awareness campaigns on topics you actually care about (Solidarity, Active citizenship and Tolerance), and leading two Erasmus+ training courses.

You'll meet people from across European Union and the Eastern Partnership, work in a multicultural team, and leave with skills you can't learn in a classroom. 📋 Download the application form here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dE2Hw8ii2lyTXjOuutjBKmk04JmH-V6O Fill it in (no AI tools, please!) and send it back to us at epvp6.2@gmail.com before 21st June 2026.
